en.name: Aphotic Shield
en.desc:
Summons dark energies around an ally unit, dispelling them and creating an all damage barrier that absorbs a set amount of damage before expiring. When the barrier is destroyed it will burst and deal damage equal to the amount it could absorb to an area around it.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: The max damage is always dealt whether the barrier is destroyed by expiring or absorbing damage.
The explosion does not damage units hidden by the fog of war.
en.shard: 75% of absorbed damage is dealt to nearby enemies.

zh.name: 无光之盾
zh.desc:
召唤黑暗能量环绕友方单位，驱散他们并创造一个全伤害护盾，护盾在消失前能吸收一定量的伤害。护盾消失或被摧毁后将会爆炸，对附近区域的单位造成伤害，伤害值为护盾的最大吸收量。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes: 不论护盾因持续时间结束或吸收足够伤害后被摧毁都将造成最大伤害。
爆炸将不会对战争迷雾内单位造成伤害。
zh.shard: 会对附近敌人造成吸收伤害的75%。

en.name: Borrowed Time
en.desc:
When activated, dispels you and all damage dealt to you will heal instead of harm. If the ability is not on cooldown, it will automatically activate if your health falls below 400.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Borrowed Time can be manually activated while Abaddon is disabled, but not while silenced.  The passive activation can still occur while silenced.
Aphotic Shield does not block any damage to Abaddon when Borrowed Time is active, allowing him to heal.
Break prevents Borrowed Time from automatically activating.
en.scepter: Increases duration. While Borrowed Time is active, anytime an ally takes more than 550 damage while within Mist Coil's cast range of Abaddon, an individual Mist Coil will automatically fire towards that ally.

zh.name: 回光返照
zh.desc:
启动后驱散自身，所有受到的伤害转而产生治疗效果。只要技能不在冷却中，在生命值低于400点时技能会自动启动。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes: 在亚巴顿受到眩晕作用时依然可以手动开启回光返照，但是受到沉默作用时不可以。不过被沉默时被动效果依然能生效。
无光之盾在回光返照生效期间不会吸收伤害，因此也不会影响治疗效果。
破坏会使回光返照无法自动触发。
zh.scepter: 提升持续时间。启动回光返照后，亚巴顿附近迷雾缠绕的施法距离内友方英雄受到的伤害超过550点时亚巴顿就会自动对其施放迷雾缠绕。

en.name: Mist Coil
en.desc: Abaddon releases a coil of deathly mist that can damage an enemy unit or heal a friendly unit at the cost of some of Abaddon's health.
notes: Abaddon can not kill himself with this skill.

zh.name: 迷雾缠绕
zh.desc: 亚巴顿以自身的部分生命为代价，释放出一团致命迷雾，可以对敌方单位造成伤害，或者治疗友方单位。
notes: 亚巴顿不能使用此技能自杀。

en.name: Curse of Avernus
en.desc: Abaddon strikes an enemy, affecting them by a chilling curse, slowing them, causing them to take damage over time, and all attacks against them gain an attack speed boost. Damage over time component to buildings is reduced by 100%.

zh.name: 魔霭诅咒
zh.desc: 亚巴顿打击一个敌人，使其受到寒心诅咒的作用，被减速，并且持续受到伤害，同时所有攻击目标的单位将提升攻击速度。对建筑的持续伤害减少100%。

en.name: Withering Mist
en.desc: Damaging enemies applies the Withering Mist debuff for 5s. Affected enemies have their Health Restoration reduced by 29.5% if they are below 40% HP.

zh.name: 凋零迷雾
zh.desc: 对敌人造成伤害时会施加凋零迷雾的负面效果，持续5秒。受作用敌人如果血量低于40%，那么生命回复会降低29.5%。

en.name: Archer Aura
en.desc: Increases movement of nearby units.

zh.name: 射手光环
zh.desc: 提升周围单位的移动速度。

en.name: Last Will
en.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

zh.name: 遗愿
zh.desc: 对杀死死灵战士的单位造成伤害。

en.name: Mana Break
en.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

zh.name: 法力损毁
zh.desc: 每次攻击燃烧掉目标的魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害

en.name: Abyssal Horde
en.desc:
After teleporting through the Fiend's Gate, Underlord brings forth a Warrior or an Archer to aid him every 2s that last for the duration of the Fiend's Gate.

The Warrior burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it. The Archer has a passive movement speed aura.

zh.name: 深渊大军
zh.desc:
穿过恶魔之扉后，在恶魔之扉持续时间内每2秒孽主就会召唤一个战士或一个射手来援助他。

战士每次攻击都会燃烧魔法，并且对击杀它的单位造成魔法伤害。射手拥有被动移速光环。

en.name: Atrophy Aura
en.desc: Nearby enemy units are weakened, losing a portion of their base damage. If an enemy dies while under this effect, Underlord gains temporary bonus damage.
notes: Break disables the Attack Damage Reduction aura and prevents Underlord from gaining new bonus damage.

zh.name: 衰退光环
zh.desc: 周围所有敌方单位遭到了削弱，损失部分基础攻击力。如果敌方英雄在光环范围内死亡，孽主将获得临时的额外攻击力加成。
notes: 破坏会使攻击力降低光环失效，并且孽主无法获得新的额外攻击力。

en.name: Fiend's Gate
en.desc: Opens 2 portals, one next to Underlord and one in the target location. Heroes can channel a portal for 3.5 seconds to teleport to the other side. Portals have to be at least 1500 away from each other.
notes: Double-click to teleport to your team's base, in front of your fountain
en.scepter: Summons a Pit of Malice around each of the portals. Reduces cooldown.

zh.name: 恶魔之扉
zh.desc: 打开2个传送门，一个在孽主身旁，另一个在目标地点。英雄可以对一个传送门持续施法3.5秒，传送至另一端。传送门之间的距离必须超过1500。
notes: 双击会在己方基地的泉水前打开另一个传送门。
zh.scepter: 在传送门两端各召唤一个怨念深渊。减少冷却时间。

en.name: Firestorm
en.desc: Calls down waves of fire that damage enemy units in the target area, burning for additional damage over time.
en.shard: Firestorm can be allied targeted. When used that way, the Firestorm follows the hero around.  The wave count is increased, and tick rate / duration time occur more quickly.

zh.name: 火焰风暴
zh.desc: 召唤数波火焰风暴攻击目标区域内的所有单位，并额外持续造成烧灼伤害。
zh.shard: 火焰风暴可以对友军施放。施放后火焰风暴会跟随该英雄。火焰风暴的波数增加，伤害触发间隔/持续时间更短。
stats: 持续时间/伤害间隔减少：25%

en.name: Pit of Malice
en.desc: A deadly pit is conjured at the target location; any unit that enters will be damaged and rooted. Each enemy unit within the pit are affected by the root only every 3.6 seconds.

zh.name: 怨念深渊
zh.desc: 在目标区域制造致命的深渊；踏入深渊的敌方单位将受到伤害并且被缠绕。每个敌方单位每隔3.6秒才会再次受到作用。

en.name: Invading Force
en.desc: After an allied hero Teleports, they temporarily gain Damage Reduction and Movement Speed. Allies receive 2x bonuses if teleporting via Fiend's Gate.

zh.name: 侵略大军
zh.desc: 友方英雄传送后会临时获得承受伤害降低和移动速度加成。友军通过恶魔之扉传送后会获得2倍加成。

en.name: +250 Gold
en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.name: +250 金钱
zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.name: +250 Gold
en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.name: +250 金钱
zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.name: +750 Gold
en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.desc: Associated ability not drafted, have some gold!

zh.name: +1250 金钱
zh.desc: 未选择关联技能，拿点黄金吧！

en.name: Acid Spray
en.desc: Sprays high-pressure acid across a target area. Enemy units who step across the contaminated terrain take damage per second and have their armor reduced.

zh.name: 酸性喷雾
zh.desc: 向目标区域喷洒高压酸雾。穿过受污染地带的敌人每秒会受到物理伤害，同时护甲被削弱。

en.name: Berserk Potion
en.desc:
Alchemist throws a potion at an ally, applying a basic dispel and giving them attack speed, movement speed and HP regen.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 狂暴药剂
zh.desc:
炼金术士向友军目标扔出一瓶药剂，施加弱驱散效果，并提供攻击速度、移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Chemical Rage
en.desc:
Alchemist causes his Ogre to enter a chemically induced rage, reducing base attack cooldown and increasing movement speed and health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Has a 0.35 second transformation time, which can be used to dodge projectiles and stuns.

zh.name: 化学狂暴
zh.desc:
炼金术士诱发他的食人魔同伴进入化学狂暴，降低攻击间隔，提高移动速度和生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 拥有0.35秒的变身时间，可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道以及眩晕技能。

en.name: Corrosive Weaponry
en.desc:
Alchemist coats his weapons and empowers his spells with an acid that applies a stacking slow and base attack damage reduction to enemies hit.

Attacks apply 2 stacks. Unstable Concoction applies 1 stack per second of brew time.
stats: BASE ATTACK DAMAGE REDUCTION PER STACK: 2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4

zh.name: 腐蚀兵械
zh.desc:
炼金术士使他的武器浸满强酸，对击中的敌人施加可叠加的减速和基础攻击力降低效果。

每次攻击施加2层叠加效果。不稳定化合物每调制1秒施加1层叠加效果。
stats: 每层叠加降低基础攻击力：2.5 / 3 / 3.5 / 4%

en.name: Greevil's Greed
en.desc: Alchemist synthesizes additional gold from his enemies and bounty runes. With each kill, Alchemist earns base bonus gold and extra bonus gold. If Alchemist kills another unit which yields gold within the next 40 seconds, an additional instance of Extra Bonus Gold is added to the total. Additionally, causes bounty runes to yield more gold.
en.scepter: Alchemist melts down Aghanim's Scepter to grant an allied hero all Aghanim's Scepter upgrades. Alchemist will gain bonus 15 damage and 3 additional base and max Greevil's Greed Extra Gold for each melted Scepter.

zh.name: 贪魔的贪婪
zh.desc: 炼金术士将敌人的尸体和赏金神符转化成额外的金币。炼金术士每杀死一个单位，就能获得基础额外金钱和附加额外金钱。如果炼金术士在接下来40秒内又杀死了一个单位，获得了黄金，那么他所获得的附加额外金钱将有一定幅度的增加。另外，赏金神符将提供成倍金钱。
zh.scepter: 炼金术士熔铸阿哈利姆神杖并让一位友方英雄获得所有神杖升级效果。炼金术士每送出一把神杖都将获得15点攻击力加成，贪魔的贪婪的基础和最高金钱增加3。

en.name: Unstable Concoction
en.desc: Alchemist brews up an unstable concoction that he can throw at an enemy hero, to stun and deal damage in an area around the explosion. The longer the concoction brews, the more damage it deals and the longer the stun. Alchemist is faster while charging the concoction. After 5 seconds, the brew reaches its maximum damage and stun time. However, after 5.5 seconds, the concoction will explode on Alchemist himself if not thrown.
notes: While brewing, this ability is replaced by Unstable Concoction Throw.  Alchemist can move and act normally while brewing.
A timer above Alchemist's head will indicate the remaining brew time. This timer is visible to enemies.
You can deny yourself with this skill.
Unstable Concoction cannot be disjointed and once thrown Unstable Concoction stops brewing.
Unstable Concoction explosion damages heroes and creeps.

zh.name: 不稳定化合物
zh.desc: 炼金术士调制一瓶不稳定的化合物，投向敌方英雄，对爆炸点周边范围的单位造成伤害并眩晕。调制的时间越久，伤害越大，眩晕时间也越长。炼金术士在调制期间获得移动速度加成。调制5秒后达到最大伤害量和最长眩晕时间。然而，若5.5秒后未扔出药剂，则会在炼金术士自己手中爆炸。
notes: 摇制开始后，本技能替换为投掷不稳定化合物。炼金术士在摇制期间可以像平常一样移动和攻击。
炼金术士的头顶会有倒计时，提示剩余的摇制时间。倒计时对敌人可见。
可以用此技能将自己反补。
不稳定化合物无法被躲避，并且不稳定化合物被掷出后会停止调制。
不稳定化合物的爆炸会对英雄和非英雄单位造成伤害。

en.name: Unstable Concoction Throw
en.desc: Throw it before it blows up!

zh.name: 投掷不稳定化合物
zh.desc: 在爆炸前扔出去！

en.name: Packleader's Aura
en.desc: The Alpha Wolf's ruthless attacks do extra damage. His commanding presence inspires nearby allies to attack ruthlessly as well.

zh.name: 头狼光环
zh.desc: 头狼无情的攻击造成额外伤害。在他的带头指挥下，周围友军的攻击也同样残忍无情。

en.name: Critical Strike
en.desc: The cruel Alpha Wolf attacks his enemy's unprotected vitals at every opportunity, inflicting critical damage.

zh.name: 致命一击
zh.desc: 残忍的头狼抓住任何一个破绽攻击敌人的命脉，造成致命伤害。

en.name: Bone Chill
en.desc: When Ancient Apparition deals Magic damage to an enemy with his abilities, it is slowed for a short duration. If the target is a Hero, its Strength is also reduced. Multiple instances of this effect stack and have independent durations.
en.scepter: Increases Base Strength Reduction by 0.8.

zh.name: 刺骨严寒
zh.desc: 每当远古冰魄通过他的技能对敌人造成魔法伤害，敌人就会减速一段时间。如果目标是英雄，力量还会降低。多个本效果会叠加，并且持续时间相互独立。
zh.scepter: 基础力量降低提升0.8。

en.name: Chilling Touch
en.desc: Enhances Ancient Apparition's attack with increased range and a burst of magical damage and slow.
en.scepter: Removes cooldown.

zh.name: 极寒之触
zh.desc: 使自己的普通攻击附带距离提升，高额魔法伤害和减速效果。
zh.scepter: 移除了冷却时间。

en.name: Cold Feet
en.desc: Places a curse on an enemy, dealing damage over time.  If the enemy unit doesn't move outside of the given range from the initial location, it will be stunned and frozen in place after 4 seconds.
notes: Deals damage every half second.

zh.name: 寒霜之足
zh.desc: 对一个敌人施加诅咒，造成持续伤害。如果目标没有在4秒内远离初始地点走出足够距离，那么将被眩晕并冻在原地。
notes: 每0.5秒造成一次伤害。

en.name: Ice Blast
en.desc: Launches a tracer toward any location on the battlefield, which must be triggered again to mark the area to be blasted by a damaging explosion of hail. The further the tracer travels, the larger the explosion will be. Enemies caught in the explosion, or who touch the icy ball of hail as it travels, are Frostbitten, taking damage over time and prevented from regenerating or healing. If a Frostbitten unit's health drops below a certain percentage, they will instantly shatter.
notes: Upon cast, this ability is replaced by Release, used to stop the tracer on the target area.
The area of effect is 300 + 50*TimeTraveled, capped at 1000.
Kill will be granted to the source of the damage that triggers the shatter.
The shatter effect doesn't work on illusions.
The HP Freeze prevents most kinds of healing, including the fountain, except Sunder, Time Lapse and Supernova.
en.shard: Freezes enemies hit with the current level of Cold Feet for 50% of the duration.

zh.name: 冰晶爆轰
zh.desc: 向地图的任意位置发出爆炸冰球，在冰球飞行时再次施放此技能将使其停下，使所在区域产生毁灭性的冰爆。冰球飞行的距离越长，冰爆影响的范围也将越大。冰爆范围内的所有敌方单位将马上受到大量伤害，而处于冰球飞行路径上的敌方英雄将与冰爆范围内的敌方英雄一同受到寒霜诅咒的作用，持续受到小幅伤害，同时无法恢复生命值。在此期间如果生命值低于一定百分比，该英雄将立刻死亡。
notes: 施放后本技能替换为释放，将使指向球停在目标区域。
作用范围的大小是300 + 50*指向球的飞行时间，上限为1000。
击杀目标的英雄由触发即死的伤害来源决定。
斩杀效果对幻象无效。
寒霜诅咒的负面状态无法被驱散，包括身处泉水附近，但魂断、时光倒流和超新星除外。
zh.shard: 冻结击中的敌人，持续时间为当前等级寒霜之足眩晕时间的50%。

en.name: Release
en.desc: Releases the ice blast to explode at the tracer's current location. Can be cast while silenced.

zh.name: 释放
zh.desc: 在它当前的位置放出冰晶爆轰。被沉默时可以施放。

en.name: Ice Vortex
en.desc: Creates a vortex of icy energy that slows, deals damage, and increases magic damage done to enemies in its range.
notes: Provides vision in a small area where it is placed.

zh.name: 冰霜漩涡
zh.desc: 创造一个寒冰能量的漩涡，对范围内敌人造成伤害和减速，并增加他们受到的魔法伤害。
notes: 提供放置地点的小片视野。

en.name: Weakening Aura
en.desc: The Rock Golem's imposing figure makes enemies more susceptible to Physical Damage.

zh.name: 弱化光环
zh.desc: 岩石傀儡的形象富有压迫感，让敌人更难抵挡物理伤害。

en.name: Blink
en.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Anti-Mage to move in and out of combat.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
en.scepter: After casting Blink, your next Mana Break within 5s burns an additional 20% max mana and prevents the target from regenerating or gaining mana for a short duration. This debuff is undispellable.

zh.name: 闪烁
zh.desc: 短距离传送，能让敌法师自由出入战场。
notes: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
zh.scepter: 施放闪烁后，5秒内的法力损毁将额外燃烧20%最大魔法值，并且阻止目标在短时间内恢复或获得魔法。这个负面状态无法驱散。

en.name: Counterspell
en.desc: Passively grants magic resistance. Counterspell may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around Anti-Mage that blocks and reflects any targeted spells.
notes: Break disables the passive magic resistance.
en.shard: Creates a blinked fragment of Anti-Mage next to the enemy caster upon reflecting their unit-targeted spell while active.

zh.name: 法术反制
zh.desc: 被动提升魔法抗性。可以主动开启法术反制，创造一个环绕敌法师的反魔法外壳，抵挡和反弹所有指向性技能。
notes: 破坏会使被动魔法抗性失效。
zh.shard: 开启后反弹指向性技能时会在敌方施法者身边制造一个敌法师的闪烁碎片。

en.name: Counterspell Ally
en.desc: Counterspell Ally may be activated to create an anti-magic shell around an allied hero that blocks and reflects any targeted spells. Any time a spell is blocked by Counterspell or Counterspell Ally, an illusion of Anti-Mage will be created next to the enemy.

zh.name: 友军法术反制
zh.desc: 在附近一个友军目标周围制造一个反魔法外壳，抵挡并反弹所有指向性技能。法术反制或友军法术反制抵挡技能后，都会在敌人身旁产生一个敌法师的幻象。

en.name: Mana Break
en.desc: Burns an opponent's mana on each attack and deals damage equal to a percentage of the mana burnt.
notes: Mana Break has 25% mana burn effect if caused by illusions.
en.scepter: Increases Max Mana Burned per Hit.

zh.name: 法力损毁
zh.desc: 每次攻击损毁目标魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。
notes: 幻象继承法力损毁的燃烧魔法为25%。
zh.scepter: 提升每次攻击燃烧的最大魔法值。
stats: 每次攻击损毁最大魔法值：1.8 / 2.7 / 3.6 / 4.5

en.name: Mana Void
en.desc: For each point of mana missing by the target unit, damage is dealt to it and surrounding enemies.  The main target is also mini-stunned.
notes: Damage is calculated based on the primary target's mana, but applied to all enemies within the area of effect.

zh.name: 法力虚空
zh.desc: 根据目标损失的魔法值，对目标和其周围的敌人造成伤害。所有受到伤害的单位都会被短暂眩晕。
notes: 伤害的计算根据主目标失去的魔法，但是对作用范围内所有敌人均有效。
stats: 每点缺失魔法造成伤害：1

en.name: Persecutor
en.desc: Attacks slow enemies based on how much mana they are missing. Min slow at 60% mana, up to max slow at 0% mana. No effect if enemy is above 60% mana.
notes: Full effect if caused by illusions.

zh.name: 绝人之路
zh.desc: 攻击会根据敌人缺失的魔法值造成减速。60%魔法时造成最低减速，0%魔法时造成最高减速。敌人高于60%魔法时没有效果。
notes: 幻象造成全额效果。

en.name: Flux
en.desc: Infuses a lone enemy unit with swirling, volatile energy, dealing damage over time and slowing the target. The damage is not applied if another enemy unit is near the target.
en.scepter: Flux silences when the target is alone, deals more damage, and lasts longer.

zh.name: 乱流
zh.desc: 将不稳定的涡流能量灌注到落单敌人体内，造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度。如目标周围有其他敌方单位 ，则不会造成伤害。
zh.scepter: 目标落单时乱流具有沉默效果，造成更高伤害，而且持续时间更长。

en.name: Magnetic Field
en.desc: Arc Warden generates a circular distortion field of magnetic energy. The Magnetic Field grants bonus attack speed and protects allied units within it by evading attacks coming from outside the field. The Magnetic Field pulls runes, and runes inside Magnetic Field automatically activate.

zh.name: 磁场
zh.desc: 天穹守望者制造一个充满磁能的圆形扭曲力场。磁场提供攻击速度加成，并且其中的友方单位可以闪避来自磁场外的攻击。磁场可以牵引神符，并且自动激活其中的神符。

en.name: Runic Infusion
en.desc: Runes of Power fuse to the Self. Arc Warden gains +1.5 all attributes permanently whenever Arc Warden or the Tempest Double activates a Power Rune.

zh.name: 神符灌注
zh.desc: 神符之力与本尊融合。天穹守望者或风暴双雄每次激活强化神符后天穹守望者都会永久获得+1.5 全属性。

en.name: Spark Wraith
en.desc: Summons a Spark Wraith that slowly materializes and patrols a targeted area until an enemy comes within its range. Once a target has been found the wraith fuses with them, dealing magical damage and slowing the unit.
notes: Spark Wraiths can not be disjointed.

zh.name: 闪光幽魂
zh.desc: 召唤一个缓慢实体化的闪光怨灵萦绕在目标区域，直到有敌人进入范围。一旦有敌方单位进入范围，怨灵将贴近敌人自我熔化，造成魔法伤害并使目标减速。
notes: 闪光幽魂无法被躲避。

en.name: Tempest Double
en.desc:
Briefly refocusing its fractured elements into a single form, the Arc Warden is able to create a perfect electrical duplication of itself. The duplicate can use all of Arc Warden's current items and spells, except most consumables and items that drop on death. The duplicate has separate item and ability cooldowns.

The Tempest Double loses its sense of self and fractures over time, becoming slower and less accurate.
notes: Tempest Double and Refresher Orb cannot be used by the duplicate.
en.shard:
The Tempest Double is infused with the bonuses of Arcane, Invisibility, and Haste Runes for 12s when created.

Does not trigger Runic Infusion.

zh.name: 风暴双雄
zh.desc:
天穹守望者将破碎的自我汇聚到一起，创造出自身的完美电子复制体。复制体可以使用天穹守望者的当前所有物品和基础技能，但是大部分消耗品以及死亡时会掉落的物品除外。复制体的物品和技能冷却时间会独立计算。

复制体会逐渐失去自我意识，移动速度变慢，攻击准确度下降。
notes: 复制体无法使用风暴双雄或刷新球。
zh.shard:
风暴双雄产生时带有奥术、隐身和极速神符的效果，持续12秒。

不会触发神符灌注。

en.name: Attribute Bonus
en.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

zh.name: 属性附加
zh.desc: 消耗技能点提升所有属性

en.name: Battle Hunger
en.desc: Enrages an enemy unit, causing it to take damage over time until it kills another unit or the duration ends. The enemy is slowed as long as they are facing away from Axe.
notes: Destroying buildings will also remove the debuff.
en.shard: Multiple instances of Battle Hunger can stack on a single target.

zh.name: 战斗饥渴
zh.desc: 激怒一个敌方单位，使他受到持续伤害，直到他杀死一个单位或者持续时间结束。敌人只要背朝斧王还将被减速。
notes: 摧毁建筑也能移除该状态效果。
zh.shard: 多个战斗饥渴效果可以叠加在单个目标身上。

en.name: Berserker's Call
en.desc: Axe taunts nearby enemy units, forcing them to attack him while he gains bonus armor during the duration.
en.shard: Berserker's Call applies Battle Hunger to affected units.

zh.name: 狂战士之吼
zh.desc: 斧王嘲讽附近的敌方单位，强迫他们攻击自己，同时获得额外护甲。
zh.shard: 狂战士之吼会对作用下单位施加战斗饥渴。

en.name: Counter Helix
en.desc: After a set number of attacks, Axe will perform a helix counter attack, dealing pure damage to all nearby enemies.
notes: Counter Helix triggers when the attack hits.
Illusions' counters don't increase when they attack when you have a Scepter.
en.scepter: Counter Helix now applies a stacking debuff to enemies hit by it that causes them to deal less total attack damage to Axe. Counter Helix no longer has a cooldown and its counter advances when Axe attacks.

zh.name: 反击螺旋
zh.desc: 受到一定次数攻击后，斧王就会做出螺旋反击，对附近所有敌方单位造成纯粹伤害。
notes: 反击螺旋会在斧王受到攻击时触发。
拥有神杖后自身幻象的攻击不会计入触发计数。
zh.scepter: 反击螺旋现在对击中的敌人施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使其对斧王造成的攻击伤害减少。反击螺旋不再具有冷却时间，并且斧王的攻击也会计入触发记数。

en.name: Culling Blade
en.desc:
Axe spots a weakness and strikes, dealing pure damage. When an enemy hero is killed with Culling Blade, its cooldown is reset, and all nearby allied units gain bonus movement speed and armor.

Axe permanently drenches his blade every time he kills an enemy Hero with Culling Blade, gaining bonus armor for each stack.
notes: Culling Blade death cannot be prevented with other abilities like Shallow Grave.

zh.name: 淘汰之刃
zh.desc:
斧王洞察到弱点并出击，造成纯粹伤害。淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄时将重置冷却时间，而附近所有友军单位获得移动速度和护甲加成。

每当斧王通过淘汰之刃击杀敌方英雄，他的战刃就会浸满鲜血，获得永久叠加效果，每层都会提供护甲加成。
notes: 淘汰之刃的斩杀效果无法被薄葬等技能阻止。

en.name: One Man Army
en.desc: Axe gains Strength based on 50% of his Armor as long as there are no allied heroes within 700 distance from Axe.  The effect fades over 3s after approaching an ally.

zh.name: 一人之军
zh.desc: 只要斧王附近700范围内没有友方英雄，他就会获得50%自身护甲值的力量加成。这个效果在接近一名友军后会在3秒内消失。

en.name: Backdoor Protection
en.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

zh.name: 偷塔保护
zh.desc: 只要附近没有敌方的小兵，建筑所受的伤害就会有一定的减免，而且会快速恢复生命值。

en.name: Backdoor Protection
en.desc: Structure takes reduced damage, and quickly regenerates any damage taken while no enemy creeps are nearby.

zh.name: 偷塔保护
zh.desc: 只要附近没有敌方的小兵，建筑所受的伤害就会有一定的减免，而且会快速恢复生命值。

en.name: Brain Sap
en.desc: Feasts on the vital energies of an enemy unit, healing Bane and dealing damage.
en.shard: Reduces cooldown by 3. Causes Brain Sap to become a 550 AoE spell. Secondary targets only heal for 30%.

zh.name: 蚀脑
zh.desc: 暴食一个敌方单位的生命能量，造成伤害并回复自身生命值。
zh.shard: 减少3秒冷却时间。蚀脑变成550作用范围的技能。次级目标只有30%治疗效果。

en.name: Enfeeble
en.desc: Deals damage every second and lowers the enemy's total attack damage and cast range.

zh.name: 虚弱
zh.desc: 每秒造成伤害，并且降低敌人的总攻击力和施法距离。

en.name: Fiend's Grip
en.desc: CHANNELED - Grips an enemy unit, disabling it and causing heavy damage over time, while stealing mana every 0.5 seconds based on the unit's maximum mana.
en.scepter: Reduces Fiend's Grip cooldown by 40s. Fiend's Grip now creates two uncontrollable illusions that are also channeling Fiend's Grip on the target. Illusions take 225% incoming damage and immediately die if they are interrupted. Damage does not stack.

zh.name: 魔爪
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 抓住一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并持续受到大量伤害，同时每0.5秒按目标最大魔法值一定比例吸取魔法。
zh.scepter: 魔爪的冷却时间减少40秒。魔爪将产生两个不可控制的幻象，幻象也将对目标持续施放魔爪。幻象承受225%伤害，并且被打断后立刻消失。伤害不会叠加。

en.name: Ichor of Nyctasha
en.desc: Every time Bane kills an enemy hero or they die under the effect of Bane's debuff, they receive a Terror for the rest of the game that decreases their status resistance to Bane's subsequent debuffs.

zh.name: 妮塔莎脓血
zh.desc: 每次祸乱之源击杀敌方英雄，或者他们在祸乱之源的负面效果下阵亡，他们都会在游戏的剩余时间内获得一层恐惧的效果，使敌人对祸乱之源施加的负面状态的状态抗性减少。
stats: 每名英雄最高恐惧叠加层数：6
每层恐惧降低状态抗性：4%

en.name: Nightmare
en.desc:
Puts the target enemy or friendly Hero to sleep. Sleeping units walk in Bane's chosen direction and are awakened when damaged. If the target was directly attacked, the Nightmare passes to the attacking unit. Bane can attack and damage Nightmared targets freely.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the target stand still.
notes: In the first second of Nightmare, the unit is invulnerable.
Bane can wake himself from Nightmare.
On cast, replaced with Nightmare End: Ends all ongoing Nightmares on any affected units.

zh.name: 噩梦
zh.desc:
让目标敌方或友方英雄进入沉睡。睡着的单位会向祸乱之源选定的方向走去，受到攻击便会醒来。目标被直接攻击时，噩梦将转移到攻击者身上。祸乱之源可以随意攻击噩梦中的目标或造成伤害，而且获得额外攻击速度。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让目标站立不动。
notes: 在噩梦的第一秒，作用单位是无敌状态。
祸乱之源可以把自己从噩梦中唤醒。
施放后将替换为结束噩梦：结束所有受作用单位身上的噩梦。

en.name: Nightmare End
en.desc: Ends all ongoing Nightmares.

zh.name: 噩梦终止
zh.desc: 将所有人从噩梦中唤醒。

en.name: Firefly
en.desc: Batrider takes to the skies, moving increasingly fast and laying down a trail of flames from the air. The fire damages any enemies it touches and destroys trees below Batrider. Maximum movement speed bonus is reached at the end of Firefly's duration.
notes: During this the Batrider can fly above units, trees and impassable terrain.
If duration ends when above impassable terrain, the Batrider can get stuck.
The trail persists through Batrider's death.

zh.name: 火焰飞行
zh.desc: 蝙蝠骑士飞向天空，从空中留下一道燃烧的尾迹。飞行时，燃烧尾迹会破坏树木，对经过的敌人造成伤害。在火焰飞行持续时间的最后会达到最高移动速度加成。
notes: 火焰飞行期间蝙蝠骑士可以飞越任何单位，树木和不可通行的地形。
如果蝙蝠骑士在持续时间结束时正好在不可通行的地形上方，那么他将会卡住。
蝙蝠骑士死亡后火焰效果将继续存在。

en.name: Flamebreak
en.desc: Hurls an explosive cocktail that explodes when it reaches the target location, knocking back, slowing and dealing damage over time to enemies in the area.

zh.name: 烈焰破击
zh.desc: 投掷一瓶爆炸性的混合物，到达目标地点时爆炸，击退区域内的敌人并造成减速和持续伤害。

en.name: Flaming Lasso
en.desc: Lassoes an enemy and drags them in Batrider's wake. Dragged units cannot move, attack, or use abilities.  Teleporting or blinking will break the lasso.
notes: Killing the target or the Batrider will break the lasso before its expiration.
If Batrider moves more than 425 units in 0.05 seconds the lasso breaks.
Batrider cannot attack while using Flaming Lasso.
en.scepter: Flaming Lasso grabs both its target, as well as the target's nearest allied hero within 650 units. The secondary target is tethered to the first.

zh.name: 燃烧枷锁
zh.desc: 用枷锁捆住一个敌人，在蝙蝠骑士的后面拖行。被拖行的单位不能移动、攻击或使用技能。传送或闪烁会打破枷锁。
notes: 杀死目标或蝙蝠骑士都能在技能结束前打破枷锁。
如果蝙蝠骑士在0.05秒内移动距离超过425码枷锁将会断裂。
蝙蝠骑士在使用燃烧枷锁时不能攻击。
zh.scepter: 燃烧枷锁除了抓取目标外，还能抓取目标附近650范围内最近的友方英雄。第二目标将与第一目标相连。

en.name: Smoldering Resin
en.desc: Batrider's attacks apply a debuff that deals 20% of the attack damage every 1s for 2s.

zh.name: 闷烧树脂
zh.desc: 蝙蝠骑士的攻击会施加一个负面效果，每1秒造成20%攻击伤害，持续2秒。

en.name: Sticky Napalm
en.desc: Drenches an area in sticky oil, amplifying damage from Batrider's attacks and abilities and slowing the movement speed and turn rate of enemies. Additional casts of Sticky Napalm continue to increase damage, up to 20 stacks. Applies a small amount of damage with each cast.
notes: All damage from Batrider gets amplified, except for Radiance, Orb of Venom, Urn of Shadows, and Spirit Vessel.
Sticky Napalm does not require turning to cast.
Sticky Napalm deals 20% damage to creeps.
en.shard:
Sticky Napalm no longer has a stack limit.

Sticky Napalm deals damage to structures.

zh.name: 粘性燃油
zh.desc: 用粘性油浸透一块区域，蝙蝠骑士的攻击和技能对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的移动速度和转身速率。再次施法可以继续提高伤害，最多叠加20次。每次施放还会造成少量伤害。
notes: 所有来自蝙蝠骑士的伤害均会加深，辉耀，淬毒之珠，影之灵龛和魂之灵瓮除外。
粘性燃油无需转身即可施放。
粘性燃油对非英雄单位造成20%伤害。
zh.shard:
粘性燃油不再具有叠加上限。

粘性燃油会对建筑造成伤害。

en.name: Poison
en.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

zh.name: 毒素攻击
zh.desc: 降低移动和攻击速度的毒性攻击。

en.name: Drums of Slom
en.desc:
Attacks from Beastmaster or a nearby unit he controls will cause him bang his drum, dealing damage to nearby units and healing Beastmaster and units under his control for a portion of the damage dealt. Every attack decreases the interval between drum hits down to a minimum of 0.5s between hits after 20 attacks. If no attacks are made, the intervals gradually increase.

Using Primal Roar counts as 10 attacks.

zh.name: 斯洛姆战鼓
zh.desc:
兽王或周围他控制的单位攻击敌人都会使他敲下战鼓，对附近单位造成伤害，并且治疗自身和他控制的单位，数值为造成伤害的一定百分比。每次攻击都会降低敲鼓的间隔，20次攻击后降低至最短0.5秒敲击一次。如果没有发动攻击，敲鼓间隔会逐渐变长。

使用原始咆哮时自动增加10层敲鼓叠加效果。
stats: 最短间隔所需攻击次数：20

en.name: Poison
en.desc: Inflicts a poison that slows attack and movement speeds.

zh.name: 毒素攻击
zh.desc: 降低移动和攻击速度的毒性攻击。

en.name: Dive Bomb
en.desc: Flies towards the target enemy, dealing damage and rooting it.

zh.name: 俯冲炸弹
zh.desc: 飞向敌方目标，造成伤害并缠绕。

en.name: Inner Beast
en.desc: Untaps the inner fury of Beastmaster and units he controls, passively increasing their attack speed.
notes: Break disables the passive attack speed bonus.

zh.name: 野性之心
zh.desc: 唤起兽王和他控制单位的内心狂怒，被动提高他们的攻击速度。
notes: 破坏会使被动攻击速度加成失效。

en.name: Primal Roar
en.desc: Beastmaster lets loose a deafening roar that stuns, and shoves open a path to its target. All units in the path of the roar are damaged, while units shoved aside by the roar have their movement and attack speed slowed. Additionally, Beastmaster and his units gain 40% movement speed for 2 seconds.

zh.name: 原始咆哮
zh.desc: 兽王发出震耳欲聋的咆哮，使目标敌方单位受到伤害并眩晕，同时在兽王和他的猎物之间清出一条通道。通道上的所有单位都被震开，也受到伤害并被降低移动和攻击速度。另外，兽王和他的单位获得40%移动速度提升，持续2秒。

en.name: Rugged
en.desc: Beastmaster's melee hero Damage Block Chance is increased from 50% to 100% versus non-hero units and non-building units.

zh.name: 刚毅
zh.desc: 兽王对非英雄和非建筑单位的近战英雄伤害格挡几率从50%提升至100%。

en.name: Summon Raptors
en.desc: Beastmaster summons 2 hawks that circle around Beastmaster and dive-bombs at enemies with a base attack rate of every 4s, damaging and rooting them. Attack rate increases with the Hawk's attack speed. Prioritizes heroes.
en.shard: Increases Hawk duration by %bonus_duration%s and summons an additional Hawk.

zh.name: 召唤猛禽
zh.desc: 兽王召唤2只战鹰环绕在他周围，战鹰以4秒的基础攻击间隔俯冲攻击敌人，造成伤害并缠绕。战鹰提升攻击速度后会提升攻击频率。以英雄优先。
zh.shard: 战鹰的持续时间提升%bonus_duration%秒，并且额外召唤一只战鹰。

en.name: Summon Razorback
en.desc: Beastmaster calls forth a Boar to aid in the battlefield. The Boar has a passive poison attack that slows attack and movement speeds.

zh.name: 召唤刀背兽
zh.desc: 兽王召唤一头豪猪前来助阵。豪猪拥有被动的毒素攻击，可以减缓攻击和移动速度。

en.name: Wild Axes
en.desc: Beastmaster sends his axes flying and calls them home again, slicing through enemy units and trees along their path.  Each axe can hit an enemy once, and amplifies subsequent damage from Beastmaster and his units.
notes: This ability destroys trees.
en.shard: Beastmaster's attacks on enemy heroes also apply the Wild Axes debuff of its corresponding level.

zh.name: 野性之斧
zh.desc: 兽王投出他的斧头然后召回它们，切开飞过的敌人和树木。每把飞斧对同一个敌人只能击中一次，并且加深来自兽王和其单位的伤害。
notes: 此技能将摧毁树木。
zh.shard: 兽王对敌方英雄的攻击还会施加相应等级的野性之斧负面状态。

en.name: Break
en.desc: Whenever Hill Troll Berserker attacks a unit it applies break to it.

zh.name: 破坏
zh.desc: 丘陵巨魔狂战士攻击单位时就会施加破坏效果。

en.name: Frenzy
en.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide works an ally into a frenzy, causing his ally to have increased attack speed.

zh.name: 暴怒
zh.desc: 远古雷肤兽将一名友军变得狂热，提升其攻击速度。

en.name: Slam
en.desc: The Ancient Thunderhide slams his mammoth body against the ground. The shock damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing. Heroes regain their balance more quickly.

zh.name: 猛击
zh.desc: 远古雷肤兽用它巨大的身体猛击地面。震击伤害附近敌人并掀倒他们。英雄在较短时间内即可恢复平衡。

en.name: War Drums Aura
en.desc: The rhythm of the Thunderhide's heartbeat increases the attack speed and accuracy of nearby allies.

zh.name: 战鼓光环
zh.desc: 雷肤兽心跳的节奏提升了周围友军的攻击速度和必中率。

en.name: Dragonhide Aura
en.desc: The Ancient Black Dragon's dreaded presence grants nearby allies additional armor. This bonus can stack with itself.

zh.name: 龙肤光环
zh.desc: 远古黑龙可怕的存在让附近的友军获得了额外护甲。这个光环效果多个叠加。

en.name: Fireball
en.desc: Hurls a fire blast on the ground, igniting the area in a 300 radius for 8 / 9 / 10 / 12 seconds. Enemies caught in the fire will take 85 damage per second.

zh.name: 火球
zh.desc: 对地面喷出火球，点燃300范围内的区域，持续8 / 9 / 10 / 12秒。火海内的敌人每秒将受到85点伤害。

en.name: Splash Attack
en.desc: The Black Dragon's explosive attacks are felt by all nearby enemies.

zh.name: 溅射攻击
zh.desc: 周围所有敌人都感受到黑龙的爆炸攻击。

en.name: Magic Amplification Aura
en.desc: The Black Drakes' gaze make enemies more susceptible to Spell Damage.

zh.name: 魔法增强光环
zh.desc: 黑蜉蝣的凝视让敌人更难抵挡技能伤害。

en.name: Blood Rite
en.desc: Bloodseeker baptizes an area in sacred blood. After 2.9 seconds the ritual completes, causing any enemies caught in the area to take damage and become silenced.
notes: Total time is a 2.6 second delay plus a 0.3 second cast time.

zh.name: 血祭
zh.desc: 血魔用圣血为一片区域洗礼。2.9秒后祭祀完成，区域范围内所有敌人都会受到伤害，并被沉默。
notes: 总时间为2.6秒的施法时间加上%castpoint_tooltip%秒的生效延迟。

en.name: Blood Mist
en.desc:
Bloodseeker sprays his blood continuously in the area around him, losing health to damage and slow his enemies. While active, Sanguivore's healing is increased. Cannot be turned off while on cooldown. 

Additionally, passively turns all your overheal from your own abilities into an all damage barrier up to 50% of Bloodseeker's Max Health. Barrier amount decays by 0.5% per second.
notes: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

zh.name: 血雾
zh.desc:
血魔将自己的鲜血撒向一片区域，伤害自身的同时对敌人造成伤害和减速。开启时食血动物的治疗效果提升。技能处于冷却时无法关闭。

另外，被动使来自自身技能的超量治疗变成全伤害护盾，最多可达血魔最大生命的50%。护盾数值每秒衰减0.5%。
notes: 对血魔造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

en.name: Bloodrage
en.desc: Drives Bloodseeker into a bloodthirsty rage which causes him to attack faster and deal more spell damage at the cost of a percentage of his health per second.
notes: Damage dealt to Bloodseeker is non-lethal.
en.shard: Bloodseeker's Bloodrage attacks now deal 1.5% of the target's max health as Pure damage.

zh.name: 血怒
zh.desc: 使血魔陷入渴望鲜血的狂怒中，以每秒流失一定百分比生命的代价获得攻击速度和技能增强加成。
notes: 对血魔造成的伤害不致死。
zh.shard: 血怒下血魔的攻击现在造成1.5%目标最大生命值的纯粹伤害。

en.name: Rupture
en.desc: Causes an enemy unit's skin to rupture, dealing initial damage based on its current health. If the unit moves, it takes damage based on the distance moved.
en.scepter: Increases initial damage and grants 2 Rupture Charges.

zh.name: 割裂
zh.desc: 让一个敌方单位皮开肉绽，根据其当前生命值造成初始伤害。单位移动后会根据移动的距离受到伤害。
zh.scepter: 提升初始伤害，并且提供2点割裂能量点数。

en.name: Sanguivore
en.desc:
Bloodseeker restores some life when he kills a unit, equal to 30 health plus a percentage of the units max health.

Restores for half values if an ally kills a nearby enemy hero.
notes: Creeps lifesteal is reduced by 40%.

zh.name: 食血动物
zh.desc:
血魔每杀死一个单位都会回复部分生命，回复量为基础30点加上该单位最大生命值的一定百分比。

友军击杀了附近的敌方英雄时会回复半额数值。
notes: 非英雄单位的吸血效果减少40%。

en.name: Thirst
en.desc: Bloodseeker is invigorated by the wounds of his enemies, gaining bonus movement speed when an enemy hero's health falls below 100%, with the bonuses increasing as their health falls further. If an enemy hero's health falls below 25%, he will also gain vision and True Sight of that hero. Bonuses stack per hero. Unlocks max movement speed for Bloodseeker.
notes: Not triggered by Illusions.
Max movement speed bonus occurs when an enemy's health is at or below 25%.
Effects linger for 4 seconds if a target dies.

zh.name: 焦渴
zh.desc: 血魔能够感知到敌人的伤口中涌出的鲜血，敌方英雄的生命值低于100%，他的移动速度就会提升，而且生命值越低，提升效果越大。如果生命值低于25%，他还将获得该英雄的视野和真实视域。焦渴的效果可以叠加。血魔可以突破最大速度限制。
notes: 幻象不能触发该技能。
移动速度加成在敌人生命值低于25%时达到上限。
目标死亡后效果延续4秒。

en.name: Big Game Hunter
en.desc: Bounty Hunter receives 20% more kill and assist gold if the dying enemy hero is Big Game. An enemy hero is considered Big Game if they are one of the top 3 net worth heroes on the enemy team.

zh.name: 职业猎人
zh.desc: 如果阵亡的敌人是重大目标，赏金猎人获得的击杀和助攻金钱提升20%。敌方英雄的财产总和在他们团队中排名为前三就被视为重大目标。

en.name: Cutpurse
en.desc: Bounty Hunter steals 4 gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.
notes: Reapplying Track does not steal gold with Cutpurse.

zh.name: 妙手空空
zh.desc: Bounty Hunter steals 4 gold when targeting enemy heroes with his abilities or items.
notes: 重新施加追踪术不会触发妙手空空的窃取金钱。

en.name: Jinada
en.desc: Bounty Hunter plans his next hit, dealing bonus damage and stealing some unreliable gold.

zh.name: 忍术
zh.desc: 赏金猎人准备好他的下次攻击，造成额外伤害并窃取若干不可靠金钱。

en.name: Shuriken Toss
en.desc: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a 1200 radius of each other.
en.scepter: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

zh.name: 投掷飞镖
zh.desc: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围1200范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
zh.scepter: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。

en.name: Track
en.desc: Tracks an enemy hero, granting True Sight of the target, increasing the damage they take and providing information on how much gold it is carrying. If the target dies, Bounty Hunter and nearby heroes collect a bonus bounty of gold. Casting Track does not take you out of invisibility.
notes: Bounty Hunter will get the bonus gold if the target dies while Track is active, regardless of how it died.
Track's effect is only visible to allies.
You can see the amount of gold the target is carrying by mousing over the debuff icon above the target's ability bar.
Bonus gold is reliable gold.

zh.name: 追踪术
zh.desc: 追踪一个敌方英雄，获得目标的真实视域，使目标受到的伤害增加，同时掌握目标当前携带的金钱数额。如果目标在被追踪期间死亡，赏金猎人和附近友方英雄都将获得若干金钱奖励。施放追踪术不会脱离隐身。
notes: 只要目标在追踪术期间以任何方式死亡，赏金猎人都能获得金钱奖励。
追踪术效果仅对友方单位可见。
鼠标移至目标技能栏上方的负面效果图标可以看到目标携带的金钱数额。
金钱奖励为不可靠金钱。

en.name: Shadow Walk
en.desc: Bounty Hunter becomes invisible and gains bonus movement speed and the ability to move through other units until he attacks or casts a spell.  If he breaks the invisibility with an attack, that attack will stun the target for a short duration.
notes: Will not break most channeling of spells upon activation.

zh.name: 暗影步
zh.desc: 赏金猎人进入隐身，获得移动速度加成，并能够穿越其它单位，直到他攻击或使用技能。破隐一击会短暂眩晕目标。
notes: 开启后不会打断大多数持续施法技能。

en.name: Friendly Shadow
en.desc: Applies Shadow Walk and all of its bonuses to the target ally. Allied fade time is 0.5s. Does not break Bounty Hunter's invisibility when cast.

zh.name: 暗影情谊
zh.desc: 对友军目标施加暗影步及其所有加成效果。友方单位的渐隐时间是0.5秒。施放时不会使赏金猎人脱离隐身状态。

en.name: Cinder Brew
en.desc:
Rolls a barrel of ale at enemies that damages enemies along its path and spills out at the target location.

Any enemy in the path or the spill area is drenched in cinder brew, becoming slowed.  If the enemy receives Magic or Pure damage, they will be ignited, extending the duration by 3s and causing them to take damage over time.

zh.name: 余烬佳酿
zh.desc:
向敌人扔出一个酒桶，对沿途的敌人造成伤害，并在目标地点溅出酒液。

路径上和溅酒点的敌人会浸满余烬佳酿，并且被减速。受到魔法或纯粹伤害后还将被点燃。点燃时持续时间增加3秒，并且受到持续伤害。

en.name: Drunken Brawler
en.desc:
Brewmaster can switch stances based on the elements he controls.

Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up, increasing his stance power by 150% for 5s.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended by 2s. After Brewed Up expires, he is hungover and cannot Brew Up again for 9s.

Earth Brawler gains bonus Magic Resistance and Armor.

Storm Brawler gains bonus Evasion and Movement Speed.

Fire Brawler gains bonus Attack Speed and chance to critical strike.
notes: Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

zh.name: 醉拳
zh.desc:
酒仙可以根据操控的元素来切换拳法。

每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升150%，持续5秒。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长2秒。浸酒状态结束后，他会进入大醉状态，9秒内无法再次进入浸酒状态。

大地拳法 - 获得护甲和魔法抗性加成。

狂风拳法 - 获得闪避和移动速度加成。

烈火拳法 - 获得攻击速度加成，并且拥有几率造成致命一击伤害。
notes: 与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

en.name: Drunken Brawler - Brew Up
en.desc: Whenever Brewmaster casts an ability, he becomes Brewed Up and his stance becomes empowered.  If he casts another ability while Brewed Up, the duration is extended.  The cooldown starts when the effect ends.

zh.name: 醉拳 - 浸酒
zh.desc: 每当酒仙施放技能，他都会进入浸酒状态，拳法的威力提升。如果他在浸酒状态下又施放了技能，持续时间会延长。效果结束后开始冷却。

en.name: Hurl Boulder
en.desc: Throws a boulder at a unit, doing damage and stunning it.

zh.name: 投掷巨石
zh.desc: 对一个单位投掷巨石，造成伤害并使其眩晕。

en.name: Demolish
en.desc: Deals bonus damage to buildings.

zh.name: 粉碎击
zh.desc: 对建筑物造成额外伤害。

en.name: Earth Element
en.desc: Magic, status, and slow resistance increased.

zh.name: 大地元素
zh.desc: 魔法抗性和减速抗性提升。

en.name: Permanent Immolation
en.desc: Burns nearby enemy units.

zh.name: 永久献祭
zh.desc: 烧灼附近的敌方单位。

en.name: Permanent Phase
en.desc: Provides the Brewling with phased movement and bonus Status Resistance.

zh.name: 永久相位
zh.desc: 向元素战士提供相位移动状态和状态抗性加成。

en.name: Liquid Courage
en.desc: When Brewmaster drops below 50% Health he gains a Status Resistance buff and his movement speed alternates every 1s between being faster and being slower. The effect becomes stronger at lower health, scaling from 0 up to max values at 20% Health.
en.shard:
Toss a strong drink to a teammate or drink it yourself, activating the maximum power effect of Liquid Courage and granting 3% Max HP Regen per second.

Lasts 5 seconds.

zh.name: 壮胆酒
zh.desc: 当酒仙的生命值低于50%，他就会获得状态抗性加成，而且他的移动速度每1秒都会在加速和减速之间改变。血量越低，效果越强，从0开始到20%生命值时达到最大数值。
zh.shard:
向队友丢出一杯烈酒，或自己一饮而尽，获得壮胆酒的最大效果，并且还会获得每秒3%最大生命值的回复。

持续5秒。

en.name: Primal Companion
en.desc:
Creates a Brewling based on Brewmaster's current Drunken Brawler Stance.

A new Brewling cannot be resummoned for 3s if the current one takes damage from enemy Heroes or hero-controlled units. If the Brewling dies, the ability goes on cooldown for 70 seconds.

Only one Brewling can exist at a time. If Brewmaster uses Primal Split, the existing Brewling disappears.

zh.name: 元素伙伴
zh.desc:
根据酒仙的当前醉拳拳法制造一个元素战士。

如果当前的元素战士受到来自敌方英雄或者英雄控制单位的伤害，3秒内无法召唤新的元素战士。如果元素战士阵亡，技能进入70秒的冷却状态。

同一时间只能存在一个元素战士。如果酒仙使用元素分离，现有的元素战士将会消失。

en.name: Primal Split
en.desc: Splits Brewmaster into elements, forming 3 specialized warriors, adept at survival, each with their own abilities. If any of them survive until the end of their summoned timer, the Brewmaster is reborn.  Each Warrior gains its respective Drunken Brawler stance.
notes: The Earth Element will carry all auras that the Brewmaster has, as well as True Sight.
The Fire Element has phased movement.
When the spell ends, Brewmaster will take the place of an element in this order, assuming they are alive: Earth, Storm, Fire.
en.scepter:
Primal Split gains 1 max and current level, improving the Brewlings and their abilities.

Allows Primal Split to be cancelled early, and causes the Brewlings to be Brewed Up when Primal Split begins.

zh.name: 元素分离
zh.desc: 酒仙分裂成元素，产生3个各有所长的战士，生存能力极强，每个都拥有独特技能。只要其中任何一个在召唤时间结束后存活下来，酒仙就能重生。每个战士都会获得对应的醉拳拳法。
notes: 大地战士将继承酒仙的所有光环，以及真视宝石的真视效果。
烈火战士拥有相位移动的能力。
技能结束后，酒仙会根据大地→狂风→烈火的顺序选择未阵亡的元素重生。
zh.scepter:
元素分离获得1级最高和当前等级，强化元素战士和他们的技能。

元素分离可以提前结束，而且元素分离开始时元素战士是浸酒状态。

en.name: Primal Split Cancel
en.desc: Cancel the Primal Split.

zh.name: 元素分离中止
zh.desc: 中止元素分离。

en.name: Cyclone
en.desc: Encloses a unit in a tornado, removing it from the battlefield and deals 75 / 75 / 75 / 100 damage when after they land.

zh.name: 龙卷风
zh.desc: 用龙卷风困住一个单位，将其从战场中隔离出去，落地时会对其造成75 / 75 / 75 / 100点伤害。

en.name: Dispel Magic
en.desc:
Damages summoned units in an area and dispels most buffs or debuffs.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Can be cast on invulnerable units.

zh.name: 驱散魔法
zh.desc:
驱散区域内大部分增益或负面效果并对召唤单位造成伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 可以对无敌单位施放。

en.name: Wind Walk
en.desc: Provides temporary invisibility.  Bonus movement speed and attack damage when invisible.

zh.name: 疾风步
zh.desc: 暂时进入隐身状态。隐身时有移动速度加成，破隐一击有额外伤害。

en.name: Thunder Clap
en.desc: Slams the ground, dealing damage and slowing the movement speed and attack rate of nearby enemy units.

zh.name: 雷霆一击
zh.desc: 猛击地面，造成伤害并降低附近敌方单位的移动速度和攻击速度。

en.name: Brawler's Grit
en.desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for 8s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.

zh.name: 斗士的勇气
zh.desc: Every time Bristleback is Stunned, Hexed, Feared, Taunted, or Rooted he gains a stacking buff for 8s that provides status resistance and debuff amplificiation, up to a maximum of 4 stacks.
stats: 每层叠加负面效果增强：2.9%

en.name: Bristleback
en.desc: Bristleback takes less damage if hit on the sides or rear. If Bristleback takes enough damage from the rear, he releases a Quill Spray of the current level.
notes: Bristleback's rear is considered to be within 70 degrees from the back.
Bristleback's side is considered to be within 110 degrees from the back.
Damage done by Quill Sprays released by this ability passively is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
en.scepter: Adds active ability to Bristleback. Bristleback rotates towards the targeted direction and, after 0.5s, forcefully ejects 5 sequential Quill Sprays in a tight conical pattern out of his back every 0.4s. Bristleback's facing is locked during this time, he is disarmed, and his speed is reduced by -40%.

zh.name: 钢毛后背
zh.desc: 如果伤害来自钢背兽的侧面或者背后，他所受的伤害将会降低。钢背兽每次从背后受到一定量伤害会自动释放一次当前等级的刺针扫射。
notes: 钢背兽的背面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈70度角的扇形区域。
钢背兽的侧面是以背部中心点为原点，向左向右各呈110度角的扇形区域，背面的扇形区域不算在内。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
zh.scepter: 钢毛后背增加主动效果。钢背兽将背部转向目标方向，0.5秒后以0.4秒间隔朝背部前方的锥形范围强行连续喷出5次刺针扫射。钢背兽在这段时间内面朝方向被锁定，被缴械，并且移动速度减缓-40%。

en.name: Hairball
en.desc: Coughs a quill-packed hairball towards the target location. Erupts at the location, hitting enemies with Viscous Nasal Goo stacks and Quill Spray.

zh.name: 毛团
zh.desc: 向目标地点咳出一团满是刺针的毛团。毛团会在该地点爆开，范围内的敌人都将受到多个鼻液叠加效果和单次刺针扫射的作用。

en.name: Prickly
en.desc: Bristleback has bonus damage and debuff duration amp against enemy heroes that are behind him.

zh.name: 尖刺在背
zh.desc: 钢背兽攻击身后的敌方英雄时拥有额外伤害和负面效果持续时间增强。
stats: 伤害和负面效果持续时间增强：4.5%

en.name: Quill Spray
en.desc: Sprays enemy units with quills dealing damage in an area of effect around Bristleback.  Deals bonus damage for every time a unit was hit by Quill Spray in the last 14 seconds.
notes: Quill Spray damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

zh.name: 刺针扫射
zh.desc: 将尖刺喷射向敌人，对钢背兽附近的敌人造成伤害。任何单位最近14秒内每次受到刺针扫射的打击都会受到额外伤害。
notes: 刺针扫射的伤害不能被伤害格挡类技能减免。

en.name: Viscous Nasal Goo
en.desc: Covers a target in snot, causing it to have reduced armor and movement speed for 5 seconds.  Multiple casts stack and refresh the duration.

zh.name: 粘稠鼻液
zh.desc: 用鼻涕包裹一个敌方单位，降低护甲和移动速度，持续5秒。多次施放的效果会叠加，并且刷新持续时间。

en.name: Warpath
en.desc: Bristleback works himself up into a fury every time he casts a spell, increasing his movement speed and damage.
notes: Bristleback's illusions will receive the bonuses.
Items will not trigger Warpath.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 战意
zh.desc: 钢背兽每次使用技能时都会进入狂暴状态，移动速度和攻击力都将提升。
notes: 钢背兽的幻象也能继承加成效果。
使用物品不会触发战意。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

en.name: Incapacitating Bite
en.desc: Broodmother's venom cripples enemy units, causing her attacks to slow and giving the affected unit a chance to miss its attacks and extra damage from attacks.
notes: The miss chance stacks with evasion and terrain dodge chance.

zh.name: 麻痹之咬
zh.desc: 育母蜘蛛用毒液削弱敌方单位，使她的攻击带有减速效果，中毒单位的攻击有一定概率落空，并且被攻击时承受额外伤害。
notes: 攻击落空几率与闪避和上下坡丢失叠加。

en.name: Insatiable Hunger
en.desc: A violent lust for vital fluids increases Broodmother's attack damage and gives her and her Spiderlings a vampiric attack.
en.shard: While Hunger is active, the bonus damage is increased by 4% every 1s.

zh.name: 极度饥渴
zh.desc: 对活物体液的强烈饥渴提高了育母蜘蛛的攻击力，并使她和她的小蜘蛛的攻击附带吸血效果。
zh.shard: 开启极度饥渴后，攻击力加成每1秒提升4%。

en.name: Poison Sting
en.desc: Slows enemies with each attack.

zh.name: 毒刺
zh.desc: 每次攻击都会减缓敌人的移动速度。

en.name: Spawn Spiderling
en.desc: Applies debuff on attack. If debuffed unit dies, a spiderling will spawn.

zh.name: 孵化蜘蛛
zh.desc: 攻击会感染敌人。如果目标在感染期内死亡，一只小蜘蛛会从尸体中产出。

en.name: Spawn Spiderlings
en.desc: Broodmother injects her young into an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing them for 4 seconds. The spiderlings will hatch if the target is killed while under this influence.
notes: If the target is killed within 20 seconds of being hit with this skill, the Spiderlings will spawn.
Units killed by Spiderlings will then give birth to additional Spiderlings.

zh.name: 孵化蜘蛛
zh.desc: 育母蜘蛛将她的卵注入敌人体内，造成伤害和减速，持续4秒。如果目标在感染期间被击杀，卵会孵化成小蜘蛛。
notes: 如果目标在受到此技能后20秒内被杀死，小蜘蛛就会孵化。
被小蜘蛛杀死的单位会生出额外的小蜘蛛。

en.name: Spider's Milk
en.desc: Whenever Broodmother kills a unit, she and all units under her control in a 600 radius receive a buff for 3s that heals them for a percentage of the victim's health every 0.5 seconds. Healing from creeps is reduced by 40%.

zh.name: 蜘蛛奶
zh.desc: 育母蜘蛛击杀一个单位后，她和600范围内她控制的所有单位都会获得持续3秒的状态效果，每0.5秒治疗一定生命，治疗量为遇害者生命值的一定百分比。非英雄单位提供的治疗量减少40%。

en.name: Spin Web
en.desc:
Spins a large web that grants Broodmother a passive movement speed increase and increases her Turn Rate, while in its vicinity, as well as giving free movement.

Spin Web can be cast from anywhere as long as the new web touches an existing web. Webs never expire, and can be manually destroyed. When the maximum limit of webs is exceeded, the oldest web disappears.
notes: Also affects Spiderlings.

zh.name: 织网
zh.desc:
编织出一张蜘蛛网，育母蜘蛛在蛛网里被动提升移动速度和转身速率，并且获得无视地形移动的能力。

织网现在可向其他蛛网触及的区域全地图施放。蛛网永久存在，不过可以手动摧毁。当其数量超过上限，最早的蛛网将会消失。
notes: 也会作用于小蜘蛛。

en.name: Destroy Spin Web
en.desc: Destroys the selected Spin Web.

zh.name: 摧毁蛛网
zh.desc: 摧毁选中的蛛网。

en.name: Spinner's Snare
en.desc: Broodmother may create up to 5 invisible web lines touching any existing web. Enemy Heroes that cross the web line will spring the trap, becoming rooted, revealed in fog, and take damage over time.  Multiple Heroes can trip on the same line until it's destroyed after being initially triggered.  Broodmother's team is alerted via the minimap when an enemy has triggered the snare.

zh.name: 蛛纱陷阱
zh.desc: 育母蜘蛛可以制造出最多5个触碰已有蛛网的隐形网线。敌方英雄穿过网线将会触发陷阱，被缠绕，在战争迷雾中显形，并持续受到伤害。网线一开始被触发后，多名英雄还可以在同根网线上被绊倒，直到网线被摧毁。只要有人触发陷阱，育母蜘蛛的队友就会在小地图上发现。

en.name: Double Edge
en.desc: Centaur strikes a mighty blow at melee range, damaging both himself and a small area around the target. Deals extra damage based on your strength. Centaur cannot die from Double Edge.
notes: Double Edge deals magic type damage to both the targets and himself.
en.shard: Causes Double Edge to slow enemy heroes and increase Centaur's strength per hero hit for a short time. Duration refreshes per stack, up to a max of 5 stacks.

zh.name: 双刃剑
zh.desc: 半人马战行者以猛烈的力量进行近战攻击，对目标周围单位和自身造成伤害。将基于力量值造成额外伤害。此技能无法用于自杀。
notes: 双刃剑对目标和自身都造成魔法伤害。
zh.shard: 双刃剑可以对敌人造成减速，并且每击中一名英雄都会暂时提升半人马战行者的力量值。每次叠加都会刷新持续时间，最多叠加5次。

en.name: Hoof Stomp
en.desc: After a brief windup, Centaur Warrunner slams the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemy units. During the delay, he is disarmed but can move.

zh.name: 马蹄践踏
zh.desc: 经过短暂的蓄力后，半人马战行者猛踏地面，眩晕并伤害身边的敌方单位。在延迟期间，他被缴械，但可以移动。

en.name: Horsepower
en.desc:
Centaur Warrunner gains 40% of his strength as bonus movement speed.

 This Movement speed bonus does not stack with bonuses from boots.

zh.name: 开足马力
zh.desc:
半人马战行者获得移动速度加成，数值为40%自身力量值。

这个移动速度加成不与鞋类物品叠加。

en.name: Swiftness Aura
en.desc: The fearsome Hellbear attacks more quickly and bullies nearby allies into following suit.

zh.name: 迅猛光环
zh.desc: 可怕的地狱熊怪发起攻击更为迅捷，并鼓舞附近友军效仿。

en.name: War Stomp
en.desc: The Centaur Conqueror's powerful hooves stomp the ground, stunning and damaging nearby enemies. Heroes recover more quickly.

zh.name: 战争践踏
zh.desc: 半人马征服者用强有力的蹄践踏地面，对附近敌人造成伤害并眩晕。英雄将从眩晕中更快苏醒。

en.name: Hitch A Ride
en.desc: Centaur tosses an ally into a cart hitched behind him. While in the cart, the ally is invulnerable and can still cast and attack normally, but cannot move independently or be targeted by opponents. Increases the attack range of melee heroes by 200.

zh.name: 便车
zh.desc: 半人马将一名友军抛入他身后的一辆便车中。友军在便车内是无敌状态，依然可以施法和攻击，不过无法移动，也无法成为敌人的目标。便车内近战英雄的攻击距离提升200。

en.name: Rawhide
en.desc: Permanently gain 25 max health every 120s.

zh.name: 皮糙肉厚
zh.desc: 每120秒永久获得25点生命上限。

en.name: Retaliate
en.desc: Centaur counters all attacks, dealing damage back to the attacker. Returns a fixed amount plus a percentage of your strength. Deals half damage to towers.
notes: Retaliate triggers when the attack hits.
Retaliate deals damage to towers.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 反伤
zh.desc: 半人马战行者向攻击他的单位发出反击。反弹固定伤害加上自身力量的一定百分比。对防御塔的伤害减半。
notes: 反伤会在受到攻击时触发。
反伤能对防御塔造成伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Stampede
en.desc: Centaur leads all allies into a vicious charge causing them to move through units at max speed and slow any enemy units they trample. Trampled enemies take damage based on Centaur Warrunner's strength. Each enemy can be trampled once.

zh.name: 奔袭冲撞
zh.desc: 半人马战行者带领所有队友向胜利冲锋，所有友方英雄达到极限移动速度，并使踩到的敌人减速。每个敌人只会受到一次踩踏作用，并受到基于半人马战行者力量值的伤害。

en.name: Work Horse
en.desc: Centaur hitches a cart behind him. While active, Centaur gains the benefit of Stampede for the current level of Stampede, and can cast Hitch a Ride on a target ally.

zh.name: 马到成功
zh.desc: 半人马战行者套上一辆便车。开启后半人马战行者获得当前等级奔袭冲撞的加成效果，而且可以对友方目标施放便车。

en.name: Chaos Bolt
en.desc: Throws a mysterious bolt of energy at the target unit. It stuns for a random duration and deals random damage.
notes: The stun duration and damage values dealt are inversely related.
Nearby illusions will mimic the cast animation.
en.shard: Causes Chaos Bolt to create a Phantasm illusion to attack the target. This illusion deals 15% less damage.

zh.name: 混乱之箭
zh.desc: 对目标单位投掷一支神秘的能量箭。造成随机时间的眩晕和随机的伤害。
notes: 眩晕持续时间和伤害值为负相关。
附近的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
zh.shard: 混乱之箭会制造一个混沌之军的幻象来攻击目标。这个幻象造成的伤害减少15%。

en.name: Chaos Strike
en.desc: Chaos Knight and his illusions' attacks have a chance to deal a critical strike of varying strength with bonus lifesteal. Lifesteal from creeps is reduced.

zh.name: 混沌一击
zh.desc: 混沌骑士和他的幻象在攻击时有几率造成威力不一的致命一击，并且触发时具有吸血效果。对非英雄单位的吸血效果减少。

en.name: Fundamental Forging
en.desc: Chaos Knight's Neutral Items get an additional random enchantment.
notes: The random enchantment can be any available enchantment in that tier except for enchantments with negative effects, including enchantments that are normally not available for Strength heroes.
The random enchantment cannot be the same as the chosen enchantment.

zh.name: 基本法则锻造
zh.desc: 混沌骑士的中立物品额外获得一个随机附魔。
notes: 随机附魔会从该级别的所有可选附魔中选取，包括一般不会对力量英雄开放的附魔，拥有负面效果的附魔除外。
随机附魔不会和选定附魔重复。

en.name: Phantasm
en.desc:
Summons several phantasmal copies of the Chaos Knight from alternate dimensions. The phantasms are illusions that deal 60 / 80 / 100% damage, but take 350% damage.
DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Chaos Knight.
Chaos Knight is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing him to dodge stuns and damage.
en.scepter:
Gains a passive component.  When an illusion of Chaos Knight is created, there is a 50% chance to create an additional illusion under Chaos Knight's control.

When Phantasm is activated, also creates an illusion of allied heroes globally.

zh.name: 混沌之军
zh.desc:
从其他维度召唤若干个混沌骑士的幻象。幻象继承60 / 80 / 100%攻击力，但是承受350%伤害。
驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 能够移除混沌骑士的大部分负面状态。
混沌骑士在施放时有0.5秒的无敌时间，可以躲避眩晕和伤害技能。
zh.scepter:
增加被动效果。混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有50%几率额外产生一个在其控制下的幻象。

施放混沌之军时，会产生全地图上所有友方英雄的一个幻象。

en.name: Phantasmagoria
en.desc: All Chaos Knight Illusions are Strong Illusions and take less damage when near him.
notes: All illusions created by Chaos Knight or of Chaos Knight are Strong Illusions. Chaos Knight's Illusions within 1200 radius have 20% damage reduction.
Also applies to Aghanim's Scepter Phantasm Illusions.
Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.
Break disables the passive Damage Reduction aura.

zh.name: 千变幻景
zh.desc: 所有混沌骑士的幻象都是强幻象，并且在他附近时承受的伤害降低。
notes: 混沌骑士自身制造，或源自混沌骑士的所有幻象都是强幻象。1200范围内的混沌骑士幻象拥有20%承伤降低。
对阿哈利姆神杖升级混沌之军幻象同样有效。
强幻象不会被技能秒杀。
破坏会使被动的承受伤害降低光环失效。

en.name: Reality Rift
en.desc: Teleports Chaos Knight, any illusions he has, and the target unit to a point along the line between him and the target. The enemy unit has their armor reduced for 6s.
notes: Chaos Knight and the target unit are made to face each other, and Chaos Knight and his phantasms are issued an attack order against the target.
en.shard: Allows Reality Rift to be cast on any enemy hero that is within 1200 range of you or one of your illusions. Gathers all of your illusions and your hero and teleports them to the target enemy.

zh.name: 实相裂隙
zh.desc: 将混沌骑士及混沌骑士的幻象和目标单位传送到混沌骑士与目标连线上的一点。降低敌方单位的护甲，持续6秒。
notes: 目标单位将会强制面向混沌骑士，而且混沌骑士和幻象默认对目标发动攻击。
zh.shard: 实相裂隙可以对自身或幻象1200范围内的任意敌方英雄施放。自身英雄和所有幻象会集合，并传送至敌方目标处。

en.name: Reins of Chaos
en.desc: Whenever illusions of Chaos Knight are created, there is a 50% chance that an additional 1 extra illusion will spawn.

zh.name: 混沌称霸
zh.desc: 混沌骑士产生幻象时都会有50%几率额外产生1个幻象。

en.name: Divine Favor
en.desc:
Passively provides an aura that grants increased health regeneration. Can be cast on allies to provide them with bonus armor and increasing the healing and health regeneration they receive.

If cast on Chen, all units controlled by Chen receive the buff.

zh.name: 神力恩泽
zh.desc:
被动提供光环，提供生命恢复加成。可以主动对友军施放，提供护甲加成，以及治疗和生命恢复增强。

对陈施放后，陈控制的所有单位都会获得增益效果。

en.name: Hand of God
en.desc: Heals all allied heroes on the map as well as all units under Chen's control. A large heal is applied at first and a slow heal over time is applied for 10 seconds afterwards.
notes: Can heal invulnerable and hidden/banished allies.
en.scepter: Decreases the cooldown of Hand of God to 150 / 130 / 110s and it becomes a channelled spell that lasts for up to 6 seconds. The initial heal happens at the start of the channel, and while channeling other nearby allied units become debuff immune with 60% magic resistance and the power of the heal over time is increased by 200%.

zh.name: 上帝之手
zh.desc: 治疗地图上的所有友军英雄以及陈控制的所有单位。一开始先施加高额治疗，在之后10秒内持续进行小额治疗。
notes: 可以治疗无敌和被隐藏/放逐友军。
zh.scepter: 上帝之手的冷却时间降低至150 / 130 / 110秒，并且变为持续施法型技能，持续最多6秒。初始治疗会在持续施法起始时发生，持续施法期间其他附近友方单位变为减益免疫状态，拥有60%魔法抗性，而且持续治疗的威力提升200%。
stats: 魔晶升级神圣劝化远古生物数量：1 / 2 / 3

en.name: Holy Persuasion
en.desc: Chen takes control of an enemy or neutral creep and receives a percentage of its bounty. Its maximum health is set to 400. Converted creeps will have increased movement speed and bonus damage. Chen may globally target his own creep if it has not taken damage in the last 3 seconds to unsummon it.
notes: Persuading a new creep above max unit count causes the oldest persuaded creep to die.
Can target Ancient creeps when Chen has Aghanim's Shard.
The health of creeps already under Chen's control does not update to the new level upon leveling Holy Persuasion further.
Fully restores the creep's mana upon converting.
en.shard: Allows Holy Persuasion to target Ancient creeps. Can control up to 1/2/3 Ancient creeps based on Hand of God's level. Additionally levels up some abilities of creeps by 1 level.

zh.name: 神圣劝化
zh.desc: 陈控制住敌方小兵或者中立生物，并获得击杀金钱一定百分比的金钱。被劝化目标的最大生命值会被设为400。被劝化的单位将提升移动速度和伤害输出。陈自己的单位如果在3秒内未受到伤害可以在全地图范围内成为技能的目标，施放后取消劝化。
notes: 如果达到劝化生物的数量上限后再劝化生物，最早劝化的单位将立即死亡。
拥有阿哈利姆魔晶后可以对远古中立生物施放本技能。
升级此技能后在升级前劝化的单位并不会增加生命值。
劝化时单位的魔法恢复至满魔。
zh.shard: 神圣劝化可以对远古中立生物施放。根据上帝之手等级可以控制最多1/2/3个远古生物。使中立生物的部分技能额外升1级。

en.name: Martyrdom
en.desc: Sacrifice the life of this unit to damage an enemy for 25 + 20% of this unit's current health.  Allies may also be targeted for a heal with 50% of the damage value.

zh.name: 殉道
zh.desc: 牺牲这个单位的生命，对一个敌人造成伤害，伤害量为25 + 20%该单位当前生命值。友军也能成为目标，获得治疗效果，治疗量为50%伤害值。

en.name: Penitence
en.desc: Damages enemy unit, forces it to move slower and lets allies attack it more quickly.

zh.name: 赎罪
zh.desc: 对敌方单位造成伤害，并使其移动变慢，友军攻击他时攻速提升。

en.name: Zealot
en.desc:
Whenever Chen respawns, he is joined by a Zealot, a melee warrior creep with the ability to sacrifice itself to heal or deal damage to an enemy.  The Zealot receives Holy Persuasion's benefits and scales up with other lane melee creeps as game time increases and gains extra base damage.  The Zealot respawns next to Chen.

Zealot may be activated to teleport a unit under your control to Chen after a 6 second delay.  If Chen is targeted, it will teleport all units you control. Taking damage from enemy heroes or their units will cancel the teleport.

zh.name: 狂热者
zh.desc:
陈复活时都会带着一个狂热者加入战斗，这是近战小兵战士，可以牺牲自己治疗友军，或者对敌人造成伤害。狂热者会获得神圣劝化的加成效果，并且和其他线上近战小兵一样随着游戏时间的增加提升属性，获得额外基础攻击力。狂热者会在陈身边复活。

狂热者技能可以主动使用，在6秒延迟后把控制下的目标单位传送到陈的身边。如果陈是技能的目标，将传送控制的所有单位。受到来自敌方英雄及其单位的伤害会中止传送过程。

en.name: Bone and Arrow
en.desc: Clinkz summons a Skeleton Archer when he dies.

zh.name: 骨头和箭头
zh.desc: 克林克兹死亡时会召唤一个骷髅弓手。

en.name: Burning Army
en.desc: Summons a row of Burning Skeleton Archers in the target location.

zh.name: 烈焰之军
zh.desc: 在目标地点召唤一列烈焰骷髅弓手。

en.name: Burning Barrage
en.desc: CHANNELED - Clinkz channels and shoots multiple piercing arrows in the target direction that hit all enemy units dealing a percentage of Clinkz' attack damage and applying attack modifiers.
notes: Bonus Attack Range increases the length of Burning Barrage.

zh.name: 炽烈火雨
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 克林克兹持续施法，朝目标方向射出多支灼热的箭矢，击中所有敌人，造成克林克兹攻击伤害的一定百分比并施加攻击特效。
notes: 攻击距离加成会提升炽烈火雨的长度。

en.name: Death Pact
en.desc: Clinkz consumes the target enemy creep or friendly Skeleton Archer, healing and gaining max health. Does not take Clinkz out of Skeleton Walk.
notes: If the target is an enemy, Clinkz will gain the correct experience and gold.
Increases Clinkz' current and max HP.
When the duration ends, max HP returns to normal, but current HP stays the same.

zh.name: 死亡契约
zh.desc: 克林克兹以敌方非英雄单位或友方骷髅弓手为吞噬的目标，治疗并获得最大生命值。不会使克林克兹脱离骨隐步。
notes: 如果目标是敌方单位，克林克兹将获得经验和金钱。
克林克兹的当前血量和生命值上限都将提高。
持续时间结束后，血量上限回到正常值，但是当前生命值不变（不会高于血量上限）。

en.name: Infernal Shred
en.desc:
Clinkz and his skeletons apply a stacking debuff that causes their attacks to pierce up to 20% of the target's total physical armor (does not reduce their armor).  Clinkz applies 3% per attack, and skeletons apply 1%. 

Lasts 5 seconds.

zh.name: 地狱之裂
zh.desc:
克林克兹和他的骷髅弓手会施加一个可叠加的负面效果，使他们的攻击可以穿透最高目标20%总物理护甲（不会降低他们的护甲）。克林克兹每次攻击施加3%，骷髅弓手施加1%。

持续5秒。

en.name: Searing Arrows
en.desc:
Imbues Clinkz's arrows with fire for extra damage.

Skeleton Archers will fire Searing Arrows at targets Clinkz attacks for 50% damage.
notes: Searing Arrows deal damage to structures.
The damage is directly added to Clinkz' attack damage, as physical damage.

zh.name: 灼热之箭
zh.desc:
让克林克兹的箭矢带有火焰，造成更多伤害。

骷髅弓手在攻击克林克兹的攻击目标时会发射灼热之箭，造成50%伤害。
notes: 灼热之箭能对建筑造成伤害。
伤害直接作为物理伤害加到克林克兹的攻击伤害中。

en.name: Strafe
en.desc:
Clinkz gains attack speed and has bonus attack range. Any current Skeleton Archers within a 1200 radius of Clinkz also gain bonus attack range and 40% of the attack speed bonus. 

 Casting Strafe does not break Skeleton Walk invisibility.

zh.name: 扫射
zh.desc:
克林克兹获得攻击速度和攻击距离加成。克林克兹1200范围内现有的骷髅弓手也会获得攻击距离加成和40%攻击速度加成。

施放扫射不会脱离骨隐步的隐身状态。

en.name: Tar Bomb
en.desc:
Clinkz throws a projectile filled with tar at the target enemy, dealing Magic damage on impact. After impact, the tar spills onto the ground and stays there for 5 seconds. Any enemy that walks across it gets slowed, and attacks from Clinkz or his Skeleton Archers will deal bonus physical damage.

 When the Tar Bomb hits, any Skeleton Archers within attack range will attack the target. If autocast is activated, Clinkz will throw a tar bomb when attacking the target, if it is available.

zh.name: 焦油炸弹
zh.desc:
克林克兹对敌方目标扔出一个涂满焦油的弹道，击中时造成魔法伤害。击中后焦油会溅到地上，并留在地面上，持续5秒。经过的敌人都会被减速，并且受到来自克林克兹或他的骷髅弓手的攻击都会承受额外物理伤害。

焦油炸弹击中时，攻击距离内的骷髅弓手都会攻击该目标。如果设为自动施放，克林克兹会在技能可用的情况下攻击目标时扔出焦油炸弹。

en.name: Skeleton Walk
en.desc:
Clinkz moves invisibly through units until the moment he attacks or uses items. Leaving Skeleton Walk creates Skeleton Archers.

Skeleton Archers are immobile and die within multiple attacks from a hero or tower. Skeleton Archers deal a percentage of Clinkz' damage, and deal 75% less damage to buildings. Attack range is equal to Clinkz' attack range.
notes: Has a fadetime of 0.6 seconds.

zh.name: 骨隐步
zh.desc:
克林克兹进入隐身状态，移动可以穿过其他单位，攻击或使用物品时现形。脱离隐身后会产生骷髅弓手。

骷髅弓手不能移动，需要多次英雄或防御塔攻击才会被击杀。骷髅弓手继承克林克兹一定百分比的攻击力，对建筑造成的伤害降低75%。攻击距离与克林克兹相同。
notes: 渐隐时间为0.6秒。
stats: 骷髅弓手摧毁所需攻击次数：2

en.name: Auto Deliver
en.desc: Toggle auto delivering of items.

zh.name: 自动运送
zh.desc: 开关自动运送物品的功能。

en.name: Speed Burst
en.desc: The courier gains a burst of speed for 6 seconds

zh.name: 加速
zh.desc: 信使的速度得到极大提升，持续6秒

en.name: Go To Secret Shop
en.desc: Sends the courier to your team's secret shop

zh.name: 前往神秘商店
zh.desc: 派信使前往本方的神秘商店

en.name: Return Items
en.desc: Return items to stash

zh.name: 送回物品
zh.desc: 将物品运送回储藏处

en.name: Return to Base
en.desc: Returns the courier to base

zh.name: 返回基地
zh.desc: 命令信使返回基地

en.name: Shield
en.desc: Summons a protective shield around the courier

zh.name: 护盾
zh.desc: 在信使周围召唤一个护盾

en.name: Retrieve Items
en.desc: Retrieve items from stash

zh.name: 取回物品
zh.desc: 从储藏处取回物品

en.name: Transfer Items
en.desc: Transfer items to hero

zh.name: 运送物品
zh.desc: 将物品运送给英雄

en.name: Runty
en.desc: Runty Units Deal reduced damage to hero units.

zh.name: 绵力
zh.desc: 绵力单位对英雄单位造成的伤害会减少。

en.name: Piercing
en.desc: Piercing Units Deal Bonus Damage to non-hero, non-heavy units and reduced damage to heroes and heavy units.

zh.name: 穿刺
zh.desc: 穿刺单位对非英雄、非坚锐单位造成额外伤害，对英雄和坚锐单位造成的伤害减少。

en.name: Reinforced
en.desc: Reinforced Units and Buildings Deal Bonus Damage to other Reinforced Units and Buildings and take less attack damage from other units.

zh.name: 坚锐
zh.desc: 坚锐单位和建筑对其他坚锐单位和建筑造成额外伤害，并且受到其他单位的伤害变低。

en.name: Arcane Aura
en.desc:
Gives mana regeneration to all friendly units on the map. Allies within a 1200 radius of Crystal Maiden receive more mana regeneration.

Crystal Maiden passively gains mana regen amplification.

zh.name: 奥术光环
zh.desc:
地图上所有友方单位获得额外魔法恢复。水晶室女附近1200范围内友军获得更高的魔法恢复。

水晶室女被动获得魔法恢复增强。

en.name: Crystal Clone
en.desc: Slides in a direction, creating a crystal clone of herself in her place and disjointing incoming projectiles. If the clone takes enough damage or times out, it shatters, Frostbiting enemies in a 450 AoE around its place. The Clone can also be destroyed by Crystal Maiden's own spells.

zh.name: 冰晶克隆
zh.desc: 向一个方向滑行，在原地制造一个自身的冰晶克隆，并且躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。如果克隆受到了足量伤害，或者超过一定时间都会碎裂，对附近450范围内敌人施加冰封禁制。克隆体也可以被水晶室女自身的技能摧毁。

en.name: Crystal Nova
en.desc: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes: Crystal Nova provides vision in the targeted area for the duration.

zh.name: 冰霜新星
zh.desc: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
notes: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。

en.name: Freezing Field
en.desc: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with 100 random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts 10 seconds.
notes: The slow is applied on all enemies in the radius, even if they aren't hit by an explosion (lasts 1 second).
Explosions occur every 0.1 seconds.
en.scepter: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move 75% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by 20%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over -1s.

zh.name: 极寒领域
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤100次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续10秒。
notes: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续1秒）。
每0.1秒产生一次爆炸。
zh.scepter: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低75%。冰爆总数提升20%。对极寒领域内停留超过-1秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。

en.name: Stop Freezing Field
en.desc: Immediately stops the Freezing Field

zh.name: 停止极寒领域
zh.desc: 立刻停止极寒领域

en.name: Frostbite
en.desc: Encases an enemy unit in ice, prohibiting movement and attack, while dealing damage over time. Deals 4x damage to non-ancient creeps.
notes: Frostbite is considered a root.

zh.name: 冰封禁制
zh.desc: 操控冰霜包围一个敌方单位，禁止移动和攻击，并持续造成伤害。对非远古的普通单位施放将造成4倍伤害。
notes: 冰封禁制为捆缚效果。

en.name: Glacial Guard
en.desc: A portion of the mana Crystal Maiden spends on her abilities is converted into a physical barrier.

zh.name: 冰川护体
zh.desc: 水晶室女消耗在她技能上的一部分魔法会转化为物理护盾。

en.name: Quick Wit
en.desc:
Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

When Dark Seer levels up, he restores a percentage of his max health and mana.

zh.name: 才思敏捷
zh.desc:
黑暗贤者从每点智力获得1攻击速度。

黑暗贤者升级时会恢复最大生命值和魔法值的一定百分比。

en.name: Heart of Battle
en.desc: Dark Seer moves faster when near other heroes.
notes: Dark Seer gains 7% of the movement speed of heroes within 1200 radius. Base movement speed reduced.

zh.name: 战斗之心
zh.desc: 黑暗贤者靠近其他英雄时移动速度更快。
notes: 黑暗贤者获得1200范围内所有英雄的7%移动速度。基础移动速度减少。

en.name: Ion Shell
en.desc: Surrounds the target unit with a bristling shield that damages enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Deals small amounts of damage in 0.2 second intervals.
Doesn't damage the target it is cast on.
If cast on a unit that already has Ion Shell, the new Shell replaces the old one.

zh.name: 离子外壳
zh.desc: 将目标用一个尖刺之盾包裹起来，对周围的敌人造成伤害。
notes: 每0.2秒造成一次若干伤害。
离子外壳对其作用单位没有伤害。
如果对已经套上离子外壳的单位再次施放，新的离子外壳会取代旧的。

en.name: Mental Fortitude
en.desc: Dark Seer's Intelligence cannot be lower than the average of his Strength and Agility.
notes: If the average between his Strength and Agility is higher, he gains Bonus Intelligence to match them.

zh.name: 神智刚毅
zh.desc: 黑暗贤者的智力不会低于他的力量和敏捷的平均值。
notes: 如果他的力量和敏捷的平均值更高，那么他会获得额外智力与之匹配。

en.name: Normal Punch
en.desc: Passive ability. Causes Dark Seer's next attack on a hero to have True Strike, knock a replica out of the victim, damaging and stunning them based on how far Dark Seer has moved in the past 3 seconds. Max power is reached after 1100 distance moved.

zh.name: 普通一拳
zh.desc: 被动技能。使黑暗贤者下次对英雄的攻击具有克敌机先效果，可以打出目标的复制体，并且根据过去3秒内黑暗贤者的移动距离造成伤害和眩晕。移动1100距离以上将造成最大威力。

en.name: Quick Wit
en.desc: Dark Seer gains 1 Attack Speed from each point of Intelligence.

zh.name: 才思敏捷
zh.desc: 黑暗贤者从每点智力获得1攻击速度。

en.name: Surge
en.desc: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
notes: Units with Surge cannot be slowed unless the Surge effect is removed.
en.shard: Surged units leave behind a 150 radius trail that lasts 7s, slows enemies around it by 35% and deals 40 damage per second in 0.5s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.

zh.name: 奔腾
zh.desc: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
notes: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。
zh.shard: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为150，持续7秒，对附近的敌人造成35%减速，并且每秒造成40点伤害，伤害间隔为0.5秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。

en.name: Vacuum
en.desc: Dark Seer creates a vacuum over the target area that sucks in enemy units, disrupting them and dealing damage.
notes: This ability interrupts channeling.
Pulls units over 0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6 seconds before dealing damage.
Trees near the center of the vacuum will be destroyed.

zh.name: 真空
zh.desc: 黑暗贤者在目标区域制造一个真空环境，将周围的敌方单位吸入，具有打断效果并造成伤害。
notes: 此技能可以打断持续施法。
牵引过程为0.3 / 0.4 / 0.5 / 0.6秒，伤害在牵引后产生。
真空中央附近的树木将会被摧毁。

en.name: Wall of Replica
en.desc: Raises a wall of warping light that slows, damages, and creates replicas of any enemy hero who crosses it. Enemy replicas serve at the Dark Seer's will. Replicas last until they are destroyed, or until the wall's duration ends.
notes: Doesn't create illusions from other illusions.
There cannot be more than one illusion per player per wall.

zh.name: 复制之墙
zh.desc: 制造一堵扭曲的光墙，对穿过的敌方英雄造成伤害和减速，并复制一个其自身的幻象，幻象由黑暗贤者控制，持续到光墙消失，或者被敌人消灭。
notes: 幻象不会产生幻象。
每堵光墙同一时间产生的为一名英雄产生的幻象只有一个。

en.name: Ensnare
en.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner tosses netting around an enemy's feet, briefly immobilizing the unit, though the unit can still attack and use abilities.

zh.name: 诱捕
zh.desc: 黑暗巨魔召唤法师向一个敌人脚下扔出诱捕网，使他暂时无法移动，被网住的单位仍然可以攻击和使用技能。

en.name: Raise Dead
en.desc: The Dark Troll Summoner stirs the ground underfoot, raising the remains of trolls long dead, bringing to life three skeleton Warriors who will fight at his side.

zh.name: 亡灵复生
zh.desc: 黑暗巨魔召唤法师搅动脚下的大地，从死亡巨魔的尸体中招出三个骷髅战士为他作战。

en.name: Bedlam
en.desc: Dark Willow sends her pet wisp to roam around herself for the duration, rapidly attacking nearby enemies.  Bedlam cannot be used while Terrorize is active.

zh.name: 作祟
zh.desc: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物在持续时间内围绕自身飞行，快速攻击周围敌人。恐吓生效期间不能使用作祟。

en.name: Bramble Maze
en.desc: Dark Willow creates a 500 AoE maze of 8 brambles that grow in the target area after 0.3 seconds. Enemies that walk into a bramble are rooted and take damage over time. Lasts 12 seconds.
notes: Does not interrupt channeling spells upon rooting.

zh.name: 荆棘迷宫
zh.desc: 0.3秒后邪影芳灵在目标区域创造出500范围的迷宫，迷宫拥有8棵荆棘。进入荆棘的敌人将被缠绕，并且持续受到伤害。迷宫持续12秒。
notes: 缠绕无法打断持续施法。

en.name: Cursed Crown
en.desc: Dark Willow casts an ancient fae curse on the target. After a delay, the target and nearby enemies are stunned.
en.shard: Cursed Crown creates 4 brambles in a 175 radius around the target after the counter ends. Triggers even upon dispel. Cursed Crown cooldown reduced by 1.5 seconds.

zh.name: 诅咒王冠
zh.desc: 邪影芳灵授予敌人一顶被诅咒的古老仙灵王冠。经过一定延迟后，目标和周围的所有敌人都会被眩晕。
zh.shard: 诅咒王冠在倒计时结束时会围绕目标在175范围内产生4朵荆棘。即使效果被驱散也会触发。诅咒王冠的冷却时间减少1.5秒。

en.name: Pixie Dust
en.desc: Dark Willow gains 20% bonus Health and Mana Regeneration, increased to 100% while she is untargetable or invulnerable.

zh.name: 仙灵粉尘
zh.desc: 邪影芳灵获得额外20%生命恢复和魔法恢复，而她无法作为目标或无敌时将提升至100%。

en.name: Shadow Realm
en.desc: Dark Willow recedes into the shadows, becoming untargetable.  Her next attack has 600 bonus attack range and deals bonus magic damage, and will end Shadow Realm. Damage scales based on how long she remains under the effects of Shadow Realm, the maximum being reached after 3 seconds.
notes: Disjoints projectiles upon cast.
Grants phased movement.
Spells which require vision cannot affect Dark Willow in the Shadow Realm.
en.scepter: Attacking no longer takes Dark Willow out of Shadow Realm. Each attack still has bonus damage based on the duration of the buff.

zh.name: 暗影之境
zh.desc: 邪影芳灵遁入暗影之境，无法成为攻击或技能的目标。她的下次攻击具有600额外攻击距离，并且造成额外魔法伤害，暗影之境技能也会随之结束。在暗影中时间越长，伤害越高。在暗影之境内的时间超过3秒将达到最高伤害。
notes: 施法时能躲避弹道。
获得相位移动状态。
需要视野的技能无法作用于暗影之境中的邪影芳灵。
zh.scepter: 发动普通攻击不再使邪影芳灵脱离暗影之境。持续时间内每次攻击都带有额外伤害。

en.name: Terrorize
en.desc: Dark Willow releases her pet wisp to terrorize her enemies. After a short delay, all enemies in the target area become fearful and run toward their home fountain. Terrorize cannot be used while Bedlam is active.
notes: Terrorize provides vision on affected units.

zh.name: 恐吓
zh.desc: 邪影芳灵放出她的精灵宠物恐吓她的敌人。经过一定延迟后，目标区域内所有敌人变得害怕，朝自己的泉水狂奔。作祟开启期间不能使用恐吓。
notes: 恐吓提供受作用单位的视野。

en.name: Break of Dawn
en.desc: Whenever the sun comes out, Dawnbreaker gains bonus base damage and vision that decreases throughout the course of the day. If Dawnbreaker causes the day these bonuses are at full power for the entirety of that daytime.
en.scepter: Break of Dawn provides healing amplification equal to the current damage increase.

zh.name: 辰星破晓
zh.desc: 只要太阳出来，破晓辰星就会获得基础攻击力加成和额外视野，加成效果会在整个白天内逐渐降低。如果是破晓辰星制造的白天，在整个白天时间内加成效果始终是最大值。
zh.scepter: 辰星破晓提供治疗增强，数值等于当前攻击力提升。

en.name: Celestial Hammer
en.desc: Dawnbreaker hurls her weapon at a target, damaging enemies struck along the way. The hammer pauses for 2 seconds at the destination before flying back to her, leaving a trail of fire that slows enemies. Dawnbreaker can recall the hammer at any time, pulling her towards it so they meet in the middle.
notes: The hammer damages enemies both when thrown and when returning to Dawnbreaker.
Dawnbreaker's Converge movement distance is capped at the ability's cast range.
Starbreaker cannot be cast while the Hammer is out.

zh.name: 上界重锤
zh.desc: 破晓辰星向一个目标扔出她的武器，对沿途的敌人造成伤害。战锤会在目的地停留2秒，再飞回她的手中，期间留下一道炽烈之径，减缓敌人的移动速度。破晓辰星可以随时召回战锤，将自身朝战锤牵引，使二者在中点相遇。
notes: 战锤在飞出和飞回时都会对敌人造成伤害。
破晓辰星的会合移动距离不会超过技能的施法距离。
星破天惊无法在战锤脱手时施放。

en.name: Converge
en.desc: Dawnbreaker recalls her hammer, pulling them together so they meet in the middle.

zh.name: 会合
zh.desc: 破晓辰星召回她的战锤，使二者在中点相遇。

en.name: Starbreaker
en.desc: Dawnbreaker whirls her hammer around 3 times, damaging enemies with her attack plus bonus damage. On the final strike, she smashes her hammer down, stunning and damaging enemies in front of her.
notes: Dawnbreaker travels at a rate of 215 for the duration of the ability and takes a brief 0.2s to recover after the final strike.
Celestial Hammer or Solar Guardian cannot be cast during the combo.
Cleave does not work with this ability.
Can be self-cast to move forward.
The first two strikes will slow enemy movement speed by -100% for 0.12s.
en.shard: Dawnbreaker gains debuff immunity with 50% magic resistance and free movement during Starbreaker. Dawnbreaker is slowed by 35% down to a minimum of 215.

zh.name: 星破天惊
zh.desc: 破晓辰星将她的战锤旋转3次，对敌人造成攻击伤害以及额外伤害。最后一次打击时，她将战锤击向地面，对她前方的敌人造成眩晕和伤害。
notes: 破晓辰星在技能持续时间内以215的移动速度行进，并且最后一击后需要0.2秒才能复原。
连击期间无法施放上界重锤或天光现世。
此技能不继承分裂效果。
可以对自身施放来向前移动。
前两次挥击会减少敌人-100%移动速度，持续0.12秒。
zh.shard: 破晓辰星在星破天惊期间获得减益免疫，50%魔法抗性加成和自由移动状态。破晓辰星会被减速35%，移速最低为215。

en.name: Luminosity
en.desc: After a number of attacks, Dawnbreaker powers up, charging her next attack with a critical hit that heals all allied heroes within 650 units around her for a portion of attack damage dealt. Creeps and neutral enemies provide less healing. Allies are healed for 50% of the amount.
notes: Luminosity Heal is increased by sources of Health Restoration Amplification.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
en.scepter: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.

zh.name: 熠熠生辉
zh.desc: 破晓辰星在数次攻击后提升了力量，她的下一次攻击会造成致命一击，并治疗她附近650范围内所有友方英雄，治疗量为攻击伤害的一定百分比。攻击小兵和野怪产生的治疗量有所减少。对友军的治疗量为50%。
notes: 熠熠生辉的治疗效果可以通过生命回复增强效果获得提升。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
zh.scepter: Dawnbreaker gets 2 Luminosity attacks every time she powers up.
stats: 攻击普通单位治疗减少：40%

en.name: Solar Guardian
en.desc:
CHANNELED - Dawnbreaker creates a pulsing effect at a location within 350 units of an allied hero anywhere on the map and creates daylight for 6s. Each pulse damages enemies and heals allies.

After a short duration, she flies to the target location and deals additional damage and stuns enemies upon landing.

Once channeled, Dawnbreaker cannot stop the ability.
notes: Pulse interval is 0.5s.
Total flight duration is 1.7 seconds of channel time + 0.8 of flight time.
Instantly recalls the Hammer on cast.
en.scepter: Solar Guardian's aura follows Dawnbreaker for 2s after landing.

zh.name: 天光现世
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 破晓辰星在地图上任意友方英雄350距离内的一个地点创造一个脉冲效果，并制造持续6秒的白天。每次脉冲都会对敌人造成伤害，并治疗友军。经过一段短暂时间后，她飞向目标地点，落地时造成额外伤害并眩晕敌人。开始持续施法后，破晓辰星无法中止此技能。
notes: 脉冲间隔为0.5秒。
总飞行时间为1.7秒持续施法时间 + 0.8秒飞行时间。
施放时立刻召回战锤。
zh.scepter: 天光现世的光环在破晓辰星落地后会跟随2秒。

en.name: Weave
en.desc: Dazzle's abilities apply Weave to both allies and enemies they affect, increasing allied armor and reducing enemy armor. Multiple instances of this effect stack.
en.shard: Applying Weave to an ally heals them for 60 per stack of Weave.

zh.name: 编织
zh.desc: 戴泽的技能会对范围内友军和敌人同时施加编织，提升友军的护甲并减少敌人的护甲。本效果可以多次叠加。
zh.shard: 对友军施加编织时，每层编织效果治疗60点。

en.name: Nothl Boon
en.desc: Dazzle's overhealing is converted into a barrier. Weave is stronger on allies and amplifies incoming heals from Dazzle.
notes: Whenever Dazzle overheals himself or an ally, it grants that hero a physical damage barrier equal to the amount overhealed for 12 seconds. If the overhealed target already has a larger barrier its duration will be refreshed instead.

zh.name: 虚无之恩
zh.desc: 戴泽的超量治疗会转化为护盾。编织对友军的效果更强，还会增强来自戴泽的治疗效果。
notes: 每次戴泽对自身或友军产生超量治疗时，该英雄都会获得一个物理伤害护盾，数额等于超量治疗量，持续12秒。如果超量治疗的目标已经拥有数额更大的护盾，那将改为刷新其持续时间。

en.name: Nothl Projection
en.desc: Dazzle departs his body, traveling through the Nothl Realm as an invulnerable spirit that can cast spells, attack, and use items, leaving his body behind in the world with a visible tether. While active, Dazzle's basic abilities are empowered: Poison Touch hexes enemies, Shallow Grave heals upon expiration, and Shadow Wave has a shorter cooldown. The effect can be ended early, and Dazzle returns to the body at the end.
notes: When Dazzle's spirit is further than 1600 units from the body, the tether will begin to pull him back. The strength of the pull increases with distance.
Dazzle's Soul cannot attack buildings.
en.shard: Nothl Projection can be cast while Dazzle is disabled. Increases healing done while in the Nothl Realm.

zh.name: 虚无投影
zh.desc:
戴泽的灵魂离开身体，穿过虚无之境变成无敌的幽灵，可以施放技能、攻击和使用物品，他的身体还留在这个世界，和灵魂之间存在着可见的连接。在灵魂形态下，戴泽的基础技能都已强化：
剧毒之触带有妖术效果；
薄葬结束时会治疗；
暗影波的冷却时间变短。

效果可以提前结束，效果结束时戴泽的灵魂会返回身体。
notes: 戴泽的灵魂离开身体超过1600距离后会被拉向身体。戴泽的灵魂移动得越远，拉力就越大。
戴泽的灵魂不能攻击建筑。
zh.shard: 虚无投影可以在戴泽被控制时施放。他在虚无之境时治疗效果得到增强。

en.name: End Projection
en.desc: Ends Dazzle's sojourn in the Nothl Realm and returns his spirit to his body.

zh.name: 结束投影
zh.desc: 结束戴泽在虚无之境的逗留，让他的灵魂回到他的身体。

en.name: Poison Touch
en.desc: Releases a cone of poison that strikes multiple enemy units. Deals damage over time and slows the targets. Anytime the targets get attacked by Dazzle, the debuff duration is refreshed and slow is increased.
notes: The damage is not reduced by damage block abilities.

zh.name: 剧毒之触
zh.desc: 施放一股锥形的毒素，可以打击多个敌方单位。造成持续伤害和减速。每当目标受到戴泽的攻击，负面效果的持续时间都会刷新，减速效果也会提升。
notes: 伤害格挡类技能不能减少该技能伤害。

en.name: Shadow Wave
en.desc: Sends out a bolt of power that arcs between allies, healing them while damaging any enemy units standing nearby.  Dazzle is always healed by Shadow Wave.
notes: Prioritizes allied heroes over creeps.
If enemies are near multiple allied units affected by Shadow Wave, they will take multiple instances of damage.
en.scepter: Shadow Wave can now target and bounce between enemies in addition to allies. When bouncing to an enemy, they will take damage and heal nearby allies equal to 100% of the normal healing and damage values. Dazzle will also perform an attack against any enemy that Shadow Wave bounces to.

zh.name: 暗影波
zh.desc: 放出一道能量弧，可以瞬间跳跃至目标附近的队友，治疗的同时还将对附近的敌方单位造成伤害。施放暗影波时戴泽必定会享受到治疗效果。
notes: 优先治疗友方英雄
如果敌军附近有多个我方单位，那么他将受到多重暗影波的伤害。
