zh.scepter: 暗影波现在也可对敌人施放，在友军和敌人之间都可以弹跳。弹跳至敌人时，他们会受到伤害，并且治疗附近友军，数值为100%平常治疗和伤害量。戴泽还会对暗影波弹跳到的每个敌人发动一次攻击。

en.name: Shallow Grave
en.desc: An ally blessed with Shallow Grave, no matter how close to death, cannot die while under its protection. Healing on that ally is also amplified for the duration based on the hero's HP.
notes: HP cannot go below 1 while under the effects of Shallow Grave, but Axe's Culling Blade will still kill the hero.

zh.name: 薄葬
zh.desc: 友军身受薄葬的福佑，在其保护下不论受到多大的伤害都不会阵亡。对该友军的治疗效果在持续时间内也会根据其生命值得到增强。
notes: 在薄葬作用下生命值至少为1点，但是斧王的淘汰之刃还是可以斩杀目标英雄。

en.name: Crypt Swarm
en.desc: Sends a swarm of winged beasts to savage enemy units in front of Death Prophet.
notes: Can hit units up to 1110 range away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 地穴虫群
zh.desc: 召唤一群食腐虫在死亡先知面前的敌人中肆虐。
notes: 最远能伤害1110距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Exorcism
en.desc: Unleashes evil spirits to drain the life of nearby enemy units and structures. Spirits need to return back to Death Prophet in order to attack again. At the end of the spell's duration, Death Prophet is healed in proportion to the damage dealt. Deals 50% damage to buildings. Lasts 40 seconds.
notes: Radius represents the area in which the spirits will acquire targets around Death Prophet.
Spirit damage isn't reduced by damage block abilities.
en.scepter: Whenever an enemy is affected by Death Prophet's spells or when she attacks an enemy, a ghost will fly out and hit the enemy for an increased bonus of its usual damage then return to her with life.

zh.name: 驱使恶灵
zh.desc: 释放恶灵偷走敌方单位和建筑的生命。恶灵需要回到她身上才能再次攻击。持续时间结束后，死亡先知根据造成的伤害量，获得一定比例的治疗。对建筑造成50%伤害。持续40秒。
notes: 作用范围代表死亡先知周围的恶灵寻找目标的范围。
伤害格挡类技能不能减少恶灵伤害。
zh.scepter: 敌人受到死亡先知的技能作用，或被死亡先知攻击时，会有一只恶灵飞出攻击敌人，造成高于平常的伤害，再返回使自身回复生命。

en.name: Mourning Ritual
en.desc: Death Prophet delays a percentage of incoming damage, taking the damage in even intervals over a short duration.
notes: Delayed damage matches the damage type of the initial damage and bypasses armor, magic resistance, and damage block.

zh.name: 哀悼仪式
zh.desc: 死亡先知延缓承受一定百分比的伤害，短时间内每隔一段时间受到伤害。
notes: 延缓的伤害与初始伤害的类型相同，并且无视护甲、魔法抗性和伤害格挡。

en.name: Silence
en.desc: Fires a projectile that prevents enemy units in a target area from casting spells.
notes: Doesn't prevent usage of items.

zh.name: 沉默魔法
zh.desc: 放出一个弹道，阻止目标区域内的敌人施放魔法。
notes: 不能阻止使用物品。

en.name: Spirit Collector
en.desc: Hero deaths empower your next Exorcism.
notes:
Whenever a hero dies, Death Prophet traps their spirit for later use. When she casts Exorcism, each trapped hero spirit will replace a standard spirit. Hero spirits deal more damage than standard spirits.

When a hero is killed while Exorcism is active a standard spirit will be replaced with a hero spirit if possible and stored for the next cast of Exorcism.
Includes Death Prophet's own death.

zh.name: 灵魂收集
zh.desc: 英雄的死亡会使下次驱使恶灵的威力增加。
notes:
每当英雄阵亡，死亡先知都会俘获他们的灵魂以备后用。她施放驱使恶灵后，每个被俘获的英雄灵魂都会取代标准的恶灵。英雄灵魂造成的伤害比标准恶灵更高。

驱使恶灵开启时有英雄阵亡的话，也会在可能的情况下让英雄灵魂取代标准恶灵，同时储存用作下次驱使恶灵。
包括死亡先知自己的死亡。

en.name: Spirit Siphon
en.desc: Creates a spirit link between Death Prophet and an enemy unit, draining health from the enemy.
notes: Cannot cast multiple on same target.
en.shard: Increases Spirit Siphon charges by 1 and causes enemies to be feared for 1 seconds if they are siphoned for 3 seconds consecutively.

zh.name: 吸魂巫术
zh.desc: 创造一个灵魂连接，将死亡先知与一个敌方单位相连。每秒吸取生命值。
notes: 多个连接不能同时作用于一个目标。
zh.shard: 吸魂巫术的能量点数提升1点，敌人连续3秒受到吸魂巫术作用后会被恐惧1秒。

en.name: Witchcraft
en.desc: Death Prophet's occult knowledge deepens with experience, gaining movement speed and spell cooldown reduction.

zh.name: 巫术精研
zh.desc: 死亡先知的神秘学识随着经验积累而加深，获得移动速度和技能冷却时间减少。

en.name: Electromagnetic Repulsion
en.desc: Whenever Disruptor takes more than 250 damage from any source within 400 radius, all nearby enemies within take damage equal to 1.5x of Disruptor's Intelligence, and are pushed back up to a 400 distance away.
notes: After 7s, the damage counter is reset.

zh.name: 电磁排斥
zh.desc: 每当干扰者受到400范围内来自任意来源的250点伤害，附近所有敌人都会受到1.5倍干扰者智力值的伤害，并且被推开最多400距离。
notes: 7秒后伤害计数会重置。

en.name: Glimpse
en.desc: Teleports the target hero back to where it was 4 seconds ago.  Instantly kills illusions. Deals damage equal to a percentage of the distance glimpsed, that cannot go over a damage maximum.
notes: The travel time is a function of the distance the target will travel.

zh.name: 恶念瞥视
zh.desc: 将目标英雄传送回他4秒前所在位置。瞬间消灭幻象单位。根据瞥视距离的一定百分比造成伤害，不能超过最大伤害。
notes: 飞行时间由目标的飞行距离决定。

en.name: Kinetic Fence
en.desc: After a short formation time, creates a wall out of kinetic energy that enemies cannot pass.

zh.name: 动能栅栏
zh.desc: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一面敌人无法通过的动能墙壁。

en.name: Kinetic Field
en.desc: After a short formation time, creates a circular barrier of kinetic energy that enemies can't pass.
notes: Debuff Immune units can travel through the field.
en.shard: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

zh.name: 动能力场
zh.desc: 在短暂的构造时间后，创造一个敌人无法通过的环形动能屏障。
notes: 力场不能困住减益免疫单位。
zh.shard: Both shapes have an independent cooldown.

en.name: Static Storm
en.desc: Creates a damaging static storm that also silences all enemy units in the area for the duration.  The damage starts off weak, but increases in power over the duration.
en.scepter: Mutes items.

zh.name: 静态风暴
zh.desc: 创造一场静态风暴，在持续时间内伤害并沉默区域内的所有敌方单位。伤害刚开始时很低，但会在持续时间内逐渐增加。
zh.scepter: 锁闭物品。

en.name: Thunder Strike
en.desc: Repeatedly strikes the targeted unit with lightning.  Each strike damages nearby enemy units in a small radius and slows enemy movement and attack speed by 100% for 0.3 seconds.  Provides vision of its target.
en.shard: Increases the cast range and strike count of Thunder Strike. It can now also be ground targeted, where it will lie dormant for up to 4 seconds and attach to the first enemy that comes within the radius.

zh.name: 风雷之击
zh.desc: 用闪电反复打击目标单位。每次打击会伤害附近小范围内的敌方单位，并施加0.3秒的100%攻击速度和移动速度降低效果。提供目标的视野。
zh.shard: 提升风雷之击的施法距离和打击次数。还可以对地施放，使风雷之击先潜伏最多4秒，并附着到第一个进入作用范围的敌人身上。

en.name: Devil's Bargain
en.desc: Temporarily Disabled

zh.name: 恶魔的交易
zh.desc: Temporarily Disabled

en.name: Devour
en.desc: Consumes an enemy or neutral creep, acquiring any special abilities that it possessed. If alt-cast is activated, Doom will not acquire the creep's abilities. Duration is equal to the cooldown.
notes: Gives Doom the original bounty of the creep, along with the bonus gold.
If you devour a creep without abilities, you'll keep the abilities you had previously.
en.shard: Devour has 2 charges and can target Ancients. Stolen creep abilities have 15% increased AoE and 40% increased spell amplification.

zh.name: 吞噬
zh.desc: 消化一个敌军或中立生物，获得其特殊技能。开启多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，末日使者不会获得其技能。持续时间与冷却时间相同。
notes: 末日使者将获得该生物的正常金钱，还有技能的额外金钱。
如果吞噬的单位没有技能，之前获得的技能将会保留。
zh.shard: 吞噬拥有2点能量点数，能以远古生物为目标。获得的野怪技能拥有15%额外作用范围和40%额外技能增强。

en.name: Doom
en.desc:
Inflicts a curse that dispels an enemy and prevents them from casting spells or healing in any way, while taking damage over time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
en.scepter: Doom applies Break to enemies. Allies in a 350 radius around the doomed target also suffer the effects of Doom. Allows Doom to be self-cast to affect enemies around himself with Doom.

zh.name: 末日
zh.desc:
对敌人施加末日诅咒，对其进行驱散，并且使其无法施放技能或获得任何治疗效果，同时造成持续伤害。

驱散类型：弱驱散
zh.scepter: 末日对敌人施加破坏效果。末日作用下目标350范围内友军也会受到末日的作用。可以对自身施放末日，使末日作用于末日使者周围的敌人。

en.name: Devoured Ability
en.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

zh.name: 技能（来自吞噬）
zh.desc: 本技能栏在使用吞噬获得技能后可以使用。

en.name: Devoured Ability
en.desc: This slot will be replaced with abilities acquired using Devour.

zh.name: 技能（来自吞噬）
zh.desc: 本技能栏在使用吞噬获得技能后可以使用。

en.name: Infernal Blade
en.desc: Doom swings his burning sword, igniting the enemy. Stuns for 0.66 seconds and applies a 4 second burn that deals a base damage plus a percentage of the target's Max HP as damage per second.
notes: Interrupts channeling abilities.

zh.name: 阎刃
zh.desc: 末日挥舞他的炽烈之剑，将敌人点燃。造成0.66秒眩晕，并施加一个燃烧效果，持续4秒，每秒造成伤害，数值为基础伤害+目标最大生命值的一定百分比。
notes: 可以打断持续施法类技能。

en.name: Lvl ? Pain
en.desc: Doom's attacks curse enemy heroes. After 2.5s, the cursed hero bursts with a pillar of fire, damaging itself and all units in a 66 AoE for 10% of the damage taken from Doom during the curse. The damage and radius of the curse is 66% stronger if the enemy's level is a multiple of 6.
notes: Also applies to all attacks when Doom is at max level.

zh.name: 等级？痛苦
zh.desc: 末日使者的攻击会诅咒敌方英雄。2.5秒后，被诅咒的英雄会爆发出一根火柱，对自身和66范围内所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量为诅咒期间内承受来自末日使者的10%伤害。如果被诅咒的英雄等级为6的倍数，诅咒的伤害和作用范围会提升66%。
notes: 末日使者达到满级后也会生效。

en.name: Scorched Earth
en.desc: Carpets the nearby earth in flames which damage enemies, while also granting Doom increased movement speed and health regeneration.
notes: Scorched Earth follows Doom, centered on his location.

zh.name: 焦土
zh.desc: 用火焰覆盖周围的土地，对敌人造成伤害，同时末日使者的移动速度和生命恢复得到提升。
notes: 焦土会跟随末日使者，以他所在位置为中心。

en.name: Breathe Fire
en.desc: Unleashes a breath of fire in front of Dragon Knight that burns enemies and reduces the damage their attacks deal.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 火焰气息
zh.desc: 向龙骑士的前方喷射出一团火焰，烧灼碰到的敌人，并使其攻击力降低。
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Dragon Blood
en.desc:
The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's health regeneration and armor.  

Regen and armor are increased by 50% during Elder Dragon Form.

zh.name: 龙族血统
zh.desc:
神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的生命恢复和护甲。

在古龙形态下生命恢复和护甲均提升50%。

en.name: Dragon Tail
en.desc: Dragon Knight smites an enemy unit with his shield, stunning and damaging it and units close to it.

zh.name: 神龙摆尾
zh.desc: 龙骑士用盾对身边的一个敌方单位进行打击，对它和它身边的目标造成眩晕和伤害。

en.name: Elder Dragon Form
en.desc:
Dragon Knight assumes the form of the Elder Dragon, increasing the range of his abilities, gaining bonus movement speed, and a ranged attack with various properties.  The Dragon evolves per level. The bonuses are cumulative. 

Level 1 Green: Grants a corrosive damage over time that can also damage buildings.

Level 2 Red: Grants splash damage to the dragon's attacks.

Level 3 Blue: Grants a debuff immunity piercing movement and attack frost slow on attack.
en.scepter: Increases the current level of Dragon Form by one. Adds a Level 4 Black Dragon that has free pathing, bonus magic resistance, and increased other bonuses.

zh.name: 古龙形态
zh.desc:
龙骑士化身为古龙，提升了技能的施法距离，获得移动速度加成，和拥有各种特性的远程攻击。古龙每级都会进化。加成效果会累加。

1级碧龙：攻击获得持续的腐蚀伤害，也能作用于建筑。

2级赤龙：攻击获得溅射伤害。

3级苍龙：攻击获得无视减益免疫的移动速度和攻击速度降低效果。
zh.scepter: 使古龙形态的当前等级提升1级。增加的4级黑龙拥有自由移动，魔法抗性加成和其他更高的加成效果。

en.name: Fireball
en.desc: Ignites an area, dealing damage over time that lingers on enemies in it. Has reduced cast range when melee.

zh.name: 龙炎火球
zh.desc: 点燃一片区域，对其中的敌人持续造成伤害，伤害效果还会粘滞。近战形态下施放距离较近。

en.name: Wyrm's Wrath
en.desc: The life blood of the Dragon improves Dragon Knight's abilities and items to have increased AoE and causes his attacks to deal additional magic damage to enemy units.

zh.name: 飞龙之怒
zh.desc: 神龙的生命之血提升了龙骑士的技能和物品，使其拥有作用范围加成，并且攻击会对敌方单位造成额外魔法伤害。

en.name: Frost Arrows
en.desc: Adds a freezing effect to Drow's attacks, slowing enemy movement and dealing bonus damage.  Slow lasts 1.5 seconds.
notes: The slow duration is refreshed on successive casts.
en.scepter: Frost Arrows now apply a Hypothermia stack to enemies, increasing damage from Frost Arrows and reducing their Health Restoration per stack. If an enemy dies with Hypothermia stacks, they burst and deal damage per stack and slow in an area around it.

zh.name: 霜冻之箭
zh.desc: 卓尔游侠在箭矢中附上冰冻效果，减缓敌人的移动速度并造成额外伤害。持续1.5秒。
notes: 减速的持续时间在下一支冰箭射中后刷新。
zh.scepter: 霜冻之箭现在对敌人施加低温的叠加效果，提升霜冻之箭的伤害，并且每层叠加效果都会降低生命回复。若敌人在低温效果下阵亡，他们将会爆炸，对范围内的敌人造成伤害和减速。
stats: 每层叠加生命回复降低：10%

en.name: Glacier
en.desc:
Drow creates a hill of ice beneath her, knocking away nearby enemies. Units on the hill gain flying vision and Drow and her ranged allies gain bonus attack range. Drow gains additional damage while on the Glacier and attacking targets below her.

The front of the hill obscures vision and cannot be moved through except by Drow. Does not interrupt Multishot when cast.

zh.name: 冰川
zh.desc:
卓尔游侠在她脚下创造一片冰山，击退附近的敌人。站在山上的单位会获得飞行视野，而卓尔游侠和她的远程友军会获得攻击距离加成。卓尔游侠站在山上时攻击下方目标时获得额外伤害。

山的前面会阻挡视野，并且除了卓尔游侠外无法穿行。施放时不会打断数箭齐发。

en.name: Marksmanship
en.desc: Drow's experiences in battle grant her a chance to launch arrows with incredible accuracy and effectiveness. Pierces through the enemy's defenses, ignoring their base armor. This ability is disabled if there is an enemy hero within 300 range.
notes: Marksmanship procs have true strike.

zh.name: 射手天赋
zh.desc: 卓尔游侠的战斗经验使她有概率发出极其精准高效的箭矢。箭矢将穿透敌人的防御，无视他们的基础护甲。如果300范围内有敌方英雄，本技能没有效果。
notes: 射手天赋的触发效果拥有克敌机先。

en.name: Multishot
en.desc:
CHANNELED - Drow releases a flurry of arrows in continuous salvos, hitting enemies for extra damage and applying Frost Arrows with a range of Drow's Attack Range + 475. Lasts up to 1.75 seconds.

Drow can move slowly and use items while casting Multishot.
notes: Arrow base damage pierces magic immunity.
Frost Arrows' damage and slow do not pierce magic immunity.

zh.name: 数箭齐发
zh.desc:
持续施法 - 卓尔游侠在最多1.75秒内不断地射出阵阵箭矢，对卓尔游侠攻击距离 + 475的距离内击中的敌人造成额外伤害，并施加霜冻之箭效果。

卓尔游侠在施放数箭齐发时可以缓慢移动和使用物品。
notes: 箭矢的基础伤害无视减益免疫。
霜冻之箭的额外伤害和减速效果不无视减益免疫。

en.name: Precision Aura
en.desc: Grants Drow bonus agility based on Drow's current agility and level. Nearby ranged heroes received 50% of the bonus agility.

zh.name: 精准光环
zh.desc: 卓尔游侠根据她自身的当前敏捷和英雄等级获得敏捷加成。附近远程英雄获得50%敏捷加成。

en.name: Gust
en.desc: Releases a wave that silences and knocks back and reveals invisible enemy units. Knockback distance is relative to how close they are to Drow.

zh.name: 狂风
zh.desc: 释放一阵狂风，沉默敌方单位并将其击退，同时使隐身敌人显形。击退距离与敌人和卓尔游侠的距离成反比。

en.name: Boulder Smash
en.desc: Earth Spirit smashes the target enemy or ally, sending them in the direction he is facing. If Earth Spirit targets an area, he will smash the nearest unit in a 200 radius, prioritizing Stone Remnants. The travelling unit or Remnant damages all enemy units it hits.  If an enemy is hit by a Stone Remnant, they are also slowed. Stone Remnants travel further than other units.

zh.name: 巨石冲击
zh.desc: 大地之灵将敌方单位或友方单位作为目标，将其击飞，目标将沿他面朝的方向飞行一段距离。如果大地之灵点地为目标，他将击飞200范围内距离最近的单位，优先以残岩为目标。击飞的单位或残岩会对碰到的所有单位造成伤害。如果敌人是被残岩击中还将额外被减速。残岩被击飞的距离比其他单位更远。

en.name: Geomagnetic Grip
en.desc:
Earth Spirit pulls the target Stone Remnant or Allied Unit. Enemies struck by the gripped target will be silenced.

Pulled Remnants also deal damage to struck enemies.

Cast range is reduced when targeting an ally.
notes: Will not work on a unit inside Chronosphere, Duel, or Black Hole.
Geomagnetic Grip can also target allied creeps.
en.shard: Decreases cooldown to 13s and increases allied unit cast range and pull speed.

zh.name: 地磁之握
zh.desc:
大地之灵将目标残岩或友方单位拉扯到自己所在的位置，行进路径上被击中的敌人都会被沉默并受到伤害。

拉扯的残岩也会对击中的敌人造成伤害。

以友军为目标时施法距离减少。
notes: 如果目标处于时间结界，决斗或黑洞之中则不起作用。
地磁之握还可以对友方小兵施放。
zh.shard: 冷却时间减少至13秒，对友方单位的施法距离和牵引速度提升。

en.name: Magnetize
en.desc: Magnetizes units in a small nearby area, causing them to take damage for a short duration. Magnetized heroes cause nearby Stone Remnants to explode, destroying the remnant and refreshing Magnetize's duration on all nearby enemies. This process can repeat multiple times. If an enemy hero is affected by Geomagnetic Grip or Boulder Smash, all magnetized heroes share the effects.

zh.name: 磁化
zh.desc: 将附近小范围内的敌方单位磁化，使其短时间内受到伤害。被磁化的英雄单位将会引起附近残岩的爆炸，每次爆炸都将摧毁残岩并刷新残岩附近单位身上的磁化时间（若附近单位未被磁化则为其施加一个磁化效果）。该过程可重复数次。如果一个被磁化的英雄受到了地磁之握或巨石冲击的作用，那么所有被磁化的英雄都会受到同样效果。
stats: 残岩刷新/爆炸作用范围：600

en.name: Enchant Remnant
en.desc:
Earth Spirit temporarily enchants a hero, granting them the properties of a Stone Remnant. After a short duration the remnant shatters, releasing the hero and damaging nearby enemies. 
Can be cast on Stone Remnants. Has a 5 second cooldown when used that way.
Has a larger cast range when cast on an ally hero.
notes: Earth Spirit himself can be targeted by Boulder Smash if he is enchanted.

zh.name: 残岩魔咒
zh.desc:
大地之灵对一名英雄施法，使其暂时获得残岩的属性。经过短时间后残岩就会碎裂，释放出英雄，并对周围单位造成伤害。

可以对残岩施放。对残岩施放时冷却时间为5秒。
对友方英雄施放时施法距离更远。
notes: 如果大地之灵自身受到残岩魔咒的效果，也可以成为巨石冲击的目标。

en.name: Rolling Boulder
en.desc: Earth Spirit gathers himself into a boulder and, after a 0.6s delay, rolls toward the target location, dealing 60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + 100% STR damage and stunning enemy units. He will stop if he collides with an enemy hero or is stunned. If he rolls over a Stone Remnant, he will travel further and faster, and stun enemies for longer.
notes: Rolling over a Stone Remnant will destroy the Remnant.
The boulder has a radius of 160.
Earth Spirit is untargetable and invulnerable while rolling.

zh.name: 巨石翻滚
zh.desc: 大地之灵化身为巨石，经过0.6秒延迟后向目标位置翻滚，对经过的敌人造成伤害和眩晕，伤害值为60 / 70 / 80 / 90 + 100%力量。如果撞到敌方英雄或自身被眩晕，翻滚都会中止。如果翻滚过程中经过残岩将会大幅提高翻滚距离和速度，造成的眩晕时间更长。
notes: 翻滚时经过残岩会将其摧毁。
巨石的作用范围为160。
大地之灵在滚动时无法作为目标，而且无敌。

en.name: Stone Remnant
en.desc:
Call a Stone Remnant to the target location.  Stone Remnants have no vision and are invulnerable, and can be used with Earth Spirit's abilities.  Calling a Stone Remnant consumes a charge, which recharge over time. Stone Remnant has 7 charges.

Earth Spirit passively gains 3% bonus damage per unused Stone Remnant charge, and gains an additional 7.5% bonus damage for 10s when a Stone Remnant is targeted with an ability (does not stack).

zh.name: 残岩
zh.desc:
在指定位置召唤一块残岩。残岩没有视野，为无敌状态，可以加强大地之灵的技能效果。召唤残岩需要消耗一点能量点数，能量点数会随时间恢复。残岩拥有7点能量点数。

每点未使用的残岩能量都会使大地之灵被动获得3%攻击力加成，并且技能用过残岩后会额外获得7.5%攻击力加成，持续10秒（无法叠加）。

en.name: Aftershock
en.desc: Causes the earth to shake underfoot, adding additional damage and stuns to nearby enemy units when Earthshaker casts his abilities.
notes: Using items does not trigger Aftershock.

zh.name: 余震
zh.desc: 撼地者施放技能时会引起脚下的大地震动，眩晕附近的敌方单位并造成额外伤害。
notes: 使用物品不会触发余震。

en.name: Echo Slam
en.desc: Shockwaves travel through the ground, damaging enemy units.  Each enemy hit causes an echo to damage nearby units. Real heroes cause two echoes.

zh.name: 回音击
zh.desc: 穿过地面的冲击波，伤害敌方单位。每个受到攻击的敌人都会引起伤害附近单位的反射波。英雄本体将引起两次反射。

en.name: Enchant Totem
en.desc: Empowers Earthshaker's totem, causing it to deal extra damage and have 100 bonus attack range on the next attack.
notes: Bonus damage is based on base damage and that given by primary attribute.
en.scepter: Enchant Totem becomes a ground target ability, causing Earthshaker to jump in the air and land at the target spot, casting Enchant Totem there.  Self-casting the ability will behave in the original form, without jumping. Grants Enchant Totem a cleaving attack.

zh.name: 强化图腾
zh.desc: 强化撼地者的图腾，使下次攻击拥有额外攻击力和100攻击距离加成。
notes: 攻击力加成是基于基础攻击力和主属性数值。
zh.scepter: 强化图腾可以对地施放，施放后会跳至半空中再降落至目标地点，在目标地点施放强化图腾。双击技能会按原技能施放，不会跳跃。强化图腾拥有分裂效果。

en.name: Fissure
en.desc: Slams the ground with a mighty totem, creating an impassable ridge of stone while stunning and damaging enemy units along its line.
notes: Creeps will wait for Fissure to disappear. They will not attempt to walk around it.
Fissure is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
en.shard: Reduces Fissure cooldown and releases an Aftershock along its path that stuns for a shortened duration when Earthshaker casts another ability.

zh.name: 沟壑
zh.desc: 用威武的图腾猛击地面，沿直线裂开地面，制造一条无法通过的岩脊，对沿途的敌方单位造成眩晕和伤害。
notes: 小兵将会等待沟壑消失，不会去尝试绕开它。
沟壑不会被林肯法球抵挡。
zh.shard: 降低沟壑的冷却时间，并且撼地者每次施放其他技能时都会沿着沟壑释放余震，造成眩晕的时间有所降低。

en.name: Slugger
en.desc: Enemies killed with Enchant Totem or Earthshaker's other abilities are sent flying, dealing damage to enemies they hit.
stats: FLYING ENEMY'S MAX HEALTH AS DAMAGE: 7%

zh.name: 强击图腾
zh.desc: 利用强化图腾的攻击或撼地者的其他技能击杀敌人后都会把尸体击飞，对击中的敌人造成伤害。
stats: 击飞敌人的最大生命值伤害：7%

en.name: Spirit Cairn
en.desc: When Earthshaker dies, a 75 radius fissure is created where he died. This fissure blocks movement and allows Earthshaker to continue to gain experience around it. It remains until Earthshaker respawns.

zh.name: 灵魂石冢
zh.desc: 撼地者死亡时会在他阵亡的地点产生一道75范围的沟壑。这道沟壑会阻碍移动，并且使撼地者持续获得周围的经验。沟壑会一直持续到撼地者复活。

en.name: Astral Spirit
en.desc:
Elder Titan sends forth his Astral Spirit, damaging any units it passes through.  When the spirit rejoins the Titan, it grants bonus damage and movement speed for each unit it passed through.

The Astral Spirit possesses the Echo Stomp, Return Spirit, and Natural Order abilities.
en.scepter: Causes Elder Titan to become debuff immune and gain 50% magic resistance for 2 seconds per affected enemy Hero when the spirit returns.

zh.name: 灵体游魂
zh.desc:
上古巨神放出他的灵体游魂，灵魂对任何经过的单位都会造成伤害。当它与巨神合体时，它每伤害过一个单位都会给予若干攻击力和移动速度加成。

灵体游魂拥有回音重踏，回归和自然秩序三个技能。
zh.scepter: 游魂每碰到一名英雄就能使上古巨神在游魂回归后获得2秒减益免疫状态和50%魔法抗性提升。

en.name: Earth Splitter
en.desc: Sends forth a jagged crack in front of Elder Titan. After 3 seconds, the crack implodes, slowing movement while dealing damage to each enemy based on their maximum life. Half of the damage dealt is Magical damage, while the other half is Physical damage.

zh.name: 裂地沟壑
zh.desc: 上古巨神向前方放出一道不平坦的裂纹。3秒后裂纹塌陷，范围内的单位将被减速，并受到基于他们自身生命最大值的伤害。其中一半伤害为魔法伤害，另一半为物理伤害。

en.name: Echo Stomp
en.desc: CHANNELED - Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.
notes: If a unit is hit by Astral Spirit and Elder Titan, they will take both instances of damage.
en.shard: Lowers Cooldown. Echo Stomp may be placed on alt-cast to allow Elder Titan to take the place of the Astral Spirit as it completes its stomp.

zh.name: 回音重踏
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。
notes: 若同时处于灵体游魂和上古巨神的回音重踏作用范围内将受到两次伤害。
zh.shard: 减少冷却时间。回音重踏可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，使上古巨神完成重踏后会取代灵体游魂。

en.name: Echo Stomp
en.desc: Elder Titan and his Astral Spirit both stomp the ground, damaging and knocking nearby enemy units unconscious around their locations.  The Elder Titan stomp deals physical damage, while the Spirit stomp deals magical damage.  Unconscious enemies will wake if they take damage.

zh.name: 回音重踏
zh.desc: 上古巨神与他的灵体游魂一起践踏地面，对敌方单位造成伤害并使他们在原地昏迷。上古巨神造成物理伤害，灵体游魂造成魔法伤害。昏迷的敌人受到伤害会被惊醒。

en.name: Momentum
en.desc: Elder Titan gains armor equal to a percentage of his bonus movement speed.
notes: Bonus movement speed is any movement speed above his base movement speed.
Momentum does not reduce Elder Titan's Armor if he is slowed below his base movement speed.

zh.name: 动量
zh.desc: 上古巨神获得额外护甲，数值为移动速度加成的一定百分比。
notes: 移动速度加成是指高于基础移动速度的部分。
上古巨神被减速到低于基础移动速度时动量不会降低上古巨神的护甲。

en.name: Move Astral Spirit
en.desc: Moves the Astral Spirit to target location.

zh.name: 移动灵体游魂
zh.desc: 将灵体游魂向目标地点移动。

en.name: Natural Order
en.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
en.shard: Every %tick_rate%s that enemy heroes stay under the effect of Natural Order, their armor is reduced by %armor_per_tick%, and magic resistance is reduced by %magic_resistance_per_tick%%. Stacks up to %max_stacks% times.

zh.name: 自然秩序
zh.desc: 使所有元素降低至基础水平，移除附近敌方单位的基础物理护甲和魔法抗性。护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。
notes: 没有施放灵体游魂时，护甲和魔法抗性降低效果均以上古巨神为中心。
zh.shard: 敌方英雄在自然秩序效果下每停留%tick_rate%秒，他们的护甲就会降低%armor_per_tick%点，魔法抗性降低%magic_resistance_per_tick%%。叠加效果最多可叠加%max_stacks%次。

en.name: Natural Order
en.desc: Reduces all elements to their basic levels, removing base armor and magic damage resistance from nearby enemy units. The armor reduction is centered around the hero, while the magic armor reduction is centered around Astral Spirit.
notes: When the Astral Spirit isn't present, both the armor and magic armor reduction is centered around Elder Titan.
Break disables the armor reduction aura.

zh.name: 自然秩序
zh.desc: 使所有元素降低至基础水平，移除附近敌方单位的基础物理护甲和魔法抗性。护甲降低效果以英雄为中心，魔法抗性降低效果以灵体游魂为中心。
notes: 没有施放灵体游魂时，护甲和魔法抗性降低效果均以上古巨神为中心。
破坏会使护甲降低光环失效。

en.name: Return Astral Spirit
en.desc: Returns the Astral Spirit to Elder Titan.

zh.name: 灵体游魂回归
zh.desc: 使灵体游魂回归至上古巨神。

en.name: Tip the Scales
en.desc: Allied creeps and buildings affected by Glyph of Fortification or Roshan's Banner deal 100% bonus damage.

zh.name: 局势失衡
zh.desc: 受到防御符文或者肉山的战旗作用的友方小兵和建筑造成100%额外伤害。

en.name: Activate Fire Remnant
en.desc: Select the Fire Remnant to arrive at.

zh.name: 激活残焰
zh.desc: 选择残焰，灰烬之灵将向其冲去。

en.name: Fire Remnant
en.desc: Sends a Fire Remnant that runs to the target location at 250% Ember Spirit's speed. Using Activate Fire Remnant, Ember Spirit will dash out to all active Fire Remnants, destroying them and dealing damage in an area and then moving to the nearest Remnant.  Ember Spirit will end at the Remnant closest to the targeted location.
notes: Starts with 3 charges (maximum).
en.shard: If an enemy hero dies near Ember Spirit, a Fire Remnant charge will be replenished. Additionally, when Ember Spirit dies a Fire Remnant is spawned at his location.
en.scepter: Increases cast range, initial remnant speed, and maximum charges.

zh.name: 残焰
zh.desc: 可以放出一个残焰，向目标地点冲去，速度为灰烬之灵移动速度的250%。使用“激活残焰”技能后，灰烬之灵向所有残焰像冲去，将其摧毁并造成范围伤害，并移动至最近的残焰像。灰烬之灵最后会到达离目标地点最近的残焰像。
notes: 学习后马上拥有3个残焰（上限数量）。
zh.shard: 灰烬之灵附近范围内有敌方英雄阵亡时，恢复一点残焰能量点数。另外，灰烬之灵阵亡时会在原地留下一个残焰。
zh.scepter: 提升施法距离、初始残焰速度和最大能量点数。

en.name: Flame Guard
en.desc: Ember Spirit surrounds himself with a ring of fire that consumes incoming magic damage, absorbing a percentage of the damage taken. Flame Guard deals damage per second in an area around Ember Spirit while Flame Guard is active. If the shield is broken, the damage is also lost.
notes: Magic damage reduction is calculated before any reductions.
The damage lingers for an additional 0.5 seconds after application.

zh.name: 烈火罩
zh.desc: 灰烬之灵用火焰之环将自己包裹起来，会消耗受到的魔法伤害，使受到的魔法伤害被吸收一定百分比。烈火罩开启后会对灰烬之灵周围的敌人造成每秒伤害。护盾消失后将失去伤害效果。
notes: 魔法伤害的吸收伤害值计算先于任何伤害减免效果。
伤害在施加后会额外粘滞0.5秒。

en.name: Immolation
en.desc: Ember Spirit is continuously burning, dealing damage per second to all nearby enemies at all times.
notes: Break does not disable Immolation for Fire Remnants when upgraded with Aghanim's Shard.
en.shard: Grants Fire Remnants the current level of Immolation, and increases the damage per second and radius.

zh.name: 献祭心
zh.desc: 灰烬之灵持续燃烧，时刻对周围所有敌人造成每秒伤害。
notes: 破坏不会使阿哈利姆魔晶升级的残焰继承的献祭心失效。
zh.shard: 使残焰获得献祭心，并且每秒伤害和作用范围提升。

en.name: Searing Chains
en.desc: Ember Spirit unleashes fiery bolas that wrap around nearby enemies, anchoring them in place and dealing damage each second.
notes: Targets are chosen randomly around Xin.
Does not affect Debuff Immune or invisible units.

zh.name: 炎阳索
zh.desc: 灰烬之灵释放出火焰绳索来缠绕附近的敌人，将他们困于原地并每秒造成一定伤害。
notes: 将随机选取炘周围的单位作为目标。
不能作用于减益免疫或隐身单位。

en.name: Sleight of Fist
en.desc: Ember Spirit dashes around with blazing speed, attacking all enemies in the targeted area of effect, then returning to his start location.  Deals bonus damage to heroes.
notes: Targets are determined when the spell is cast.
A regular attack is done to each target every 0.25 seconds.
Any attack modifier that Xin has (such as Critical Strike, Bash, Cleave, or Orb effects) will be applied normally on these attacks.
Abilities and items can be used while Sleight of Fist is active.

zh.name: 无影拳
zh.desc: 灰烬之灵以燎原之火的速度横冲直撞，攻击目标区域内所有敌人，随后返回所在位置。对英雄造成额外伤害。
notes: 在施放技能时作用的目标就已决定。
对目标的攻击每次间隔为0.25秒。
炘拥有的攻击特效（如致命一击、重击、分裂、连锁闪电等效果）在技能攻击期间都能生效。
施放无影拳时间可以使用其他技能和物品。

en.name: Sproink
en.desc: Leaps backward, dodges incoming projectiles, and launches an Impetus attack on the 2 furthest enemy units within Enchantress' attack range + 100.

zh.name: 跃动
zh.desc: 向后跳跃，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，并向魅惑魔女的攻击距离+100范围内最远的2个敌方单位发动一次附有推进的攻击。

en.name: Enchant
en.desc:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for 3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives 40% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to 30 / 60 / 90 / 120s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Illusions can be converted.
en.scepter: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.

zh.name: 魅惑
zh.desc:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续3.5 / 4 / 4.5 / 5秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得40%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续30 / 60 / 90 / 120秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 可以转化幻象。
zh.scepter: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。
stats:
对非英雄单位：
最大生命值加成：150 / 250 / 350 / 450

en.name: Impetus
en.desc: Places an enchantment on each attack while activated, causing it to deal additional damage based on how far away the target is.  The farther the target, the greater the damage dealt. Deals double damage to illusions.
notes: The damage is capped at 1750 distance.
Distance to target is measured when the projectile hits.

zh.name: 推进
zh.desc: 激活后每次攻击都有附魔效果，根据与目标的距离造成额外伤害。目标越远，伤害越高。对幻象造成双倍伤害。
notes: 造成伤害上限的距离是1750。
计算与目标之间的距离在攻击弹道击中目标时。

en.name: Little Friends
en.desc: Enchantress roots an enemy unit. All creeps, ally, enemy and neutral within a radius will gain bonus movement and attack speed and attack the chosen target for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 密友
zh.desc: 魅惑魔女缠绕一个敌方单位。目标附近所有敌方、友方和中立非英雄单位会攻击魅惑魔女选定的目标，并且具有攻击速度和移动速度加成，持续6秒。
stats: 每个单位增加缠绕时间：0.5

en.name: Nature's Attendants
en.desc: A cloud of wisps heals Enchantress and any friendly units nearby.
notes: Units with full HP will not be selected for the heal.

zh.name: 自然之助
zh.desc: 召唤一群小精灵治疗魅惑魔女以及身边的友方单位。
notes: 不会选择满血单位进行治疗。

en.name: Rabble-Rouser
en.desc: Enchantress causes neutral creeps or any unit under her control to deal additional damage to enemy Heroes.
notes: Does not affect converted neutrals, Tormentor, or Roshan.

zh.name: 煽动野怪
zh.desc: 魅惑魔女使所有中立生物和魅惑魔女控制下的单位对敌方英雄造成额外伤害。
notes: 不会影响劝化的中立生物、痛苦魔方和肉山。

en.name: Untouchable
en.desc: Enchantress beguiles her enemies, slowing their attacks when she is attacked.
notes: All units who directly attack Enchantress will get slowed.
The slow is applied on the attacking unit when the attack starts, not when damage is applied.

zh.name: 不可侵犯
zh.desc: 魅惑魔女让她的敌人神魂颠倒，受到他们攻击时会降低其攻击速度。
notes: 所有直接攻击魅惑魔女的敌方单位都会被减速。
减速效果在攻击单位产生攻击动作时出现，而不是伤害生效时。

en.name: Black Hole
en.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a vortex that sucks in nearby enemy units.  Enemies affected by Black Hole cannot move, attack, or cast spells.
en.scepter: Black Hole deals additional damage equivalent to 4% of the unit's Max Health per second and does a non-interrupting pull towards it in a 1000 AoE. Pulls at a rate of 150.

zh.name: 黑洞
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 召唤一个强引力漩涡吸住敌方单位。被黑洞影响的单位不能移动、攻击或施法。
zh.scepter: 黑洞额外造成等同于单位4%最大生命值的每秒伤害，并且产生一个1000范围，没有打断效果的牵引效果。牵引速度为150。

en.name: Demonic Summoning
en.desc: Summons three fragments of Enigma himself at the cost of health.  The eidolons health is increased by 3% of Enigma's current health. These eidolons are all under Enigma's control, and repeated successful attacks cause them to multiply.  When this happens, the eidolons have their health restored.

zh.name: 恶魔召唤
zh.desc: 以生命为代价召唤三个谜团自身的碎片。虚灵的生命值会有所增加，数值为谜团当前生命值的3%。这些虚灵都由谜团控制，在反复经过几次成功的攻击后，虚灵会再次分裂，并完全回复生命值。

en.name: Event Horizon
en.desc: Units in a 600 radius moving away from Enigma have a movespeed penalty.

zh.name: 事件视界
zh.desc: 600范围内的单位远离谜团时会受到移速惩罚。

en.name: Gravity Well
en.desc: Allies within 500 distance from Enigma have up to 9 / 11 / 13 / 15% Damage Reduction. Effect starts at 0% at max distance and increases to its maximum strength when the ally is at 200 distance. Does not affect Enigma itself.

zh.name: 重力井
zh.desc: 谜团附近500距离内的友军拥有最多9 / 11 / 13 / 15%承受伤害降低。最远距离的效果为0，距离为200时达到最大效果。不会影响谜团自身。

en.name: Malefice
en.desc: Focuses Enigma's power on a target, causing it to take damage and become repeatedly stunned for multiple instances.  An instance strikes every 2 seconds.
en.shard: Increases Malefice stun duration by 0.3s and creates an Eidolon next to the target every instance of Malefice stun. These Eidolons will not multiply further.

zh.name: 憎恶
zh.desc: 将谜团的力量集中于一个目标，使它受到多次伤害并反复被眩晕。每2秒眩晕一次。
zh.shard: 憎恶的眩晕时间增加0.3秒，并且每次眩晕都会在目标身旁产生一个虚灵体。这些虚灵体不会再次分裂。

en.name: Midnight Pulse
en.desc: Steeps an area in dark resonance, dealing 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + a percentage of the enemies current HP as damage.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area.
Multiple instances of Midnight Pulse do not stack.

zh.name: 午夜凋零
zh.desc: 使一块区域浸入暗共振中，对敌方单位造成5 / 10 / 15 / 20 + 基于敌人当前生命值的伤害。
notes: 此技能将摧毁范围内的树木。
多个午夜凋零的效果不会叠加。

en.name: Splitting Image
en.desc: Enigma spawns Eidolons upon receiving damage.
notes: Whenever Enigma takes more than 375 damage from any source, he spawns an Eidolon next to him. Damage counter resets to zero after 7s. Eidolons created in this fashion grant 50% experience and gold.

zh.name: 分割图像
zh.desc: 谜团受到伤害时会产生虚灵体。
notes: 每当谜团受到任意来源的伤害超过375点，他的身旁都会产生一个虚灵体。伤害累计会在7秒后清零。这种方式产生的虚灵体提供的击杀经验和金钱减少50%。

en.name: Hurricane
en.desc: The Wildwing Ripper calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a hurricane that can push a unit in the direction of Wildwing Ripper's choice.

zh.name: 风飑
zh.desc: 枭兽撕裂者召唤风之灵，创造出一股强风，将一个单位向枭兽撕裂者选择的方向推去。

en.name: Tornado
en.desc: CHANNELED - The Wildwing calls on the spirit of the wind, creating a sentient Tornado that he can control. The Tornado slows nearby enemies and does damage. It is invulnerable and can move anywhere.

zh.name: 飓风
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 枭兽召唤风之灵，创造一股有知觉的飓风供他驱使。飓风对附近的敌人造成减速和伤害。飓风是无敌的，可以随意移动。

en.name: Toughness Aura
en.desc: The Wildwing Ripper's fury numbs it to attacks and inspires nearby allies to withstand more blows.

zh.name: 坚韧光环
zh.desc: 枭兽撕裂者的狂怒使其对攻击麻木，并鼓舞附近的友军使他们能够承受更多攻击。

en.name: Chronosphere
en.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, trapping all units caught in its sphere of influence and causes you to move very quickly inside it. Only Faceless Void and any units he controls are unaffected. Invisible enemies in the sphere will be revealed.
notes: Pauses all units and buildings, friendly or enemy, except those owned by Faceless Void.
Faceless Void is never affected by Chronospheres with any owner.

zh.name: 时间结界
zh.desc: 在时空中创造一个泡状遮罩，将所有位于其中的单位定住，并使虚空假面在其内部来去自如。只有虚空假面和他控制的单位不受影响。在其中的隐形敌人会显形。
notes: 能够定住所有单位和建筑，不论敌我。除了虚空假面控制的单位。
虚空假面不受任何时间结界的影响。

en.name: Distortion Field
en.desc: Enemy Attack Projectiles targetting Faceless Void or allied heroes within a 1200 radius of him get slowed by 40%, when they get  within 500 distance of their target.

zh.name: 扭曲力场
zh.desc: 虚空假面附近1200范围内以他或友方英雄为目标的敌方攻击弹道在进入目标500范围后会被减速40%。

en.name: Time Dilation
en.desc: Faceless Void envelops nearby enemies with time dilating fields to slow cooldown progression of their abilities. Each enveloped enemy gains one Time Dilation stack when applied, and one stack per ability they have on cooldown. Each stack deals damage per second and slows movement and attack speed. The duration is paused while affected by Chronosphere.
notes: Does not affect item cooldowns.
Number of stacks can change during the effect. Casting an ability will provide a stack if it goes on cooldown. If an ability cooldown ends during Time Dilation, a stack will be removed.
en.shard: Increases slow per stack. Provides Faceless Void with stacks that increase his attack and movement speed. Amount of stacks is equal to the total amount of Time Dilation stacks applied to enemies at the moment of the cast and linearly fades out over the duration.

zh.name: 时间膨胀
zh.desc: 虚空假面将附近所有敌人困在一个时间膨胀场中，技能的冷却都会减慢。施加时每个受困的敌人都会获得一层时间膨胀的叠加效果，每有一个技能处于冷却就再获得一层。每层叠加效果造成每秒伤害，并降低移动速度和攻击速度降低。持续时间在时间结界作用下会暂停。
notes: 不会影响物品的冷却时间。
效果期间叠加层数还会改变。施放技能后如果技能进入冷却就会提供一层叠加效果。如果技能冷却在时间膨胀期间完成，效果会被移除。
zh.shard: 提升每层叠加的减速。向虚空假面提供叠加效果，可以提升他的攻击和移动速度。叠加层数等于施放时施加给敌人的时间膨胀叠加层数的总和，效果会在持续时间内线性衰减。
stats: 每层叠加额外每秒伤害：4 / 6 / 8 / 10
每层叠加自身移速加成：9 / 10 / 11 / 12%
每层叠加自身攻速加成：9 / 10 / 11 / 12

en.name: Time Lock
en.desc: Adds the chance for an attack to lock an enemy unit in time while attacking it a second time.
notes: Does not stack with Skull Basher.

zh.name: 时间锁定
zh.desc: 攻击有一定概率将一个敌方目标锁定在时间中，再次发动攻击。
notes: 不与碎颅锤叠加。

en.name: Time Walk
en.desc: Rushes to a target location while backtracking any damage taken the last 2 seconds.
notes: Faceless Void is invulnerable while using Time Walk.
en.scepter: Applies a Time Lock to all units at the landing destination.

zh.name: 时间漫游
zh.desc: 冲到目标位置，并取消最近2秒内受到的任何伤害。
notes: 虚空假面在时间漫游过程中为无敌状态。
zh.scepter: 在落地点对所有单位施加一次时间锁定。

en.name: Reverse Time Walk
en.desc: Available for 1.5 seconds after landing Time Walk. If used in this period, you will reverse your time walk back to your previous cast location. Does not affect health or proc scepter hits.

zh.name: 反时间漫游
zh.desc: 时间漫游落地后1.5秒内可使用。施放时，自身将逆转时间漫游，回到上一个施放地点。不会影响生命值或触发神杖效果。

en.name: Time Zone
en.desc: Creates a blister in spacetime, altering the movement, cast, projectile, cooldown, and turn rate speed of all units inside. Allies have increased speed and cooldown acceleration. Enemies have decreased speed, and have frozen ability and item cooldowns. Does not affect Ultimate abilities. Time Dilation does not tick down while inside.

zh.name: 逆转时空
zh.desc: 在时空中创造一个遮罩，改变其中所有单位的移动、攻击、施法、弹道和转身速度。友军的速度提升，冷却加快。敌人的速度降低，技能和物品的冷却全部冻结。不会影响终极技能。时间膨胀的负面状态持续时间在逆转时空内不会变少。

en.name: Vex
en.desc: Silences target unit.

zh.name: 烦扰
zh.desc: 沉默目标单位

en.name: Inspiration Aura
en.desc: The Flagbearer inspires all allied creeps, granting them bonus health regeneration and magic resistance.
notes: Magic resistance bonus upgrades by 4% every 7.5 minutes, up to a maximum of 15 upgrades.

zh.name: 鼓舞光环
zh.desc: 旗手鼓舞所有友方小兵，提供额外生命恢复和魔法抗性。
notes: 魔法抗性加成每7.5分钟升级一次，增加4%，最高为15次升级。

en.name: Heal
en.desc: The Hill Troll Priest lays his holy blessing upon the target ally, replenishing some health.

zh.name: 治疗
zh.desc: 丘陵巨魔牧师对目标友军施放神圣祝福，恢复部分生命值。

en.name: Heal Amplification Aura
en.desc: Provides bonus Heal Amplification to all nearby allies.

zh.name: 治疗增强光环
zh.desc: 为周围所有友军提供额外的治疗增强。

en.name: Mana Aura
en.desc: Provides bonus mana regeneration to all nearby allies.

zh.name: 魔法光环
zh.desc: 为周围所有友军提供额外的魔法恢复。

en.name: Melting Strike
en.desc: Melts away the armor of heroes hit by the spirit's attack. Each successive hit increases the amount of armor melted.

zh.name: 灼烧攻击
zh.desc: 当熔炉精灵的攻击将熔化敌方英雄的护甲。每次攻击命中后效果会叠加。

en.name: Arm of the Deep
en.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

zh.name: 深水武器
zh.desc: 向目标方向放出一片触手，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。

en.name: Congregations of the Deep
en.desc: Sends out a slew of tentacles in all directions, stunning and damaging enemies.

zh.name: 深水鱼群
zh.desc: 向所有方向放出一片触手，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。

en.name: Riverborn Aura
en.desc: Whenever the Frog is in water, it increases all allied movement speed and outgoing damage.

zh.name: 河生光环
zh.desc: 只要青蛙处于水中，所有友军的移动速度和伤害输出都得到提升。

en.name: Tendrils of the Deep
en.desc: Sends out a cone-shaped slew of tentacles in the target direction, stunning and damaging enemies.

zh.name: 深水触须
zh.desc: 向目标方向放出一片锥形的触手，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。

en.name: Water Bubble (Large)
en.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target and all allies in the radius for 50% of the absorb amount.

zh.name: 水泡泡（大）
zh.desc: 制造一个护盾泡泡，保护目标免受魔法伤害，持续10秒。泡泡爆炸后目标和范围内所有友军会受到50%数值的治疗效果。

en.name: Water Bubble (Medium)
en.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s. After it expires, it heals the target for 50% of the absorb amount.

zh.name: 水泡泡（中）
zh.desc: 制造一个护盾泡泡，保护目标免受魔法伤害，持续10秒。泡泡爆炸后目标会受到50%数值的治疗效果。

en.name: Water Bubble (Small)
en.desc: Creates a barrier bubble that protects the target from magic damage for 10s.

zh.name: 水泡泡（小）
zh.desc: 制造一个护盾泡泡，保护目标免受魔法伤害，持续10秒。

en.name: Time Warp Aura
en.desc: Coming from a different era, the Frostbitten Golem has an innate control of time, speeding up the cooldowns of all nearby allies.

zh.name: 时间扭曲光环
zh.desc: 由于来自一个不同的纪元，霜害傀儡天生可以控制时间，使周围所有友军的技能冷却加快。

en.name: Death Throe: Rush
en.desc: When Hellbear dies, all nearby allies go into a frenzy gaining attack speed for a short amount of time.

zh.name: 临死之痛：神速
zh.desc: 地狱熊怪阵亡时，附近所有友军进入狂暴状态，短时间内获得攻击速度。

en.name: Death Throe: Power
en.desc: When Hellbear Smasher dies, all nearby allies go into a rampage gaining bonus attack damage for a short amount of time.

zh.name: 临死之痛：神力
zh.desc: 地狱熊怪阵亡时，附近所有友军进入暴走状态，短时间内获得攻击力。

en.name: Curse of the Oldgrowth
en.desc: Applies a curse on all enemy heroes within 900 range, displaying them in fog, slowing them, and dealing damage over time based on the number of trees within 250 radius. Treants count as trees for this purpose.

zh.name: 青森诅咒
zh.desc: 对900范围内所有敌方英雄施加诅咒，使他们在迷雾中显形，根据250范围内树木的数量对他们造成减速和持续伤害。在此情况下树人也被视为树木。

en.name: Nature's Call
en.desc: Converts an area of trees into Treants under the command of Nature's Prophet.
notes: Nature's Call can only create as many treants as there are trees in the target area.

zh.name: 自然的呼唤
zh.desc: 将一片树木转化成由自然先知操控的树人。
notes: 自然的呼唤产生的树人不会超过目标区域内树木的数量。

en.name: Nature's Profit
en.desc: Whenever Nature's Prophet kills an enemy hero or one dies within a 750 radius, a money tree is created in their place. Every tick, several bags of gold are dropped that can be picked up by nearby heroes. The amount of gold is equal to a multiplier of the slain hero level.

zh.name: 自然先富
zh.desc: 只要有敌方英雄被自然先知击杀，或者在他附近750范围内阵亡，会在原地长出一棵摇钱树。每次都会掉落若干金袋，所有英雄都可以拾取。每个金袋提供的金钱等于阵亡英雄等级的数倍。

en.name: Spirit of the Forest
en.desc: Nature's Prophet gains 2% bonus damage for each nearby tree. Treants also provide this bonus with multiplied values regardless of proximity. Treants also possess this ability.
notes: Treants gain bonuses from trees and other treants around them.
Treant Protector does not provide any bonuses.

zh.name: 丛林之魂
zh.desc: 附近的每棵树都会让自然先知获得2%攻击力加成。每个树人也会让自然先知获得若干倍数的加成，不论相距多远。树人也拥有这个技能。
notes: 树人会从周围的树木和其他树人获得加成效果。
树精卫士不提供任何加成。

en.name: Sprout
en.desc: Sprouts a ring of trees around a unit, damaging and trapping it in place and providing vision in a 400 radius.
notes: Sprout can be cast on any unit, or the ground.
Trees created by Sprout have the same interactions with abilities as regular trees.

zh.name: 发芽
zh.desc: 使一圈树木在一个单位的周围发芽，将其困在其中并造成伤害，提供400范围内的视野。
notes: 发芽的施放目标可以是任何单位或者地面。
发芽产生的树木跟英雄技能的相互作用与平常树木相同。

en.name: Teleportation
en.desc: Teleports to any point on the map. Gains a barrier after arriving to its destination.
notes: Mana and cooldown take effect when the cast is completed.  Nature's Prophet will not use any mana or waste the cooldown if the spell is interrupted while casting.
When the cast begins, an effect is created at the target location, which is visible to allies and enemies.

zh.name: 传送
zh.desc: 传送到地图上任何位置。到达地点后获得一个护盾。
notes: 魔耗和冷却时间都是在技能施放结束后结算。自然先知在施放技能时被打断将不会耗费魔法或使技能进入冷却。
施法开始后，目标地点将产生视觉特效，对队友和敌人均可见。

en.name: Wrath of Nature
en.desc: Damaging energy bounces around the map, striking enemies that are in vision starting with those closest to the cast point. Each enemy hit beyond the first adds damage, up to the maximum after 16 are hit.
notes: Wrath of Nature will not hit units out of vision.
Can be cast through the minimap; the nearest valid target will be selected.
en.scepter: Entangles all enemies it hits. Duration scales from 1.5s up to 3s seconds at max bounce.

zh.name: 自然之怒
zh.desc: 伤害性的能量在全地图跳跃，打击视野中的敌人，会先从距目标点最近的敌人开始打击。每击中一个敌人伤害都会增加，击中16个目标后达到最高伤害。
notes: 自然的愤怒只能伤害视野内的单位。
可以通过点击小地图施放；初始目标将选择施放地点最近的有效单位。
zh.scepter: 缠绕所有击中的敌人。持续时间根据弹跳次序从1.5秒开始增加，弹跳数达到上限时为3秒。

en.name: Frost Attack
en.desc: The Ghost launches an eerie attack that chills her enemies to their bones.

zh.name: 寒霜攻击
zh.desc: 鬼魂放出的诡异攻击，让敌人感受到刺骨的寒冷。

en.name: Critical Strike
en.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious attacks occasionally tear a vital tendon, inflicting critical damage.

zh.name: 致命一击
zh.desc: 巨狼凶猛的攻击有时会撕裂敌人的筋腱，造成致命伤害。

en.name: Intimidate
en.desc: The Giant Wolf's ferocious roar reduces all nearby enemies total attack damage.

zh.name: 恫吓
zh.desc: 巨狼凶猛的咆哮会降低周围所有敌人的攻击力。

en.name: Envenomed Weapon
en.desc: The Vhoul Assassin has soaked his weapons in his own blend of painful predator venoms that causes his enemies' natural regeneration to work against themselves. Heroes recover from the poison more quickly.

zh.name: 淬毒武器
zh.desc: 豺狼人刺客用它自己调制的痛苦捕食者毒液来浸透它的武器，使敌人的天然恢复能力反过来使他们流失生命。英雄从中毒状态中恢复的更快。

en.name: Granite Aura
en.desc: Increases the health capacity of nearby units.

zh.name: 磐石光环
zh.desc: 提高周围单位的生命值上限。

en.name: Stroke of Fate
en.desc:
Grimstroke paints a curved path of ink with his brush, damaging and slowing enemies. The damage is increased with each enemy the ink hits.

 Can be put on alt-cast to have the path be straight.

zh.name: 绝笔
zh.desc:
天涯墨客画出一道弯曲的墨迹，对敌人造成伤害和减速。墨迹每碰到一个敌人，造成的伤害都会增加。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），使墨迹为直线。
stats: 每个幻象/非英雄提高伤害：10 / 20 / 30 / 40

en.name: Dark Portrait
en.desc: Creates an ink illusion of a target enemy hero. Illusion is debuff immune, has 90% magic resistance, and has bonus movement speed and attack damage.

zh.name: 暗绘
zh.desc: 制造目标敌方英雄的墨色幻象。幻象为减益免疫状态，拥有90%魔法抗性，移动速度和继承攻击力超过本体。

en.name: Phantom's Embrace
en.desc:
Summons a phantom that moves quickly towards the target, latching to it when she arrives. Once latched, the phantom damages and silences. If she survives the full latch duration she rends her victim for heavy damage and refreshes Phantom's Embrace's cooldown.

Hero attacks against the phantom count as 3 attacks each.
notes: The phantom falls off if the target becomes invisible or spell immune.
The phantom will return if the target dies during the latch.

zh.name: 戾影
zh.desc:
召唤一个快速向目标移动的幻影，到达时将其缠住。缠住后对其造成伤害和沉默。若她在纠缠期间存活，将会撕裂目标，造成大量伤害，并刷新戾影的冷却时间。

英雄对幻影的单次攻击记为3次。
notes: 幻影在目标隐身或进入减益免疫状态后掉下。
目标在纠缠期间阵亡后幻影将会回归。

en.name: Ink Trail
en.desc: Grimstroke's attacks and spells cause affected enemy heroes to leave a trail of Ink behind them and deal less damage to Grimstroke for 4s.
notes: Provides vision over affected heroes.
Grimstroke's illusions (including Dark Portrait) also have Ink Trail.

zh.name: 墨痕
zh.desc: 天涯墨客的攻击和技能会使受作用的敌方英雄在身后留下一道墨痕，对天涯墨客造成的伤害减少，持续4秒。
notes: 获得作用下英雄的视野。
天涯墨客的幻象（包括暗绘）也拥有墨痕。

en.name: Ink Explosion
en.desc: Triggers an existing Ink Swell.

zh.name: 爆墨
zh.desc: 触发现有的墨涌。

en.name: Soulbind
en.desc: Binds a targeted enemy hero to its nearest allied hero within the bind radius, preventing both from moving away from each other. Any unit-targeted ability that either bound hero receives also gets cast on the other hero. If the bind is broken before the duration expires, the initial target will be bound to its nearest allied hero in the radius.
notes: If bound to another unit, affected units are leashed and prevented from blinking.
Provides vision of both leashed units.

zh.name: 缚魂
zh.desc: 将一名敌方英雄与束缚作用范围内最接近的队友相连，阻止他们远离彼此。任何指向性技能击中任一英雄时，这两名敌方英雄都会受到作用。若连接在效果截止前断裂，初始目标将再次与其距离内最接近的队友相连。
notes: 如果与另一个单位一起被束缚，作用下单位均被束缚，而且无法使用闪烁类技能。
被束缚的单位都将提供视野。

en.name: Ink Swell
en.desc: Grimstroke shrouds an allied unit in ink, increasing its movement speed. Enemies in range of the allied unit are damaged with inky tendrils over time. After 3 seconds it applies damage and stun in an area around the unit in proportion to how long ink tendril was near any hero.
en.shard:
Ink Swell dispels the allied unit when cast. Causes Ink Swell to deal 40% more damage and heal the target for 40% of the damage Ink Swell deals.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 墨涌
zh.desc: 天涯墨客将一个友方单位笼罩在一片墨汁中，目标的移动速度得到提升。友方单位附近的敌人会持续被墨须伤害。3秒后将根据墨须对英雄造成伤害的时间对区域内单位造成伤害和眩晕。
zh.shard:
墨涌在施放时会驱散友方单位。墨涌造成的伤害增加40%，并且治疗目标，治疗量为墨涌造成伤害的40%。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Afterburner
en.desc: Gyrocopter gains movement speed for a short duration after damaging an enemy with his attacks or abilities.

zh.name: 加力燃烧器
zh.desc: 矮人直升机通过攻击或技能对敌人造成伤害后，在短时间内获得移动速度提升。

en.name: Call Down
en.desc: Call down 3 aerial missile strikes that slow and damage enemy units in a target area. Each strike is 500 distance from the previous one.
notes: The visual indicator is visible to allies only.

zh.name: 召唤飞弹
zh.desc: 召唤3波防空导弹，对目标区域内的敌方单位造成减速和伤害。每次打击与上一次间隔500距离。
notes: 视觉指示范围仅对队友可见。

en.name: Chop Shop
en.desc: Gyrocopter can disassemble most items.
notes: Cannot disassemble Divine Rapier or Hand of Midas.
Gyrocopter can always sell recipes for full value.

zh.name: 拆东补西
zh.desc: 矮人直升机可以拆分大多数物品。
notes: 无法拆分圣剑或迈达斯之手。
矮人直升机总是能以原价出售配方图纸。

en.name: Flak Cannon
en.desc: Gyrocopter's attacks hit all enemy units in an area around it for a limited number of attacks.  Only the main target of attacks will receive attack bonuses such as Critical Strike.  Lasts 12 seconds or until the attacks are used.
notes: Attack range for the primary attack is unchanged.

zh.name: 高射火炮
zh.desc: 矮人直升机的攻击会击中目标周围一定范围内的所有敌人，持续一定次数的攻击。只有主要目标会受到致命一击等攻击特效。持续12秒或攻击次数耗尽。
notes: 对主目标的攻击距离没有改变。

en.name: Homing Missile
en.desc: Fires a homing missile to seek the targeted enemy unit. The missile gains speed over time, dealing damage and stunning when it impacts the target. Enemy units can destroy the missile before it reaches its target.
notes: Towers do half damage to the missile.
The crosshair effect is visible to allies only.
The missile will follow and hit invisible units.
en.shard: Homing Missiles now constantly fires the current level of Rocket Barrage in a 700 area of effect after 1 second of being cast. This Rocket Barrage prioritizes the Homing Missile target.

zh.name: 追踪导弹
zh.desc: 发射一枚会自动定位目标单位的追踪导弹。导弹发射后持续增加飞行速度，击中目标时造成伤害及眩晕。敌方单位可在导弹接近前将其击落。
notes: 防御塔对导弹造成半额伤害。
准星效果仅对队友可见。
导弹会跟随并击中隐身单位。
zh.shard: 追踪导弹现在从施放1秒后开始不断发射700作用范围的火箭弹幕。火箭弹幕优先以追踪导弹的目标为目标。
stats: 摧毁所需防御塔攻击次数：6

en.name: Rocket Barrage
en.desc: Launches a salvo of rockets at nearby enemy units in a radius around the Gyrocopter. Lasts 3 seconds.
notes: Rocket Barrage can't hit units Gyrocopter has no vision over.
Rocket Barrage fired from Homing Missiles do not trigger Afterburner.

zh.name: 火箭弹幕
zh.desc: 向矮人直升机附近一定范围内的敌方单位齐射导弹。持续3秒。
notes: 火箭弹幕不能伤害矮人直升机视野之外的单位。
追踪导弹发射的火箭弹幕不会触发加力燃烧器。

en.name: Side Gunner
en.desc: Gyrocopter gains a Side Gunner that attacks enemy units in a 700 unit radius every 1.3s with his attack. Prioritizes furthest unit away within its range.
notes: Side Gunner can attack even while Gyrocopter is disabled.

zh.name: 侧翼机枪
zh.desc: 矮人直升机获得侧翼机枪，每1.3秒对矮人直升机附近700范围内的敌方单位发动攻击。优先攻击范围内最远的单位。
notes: 即使矮人直升机被控制，侧翼机枪也能攻击。

en.name: Take Off
en.desc: Harpy Scout gains flying movement at the cost of movement speed. Consumes mana while active.

zh.name: 起飞
zh.desc: 鹰身女妖侦察者以移动速度为代价获得飞行移动状态。开启时消耗魔法。

en.name: Chain Lightning
en.desc: The Harpy Stormcrafter releases a high-voltage bolt of electricity at the target enemy, dealing damage. The bolt jumps to other nearby enemies, losing power with each jump.

zh.name: 连锁闪电
zh.desc: 鹰身女妖风暴巫师对目标敌人释放一道高压闪电，造成伤害。闪电会在附近敌人之间跳跃，每次跳跃损失一些威力。

en.name: Rally
en.desc: Skeleton's allies gain bonus attack damage. This Aura stacks.

zh.name: 团结
zh.desc: 骷髅兵的友军获得攻击力加成。这个光环可以叠加。

en.name: Acorn Shot
en.desc:
Fires Hoodwink's attack with an acorn at the target unit.  The acorn bounces to nearby targets, slowing them and dealing a percentage of Hoodwink's attack with bonus damage.
If point targeted, a tree is created at the target position and the acorn will bounce to nearby targets.  The ability may be placed on alt-cast to force this behavior.
notes: The same target can be hit more than once.
Bounces will seek units in the fog of war in a 525 radius, but not invisible units.
The planted tree lasts for 20 seconds.

zh.name: 爆栗出击
zh.desc:
森海飞霞向目标单位发射一颗橡栗，可以弹射至附近敌人，减缓他们的移动速度，并造成攻击伤害的一定百分比和额外伤害。
可以对地面施放，在目标地点种出一棵树，而橡栗会弹射至附近目标。设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后会强制沿用该行为。
notes: 同一个目标可以被击中超过一次。
弹射会搜寻525范围内战争迷雾中的单位，但无视隐身单位。
种下的树持续20秒。

en.name: Bushwhack
en.desc: Tosses a net trap that stuns enemies if they are near a tree in the area.  Affected enemies take damage over time and are pulled towards the tree nearest to them within the target area, and have their vision reduced to 0 for the duration of the stun.
notes: Units can be freed from the stun by destroying the tree.
Bushwhack does not hit invisible units.

zh.name: 野地奇袭
zh.desc: 扔出一张网，对区域内靠近树木的敌人造成眩晕。敌人会持续受到伤害并被拖拽到目标区域内最近的树上，并且眩晕期间视野降低至0。
notes: 若树木被摧毁，被影响的单位将解除眩晕。
野地奇袭不会击中隐身单位。

en.name: Decoy
en.desc: Hoodwink turns invisible, increasing her movement speed, and creates a decoy illusion that starts aiming a decreased damage Sharpshooter at the nearest enemy hero. If the illusion is attacked or hit by a targeted ability, it is destroyed and it throws a lesser bushwhack towards the enemy.

zh.name: 诱敌奇术
zh.desc: 森海飞霞变为隐身，提升移动速度，并且产生一个引诱敌人的幻象，幻象会瞄准最近的敌方英雄开始蓄力准备发射伤害较低的一箭穿心。如果幻象被攻击或被指向性技能击中，幻象将被摧毁并且攻击者将受到较弱的野地奇袭效果。

en.name: Hunter's Boomerang
en.desc: Tosses a boomerang in an arc. Upon contact, it returns to Hoodwink.  The boomerang will deal damage as it passes through or hits enemies, and apply a debuff that causes affected enemies to be slowed and be more vulnerable to spell damage.

zh.name: 猎手旋镖
zh.desc: 掷出一把沿弧线飞行的回旋镖。击中后会飞回至森海飞霞。回旋镖对沿途击中的敌人都会造成伤害，并且施加一个负面效果，使受到作用的敌人被减速，承受的技能伤害增加。

en.name: Mistwoods Wayfarer
en.desc: Hoodwink has a chance to redirect enemy attacks to a nearby tree.
notes: Trees that take a redirected attack are destroyed.

zh.name: 林渊旅人
zh.desc: 森海飞霞有几率使敌人的攻击转向至附近的树木。
notes: 受到转向攻击的树木会被摧毁。

en.name: Scurry
en.desc: Hoodwink gains bonus movement speed, phased movement, and tree-walking for a brief time. While active, the redirect chance of Mistwoods Wayfarer is multiplied by 2.

zh.name: 密林奔走
zh.desc: 森海飞霞在短时间内获得移动速度加成，相位移动状态和穿行树木效果。开启时林渊旅人的转向几率为2倍。

en.name: Sharpshooter
en.desc:
Hoodwink charges up and fires a deadly bolt from her crossbow, dealing heavy damage, break and slow to an enemy Hero.  The damage and debuff duration scale up to max after 3 seconds, and the bolt is fired automatically after 5 seconds.
Hoodwink is knocked backwards for a distance of 350 from the force of the shot. Creeps hit by the bolt are damaged for half the values.
en.scepter: Increases arrow speed and movement speed slow.

zh.name: 一箭穿心
zh.desc:
森海飞霞装载她的弩机，射出致命的一箭，对一名敌方英雄造成高额伤害，并施加破坏和减速效果。伤害和负面状态持续时间随着装载时间增加，3秒后达到最大效果，弩箭在5秒后自动发射。
由于弩箭的威力，森海飞霞后退350距离。弩箭穿过的非英雄单位会受到半额伤害。
zh.scepter: 提升箭矢速度和减速效果。
stats: 最长负面状态持续时间：5

en.name: End Sharpshooter
en.desc: Release the charged up shot, regain ability to move and attack.

zh.name: 中止一箭穿心
zh.desc: 释放蓄力的弩箭，重新开始移动和攻击。

en.name: Tomo'kan Tracker
en.desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last 15 seconds in a 1200 area around her.

zh.name: Tomo'kan Tracker
zh.desc: Hoodwink can see footprints of where enemy Heroes have been in the last 15 seconds in a 1200 area around her.

en.name: Berserker's Blood
en.desc: Huskar's injuries feed his power, giving increased attack speed, magic resistance and health regen based on missing health. Health regen is a percentage of your strength.
notes: Bonuses are provided linearly, no bonus at Full HP and full bonus at strictly less than 10% HP.
en.shard:
Huskar can activate Berserker's Blood for a health cost to cauterize himself. Dispels Huskar, then after a delay, heals for the amount of health consumed plus an additional bonus per debuff dispelled.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 狂战士之血
zh.desc: 哈斯卡的伤痛赐予他力量，根据他损失的生命值将获得攻击速度、魔法抗性和生命恢复加成。生命恢复为力量的一定百分比。
notes: 加成效果为线性增加，满血时没有加成，10%生命时达到最大加成。
zh.shard:
哈斯卡可以消耗一定生命来主动开启狂战士之血，炙疗哈斯卡。进行驱散，然后在一定延迟后回复消耗的生命，并且每驱散一个负面状态，他就会额外回复生命。

驱散类型：弱驱散
stats: 每个负面效果提供最大生命值治疗：3%

en.name: Blood Magic
en.desc:
Huskar does not have mana. Mana costs of items are converted into health costs.

Huskar's Health Costs are Magical Damage and can be reduced by Magic Resist.

zh.name: 血魔法
zh.desc:
哈斯卡没有魔法值。物品的魔法消耗会转换为生命消耗。

哈斯卡的生命消耗为魔法伤害，可以被魔法抗性减少。

en.name: Burning Spear
en.desc: Huskar sets his spears aflame, dealing damage over time with his regular attack.  Multiple attacks will stack additional damage.  Each attack drains some of Huskar's health.
notes: Burning Spear stacks additively when used multiple times on one target.  There is no cap.
Huskar cannot kill himself with this skill.
Incendiary does not deal extra Max Health Burn Damage to Roshan.
en.scepter: Burning Spears launches an additional %multishot_targets% spears onto random enemies within Huskar's attack range.

zh.name: 沸血之矛
zh.desc: 哈斯卡将其长矛点燃，在普通攻击的同时对敌方单位造成持续伤害。多次攻击会造成持续伤害叠加。每次攻击都将牺牲哈斯卡部分生命值。
notes: 沸血之矛在多次施放到目标身上效果可以叠加。没有叠加上限。
哈斯卡不能使用此技能自杀。
炙矛可热不会对肉山造成额外的最大生命值烧灼伤害。
zh.scepter: 沸血之矛会对哈斯卡攻击距离内随机敌人额外发射%multishot_targets%支长矛。

en.name: Inner Fire
en.desc: In a fiery rage, knocks all nearby enemies away from you to a fixed distance, dealing damage and silencing them.

zh.name: 心炎
zh.desc: 在炽烈的狂暴下将附近所有敌人击退至固定距离外，造成伤害和沉默。

en.name: Life Break
en.desc:
Huskar draws upon his health to break an enemy's life, leaping at a target to shatter a percentage of that hero's current health and slow both their movement and attack speed.  While leaping, Huskar is Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: If Huskar is disabled during the charge or the target moves more than 1400 units in 0.015 seconds, the charge stops.
Slow works on Spell Immune units.
Life Break cannot be disjointed.
en.scepter: Forces the enemy target to attack Huskar and increases cast range.

zh.name: 牺牲
zh.desc:
哈斯卡牺牲自己的生命来摧毁敌人的生命，他跃向一个目标，造成目标当前生命值一定百分比的伤害，并且降低目标的移动和攻击速度。哈斯卡在跳跃过程中为减益免疫，并且魔法抗性提升60%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 如果哈斯卡在跳跃时受到控制技能，或目标在0.015秒内移动1400码以上，跳跃就会停止。
减速效果无视减益免疫。
牺牲无法被躲避。
zh.scepter: 强迫敌方目标攻击哈斯卡，并提升施法距离。

en.name: Icefire Bomb
en.desc: The Ice Shaman chucks a blue flame towards an enemy unit or building, dealing damage over time.

zh.name: 冰火炸弹
zh.desc: 寒冰萨满向一个敌方单位或建筑抛出一团蓝色火焰，持续造成伤害。

en.name: Alacrity
en.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed based on the level of Wex and their damage based on the level of Exort.

zh.name: 灵动迅捷
zh.desc: 祈求者给友方单位灌注强大的能量，提高其攻击速度和攻击力。攻击速度提升程度取决于雷元素等级，攻击力提升取决于火元素等级。

en.name: Alacrity (AD)
en.desc: Invoker infuses an ally with an immense surge of energy, increasing their attack speed and their damage.

zh.name: 灵动迅捷（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者给友方单位灌注强大的能量，提高其攻击速度和攻击力。

en.name: Attribute Bonus
en.desc: Improves all attributes per point spent

zh.name: 属性附加
zh.desc: 消耗技能点提升所有属性

en.name: Chaos Meteor
en.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage based on the level of Exort, and rolling further based on the level of Wex. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time, receiving additional damage based on the level of Exort.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every 0.5 seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over 3 seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of 300.

zh.name: 混沌陨石
zh.desc: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，每隔一段时间撞击一次作用范围内的敌人，造成基于火元素等级的撞击伤害，滚动距离取决于雷元素的等级。每被撞击一次都将持续受到烧灼伤害，烧灼伤害取决于火元素的等级。
notes: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为0.5秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续3秒。
陨石移动的速度为300。

en.name: Chaos Meteor (AD)
en.desc: Invoker pulls a flaming meteor from space onto the targeted location. Upon landing, the meteor rolls forward, constantly dealing damage and rolling further based on the level. Units hit by the meteor will also be set on fire for a short time.
notes: Deals main damage to enemy units under meteor every 0.5 seconds and burns enemies for smaller damage over 3 seconds.
The meteor moves at a speed of 300.

zh.name: 混沌陨石（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者从太空中召唤一枚燃烧的流星打击指定位置。流星着陆后会向前滚动一段距离，根据技能等级持续造成伤害和向前滚动。每被撞击一次都将在短时间内受到烧灼伤害，
notes: 每个敌方单位受到撞击伤害的间隔为0.5秒，后续较低的烧灼伤害持续3秒。
陨石移动的速度为300。

en.name: Cold Snap
en.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration based on the level of Quas. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases based on the level of Quas.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than 10 after reductions.

zh.name: 急速冷却
zh.desc: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续时间取决于冰元素等级。敌人将受到伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击会使敌人再次冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着冰元素等级提高而缩短。
notes: 只有10点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。

en.name: Cold Snap (AD)
en.desc: Invoker draws the heat from an enemy, chilling them to their very core for a duration. The enemy will take damage and be briefly frozen. Further damage taken in this state will freeze the enemy again, dealing bonus damage. The enemy can only be frozen so often, but the freeze cooldown decreases as the level goes up.
notes: The freeze stun only triggers on damage greater than 10 after reductions.

zh.name: 急速冷却（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者将敌人的热量抽空，将其降到绝对零度，持续一定时间。敌人将伤害并被短暂冻结，后续攻击同样会使敌人冻结并造成额外伤害。被冻结的频率固定，但是冻结的冷却时间将会随着等级提高而缩短。
notes: 只有10点以上的实际伤害才能触发急速冷却。

en.name: Deafening Blast
en.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with based on the level of Exort. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration based on the level of Quas, then disarm their attacks for a duration based on the level of Wex.

zh.name: 超震声波
zh.desc: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害，伤害量取决于火元素的等级。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退，击退时间取决于冰元素的等级，同时让他们无法进行攻击，禁止攻击时间取决于雷元素的等级。

en.name: Deafening Blast
en.desc: Invoker unleashes a mighty sonic wave in front of him, dealing damage to any enemy unit it collides with. The sheer impact from the blast is enough to knock those enemy units back for a duration then disarm their attacks for a duration.

zh.name: 超震声波（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者在自己前方释放出超强的声波，对所有敌方单位造成伤害。声波的绝对冲击能够将敌方单位击退一定时间，同时让他们无法进行攻击，持续一定时间。

en.name: E.M.P.
en.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana based on the level of Wex. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 25% of the mana drained.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
en.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at 125 units per second.

zh.name: 电磁脉冲
zh.desc: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，2.9秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，并根据雷元素的等级损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得25%损毁的魔法。
notes: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。
zh.shard: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒125距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。

en.name: E.M.P. (AD)
en.desc: Invoker builds up a charge of electromagnetic energy at a targeted location which automatically detonates after 2.9 seconds. The detonation covers an area, draining mana. Deals damage for each point of mana drained.  If EMP drains mana from an enemy hero, Invoker gains 50% of the mana drained.
notes: Will not affect cycloned units (Tornado or Eul's Scepter of Divinity).
en.shard: Increases damage for each point of mana drained by EMP and pulls enemy units into the EMP's center at %shard_drag_speed% units per second.

zh.name: 电磁脉冲（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者在指定位置召唤出一道强力的自爆电磁脉冲，2.9秒后将自动爆炸。爆炸将覆盖一定区域，损毁敌方的魔法值。对敌方英雄造成损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害。祈求者将获得50%损毁的魔法。
notes: 对被吹起的单位（强袭飓风或Eul的神圣法杖）无效。
zh.shard: 提升电磁脉冲燃烧魔法的伤害系数，并且将敌方单位以每秒%shard_drag_speed%距离的速度向电磁脉冲的中心牵引。

en.name: Invoked Spell
en.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

zh.name: 祈唤技能
zh.desc: 施放元素祈唤后本技能栏会变成对应祈求者当前的冰、雷和火元素状态的十大技能之一。

en.name: Invoked Spell
en.desc: Casting Invoke will replace this slot with one of ten unique spells based on Invoker's currently active Quas, Wex, and Exort buffs.

zh.name: 祈唤技能
zh.desc: 施放元素祈唤后本技能栏会变成对应祈求者当前的冰、雷和火元素状态的十大技能之一。

en.name: Exort
en.desc: Allows manipulation of fire elements. Active Exort instances imbue Invoker with bonus attack damage. Passively grants bonus intelligence per level of Exort.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
en.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

zh.name: 火
zh.desc: 允许祈求者掌控火元素。每个活跃的火元素会让祈求者获得攻击力加成。每级火被动提供额外智力。
notes: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
zh.scepter: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

en.name: Forge Spirit
en.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. Damage and armor are based on the level of Exort while attack range, health, and duration are based on the level of Quas. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes. The number of spirits spawned is determined by the lower level of Quas and Exort.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

zh.name: 熔炉精灵
zh.desc: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。熔炉精灵的攻击力和护甲取决于火元素的等级，攻击距离、持续时间和生命值取决于冰元素的等级。元素的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。熔炉精灵的产生数量取决于冰元素和火元素中等级较低的元素。
notes: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

en.name: Forge Spirit (AD)
en.desc: Invoker forges a spirit embodying the strength of fire and fortitude of ice. The elemental's scorching attack is capable of melting the armor of enemy heroes.
notes: Casting this ability will replace currently summoned Forged Spirits.

zh.name: 熔炉精灵（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者融合火之灼热和冰之坚毅，创造出熔炉精灵。元素精灵的灼热攻击能够熔化敌方英雄的护甲。
notes: 施放此技能后原有的熔炉精灵将会死亡。

en.name: Ghost Walk
en.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Spell Immune enemies.
en.shard: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

zh.name: 幽灵漫步
zh.desc: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
notes: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。
zh.shard: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。

en.name: Ghost Walk (AD)
en.desc: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies, and slows Invoker as well based on the level.
notes: The slow effect does not work on Debuff Immune enemies.

zh.name: 幽灵漫步（OMG）
zh.desc: 祈求者操纵冰雷之力围绕自身，使自己隐形。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果基于技能等级。
notes: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

en.name: Ice Wall
en.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration based on the level of Quas. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas and deals damage each second based on the level of Exort.
en.scepter: Ice Wall becomes Ice Floe, Vector Targeted. After a delay, Ice Floe appears as a 105 width Ice Wall. Enemy heroes in its area for longer than 2.5 seconds become rooted and take magic damage based on Quas.

zh.name: 寒冰之墙
zh.desc: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙，持续时间取决于冰元素的等级。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成减速和伤害，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，每秒伤害取决于火元素的等级。
zh.scepter: 寒冰之墙变成浮冰，以矢量为目标。经过短暂延迟后，浮冰出现再产生一道105宽度的寒冰之墙。在浮冰内停留超过2.5秒的敌方英雄会基于冰的等级被缠绕并受到魔法伤害。

en.name: Ice Wall (AD)
en.desc: Generates a wall of solid ice directly in front of Invoker for a duration. The bitter cold emanating from it greatly slows nearby enemies and deals damage each second.
notes: The slow will still affect Debuff Immune enemies if their debuff immunity was created after being affected by Ice Wall.

zh.name: 寒冰之墙（OMG）
zh.desc: 在祈求者前方创造一堵寒冰之墙。冰霜之墙放射出的寒冰之气将对敌方单位造成大幅减速和每秒伤害，
notes: 如果敌人在受到寒冰之墙作用后获得减益免疫状态，那么减速效果对其依然有效。

en.name: Invoke
en.desc:
Combines the properties of the elements currently being manipulated to create a new spell for Invoker to use. Invoke cooldown is reduced by 0.3 seconds for each orb level.  Invoker gains a bonus ability point for his orbs at levels 6, 12, and 18.

Invoker's vast knowledge of magic allows him to choose from Multiple Aghanim's Scepter and Shard options.  The items must be activated before they can be used, and cannot be changed after they are chosen.

 Click the help button to see the list of possible spells.
notes: The arrangement of instances does not matter.
Invoke will not cost mana or go on cooldown if the only effect is to swap the positions of existing spells.
Invoke will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.

zh.name: 元素祈唤
zh.desc:
将当前掌握的元素精华融合，创造出新的法术供祈求者施放。每个元素球的等级都会减少0.3秒元素祈唤的冷却时间。祈求者达到6、12和18时会分别额外获得一点技能点。

祈求者高深的魔法学识让他可以从多个阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果中进行选择。物品必须先激活才能生效，而且选择后无法更改。

点击帮助按钮可查看所有可用法术。
notes: 生成的技能与三个球的排列顺序无关。
只是交换现有技能的位置并不会消耗魔法，也不会触发元素祈唤的冷却。
元素祈唤不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。

en.name: Mastermind
en.desc: When Invoker denies a lane creep, he gets 25% of the XP.

zh.name: 聪明绝顶
zh.desc: 祈求者反补线上小兵时，他会获得25%经验。

en.name: Quas
en.desc: Allows manipulation of ice elements. Active Quas instances imbue Invoker with bonus hp regeneration. Passively grants bonus strength per level of Quas.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
en.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

zh.name: 冰
zh.desc: 允许祈求者掌控冰元素。每个活跃的冰元素会让祈求者获得生命恢复加成。每级冰被动提供额外力量。
notes: 祈求者最多只有3个元素。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
zh.scepter: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

en.name: Sun Strike
en.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Deals damage based on the level of Exort, however this damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
en.shard: If Sun Strike damages an enemy Hero, a Forge Spirit of current level is created at the location.
en.scepter: Creates a Cataclysm when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 2 visible 75% damage Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.

zh.name: 阳炎冲击
zh.desc: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。伤害取决于火元素等级，区域内敌人将平摊所有伤害。
notes: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。
zh.shard: 阳炎冲击对敌方英雄造成伤害时，该地点会产生当前等级的熔炉精灵。
zh.scepter: 双击阳炎冲击会发动毁天灭地。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为90秒。每个敌方英雄附近90-180范围内产生2个可见的阳炎冲击，每个都具有75%伤害。

en.name: Sun Strike (AD)
en.desc: Sends a catastrophic ray of fierce energy from the sun at any targeted location, incinerating all enemies standing beneath it once it reaches the earth. Damage is spread evenly over all enemies hit.
notes: Gives vision of the target area before the strike.
Invoker gains experience with kills made from Sun Strike, even if made from outside of experience range.
en.scepter: Adds Cataclysm. Launched when Sun Strike is double tapped. Puts it on a 90 second cooldown. Creates 2 visible Sun Strikes within 90-180 range of each enemy hero.

zh.name: 阳炎冲击（OMG）
zh.desc: 向目标区域释放毁灭性的阳炎之光能量，一旦能量着陆，将对区域内的敌人进行灼烧。区域内所有敌人将平摊伤害。
notes: 施放后立即获得目标区域的视野。
祈求者使用阳炎冲击击杀英雄后，即使不在经验范围内也能获得经验。
zh.scepter: 增加毁天灭地。双击阳炎冲击进行施放。施放后阳炎冲击的冷却时间为90秒。每个敌方英雄附近90-180范围内产生2个可见的阳炎冲击。

en.name: Tornado
en.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level of Wex. Holds enemies in the air for a duration based on the level of Quas. Deals base damage plus added damage based on levels in Wex.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.
en.scepter: Tornado spawns twisters along its path. They persist for Tornado's duration plus additional time based on Quas, dealing damage based on Wex in a 150 radius every 0.25 seconds. (half damage to creeps.)

zh.name: 强袭飓风
zh.desc:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助地漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。最大距离取决于雷元素等级。滞空时间取决于冰元素等级。落地伤害取决于雷元素的等级。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。
zh.scepter: 强袭飓风会沿其路径产生气旋。气旋在飓风的持续时间内会一直持续，并且飓风消失后还会基于冰的等级额外持续数秒。气旋每0.25秒在150范围内基于雷的等级造成伤害。（对非英雄单位造成半额伤害。）

en.name: Tornado (AD)
en.desc:
Unleashes a fast moving tornado that picks up enemy units in its path, suspending them helplessly in the air shortly before allowing them to plummet to their doom. Travels further based on the level and holds enemies in the air for a duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Units are invulnerable while affected by Tornado, and the damage is dealt when landing.

zh.name: 强袭飓风（OMG）
zh.desc:
释放出一道快速移动的飓风，将路径上的敌方单位卷起，使其在空中无助的漂浮一段时间，然后落地受死。行进距离取决于技能等级，敌人将滞空一定时间。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 被强袭飓风吹起时单位处于无敌状态，落地时受到伤害。

en.name: Wex
en.desc: Allows manipulation of storm elements. Active Wex instances imbue Invoker with bonus movement and attack speed. Passively grants bonus agility per level of Wex.
notes: Invoker can only have 3 of any instance.
Will not break invisibility and can be cast while channeling.
en.scepter: Grants 1 current and max level.

zh.name: 雷
zh.desc: 允许祈求者掌控雷元素。每个活跃的雷元素会让祈求者获得移动和攻击速度加成。每级雷被动提供额外敏捷。
notes: 祈求者最多只有3个球。
不会打破隐身状态，而且可以在持续施法期间施放。
zh.scepter: 提供1级当前和最高等级。

en.name: Double Trouble
en.desc: Jakiro's attacks launch an attack from each head, but deal less damage each.
notes: The second attack ignores Damage Block.

zh.name: 天生一对
zh.desc: 杰奇洛攻击时两个头都会发动攻击，不过每个头造成的伤害减少。
notes: 第二次攻击无视伤害格挡。

en.name: Dual Breath
en.desc: An icy blast followed by a wave of fire launches out in a path in front of Jakiro. The ice slows enemies, while the fire delivers damage over time.
notes: Can hit units up to 1025 range away.
Has a 0.2 second interval between each breath.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 冰火交加
zh.desc: 杰奇洛对面前的敌人先后喷出寒冰和火焰。寒冰吐息减速敌人，火焰吐息对敌人造成持续伤害。
notes: 最远能伤害1025距离外的单位。
两次吐息有0.2秒的间隔。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Ice Path
en.desc: Creates a path of ice that stuns and damages enemies that touch it.
notes: It takes 0.2 seconds for the path to reach its full extent.
The stun is removed once Ice Path is destroyed.

zh.name: 冰封路径
zh.desc: 在杰奇洛前方制造一条冰封路径，对触及到的敌人造成伤害并眩晕。
notes: 路径完全成形需要0.2秒。
冰封路径消失后眩晕效果也会消失。

en.name: Destroy Ice Path
en.desc: Destroy the Ice Path, dealing damage and stunning enemies.

zh.name: 摧毁冰封路径
zh.desc: 摧毁冰封路径，对敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

en.name: Liquid Fire
en.desc: Jakiro burns his enemies in an area of effect with fire added to his attack, while slowing their attacks. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.
notes: Works on both units and buildings.
en.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Fire has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Frost.

zh.name: 液态火
zh.desc: 杰奇洛的火焰燃烧效果范围内的敌人，并降低他们的攻击速度。和液态冰共用冷却时间。
notes: 对单位和建筑都有效。
zh.shard: 杰奇洛的液态火没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态冰共用冷却时间。

en.name: Liquid Frost
en.desc: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for 5 seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.
en.shard: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

zh.name: 液态冰
zh.desc: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续5秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
zh.shard: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。

en.name: Macropyre
en.desc: Jakiro exhales a wide line of lasting flames, which deals damage per second to any enemy units caught in the fire.
notes: Units hit by Macropyre will continue to be affected after they leave the area for 1 additional seconds.
en.scepter: Increases Macropyre duration and causes it to deal Pure damage. Jakiro emits two walls of ice along the edges of the Macropyre that slow any enemies trying to cross them by 60%.

zh.name: 烈焰焚身
zh.desc: 杰奇洛释放出烈焰风暴，烈焰风暴作用范围很宽，并持续数秒。烈焰风暴每秒都会对作用范围内的敌人造成伤害。
notes: 被烈焰焚身击中后离开区域还将额外受到1秒伤害效果。
zh.scepter: 提升烈焰焚身的持续时间，并且变为纯粹伤害。杰奇洛会在烈焰焚身边缘放出两道冰墙，对试图穿过的所有敌人减速60%。

en.name: Blade Dance
en.desc: Gives Juggernaut a chance to deal critical damage with Blade Fury and on each attack.

zh.name: 剑舞
zh.desc: 主宰有一定概率在攻击时触发致命一击。

en.name: Blade Fury
en.desc: Causes a bladestorm of destructive force around Juggernaut, rendering him debuff immune with 80% magic resistance and dealing damage every 0.2s to nearby enemy units. Applies a strong dispel at the end of the spin.
notes: You can use items during Blade Fury.
Juggernaut can still perform attacks while in Blade Fury. However, only units that are not affected by Blade Fury, such as wards or structures, will take damage from these attacks.
en.scepter:
Increases radius and slows enemies in the area of effect.

 Juggernaut preforms an attack on affected enemies every %attack_interval%s.

zh.name: 剑刃风暴
zh.desc: 舞起具有破坏性力量的剑刃风暴，使主宰获得减益免疫状态，魔法抗性提升80%，并且每0.2秒对主宰周围的敌方单位造成伤害。旋转结束时施加强驱散效果。
notes: 剑刃风暴期间可以使用物品。
主宰在施放剑刃风暴的过程中依然可以进行物理攻击。但是只有不受剑刃风暴伤害的单位，如守卫和建筑才会受到这些物理伤害。
zh.scepter:
提升作用范围并减速范围内的敌人。

主宰每%attack_interval%秒对作用的敌人发动一次攻击。

en.name: Bladeform
en.desc: Juggernaut gains a stack of Bladeform every 2s that Juggernaut does not take damage. Each stack grants bonus base Agility and Movement Speed. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 剑心犹在
zh.desc: 主宰未受到伤害时每2秒获得一层剑心的叠加层数。每层叠加效果提供基础敏捷和移动速度加成。叠加效果在受到任何伤害时会粘滞2秒后再消失。
notes: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

en.name: Duelist
en.desc: Juggernaut deals 12% more damage to targets that are facing him. Damage bonus always applies during Omnislash.

zh.name: 决斗达人
zh.desc: 主宰对面朝他的目标造成的伤害增加12%。额外伤害在无敌斩期间始终有效。

en.name: Healing Ward
en.desc: Summons a Healing Ward which heals all nearby allied units, based on their max health.  The Healing Ward moves at 325 movement speed after being summoned.  Lasts 18 / 20 / 22 / 24 seconds.
notes: The Healing Ward can be controlled.
Multiple Healing Wards do not stack.
en.shard: Increases ward healing and health.

zh.name: 治疗守卫
zh.desc: 召唤一个治疗守卫，按周围友军单位最大生命值的一定比例治疗他们。治疗守卫可以移动，移动速度为325。持续18 / 20 / 22 / 24秒。
notes: 可以控制治疗守卫。
多个治疗守卫的效果不会叠加。
zh.shard: 提升守卫的治疗量和生命值。

en.name: Omnislash
en.desc:
Juggernaut leaps towards the target enemy units, and then slashes the target and other nearby enemy units at an increased attack rate. Juggernaut is invulnerable for the duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: You can use items during Omnislash.

zh.name: 无敌斩
zh.desc:
主宰挥剑跃向敌方目标单位，随后再以更短的攻击频率斩击该单位和附近的其它敌方单位。主宰在无敌斩期间无敌。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 无敌斩期间可以使用物品。

en.name: Swiftslash
en.desc: Performs a short Omnislash for 1 seconds.

zh.name: 迅风斩
zh.desc: 发动一次短时间的无敌斩，持续1秒。

en.name: Blinding Light
en.desc: A blinding light flashes over the targeted area, knocking back units to the edge of the area and blinding them, causing them to miss some attacks. Minimum knockback distance is 175 range over 0.6 seconds.
notes: Upon landing, units will destroy trees in a 150 radius.

zh.name: 致盲之光
zh.desc: 一道致盲之光在目标区域闪现，把区域内的单位击退到区域边缘，并造成致盲，使他们的部分攻击不能命中。最短击退距离是在0.6秒内击退175距离。
notes: 落地后受作用单位将摧毁150范围内的树木。

en.name: Bright Speed
en.desc:
Keeper of the Light gains 1 movement speed for every 3 Intelligence.

Whenever Keeper of the Light moves 300 distance, he leaves behind light that allows him to see 400 range for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 光明速度
zh.desc:
光之守卫每3点智力都会获得1移动速度。

只要光之守卫移动300距离，他就会留下一道光，可以看到400范围，持续3秒。

en.name: Chakra Magic
en.desc: Restores mana to the target unit and reduces cooldowns of all basic abilities currently on cooldown by a fixed amount. Is 30% more effective when used on himself.
notes: Chakra Magic does not reduce the cooldown of Ultimate abilities.

zh.name: 查克拉魔法
zh.desc: 恢复目标单位的魔法值，并减少所有冷却中基础技能（非大招）的冷却时间。对自身使用时效果提升30%。
notes: 查克拉魔法无法减少终极技能的冷却时间。

en.name: Illuminate
en.desc: CHANNELED - Channels light energy, building power the longer it's channeled.  Once released, a wave is sent forth that deals damage and gives vision in its path.  The longer it is channeled, the more damage is dealt.
notes: Gives increasing vision over the channeling time.

zh.name: 冲击波
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 引导光的能量，持续施法的时间越长，威力越大。释放后，光波沿直线向前发出，造成伤害并获得沿途的视野。
notes: 在持续施法期间获得的视野不断增大。

en.name: Release Illuminate
en.desc: Release the channel early.

zh.name: 释放冲击波
zh.desc: 提前结束能量积聚。

en.name: Solar Bind
en.desc: Weakens an enemy's magical resistance, and applies a slow that increases in strength the more the target moves.
en.shard: Grants 2 charges.

zh.name: 炎阳之缚
zh.desc: 削弱一个敌人的魔法抗性，并施加减速效果，目标移动的距离越长，减速效果越大。
zh.shard: 获得2点能量点数。

en.name: Recall
en.desc:
After a short delay, teleports the targeted friendly hero to your location.  If the targeted friendly hero takes player based damage during this time, the ability is interrupted. When cast, the teleport target's movement speed is increased. Upon teleporting, the increased movement speed buff are applied to both Keeper of the Light and the teleport target, and the latter also receives a Chakra Magic.

 If alt-cast, teleports Keeper of the Light to the target Ally instead.
