 Ability Level increases with levels of Spirit Form.
notes: If Keeper of the Light dies, the spell effect is interrupted.
Recall will interrupt channeling spells.
You can disable help to prevent Keeper from casting this spell on you.
Can be cast through the minimap, choosing the nearest friendly hero.

zh.name: 召回
zh.desc:
短暂延迟后，将友方英雄目标传送到你的位置。如果在此期间，友方英雄目标受到来自玩家的伤害，召回将被打断。施放时会对光之守卫和传送目标同时施加移动速度加成，并且传送目标会被施加查克拉魔法。

如果设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），会把光之守卫传送至目标友军。

技能等级随着灵魂形态的等级提升。
notes: 如果光之守卫死亡，技能效果将会中断。
召回将打断持续施法。
可以选择禁用帮助，防止光之守卫对你使用此技能。
可以点击小地图施放，将会选择施放点最近的友方英雄。

en.name: Special Reserve
en.desc: Keeper of the Light cannot go below 75 mana.

zh.name: 特别储备
zh.desc: 光之守卫的魔法值不会低于75。

en.name: Spirit Form
en.desc: Ezalor temporarily turns his body luminescent, gaining cast range, increasing the speed bonus from Bright Speed, and allows Illuminate to be channeled by a separate spirit and heal allies.
en.shard: Increases illuminate heal.

zh.name: 灵魂形态
zh.desc: 伊扎洛暂时使身体发光，获得施法距离加成，提升光明速度的移速加成，并且冲击波将由一个单独的灵魂施法，可以治疗友军。
zh.shard: 提升冲击波的治疗效果。

en.name: Will-O-Wisp
en.desc: Summons Ignis Fatuus at the targeted area. Alternates on and off, drawing enemies closer with its mesmerising flicker.
notes: Ignus Fatuus applies a non-interrupting pull towards it on all enemies within the radius.

zh.name: 灵光
zh.desc: 在目标区域召唤幻火。幻火交替闪亮和闪灭。闪亮时蛊惑敌人靠近，并造成伤害。
notes: 幻火会对作用范围内所有敌人施加朝其牵引的效果，该牵引效果不会打断。

en.name: Echo Slash
en.desc: Kez slashes forward in a 800 distance line with his Katana, attacking enemies in an area and applying a brief 100% impact slow. After a short delay, the area is attacked again. Heroes take bonus damage.
notes: Destroys trees. Doesn't apply Cleave.

zh.name: 回音重斩
zh.desc: 凯挥舞他的长刀向前沿一条直线斩击800距离，攻击区域内的敌人并施加短暂的100%减速。经过短暂延迟后，这个区域会被再次攻击。英雄会承受额外伤害。
notes: 会摧毁树木。不会继承分裂效果。

en.name: Falcon Rush
en.desc: Kez gains the ability to rush towards enemy targets to deliver echoing secondary attacks.  While in this state, Kez has phased collision and slow resistance.
notes: Does not work on buildings.

zh.name: 天隼冲击
zh.desc: 开启后凯可以向敌方目标冲去，发动的攻击会重复一次。在这个状态下，凯拥有相位移动状态和减速抗性。
notes: 不会对建筑生效。

en.name: Grappling Claw
en.desc: Kez swings on a grappling hook towards the target unit or tree.  When the grappling hook collides with the target, that unit has slowed movement speed. Upon reaching the enemy target, Kez lands an attack on them.

zh.name: 制敌爪钩
zh.desc: 凯向目标单位或者树木发射一枚抓钩并摆荡过去。抓钩碰到目标后，该单位会被减速。凯到达敌方目标时，落地会发动一次攻击。

en.name: Kazurai Katana
en.desc:
Katana attacks and abilities apply a stacking damage over time to enemies that deals a percentage of the original attack's damage as additional damage over time. 

Kez may activate the ability to impale the target with his attack, preventing them from moving or turning. The target's Katana debuff bursts, causing some of the stacks to deal damage instantly.
en.shard: Kez lifesteals 100% from the impale. If the impale comes from behind the target, the target is stunned. Increases max burst stacks.

zh.name: 影武长刀
zh.desc:
长刀的攻击和技能会对敌人施加一个可叠加的持续伤害效果，持续时间内造成原攻击伤害一定百分比的额外伤害。

凯可以主动使用技能，刺中目标，阻止他们移动或转身。目标身上的影武长刀效果爆发，使部分叠加数值立刻造成伤害。
zh.shard: 刺中后凯能从当次攻击吸血100%。如果从背后刺中目标，目标会被眩晕。提升最大爆发叠加数值。

en.name: Raptor Dance
en.desc:
Kez enters into an uncontrollable state for 1 second, becoming invulnerable for 0.2s and receiving a basic dispel.

If the cast completes successfully, Kez performs a series of deadly radial slashes around him that deal damage based on the max health of the target and heal Kez for a percentage of all damage dealt.
notes: Slash Lifesteal is reduced to 20% when slashing a creep or an illusion.

zh.name: 猛禽之舞
zh.desc:
凯进入不可控制的状态，持续1秒，0.2秒为无敌状态并获得一次弱驱散效果。

如果施法成功完成，凯会对周围发动致命的辐射状斩击，基于目标的最大生命值造成伤害，并且造成伤害的一定百分比会治疗凯。
notes: 斩击非英雄单位或幻象时吸血量减少至20%。

en.name: Raven's Veil
en.desc: Kez releases a wave of smoke that applies his Mark to nearby enemy heroes, briefly reducing their vision. Kez receives a basic dispel and gains bonus movement speed and invisibility until he attacks or casts a spell.

zh.name: 渡鸦之纱
zh.desc: 凯释放出一阵迷烟，对附近敌方英雄施加标记，暂时削弱他们的视野。凯获得弱驱散效果、移动速度加成和隐身状态，直到他攻击或施法。
stats: 视野负面状态持续时间：4

en.name: Shodo Sai
en.desc:
Kez has a chance to critically strike the target when attacking with Sais.

Kez may activate the ability to disarm himself, lock his facing, and parry attacks and attack effects from the targeted direction for 1.5 seconds. If an attack is parried from an enemy Hero in this way, that Hero is stunned for 0.4s and gains a Mark.  When a Marked target is attacked by Kez, it will guarantee a critical strike and stun the target.

The sub-ability may be used to cancel the blocking early.
en.shard: Parrying creates a stronger Mark that deals additional stun and critical damage.

zh.name: 翔影之钗
zh.desc:
装备双钗时凯的攻击有几率对敌人造成致命一击。

凯可以主动开启技能，使自身被缴械，面朝方向被锁定，招架来自目标方向的攻击和攻击效果，持续1.5秒。如果有敌方英雄的攻击被招架，该英雄会被眩晕0.4秒并获得印记，拥有印记的目标被凯攻击时必定会造成致命一击，并且被眩晕。

子技能可以用于提前取消招架状态。
zh.shard: 招架会产生更强的印记，造成额外眩晕和致命一击伤害。

en.name: Cancel
en.desc: Stop blocking physical attacks.

zh.name: 取消
zh.desc: 停止招架物理攻击。

en.name: Switch Discipline
en.desc:
Kez switches between his Kazurai Katana and Shodo Sai.

He gains different attack capabilities and abilities based on the weapon equipped. The abilities level up together, and when an ability is used, the associated alternate weapon ability also goes on cooldown.

Kez deals extra damage on the first Katana hit or ability after switching to Katana, and gains bonus speed after switching to Sai.
en.scepter:
Casting a weapon ability that would set its alternate weapon ability on cooldown does not do so if it's the first one used within 3 seconds after casting Switch Discipline or if it was already on cooldown.

Casting any weapon ability refreshes the cooldown of Switch Discipline.

zh.name: 流派变换
zh.desc:
凯可以在影武长刀和翔影双钗之间变换。

基于装备的武器，他会获得不同的攻击特性和技能。技能会一起升级，而且使用后，相对的武器技能也会进入冷却。

凯切换到长刀后第一次长刀攻击或技能会造成额外伤害，切换到双钗后会获得额外移动速度。
zh.scepter:
在使用流派变换后3秒内施放的第一个技能不会使相对的武器技能进入冷却，或者已进入冷却的技能会结束冷却。

施放任何武器的技能都会重置流派变换的冷却时间。
stats: 长刀敏捷额外提供基础攻击力：12%
切换双钗加速持续时间：2

en.name: Talon Toss
en.desc: Kez throws a Sai at the target unit, applying a fixed damage attack and silence.
notes: The fixed damage attack has True Strike.

zh.name: 利爪飞掷
zh.desc: 凯向目标单位掷出一把钗，施加一次固定伤害的攻击，并造成沉默。
notes: 固定伤害的攻击具有克敌机先效果。

en.name: Steal Weapon
en.desc: Every third attack Kobold Soldier will disarm its target temporarily. Attack counter doesn't increase while ability is on cooldown.

zh.name: 偷窃武器
zh.desc: 冷却时间每到第三次攻击，狗头人士兵就会暂时缴械目标。攻击计数在技能冷却期间不会增加。

en.name: Speed Aura
en.desc: The Kobold Foreman's cruel efficiency increases his movement speed and the movement speed of all nearby allies.

zh.name: 速度光环
zh.desc: 狗头人长官残酷地追求效率，提高他和附近所有友军的移动速度。

en.name: Prospecting Aura
en.desc: Kobolds are adept at finding gold, increasing nearby allied heroes' GPM.

zh.name: 淘金光环
zh.desc: 狗头人擅长淘金，提升了周围友方英雄的每分钟金钱。

en.name: Admiral's Rum
en.desc: Damage from enemy heroes, buildings, or Roshan that would reduce Kunkka below 65% threshold causes him to douse himself with The Admiral's Rum, receiving bonus movement speed and a delayed reaction to 18% of incoming damage for 5s.
notes: Damage dealt after Rum wears off is non-lethal and can never kill a hero.

zh.name: 统帅朗姆酒
zh.desc: 如果昆卡受到来自敌方英雄、建筑或肉山的伤害会使他的生命低于65%临界值，那么他会浸在统帅朗姆酒中，获得移动速度加成，并且延后承受即将受到的18%伤害，持续5秒。
notes: 在朗姆酒效果消失后造成的伤害不能致死，而且不能杀死英雄。

en.name: Ghostship
en.desc:
Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.

Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a 2x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
notes: Actual area of effect of ship's collision is larger than the boat itself.
The boat has a movement speed of 650.
en.scepter: Ghostship creates a fleet of 2 ships at the target point on a 2.5 second interval. Each ship now also fires 3 waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal 40% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

zh.name: 幽灵船
zh.desc:
召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。

被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
notes: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为650。
zh.scepter: 幽灵船在目标地点以2.5秒的间隔产生2艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射3波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成40%幽灵船伤害。

en.name: Return
en.desc: Returns the marked hero to the X.

zh.name: 送回
zh.desc: 将标记的英雄送回X位置。

en.name: Tidal Wave
en.desc: Releases a Tidal Wave that spawns behind Kunkka. Deals damage and drags enemies along it. Enemies cannot attack while being dragged.

zh.name: 潮汐波
zh.desc: 释放一道在昆卡身后出现的潮汐波。造成点伤害，并将敌人沿着波浪拖拽距离。敌人被拖拽时无法攻击。

en.name: Tidebringer
en.desc: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

zh.name: 潮汐使者
zh.desc: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。

en.name: Torrent
en.desc: Summons a rising torrent that, after a short delay, hurls enemy units into the sky, stunning, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes: The initial bubble effect is only visible to allies and provides vision in fog of war.
Units tossed in the air will be stunned and still able to be attacked.

zh.name: 洪流
zh.desc: 召唤喷涌的洪流，短暂延迟后，将敌人冲上天，造成伤害、眩晕和减速。
notes: 初始泡泡效果仅对队友可见，并且提供战争迷雾中的视野。
飞到半空的单位将会被眩晕并且可以被攻击。

en.name: X Marks the Spot
en.desc: Targets a friendly or enemy Hero, marks their position with an X, and returns them to it after several seconds.  Kunkka can trigger the return at any time during the duration. Lasts twice as long on allied heroes.

zh.name: X标记
zh.desc: 对友方或敌方英雄使用，用 X 标记他们当前位置，数秒后将他们送回 X 标记处。在技能持续时间内，昆卡可以手动触发送回。对友方英雄使用后持续时间加倍。

en.name: Amphibian Rhapsody
en.desc:
Largo gets ready to groove. He is disarmed and his ability bar switches to 3 song abilities, each with different effects. Songs are only effective if strummed on the beat.

Every time he strums successfully, he gains a stack of Groovin'. Each stack gives him bonus armor and reduces the mana cost of every song, but he loses a stack if he misses a beat. Stacks linger for a short duration when Largo's song ends.
notes: Items can be used while in this mode.
en.scepter: Largo can play two songs per beat by strumming both at the same time.
stats: SONG MANA COST REDUCTION PER STACK: 1 / 1.5 / 2

zh.name: 两栖狂想曲
zh.desc:
朗戈准备好弹奏乐曲。他被缴械，而他的技能栏切换为3个乐曲技能，每个都有不同的效果。乐曲只有弹在节拍上才会生效。

每次成功弹奏他都会获得一层律动的叠加效果。每层叠加效果都会对他提供额外护甲，并且降低每首乐曲的魔法消耗，但是他只要错过一次节拍就会失去一层叠加效果。叠加效果在朗戈的乐曲结束后还会粘滞一小段时间。
notes: 这个模式下可以使用物品。
zh.scepter: 朗戈在每次节拍时可以弹奏两首乐曲。
stats: 每层叠加乐曲魔耗降低：1 / 1.5 / 2

en.name: Catchy Lick
en.desc:
Largo licks the targeted unit with his tongue, pulling it back a short distance, applying a basic dispel, and dealing damage if it's an enemy.

Killing or dispelling an effect from a target grants Largo temporary health regeneration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Can lick runes to pull them.

zh.name: 动人之舐
zh.desc:
朗戈用他的舌头舔舐目标单位，把它拉回一小段距离，施加弱驱散，如果是敌人还会造成伤害。

击杀目标或驱散目标的效果后都会使朗戈暂时获得生命恢复。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 可以舔舐神符，将其牵引。

en.name: Croak of Genius
en.desc:
Largo strums a tune to a friendly hero. The hero's items and abilities have reduced mana cost and a percentage of their damage reverberates over the following 5 seconds.

When an affected hero spends mana, the remaining buff duration is reduced by 0.5s. Duration is not reduced for Largo himself.
notes: Only applies to damage sources affected by spell amplification.
Only applies to damage where the source and target are within 2000 units of each other.

zh.name: 灵呱一闪
zh.desc:
朗戈对一名友方英雄弹奏一首小调。英雄的技能和物品拥有的魔法消耗降低，并且造成伤害后会回响，接下来5秒内再次造成原本伤害的一定百分比。

只要作用下的英雄消耗了魔法，本增益的剩余持续时间都会减少0.5秒。朗戈身上的持续时间不会减少。
notes: 只适用于可受到技能增强作用的伤害来源。
只会在来源和目标相距2000以内时施加伤害。

en.name: Encore
en.desc: Buffs that Largo applies to himself or his team have extended duration.
en.shard:
Whenever Largo applies a Unit Target buff to a friendly hero, he also gets the buff.

If Largo targets himself, the buff is also applied to the nearest allied hero within the cast range of the targeted ability.

zh.name: 安可
zh.desc: 朗戈对自身或队友施加的增益效果会延长持续时间。
zh.shard:
只要朗戈对友方英雄施加单位目标技能的增益效果，他也会获得该增益。

只要朗戈对自身施加，该增益也会施加给指向性技能的施法距离内最近的友方英雄。

en.name: Frogstomp
en.desc: Largo tosses froglings to an area. They stomp the ground every 1 second, dealing damage and ministuns, and enemies in the area have reduced movement speed.

zh.name: 蛙力千钧
zh.desc: 朗戈把小青蛙扔到一片区域。他们每1秒都会践踏地面，造成伤害和短暂眩晕并且区域内敌人的移动速度会被减缓。

en.name: Hotfeet Hustle
en.desc: Largo plays a song that increases nearby friendly units' movement speed and grants a brief slow resistance.

zh.name: 疾步生风
zh.desc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会提升附近友方单位的移动速度，还有短时间的减速抗性。

en.name: Bullbelly Blitz
en.desc: Largo plays a song that deals 20 / 30 / 40 magical damage to nearby enemies. The song also increases nearby allied heroes' spell amplification and grants their attacks additional magic damage.
en.scepter: Deals additional 6 / 10 / 14 magic damage per Groovin' stack when this song is used in double-strumming.

zh.name: 巨腹闪电战
zh.desc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲对附近敌人造成20 / 30 / 40点魔法伤害。乐曲还会使附近友方英雄的技能增强提升，并且他们的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。
zh.scepter: 这首乐曲用于两首共弹时每层律动都会额外造成6 / 10 / 14点魔法伤害。

en.name: Island Elixir
en.desc: Largo plays a song that heals nearby friendly heroes.

zh.name: 大屿灵药
zh.desc: 朗戈弹奏的乐曲会治疗附近友方英雄。

en.name: Duel
en.desc: Legion Commander and the target enemy hero are forced to attack each other for a short duration. Neither hero can use items, and the target enemy hero cannot use abilities. If either hero dies during the duration, the hero winning the Duel gains permanent bonus damage.
notes: Duels will end if the units are pushed 2000 units apart.
en.scepter: When Legion Commander wins a duel, Press the Attack is automatically triggered around her.

zh.name: 决斗
zh.desc: 军团指挥官强制与目标敌方英雄进行决斗，持续短暂的数秒。决斗开始后双方英雄不能使用任何物品，而目标敌方英雄不能使用技能。如果有英雄在决斗期间死亡，赢得决斗的英雄将永久获得攻击力加成。
notes: 如果双方距离超过2000，决斗也会结束。
zh.scepter: 如果军团指挥官在决斗中获胜，会在她周围自动触发强攻。

en.name: Moment of Courage
en.desc: When attacked a number of times, Legion Commander will counter-attack her target with bonus lifesteal.
notes: The lifestealing strike is only triggered if being attacked.

zh.name: 勇气之霎
zh.desc: 每当受到攻击达到一定次数，军团指挥官都会对目标立即作出反击，而且此次攻击具有吸血效果。
notes: 只有在攻击他人时受到攻击才会触发带有吸血的反击。

en.name: Outfight Them!
en.desc: When Legion Commander or an allied Hero within 1200 range casts an ability, they gain bonus armor for 6s; allies gain 50% of the value.  This bonus stacks independently.

zh.name: 迎难而战！
zh.desc: 如果军团指挥官或附近1200范围内的友方英雄施放技能，他们会获得6秒的护甲加成；其中友军获得的数值为50%。这个加成效果独立叠加。

en.name: Overwhelming Odds
en.desc: Turns the foes' numbers against them, dealing a 100% impact slow for 0.3s and damage to all enemies in the area. Damage increases with each enemy unit or hero in the area, and grants Legion Commander bonus attack speed.
en.shard: Overwhelming Odds has larger radius and grants an all damage barrier based on the damage it deals to enemy heroes.

zh.name: 压倒性优势
zh.desc: 用敌人的数量反制他们，对附近的所有敌人造成伤害，击中时施加100%减速，持续0.3秒。范围内每个敌方单位和英雄都会使伤害提升。另外还会向军团指挥官提供攻击速度加成。
zh.shard: 压倒性优势的范围更大，会根据对敌方英雄造成的伤害提供全伤害护盾。

en.name: Press The Attack
en.desc:
Removes debuffs and disables from the target friendly unit, and grants bonus movement speed and health regen for a short time.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
en.scepter: Increases movement speed and becomes an 500 area of effect ability, and always affects Legion Commander when used.

zh.name: 强攻
zh.desc:
移除友方目标单位的负面效果和控制技能，并提升其移动速度和生命恢复，持续一定时间。

驱散类型：强驱散
zh.scepter: 提升移动速度，变为500范围型技能，而且使用时总是会作用于军团指挥官。

en.name: Chronoptic Nourishment
en.desc: Leshrac restores mana equal to 25% of damage dealt by his attacks. Only grants mana when attacking enemies that have mana. 50% mana restoration penalty when attacking creeps.

zh.name: 时光滋养
zh.desc: 拉席克攻击敌人后会回复25%造成伤害的魔法。只有在攻击拥有魔法的敌人时才会获得魔法。攻击非英雄单位时回复的魔法减少50%。

en.name: Defilement
en.desc: Leshrac gains 0.7 Area of Effect Bonus per Intelligence.

zh.name: 大肆污染
zh.desc: 拉席克的每点智力都会提供0.7作用范围加成。

en.name: Diabolic Edict
en.desc: Saturates the area around Leshrac with magical explosions that deal pure damage to enemy units and buildings.  The fewer units available to attack, the more damage those units will take.
notes: The explosions will continue even if Leshrac is killed.

zh.name: 恶魔敕令
zh.desc: 使拉席克周围的区域充满魔法性爆炸，对敌方单位和建筑造成纯粹伤害。范围内的敌人越少，他们受到的伤害就越高。
notes: 即使拉席克死亡，爆炸还是会在原地继续。

en.name: Nihilism
en.desc: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

zh.name: 虚无主义
zh.desc: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。

en.name: Lightning Storm
en.desc: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

zh.name: 闪电风暴
zh.desc: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。

en.name: Pulse Nova
en.desc: Creates waves of damaging energy around Leshrac, one per second, to damage nearby enemy units. Drains Leshrac's mana with each pulse.

zh.name: 脉冲新星
zh.desc: 拉席克在他周围创造破坏性的能量波，每秒对附近敌方单位造成伤害。每次脉冲都会消耗拉席克的魔法。

en.name: Split Earth
en.desc: Splits the earth under enemies. Deals damage and stuns for a short duration.
notes: Split Earth will destroy trees in its area of effect.
There is a 0.35 second delay before the effect is applied.
en.shard: Causes Split Earth to repeat in the same location 2 additional times, with a 5 second delay between each one. Each time the radius increases by 45. Split Earth echo location is visible to both teams.

zh.name: 撕裂大地
zh.desc: 撕裂敌人脚下的大地。造成伤害和短暂的眩晕。
notes: 撕裂大地将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
技能经过0.35秒延迟后生效。
zh.shard: 撕裂大地在相同地点再重复2次，重复间隔为5秒。每次作用范围增加45。撕裂大地的重复地点对双方队伍可见。

en.name: Chain Frost
en.desc: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to 10 times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes: Chain Frost cannot be disjointed.
Chain Frost has a movement speed of 850.
Chain Frost doesn't bounce to Zombies.

zh.name: 连环霜冻
zh.desc: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多10次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
notes: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为850。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

en.name: Sacrifice
en.desc:
Sacrifice an allied creep to convert its current health into mana for Lich and give Lich its experience bounty.

Begins the game on cooldown and with no charges.
notes: Cannot sacrifice ancients or creep-heroes.
Sacrificed creeps count as denies and can give experience to enemy heroes. Lich's experience bounty and enemy heroes' deny experience are independent.

zh.name: 献身
zh.desc:
牺牲一个友方非英雄单位，把它的当前生命值转化为巫妖的魔法，并且巫妖获得它的击杀经验。

游戏开始时处于冷却，没有能量点数。
notes: 无法牺牲远古或类英雄单位。
被牺牲的非英雄单位记为反补，会对敌方英雄提供经验。巫妖获得的击杀经验和敌方英雄获得的反补经验为分开计算。

en.name: Frost Blast
en.desc: Blasts the target enemy unit with damaging frost, dealing area damage and slowing movement and attack rates for 4 seconds.  The primary target receives both base and area damage.

zh.name: 寒霜爆发
zh.desc: 破坏性的寒霜在目标敌方单位身上爆发，造成范围伤害并降低范围内敌人的移动和攻击速度，持续4秒。主要目标所受伤害最高。

en.name: Frost Shield
en.desc: Applies a magical frost shield around the target, reducing damage from attacks against it. While the shield is active, ice magic will affect nearby enemy units every 1 seconds, dealing minor damage and slowing them.
notes: Spell-immune enemies are not affected by the damage or slow.
Frost Shield can be cast on buildings.

zh.name: 冰霜魔盾
zh.desc: 施加一个冰霜魔盾环绕目标，减少受到的普通攻击伤害。魔盾生效时，每1秒都会对附近的敌方单位放出冰霜魔法，造成少量伤害和减速。
notes: 免疫技能的敌人不会受到伤害或减速。
冰霜魔盾可以对友方建筑施放。

en.name: Ice Spire
en.desc:
Creates an Ice Spire at the target spot, slowing enemies around it. Can take 4 hero hits or 8 creep hits and when destroyed it will create a Frost Blast around it.

Chain Frost can be cast on the Spire and can bounce to the Spire and damage the spire by 1 hero attack if there are no other enemies in range.

Lich can cast Frost Shield on the Spire. Each Frost Shield tick will heal the spire by 1 hero attack.

zh.name: 寒冰尖柱
zh.desc:
在目标地点创造一根寒冰尖柱，减缓范围内敌人的移动速度。可以承受4次英雄攻击或8次非英雄攻击，并且被摧毁时会在附近产生一个寒霜爆发的效果。

连环霜冻可以对尖柱施放，并且范围内没有其他敌人时可以弹跳至冰柱上，同时对尖柱造成1点英雄攻击。

巫妖可以对其施放冰霜魔盾。冰霜魔盾每次造成伤害时会治疗尖柱，使其回复1次英雄攻击次数。

en.name: Sinister Gaze
en.desc: CHANNELED - Hypnotizes an enemy unit, causing it to move towards a point between the two of you and drains a percentage of its current mana.
en.scepter: Sinister Gaze becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Sinister Gaze allows Lich to cast other abilities while channeling it.

zh.name: 阴邪凝视
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 使一个敌方单位着魔，缓慢走到巫妖与其之间的一点，并吸取其当前魔法值的一定百分比。
zh.scepter: 阴邪凝视变成范围型技能，对目标区域400范围内所有单位生效。在阴邪凝视的持续施法期间可以施放其他技能。

en.name: Consume
en.desc: Lifestealer eats the host body from the inside out, exploding from within.

zh.name: 吞灭
zh.desc: 噬魂鬼从宿主身体内部吃掉宿主，同时突然现身。

en.name: Feast
en.desc: Lifestealer's attacks deal damage and provide heal for a percentage of his target's max health. He gains permanent max HP whenever he kills a unit.
notes: Works on allies and enemies. Does not affect Roshan.
The heal is independent of the damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 盛宴
zh.desc: 噬魂鬼每次攻击时还会根据目标最大生命值的一定百分比造成伤害，同时获得治疗。每次击杀单位他都会获得永久生命上限。
notes: 对友军和敌人有效。对肉山无效。
回复量与造成伤害相互独立。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
stats: 击杀英雄获得生命上限：10
击杀非英雄获得生命上限：1

en.name: Ghoul Frenzy
en.desc: Passively grants Lifestealer Attack Speed.

zh.name: 尸鬼狂怒
zh.desc: 被动提升噬魂鬼的攻击速度。

en.name: Infest
en.desc:
Lifestealer infests the body of a target unit, becoming undetectable, and healing for a portion of his max hitpoints every second while inside. He can then explode from the host body, dealing damage to nearby enemies. If the infested unit is an enemy creep or a neutral creep, he can take control of the unit's ability to move and attack, and the creep loses a portion of their max hitpoints over time. Does not work on enemy heroes.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Lifestealer gains experience while under the effects of Infest.
Creeps that are controlled while Infested gain Infest's movement speed bonus.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Infest can be used on Ancient creeps.
en.shard: Consuming a creep with Infest drenches enemies in blood which deals damage over time based on the host's remaining health.
en.scepter: Increases cast range and reduces cooldown to 20s.  Infest may target enemy heroes for a short duration, attacking them from the inside while increasing Lifestealer's regeneration rate.

zh.name: 感染
zh.desc:
噬魂鬼进入目标单位的身体，无法被察觉，而且自身在体内时每秒恢复最大生命值的一定百分比。接着可以从宿主体内现身，对周围所有敌方单位造成伤害。如果被感染单位是敌方非英雄单位或中立生物，噬魂鬼可以控制其进行移动和攻击，而且该生物会持续失去最大生命值的一部分。无法对敌方英雄生效。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 噬魂鬼在感染一个单位期间能够从周围死亡的单位身上获得经验。
被感染控制的单位会获得感染的移动速度加成。
不会触发法术反弹。
感染可以对远古生物使用。
zh.shard: 吞噬感染的中立生物会使敌人沾满鲜血，根据宿主的剩余生命值造成持续伤害。
zh.scepter: 提升施法距离并且冷却时间降低至20秒。感染可以对敌方英雄施放，持续时间较短，并在他们体内发动攻击，同时提升噬魂鬼的恢复速率。
stats: 自身最大生命值每秒恢复：3 / 4 / 5%
生物每秒最大生命值流失：1.5 / 0.75 / 0%
剩余生命值作为总伤害：30%

en.name: Open Wounds
en.desc: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
notes: Open Wounds slows over 8 different steps: 50% / 50% / 40% / 30% / 20% / 10% / 10% / 10%, with the slow decreasing one step per second.
The amount healed is amplified by Lifestealer's Health Restoration Amplification.

zh.name: 撕裂伤口
zh.desc: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
notes: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

en.name: Rage
en.desc:
Launch into a maddened rage, becoming Debuff Immune, increasing magic resistance and gaining movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 狂暴
zh.desc:
进入狂暴状态，变成减益免疫，提升魔法抗性和移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Unfettered
en.desc:
Descend into a violent fury, gaining increased status and magic resistance. Applies a dispel and can be cast while disabled.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel

zh.name: 肆意狂怒
zh.desc:
陷入狂烈的愤怒，获得状态抗性和魔法抗性加成。施加驱散，而且被控制时可以施放。

驱散类型：强驱散

en.name: Combustion
en.desc: Every 175 damage Lina does to an enemy hero causes them to overheat, doing damage to their nearby allies. This effect can trigger multiple times off a single instance of damage. Overheated illusions do less damage.

zh.name: 燎火
zh.desc: 莉娜每对一名敌方英雄造成175点伤害都会使他们过热，对附近他们的友军造成伤害。单次伤害可以多次触发该效果。过热的幻象造成的伤害会减少。

en.name: Dragon Slave
en.desc: Lina channels the breath of a dragon, sending out a wave of fire that scorches every enemy in its path.
notes: Dragon Slave can hit units up to 1225 units away.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 龙破斩
zh.desc: 莉娜引导龙的吐息，放出一波火焰，烧焦所有波及的敌人。
notes: 龙破斩最远能伤害1225距离外的单位。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Fiery Soul
en.desc: Grants bonus attack and movement speed each time Lina hits an enemy with a spell. Stacks with itself. Lasts 16 seconds.
notes: Duration refreshes each time an opponent is hit with a spell.
Using items does not trigger Fiery Soul.

zh.name: 炽魂
zh.desc: 莉娜每次利用技能击中一个敌人都会使她获得攻击和移动速度加成。可以叠加。持续16秒。
notes: 每次技能击中敌人时都会刷新持续时间。
使用物品不会触发炽魂。

en.name: Flame Cloak
en.desc: Grants Lina unobstructed movement and increases her spell damage and magic resistance. Grants max fiery soul stacks on activation.

zh.name: 腾焰斗篷
zh.desc: 使莉娜获得顺畅的移动状态，并且提升技能伤害和魔法抗性。开启时获得炽魂的最高叠加层数。

en.name: Laguna Blade
en.desc: Fires off a bolt of lightning at a single enemy unit, dealing massive damage.
notes: Laguna Blade has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
en.shard: Casting Laguna Blade temporarily supercharges Lina, granting her stacks of Fiery Soul.

zh.name: 神灭斩
zh.desc: 对单个敌方单位射出闪电，造成大量伤害。
notes: 神灭斩在技能施放到伤害生效有0.25秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
zh.shard: 施放神灭斩会暂时让莉娜的能量达到顶峰，给予炽魂的叠加效果。

en.name: Light Strike Array
en.desc: Summons a column of flames that damages and stuns enemies.
notes: Light Strike Array will destroy trees in its area of effect.

zh.name: 光击阵
zh.desc: 召唤柱状火焰伤害并眩晕敌人。
notes: 光击阵将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

en.name: Slow Burn
en.desc: Lina's abilities deal an additional 64% damage as burn damage over 4s.

zh.name: 慢热
zh.desc: 莉娜的技能会在4秒内额外造成64%原伤害的烧灼伤害。

en.name: Finger of Death
en.desc:
Rips at an enemy unit, trying to turn it inside-out, dealing massive damage to the target.

After using Finger of Death, Lion's hand becomes empowered, allowing him to use a cleaving melee attack with 250 range with bonus movement speed.

Finger of Death gains permanent bonus damage for it and the fist for each enemy Hero it or the fist kills. 

The melee attack may be disabled by setting the ability to Alt Cast.
notes: Finger of Death has a 0.25 delay before the damage is applied after the spell is cast, allowing certain abilities to avoid the damage.
Finger of Death only gains damage if the enemy hero dies within 3 seconds of being affected by Finger of Death.
en.scepter: Finger of Death gains area of effect damage on the initial cast, and increases duration and cleave damage on its subsequent melee attacks.

zh.name: 死亡之指
zh.desc:
撕裂一个敌方单位，将其折磨得死去活来，并造成巨大伤害。

使用死亡之指后，莱恩的手臂增强了力量，使他可以发动带有分裂效果的近战攻击，攻击距离为250，并拥有移动速度加成。

每次技能或重拳击杀英雄后都会分别使技能和重拳永久获得额外伤害和攻击力。

技能设为（右键点击技能栏图标）后可以禁用近战攻击。
notes: 死亡一指在技能施放到伤害生效有0.25秒延迟，因此有若干技能可以躲避该伤害。
只有在敌方英雄受到死亡之指作用后3秒内死亡才会使死亡之指额外提升伤害。
zh.scepter: 死亡之指的初始施法获得范围型伤害，并且后续的近战攻击提升持续时间和分裂伤害。

en.name: Earth Spike
en.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes: The spikes move at 2800 units per second.
Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 裂地尖刺
zh.desc: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
notes: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒2800码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Mana Drain
en.desc:
CHANNELED - Channels magical energy, taking mana and slowing enemies over time. If the enemy has no mana remaining, the slow is increased by 15%. 

 Can target allies to give them mana and movement speed at a 50% rate.
notes: Prevents heroes from going invisible.
en.shard: Causes Mana Drain to affect up to 2 additional enemies and increases break distance. Lion becomes Debuff Immune with 60% magic resistance while channeling.

zh.name: 法力吸取
zh.desc:
持续施法 - 引导魔法能量，持续吸取魔法并减缓敌人的移动速度。如果敌人没有魔法剩余，减速效果提升15%。

可以对友军施放，给予他们50%魔法和移动速度。
notes: 阻止英雄进入隐身状态。
zh.shard: 法力吸取可以作用最多2个额外敌人，并且断裂距离增加。持续施法期间莱恩为减益免疫状态，并且获得60%魔法抗性。

en.name: To Hell and Back
en.desc:
Lion gains 20% debuff duration after killing or assisting in a Hero kill while that Hero is dead.

Lion gains 20% spell amplification for 90s after respawning or resurrecting or until he gets a kill or assist.

zh.name: 下地狱再上来
zh.desc: 击杀英雄或助攻会向莱恩提供20%负面效果持续时间，持续到该英雄复活。而莱恩复活时，他就会获得持续90秒的20%技能增强，直到他完成击杀或得到助攻。

en.name: Hex
en.desc: Transforms an enemy unit into a harmless beast, with all special abilities disabled.
notes: Instantly destroys illusions.
The target will have a base movement speed of 120, but buffs granting maximum movement speed won't be disabled.

zh.name: 妖术
zh.desc: 将一个敌方单位变成人畜无害的动物，受害者无法使用所有特殊能力。
notes: 即刻摧毁幻象。
目标的基础移动速度为120，但是如果目标有满速状态则移速不受影响。

en.name: Bear Necessities
en.desc: Lone Druid can only use the first 3 items in his inventory. These items' passive bonuses are more powerful. Other item slots do not provide any bonuses. Neutral slot is unaffected.
notes:
The following attributes can be increased:
* Intelligence, Strength and Agility
* Health, Mana and Evasion
* Attack Speed and Bonus Damage
* Health and Mana Regen

zh.name: 熊亦求精
zh.desc: 独行德鲁伊只能使用他物品栏的前3个物品。这些物品的被动加成更加强大。其他物品栏不会提供任何加成。中立物品栏位不受影响。
notes:
下列属性可以提升：
* 力量、敏捷和智力
* 生命、魔法和闪避
* 攻击速度和攻击力加成
* 生命和魔法恢复

en.name: Entangle
en.desc:
Allows Lone Druid to Entangle enemies once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

When cast, applies 2 stacks to each enemy hero in the area and 5 stacks to enemy creeps. Also empowers Lone Druid for 10s, making him apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.

Leveling this ability also levels Spirit Bear's Entangling Claws ability.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Lone Druid's Empowered Buff and enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Entangled debuff is dispellable.
Creeps can't gain stacks from either Lone Druid's or Spirit Bear's attacks, and are Entangled only on cast.
Roshan is affected as if he were a hero.
en.scepter: Entangle applies 5 stacks to enemy heroes in the area and has increased radius. Enemies no longer have protection from gaining stacks while Entangled.

zh.name: 缠绕之根
zh.desc:
敌方英雄获得5层叠加效果后独行德鲁伊可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。

施放时，对区域内每个敌方英雄施加2层叠加效果，对敌方非英雄单位施加5层。独行德鲁伊的攻击还会被强化10秒，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加1层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。

升级这个技能也会升级熊灵的缠绕之爪技能。
notes: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
独行德鲁伊的强化增益和敌人叠加计数减益无法被驱散。
缠绕的减益效果可以被驱散。
独行德鲁伊或者熊灵的攻击不会使非英雄单位获得叠加效果，只会在施放缠绕之根时使他们被缠绕。
对肉山的作用机制和英雄相同。
zh.scepter: 缠绕之根会对区域内敌方英雄施加5层叠加效果，并且作用范围提升。触发缠绕的敌人不再受到保护，可以继续获得新的叠加层数。

en.name: Gift Bearer
en.desc: Lone Druid's Spirit Bear receives a copy of his Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

zh.name: 英熊好礼
zh.desc: 独行德鲁伊的熊灵会获得他身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

en.name: Savage Roar
en.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Spirit Bear.
en.shard:
Applies a basic dispel and grants allies in an area around the caster bonus movement and attack speed. Replicates between Lone Druid and Spirit Bear regardless of castability on the other.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 野蛮咆哮
zh.desc: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人恐惧，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加20%。
notes: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与熊灵共享冷却时间。
zh.shard:
施加弱驱散效果，并对施法者附近范围内友军提供移动速度和攻击速度加成。施法效果会在独行德鲁伊和熊灵之间复制，不论双方是否可以施法。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Savage Roar
en.desc: Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear roar fiercely causing nearby enemies to flee towards their base in terror. Their movement speed is increased by 20%.
notes: An entangled hero will not be able to move.
Cooldown is shared with Lone Druid.

zh.name: 野蛮咆哮
zh.desc: 独行德鲁伊和熊灵发出野性的咆哮，使周围敌人恐惧，朝自己的基地狂奔。敌人的移动速度将增加20%。
notes: 被缠绕的英雄将无法移动。
与独行德鲁伊共享冷却时间。

en.name: Summon Spirit Bear
en.desc:
Summons a powerful Spirit Bear companion that can equip items.

If the bear moves 1100 distance away from the Lone Druid, it cannot attack.  Lone Druid suffers 20% of his max health as backlash damage if the Spirit Bear dies.
Spirit Bear has Demolish, Return, Entangling Claws, Savage Roar, and Spirit Link abilities.
notes: Most spells interact with the Spirit Bear in the same way as they do with heroes.
Spirit Bear has 0 base attributes, 0 base armor, and %base_magic_resistance%% base magic resistance. Attributes from buffs or items fully affect the bear as they would for Universal heroes.
Spirit Bear cannot gain experience. The Spirit Bear levels up when Lone Druid levels up.
Spirit Bear has its own Aghanim's Scepter and Shard upgrades.
Spirit Bear receives a copy of Lone Druid's Neutral Item that has an independent cooldown.

zh.name: 熊灵伙伴
zh.desc:
召唤一只可以装备物品的熊灵伙伴。

若熊灵与独行德鲁伊的距离超过1100，则不能攻击。如果熊灵死亡，独行德鲁伊会受到自身最大生命值的20%作为反冲伤害。
熊灵拥有粉碎击、回归、缠绕之爪、野蛮咆哮和灵魂链接技能。
notes: 熊灵受到的大多数技能效果与英雄相同。
熊灵的基础属性为0，基础护甲为0并拥有%base_magic_resistance%%基础魔法抗性。熊灵装备的物品或享受的加成效果具有的属性对熊灵的加成效果与全才英雄类似。
熊灵无法获得经验。熊灵会跟随独行德鲁伊一起升级。
熊灵拥有自己的阿哈利姆神杖和魔晶升级效果。
熊灵会获得独行德鲁伊身上中立物品的复制品。这件复制品拥有独立的冷却时间。

en.name: Demolish
en.desc: Spirit Bear deals more damage to buildings.

zh.name: 粉碎击
zh.desc: 熊灵对建筑造成的伤害提升。

en.name: Entangling Claws
en.desc:
Allows Spirit Bear to Entangle enemy heroes once they gain 5 stacks. Entangled enemies are rooted and take damage over time.

Spirit Bear's attacks are permanently empowered, making them apply 1 stack with each attack on enemy heroes. Enemies cannot gain stacks while Entangled.
notes: Rooted units can't use Blink abilities and are revealed if they are invisible.
Enemy stack counter debuff cannot be dispelled.
Stacks are only applied to enemy heroes, creep heroes, and Roshan.

zh.name: 缠绕之爪
zh.desc:
敌方英雄获得5层叠加效果后熊灵可以缠绕敌方英雄。被缠绕的英雄无法移动，并受到持续伤害。

熊灵的攻击被永久强化，每次攻击敌方英雄都会施加1层叠加效果。被缠绕的英雄无法获得叠加层数。
notes: 被缠绕的单位将无法使用闪烁类技能，如果进入隐身状态也会显形。
敌人的叠加层数计数效果无法被驱散。
叠加效果只会施加给敌方英雄，类英雄单位和肉山。

en.name: Fetch
en.desc: Grabs the Target Ally, Enemy or Rune, and uncontrollably drags them towards Lone Druid for the duration. Enemies receive damage every 0.5s. When dragging a unit, they are Rooted.

zh.name: 抓取
zh.desc: 抓住友军/敌方目标，或者是神符，并且不受控制地在持续时间内将其向独行德鲁伊拽去。敌人每0.5秒受到一次伤害。拖拽过程中目标会被缠绕。

en.name: Return
en.desc: Channels for 3 seconds and then teleports the Spirit Bear back to the Lone Druid.
en.scepter: Allows Spirit Bear to attack at any range from Lone Druid, and to survive if Lone Druid dies.

zh.name: 回归
zh.desc: 经过3秒持续施法后熊灵传送回独行德鲁伊身边。
zh.scepter: 允许熊灵伙伴无视独行德鲁伊位置进行攻击，并且在独行德鲁伊死亡时不会消失。

en.name: Spirit Link
en.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.

zh.name: 灵魂链接
zh.desc: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
notes: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。

en.name: Spirit Link
en.desc: Links Lone Druid and the Spirit Bear, increasing their movement speed as well as sharing a percentage of their lifesteal with each other.
notes: Break disables the shared lifesteal.
en.scepter:
Lone Druid severs his link to his Spirit Bear, and connects to the target allied hero, sharing the Spirit Link bonuses with them for 20s. Armor sharing and attack speed are increased by 35%. Damage done by the ally heals Lone Druid, as well as the other way around.

 The Spirit Bear is feared for the duration of the transformation, unless he has his own Aghanim's Scepter.

zh.name: 灵魂链接
zh.desc: 连接独行德鲁伊和熊灵，提升双方的移动速度，另外双方共享一定百分比的吸血效果。
notes: 破坏会使共享吸血效果失效。
zh.scepter:
独行德鲁伊切断与熊灵的链接，并与目标友方英雄建立链接，与他们共享灵魂链接的加成效果，持续20秒。护甲共享和攻击速度加成的效果均提升35%。友军造成的伤害会治疗独行德鲁伊，反之亦然。

熊灵在变形期间会被恐惧，除非熊灵也拥有阿哈利姆神杖。

en.name: True Form
en.desc: Lone Druid morphs himself into a raging bear, losing his ranged advantage, but gaining bonus armor, bonus health, and bonus attack damage.

zh.name: 真熊形态
zh.desc: 独行德鲁伊将自己的形态变换为狂怒的熊，失去远程攻击的能力，但是获得额外护甲，额外生命值和额外攻击力。

en.name: Eclipse
en.desc: Showers random nearby enemies with strikes from Luna's current level of Lucent Beam. These beams do not stun their targets, and there is a maximum number of times that a single target can be struck. Also turns day into night for a short time.
notes: Eclipse doesn't work if Luna doesn't have any points in Lucent Beam.
Beams will stop if Luna is killed.
Will not hit invisible units.
There is a 0.6 seconds gap between beams, 0.3 seconds with scepter.
en.scepter: Allows Luna to cast Eclipse on an allied unit or herself and have its effects follow them, or cast it on an area. Increases total beams, reduces duration, removes the limit on beams per unit, and makes the beams appear twice as fast.

zh.name: 月蚀
zh.desc: 召唤一次月蚀，以她当前技能等级的月光随机打击附近敌人。月光只有伤害效果，不会造成眩晕，而且单一目标只能受到有限次数的打击。月蚀会暂时将白天变为黑夜。
notes: 如果露娜没有升级月光，月蚀将无法造成伤害，但是变为黑夜效果有效。
露娜阵亡后月光马上中止。
不能伤害隐身单位。
每道月光之间都有0.6秒的间隔。神杖升级后间隔为0.3秒。
zh.scepter: 露娜可以对友方单位或自身施放月蚀，使月蚀的效果跟随目标，或者对一片区域施放。增加月光数量，减少月蚀持续时间，并且移除单体打击次数上限，月光的产生间隔缩短一半。

en.name: Lucent Beam
en.desc: Calls a beam of lunar energy down upon an enemy, damaging and briefly stunning them.
en.shard: Grants Luna an attack damage bonus buff every time an enemy hero is hit by Lucent Beam. Lucent Beams created by Eclipse grant 0% of the damage amount.

zh.name: 月光
zh.desc: 召唤一道月能的光束打击敌人，造成伤害并短暂眩晕目标。
zh.shard: 每次一名敌方英雄被月光击中时，露娜都会获得一个攻击力加成的状态效果。月蚀的月光提供0%数值。

en.name: Lunar Blessing
en.desc: Grants attack damage to Luna and nearby allied heroes within 1200 range, with Luna receiving double the attack damage bonuses. At night, Lunar Blessing is global, and Luna is blessed with bonus night vision.

zh.name: 月之祝福
zh.desc: 提升露娜和附近1200范围内友方英雄的攻击力，露娜获得双倍的攻击力加成。夜晚期间月之祝福为全地图生效，并且露娜受到福佑后夜间视野提升。

en.name: Lunar Orbit
en.desc: Creates 4 glaives that rotate 225 radius around Luna. Any enemy unit that collides with a glaive will take a percentage of Luna's Attack Damage.
en.shard: Increases damage reduction. While active, Luna gains 20% bonus movement speed.

zh.name: 环月
zh.desc: 产生4个月刃在露娜身旁225范围内旋转。任何碰到月刃的敌方单位都会受到露娜攻击伤害的一定百分比。
zh.shard: 提升伤害降低效果。开启时，露娜获得20%移动速度加成。

en.name: Moon Glaives
en.desc: Empowers Luna's glaives, causing her attacks to bounce between enemy units. Deals less damage with each bounce.
notes: Moon Glaives do not proc any attack modifier except Critical Strikes.

zh.name: 月刃
zh.desc: 强化露娜的月刃，使攻击可以在敌方单位之间弹跳。每次弹跳造成的伤害都会减少。
notes: 月刃不会触发致命一击以外的任何攻击特效。

en.name: Apex Predator
en.desc: Lycan and units he controls deal extra damage to neutral creeps.

zh.name: 顶级掠食者
zh.desc: 狼人和他控制的单位对中立生物造成额外伤害。

en.name: Feral Impulse
en.desc: Increases the HP regeneration and damage of Lycan and all units under his control.

zh.name: 野性驱使
zh.desc: 提升狼人和所有他控制的单位的生命恢复和攻击力。

en.name: Howl
en.desc: Strikes fear into enemies, reducing armor and attack damage of all enemies within 2000 range of Lycan and his wolves. At night, Howl's armor and attack damage reductions are global.

zh.name: 嗥叫
zh.desc: 使敌人感到害怕，狼人和精灵狼周围2000范围内所有敌人的护甲和攻击力降低。夜晚期间嗥叫的护甲和攻击力降低效果为全地图生效。

en.name: Shapeshift
en.desc: Lycan assumes his lupine form, granting him critical strikes and added vision at night. During Shapeshift, Lycan moves at increased speed and cannot be slowed.  Movement and critical strike bonuses are also applied to all units under Lycan's control.
notes: Hex doesn't remove Lycan's movement speed.

zh.name: 变身
zh.desc: 狼人展现出他的凶狼形态，获得致命一击的能力，并且提升夜间视野。在变身期间，狼人达到超高移动速度，并且不能被减速。移动速度和致命一击也会施加给狼人控制下的所有单位。
notes: 狼人的移动速度不会受到妖术的影响。

en.name: Summon Wolves
en.desc: Summons 2 wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes: Using this spell will replace currently active summoned Wolves.
en.shard: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.

zh.name: 召狼
zh.desc: 召唤2头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
notes: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。
zh.shard: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。

en.name: Cripple
en.desc: Gives 20% to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

zh.name: 致残
zh.desc: 拥有20%几率致残目标，使其受到每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。

en.name: Hamstring
en.desc: The wolf bites down on an enemy's hamstring, rooting them for a short duration. After the bite, the next 4 attacks from units controlled by Lycan deal bonus damage.

zh.name: 断筋
zh.desc: 精灵狼咬住敌人的腿筋，短时间内缠绕他们。咬伤之后，狼人控制的单位接下来的4次攻击会对他们造成额外伤害。

en.name: Hightail
en.desc: The wolf gains a short burst of energy, gaining phased movement, evasion, hasted movement speed, and attack speed.

zh.name: 健步如飞
zh.desc: 精灵狼获得短暂的爆发能量，获得相位移动状态、闪避、移动速度和攻击速度加成。

en.name: Invisibility
en.desc: Permanently invisible when not attacking.

zh.name: 隐身
zh.desc: 不进行攻击时永久隐身。

en.name: Wolf Bite
en.desc: Lycan bites an allied hero or creep-hero, granting them Shapeshift properties. Lycan and the bitten target gain 40% Lifesteal and share the healing effect of Lifesteal with each other as long as they are within 1200 range of each other.
notes: Wolf Bite cooldown matches the cooldown of the current level of Shapeshift.

zh.name: 饿狼撕咬
zh.desc: 狼人撕咬友方英雄或类英雄单位，使其获得变身效果。自身和目标都获得40%吸血效果，并且双方距离只要不超过1200就能共用吸血效果。
notes: 饿狼撕咬的冷却时间与变身的当前等级相同。

en.name: Empower
en.desc:
When cast on an ally, grants them bonus damage and cleave on attack. 

 Empower is always on Magnus with 30% larger bonus.
notes: The bonus damage is based only on base damage and damage from primary attributes.
Cleave damage goes through spell immunity.
Ranged units cannot Cleave.

zh.name: 授予力量
zh.desc:
对友军施放时，给予攻击力加成并使其获得分裂效果。

授予力量总是在马格纳斯身上生效，拥有30%额外效果。
notes: 攻击力加成根据基础攻击力和主属性加成计算。
分裂伤害无视减益免疫。
远程单位的攻击没有分裂效果。

en.name: Horn Toss
en.desc: Magnus tosses any enemies in front of him, launching them to his rear. Enemies take damage, spend 0.6 seconds in the air, and are stunned while in the air and an additional amount of time after landing.

zh.name: 长角抛物
zh.desc: 马格纳斯顶起前方的敌人，将其甩在身后。敌人受到伤害，滞空0.6秒并处于眩晕状态，而且落地后还会眩晕一段时间。

en.name: Reverse Polarity
en.desc: Magnus changes properties of matter, pulling all nearby enemies in front of him and stunning them with a damaging slam.

zh.name: 两极反转
zh.desc: 马格纳斯改变物质的属性，将附近的敌人拖拽至他的前方，并且以震击对他们造成伤害和眩晕。

en.name: Shockwave
en.desc: Magnus sends out a wave of force, damaging enemy units in a line, pulling them towards him, and slowing them for a brief period.

zh.name: 震荡波
zh.desc: 马格纳斯放出一道能量波，对一条直线上的敌方单位造成伤害，并将他们朝自身牵引，同时受到短暂减速效果。

en.name: Skewer
en.desc: Magnus rushes forward, goring enemy units on his massive tusk. Heroes hit on the way will be dragged to the destination, then damaged and affected by slowed movement speed. The damage is increased based on distance traveled.
notes: Skewer is interrupted if Magnus is stunned, hexed or banished.
en.shard: Increases range and deals additional damage when skewering enemies into trees or cliffs.

zh.name: 巨角冲撞
zh.desc: 马格纳斯向前冲刺，用他巨大的犀角将敌人挑起。被击中的英雄将被拽至终点，然后受到伤害并且移动速度被减缓。根据行进的距离伤害也会提升。
notes: 马格纳斯受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时，巨角冲撞都会被打断。
zh.shard: 提升距离，并且使敌人穿过树木和高台时造成额外伤害。

en.name: Solid Core
en.desc: Magnus has increased slow resistance and suffers less knockback from enemy's abilities and items.

zh.name: 坚固核心
zh.desc: 马格纳斯的减速抗性得到提升，并且受到敌人技能和物品的击退效果减少。

en.name: Bodyguard
en.desc:
Passively grants Marci lifesteal and bonus attack damage.

When cast on an ally, she provides them with 75% of her passive lifesteal and attack damage bonus. Additionally Marci creates a shared all damage barrier for herself and her partner. As Marci attacks heroes, 30% of the damage dealt restores the barrier.
notes: Marci cannot cast Bodyguard on herself.
Lifesteal effectiveness gets a 40% penalty against creeps.
The shared barrier is reduced by damage on either Marci or her partner.

zh.name: 护卫术
zh.desc:
被动使玛西获得吸血和攻击力加成。

对友军施放时，使其获得她的75%被动吸血和攻击力加成。另外马上还会给她和她的搭档制造共用的全伤害护盾。在玛西攻击英雄时，造成伤害的30%会补充护盾。
notes: 玛西无法对自身施放护卫术。
吸血效果对非英雄单位减少40%。
不论是玛西或她的搭档受到伤害都会使共用护盾的数值减少。

en.name: Rebound
en.desc:
Marci bounds to the targeted allied unit, choosing a direction and distance she will spring away from it. Upon reaching the unit, Marci lunges to her final destination, damaging and stunning enemies where she lands.

When Rebound is set to alt-cast, Marci brings the target ally with her to her final destination.

 The ally receives 25% bonus movement speed for 4s.
notes: Marci's initial run to her target unit can be disjointed.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
Does not bring allies who are Rooted or Leashed when alt-cast.
en.shard: Increases damage. Rebound can be cast on enemies, and causes Marci to also get the speed boost when she casts it.

zh.name: 回身踢
zh.desc:
玛西跃向友方目标单位，选好她要弹离的方向和距离。到达目标后玛西冲向最终的目的地，对落地点的敌人造成伤害和眩晕。

回身踢设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，玛西会把她的友军目标带向最终目的地。

友军将获得25%移动速度加成，持续4秒。
notes: 玛西冲刺时目标单位可以躲避该效果。
不会触发法术反弹。
多样施法时不会带走被缠绕或束缚的友军。
zh.shard: 提升伤害。回身踢可以对敌人施放，并且玛西施放后自身也会获得加速效果。

en.name: Dispose
en.desc: Marci grabs an allied or enemy target and throws it effortlessly behind her, damaging and slowing the unit if it's an enemy. Any enemy units in the landing area will also be damaged and slowed.

zh.name: 过肩摔
zh.desc: 玛西抓起一个友方或敌方目标，将其轻松地向她身后摔去，敌方目标将受到伤害并被减速。落地区域内所有敌方单位也会受到伤害并被减速。

en.name: Special Delivery
en.desc:
Marci whistles to instantly summon her courier to her. If the courier started in the fountain, it will take items from Marci's stash. After teleporting it will transfer these items to Marci and head back to the fountain.

Passively grants all allied couriers 3 bonus levels and 1 bonus health.
notes: Special Delivery whistle has a cast point of 1 second.
If the courier didn't transfer any items or still has items after casting, it will remain next to Marci.

zh.name: 特快专递
zh.desc:
玛西吹起口哨，立刻把她的信使传送到她身边。如果信使起始于泉水，它会带上玛西储藏处内的物品。传送后会把这些物品移交给玛西，再返回泉水。

所有友方信使被动获得3级额外等级和1点额外生命。
notes: 特快专递的口哨具有1秒施法前摇。
如果信使施放后没有移交任何物品，或还拥有物品，它都会停留在玛西身边。

en.name: Unleash
en.desc:
Marci taps a hidden power, gaining Fury charges that allow her to deliver a rapid sequence of strikes that slow movement and attack speed of the target for 2s. The last strike in every Fury combo creates a damaging pulse around the target. In between Fury combos, Marci is unable to attack for 1.5s.

Marci gains 15% movement speed when Unleash is cast.
notes: Once a Fury combo is started, each attack must be delivered within 1s or the Fury combo expires.
Removes attack speed limit.
en.scepter:
Reduces Unleash cooldown by 10 seconds and causes Unleash to apply a basic dispel on Marci. While Unleash is Active, all of Marci's abilities unleash pulses when cast. All of Marci's unleash pulses will silence units for 1 seconds.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 怒拳破
zh.desc:
玛西释放潜藏的力量，获得狂怒的猛攻效果，使自身可以发动快速的打击，并且降低打击目标的移动和攻击速度，持续2秒。每次狂怒连技的最后一击都会创造一个脉冲效果，对目标周围的敌人造成伤害。在狂怒连技的间隔，玛西无法攻击，持续1.5秒。

玛西施放怒拳破时移动速度提升15%。
notes: 每次狂怒连技开始后，每次攻击都必须在1秒内完成，否则连技将会终止。
移除攻击速度限制。
zh.scepter:
怒拳破的冷却时间减少10秒，并且施放时对玛西施加弱驱散。怒拳破生效期间，玛西的所有技能在施放时都会施放脉冲。玛西的所有怒拳破脉冲都会沉默敌人，持续1秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Arena Of Blood
en.desc: After a short formation time, Mars summons an arena lined with the undead warriors of the Ash Legion, who block enemy attacks and movement. Enemy heroes near the inside edge of the arena will be attacked by spears, dealing damage and knocking them back.
en.scepter: Lowers cooldown by 10s and increases duration. If an enemy is killed in the Arena, Mars and all of his allies inside the Arena restore 35%  of their max health and mana and get a 35%  attack damage buff for 20s. This effect stacks.

zh.name: 热血竞技场
zh.desc: 经过短暂的列队时间，玛尔斯召唤出环绕着战士的竞技场，战士们将阻挡敌人的攻击和动向。竞技场内的敌方英雄靠近边缘时将被战矛攻击，受到伤害并被击退。
zh.scepter: 冷却时间降低10秒，持续时间提升。如果敌人在竞技场内阵亡，玛尔斯和竞技场内所有友军都会回复35%最大生命和魔法，并且获得35%攻击力加成，持续20秒。这个效果可以叠加。

en.name: Bulwark
en.desc:
Mars wields his massive shield to block a portion of each physical attack when hit from the front or sides.

 Can be toggled, granting phased movement, removing Mars's ability to attack, and locking the direction he is facing. When active, reduces movement speed and re-directs 70% of the attack projectiles aimed at allies towards himself.
notes: Redirect only works if the projectile targets are in a cone behind Mars or within 100 range of him.
Break disables the front and side damage reduction.
en.scepter: Creates %soldier_count% invulnerable soldiers on both sides of Mars front while Bulwark is toggled on. Soldiers move alongside Mars, dealing his attacks that have bonus damage, knock back and slow approaching enemies. An enemy can only be attacked by one soldier at a time.

zh.name: 护身甲盾
zh.desc:
每当玛尔斯受到来自正面或侧面的攻击时，他就挥舞他那面巨大的战盾来格挡一定百分比的伤害。

可以开启，开启后获得相位移动状态，但无法攻击，自身锁定为面朝的方向，并且移动速度降低，但飞向队友的攻击弹道中70%将改变方向朝他飞去。
notes: 改向只会在弹道目标位于玛尔斯身后锥形区域内或他身边100范围内才会生效。
破坏会使正面和侧面减伤效果失效。
zh.scepter: 开启护身甲盾后在玛尔斯的两侧共产生%soldier_count%名无敌的士兵。士兵会随着玛尔斯前进，继承全额攻击力和攻击特效并拥有攻击力加成，附带击退和减速效果。敌人在同一时间只会被1名士兵攻击。

en.name: Dauntless
en.desc: Mars gets more HP Regen the more he is outnumbered by enemy heroes in 900 radius.

zh.name: 无畏
zh.desc: 900范围内敌方英雄数量更多时，玛尔斯就会获得生命恢复，敌人数量越多，生命恢复也越高。
stats: 每多一个敌人生命恢复：50%

en.name: God's Rebuke
en.desc: Mars smashes enemies in front of him with his shield, knocking them back and damaging them with a critical hit based on his attack. Bonus damage is added when hitting heroes. Has True Strike.
notes: Attack modifiers have a chance to proc on God's Rebuke attacks.

zh.name: 神之谴戒
zh.desc: 玛尔斯举起他的战盾粉碎前方的敌人，将他们击退并且基于自身攻击力造成致命一击伤害。攻击英雄时攻击伤害提升。具有克敌机先效果。
notes: 神之谴戒的攻击也有几率触发攻击特效。

en.name: Immovable
en.desc: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

zh.name: Immovable
zh.desc: Mars cannot be affected by forced movement.

en.name: Spear of Mars
en.desc: Mars throws his legendary Spear with deadly precision, damaging each enemy unit it strikes. The first enemy hero it hits is skewered on the spear, pushing it back. If a skewered hero hits a tree, building, or cliff, they will be impaled to it and stunned.
notes: Spear of Mars can hit invisible units and reveals them if they are stunned.
Spear of Mars will only pin a unit to cliffs onto elevated areas, otherwise it will push them off onto lower ground.
en.shard: Spear of Mars impales up to 1 heroes and leaves a fire trail behind that deals damage over time and slows movement speed.

zh.name: 战神迅矛
zh.desc: 玛尔斯以致命的精准掷出他强大的战矛，对击中的每个敌方单位造成伤害。击中的第一个敌方英雄将被战矛刺穿，并被击退。若战矛击中树木、建筑或悬崖，目标将会被钉在上面，并受到眩晕。
notes: 战神迅矛可以击中隐身单位，造成眩晕还使其显形。
战神迅矛只会将单位从低地钉在地势变高的地方，否则会将他们推下高地。
zh.shard: 战神迅矛可以刺中最多1名英雄，并留下一道火焰路径，持续造成伤害并减缓移动速度。

en.name: Cold Blooded
en.desc: When Medusa is targeted with a spell, a single-target Mystic Snake is sent back towards the enemy that turns them into stone for 1s.

zh.name: 冷血动物
zh.desc: 美杜莎受到指向性技能作用后会对该敌人放出单体的秘术异蛇，把他们变成石头，持续1秒。

en.name: Gorgon's Grasp
en.desc: Medusa fires arrows in a line that land in 3 groups, with each grouping larger than the previous. Enemies struck by a volley of arrows take an initial burst of damage and then are rooted, cannot turn, are revealed to the enemy, and take damage per second.

zh.name: 罗网箭阵
zh.desc: 美杜莎沿着一条直线射出3组箭矢，每组的作用范围递增。齐射的箭矢击中的敌人会受到初始爆发伤害，然后被缠绕且无法转身，并对敌人可见，同时受到每秒伤害。

en.name: Mana Shield
en.desc: Creates a shield that absorbs 98% of incoming damage in exchange for Medusa's mana. Illusions absorb 60% less damage per point of mana.
notes: Absorbs damage before any damage reduction takes place, meaning that armor will not reduce the amount of mana needed to absorb damage.

zh.name: 魔法盾
zh.desc: 创造一个魔法护盾，消耗美杜莎的魔法值以吸收98%的伤害。幻象的伤害吸收系数减少60%。
notes: 伤害的吸收先于任何伤害减免机制，所以提高物理护甲，物理格挡和魔法抗性都不能减少吸收相同伤害所需的魔法。

en.name: Mystic Snake
en.desc: A mystic snake made of energy jumps from target to target dealing damage. Damage and speed increases with each jump. After it reaches its last target, it returns to Medusa to replenish her with mana. The snake returns a percentage of the targets' total mana.
notes: Mystic Snake cannot be disjointed.

zh.name: 秘术异蛇
zh.desc: 放出一条秘术异蛇在敌人之间跳跃，造成伤害。每次跳跃后伤害和速度都会增加。抵达最后一个目标后，它会返回到美杜莎身上为其恢复魔法值。异蛇会返还所有目标最大魔法值一定百分比的魔法。
notes: 秘术异蛇无法躲避。
stats: 每次跳跃递增伤害/速度：25%

en.name: Split Shot
en.desc:
Medusa magically splits her shot into several arrows. These arrows deal a lower percent of her normal damage.

The extra targets will not receive other attack effects (such as critical strike).
notes: Secondary targets will be the closest enemy units excluding the primary target.
If illusions of Medusa are created while Split Shot is active, they will also have this ability.
en.scepter: Allows on-hit effects to apply to the secondary attacks from Split Shot. Increases arrow count.

zh.name: 分裂箭
zh.desc:
美杜莎施展魔法将她的箭分裂成若干支箭矢。分裂箭造成的伤害为正常攻击力的一定百分比。

额外目标不会受到其他攻击特效（比如致命一击）的作用。
notes: 次级目标将是除了主要目标外距离最近的敌方单位。
如果在分裂箭激活的状态下创造幻象，幻象也将继承此技能。
zh.scepter: 使分裂箭的次级攻击也能继承攻击特效，并且目标数量提升。

en.name: Stone Gaze
en.desc: Any enemy units looking at Medusa will have their movement and attack speed slowed.  If 2 seconds of total time is accumulated looking at Medusa while Stone Gaze is active, that unit will turn to stone.  Petrified units are stunned, and take bonus physical attack damage.
notes: Regardless of when a unit receives the Stone Gaze buff while the ability is active on Medusa, it will still receive the full debuff duration.

zh.name: 石化凝视
zh.desc: 任何盯着蛇发女妖的敌方单位的攻击速度和移动速度均将被减缓。如果一单位在石化凝视期间盯着蛇发女妖超过2秒，该单位会被完全石化。被石化的单位处于眩晕状态，受到物理攻击时承受额外伤害。
notes: 无论敌方单位是在美杜莎施放技能期间的何时受到石化凝视作用，他受到的技能效果都是满额的持续时间。

en.name: Undulation
en.desc: Medusa's movement speed is fixed at 310 (465 during Stone Gaze). Medusa is unslowable and does not benefit from movement speed increases.
notes: Medusa can still benefit from movement speed bonuses from stream currents.

zh.name: 不动如蛇
zh.desc: 美杜莎的移动速度固定为310（石化凝视期间为465）。美杜莎不会被减速，也无法享受移动速度加成。
notes: 美杜莎还是能享受奔流的移动速度加成。

en.name: Divided We Stand
en.desc:
Meepo summons another Meepo, which levels up and shares items and experience with the main Meepo. Ability cooldowns are independent, but items share cooldowns between Meepos, except Teleport Scrolls. 

Damage, attack speed, health, mana, regeneration, mana burn, and proc chance bonuses from items are distributed equally among the amount of Meepos, making them 50 / 66 / 75 / 80% less effective.

If any Meepo dies, they all die.

zh.name: 分则能成
zh.desc:
米波再召唤出一个米波，可以跟随米波本体升级并共用物品。技能的冷却时间相互独立，但是物品的冷却时间在米波之间共用，回城卷轴除外。

来自物品的攻击力、攻击速度、生命值、魔法值、恢复效果、法力损毁和触发几率会根据米波数量均分，在每只身上的效果减少50 / 66 / 75 / 80%。

任意米波阵亡都会导致所有米波全体死亡。

en.name: Earthbind
en.desc: Tosses a net at the target point, rooting down all enemy units in an area around it.
notes: Affects invisible units, revealing them.
Does not work on Debuff Immune units or Roshan.

zh.name: 地之束缚
zh.desc: 向目标地点扔出一张网，缠绕区域内所有敌方单位。
notes: 地之束缚可以使敌方单位在进入隐身后显形，但是不能作用于已经隐身的单位。
对减益免疫单位和肉山无效。

en.name: Fling
en.desc:
Pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming yourself and disabling them.  Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier.  The carried target will be dropped after 5 seconds.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

zh.name: Fling
zh.desc:
Pick up the target friendly Meepo or creep, disarming yourself and disabling them.  Use the sub-ability to throw the carried unit at the target, dealing damage and slowing on impact.

If the carried target is a Meepo, it shares damage with the carrier.  The carried target will be dropped after 5 seconds.
notes: 不会触发法术反弹。

en.name: Geomancy
en.desc:
Meepo grants stacking bonuses to himself and his clones based on their terrain.  Each Meepo grants his bonus to the other Meepos.

If there is a tree within 250 range, he receives 1 HP regen.

If he is standing on dirt, he receives 2% bonus movement speed.

If he is in the water, his attacks slow the target by 2% for 2 seconds.
notes: Dirt includes any terrain that is not water.

zh.name: 地卜术
zh.desc:
米波会根据所在地形给予自身和克隆体可叠加的加成效果。每个米波都会给予其他米波自身的加成。

如果250范围内有树木，他会获得1点/秒生命恢复。

如果他站在土地上，他会获得2%移动速度加成。

如果他在水中，他的攻击会减缓目标2%移速，持续2秒。
notes: 土地包括所有水之外的地形。

en.name: MegaMeepo
en.desc:
Primary Meepo mounts all other Meepos in a 600 radius around him on top of his shoulders. While in this form, he gains 40% of the other Meepo stats and can Fling them at enemies, dealing damage and slowing them.

 When cast, Earthbind generates additional nets and Poof deals 50% more damage for each Meepo on top.

zh.name: 超大米波
zh.desc:
主米波将600范围内其他米波放到自己的肩膀上。在这个形态下，他会获得其他米波40%的属性，并且可以把他们扔向敌人，造成伤害和减速。

生效时地之束缚会产生额外的网，身上每只米波都会使忽悠造成额外50%伤害。

en.name: MegaMeepo Fling
en.desc: In MegaMeepo form, Meepo flings the topmost meepo towards a target within a 900 range, dealing damage and slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

zh.name: 超大米波摔扔
zh.desc: 在超大米波形态下，米波将最上端的米波向900范围内目标扔出，造成伤害和减速。
notes: 不会触发法术反弹。

en.name: Pack Rat
en.desc: All Meepos can use the item in the neutral item slot.
notes: Most items except for Consumables, Hand of Midas, and Divine Rapier can be equipped in the neutral item slot.
Using the item on one Meepo puts it on cooldown for all other Meepos for 50% of the regular cooldown.
Certain passive abilities and effects on items have reduced or no effectiveness.

zh.name: 囤积狂鼠
zh.desc: 所有米波都可以使用中立物品栏位中的物品。
notes: 除了消耗品、迈达斯之手和圣剑以外，大多数物品都可以装备在中立物品栏。
一个米波使用物品都会使其他米波身上的该物品进入冷却状态，时间为50%平常冷却时间。
某些物品的被动技能和效果有所降低，或者没有实际效果

en.name: Dig
en.desc:
Digs into the ground for a short duration, dispelling Meepo and causing him to become invulnerable and untargetable for 3s. Restores 25% of his max health over that duration.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 掘地
zh.desc:
挖掘进入地下，对自身施加驱散效果，无敌且不能作为目标，持续3秒。持续时间内回复最大生命值的25%。被缠绕时无法施放。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Poof
en.desc:
Drawing mystical energies from the earth, a Meepo can teleport to another Meepo or itself after channeling for 1.5 seconds, damaging the enemy in both the departure and arrival locations. 

If the ability is in alt-cast state, all Meepos will also cast Poof to the target. When cast on the ground, all Meepos except the selected one will Poof to the closest location.
notes: Can be cast through the minimap.
Can teleport to Meepo illusions.

zh.name: 忽悠
zh.desc:
通过从大地中汲取神秘的能量，一个米波可以在持续施法1.5秒后传送至另一个米波或自身所在之处，在离开和到达的区域都对敌人造成伤害。

如果技能设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）状态，所有米波也会对目标施放忽悠。对地施放后，除了选中的米波外所有米波会忽悠至最近的地点。
notes: 可以点击小地图施放。
可以传送至米波的幻象。

en.name: Ransack
en.desc:
Steals health from the enemy with each strike and heals all other Meepos for that amount.

Reduced to 60% against creeps.
notes: Amount healed is amplified by Health Restoration Amplification

zh.name: 洗劫
zh.desc:
每次攻击都会窃取敌人的生命值，并治疗所有其他米波相同数值生命。

对非英雄单位的效果减少至60%。
notes: 治疗数值会被生命回复增强效果提升。

en.name: Sticky Fingers
en.desc: Has an extra choice of neutral item to select from.

zh.name: 三只手
zh.desc: 打造中立物品时额外拥有一个选项。

en.name: Alleviation
en.desc: After death, the Tormentor leaves behind a verdant dale, increasing the regeneration of everyone nearby by 2.25% of their Max Health.

zh.name: 镇痛
zh.desc: 痛苦魔方被消灭后留下一片青翠的山谷，使附近所有人的生命恢复提升，数值为各自最大生命值的2.25%。

en.name: Fortification
en.desc: Damage taken is reduced by %damage_reduction_per_tower%% for each Tier 1 Tower on its team that is still standing.

zh.name: 加强防御
zh.desc: Damage taken is reduced by %damage_reduction_per_tower%% for each Tier 1 Tower on its team that is still standing.

en.name: The Shining
en.desc: Deals 20 damage to all units within 1000 range every second for 10s once attacked or damaged.

zh.name: 闪耀
zh.desc: 只要受到攻击或伤害就会每秒对1000范围内所有单位造成20点伤害，持续10秒。

en.name: Reflect
en.desc: Reflects damage received evenly to the attacker and all other heroes within 1200 radius
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 反弹
zh.desc: 所有的伤害都会反弹，均摊给1200范围内的攻击者以及其他所有英雄
notes: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Unyielding Shield
en.desc: Passively grants a regenerating All Damage Barrier. Armor can not go below 0.

zh.name: 刚强巨盾
zh.desc: 被动提供持续恢复的全伤害护盾。护甲不会低于0。

en.name: Sacred Arrow
en.desc: Fires a long-range arrow with deadly precision, which stuns and damages the first enemy unit it strikes. The stun duration ranges from 0.01 to 2.3 / 3.2 / 4.1 / 5 seconds, with bonus damage up to 180 added, based on the distance the arrow travels to its target. Instantly kills the first non-ancient creep it hits.
notes: For every 150 distance the arrow travels, the stun duration upon impact increases by 0.5 seconds, and the bonus damage added increases by 14.
Sacred Arrow can hit invisible units.
Starstruck does not apply to the second Starstorm from Aghanim's Scepter.
en.scepter: Causes Sacred Arrow to release a Starstorm on enemies along the travel path of the primary arrow, releasing a second Starstorm that deals less damage to the impacted unit.

zh.name: 月神之箭
zh.desc: 射出一支绝对精准的箭矢，对第一个击中的敌人造成伤害并眩晕目标。目标距离越远，眩晕时间越长，最短0.01秒，最长可达2.3 / 3.2 / 4.1 / 5秒。根据箭矢飞行的距离还将对目标额外造成最多180点伤害。若击中的是非远古的普通单位，将直接秒杀。
notes: 神箭每飞行150码，中箭后眩晕的持续时间将提高0.5秒，额外伤害增加14点。
月神之箭可以射中隐身单位。
流星赶月不会对阿哈利姆神杖升级群星风暴的第二次流星生效。
zh.scepter: 月神之箭在主神箭行进途中对敌人释放群星风暴。对击中的单位施放第二个群星风暴，造成的伤害有所降低。
stats: 主箭击中群星风暴伤害：80%

en.name: Celestial Quiver
en.desc: When a charge is available, Mirana's next attack will deal bonus magic damage.
en.shard: Grants 3 temporary Charges while Leap's buff is active.

zh.name: 天界箭袋
zh.desc: 有可用能量时，米拉娜的下次攻击会造成额外魔法伤害。
zh.shard: 跳跃的加成状态生效时获得3点临时能量。

en.name: Moonlight Shadow
en.desc: Turns Mirana and all allied heroes invisible and grants bonus movement speed. Mirana gains bonus outgoing damage during the duration. If a hero is revealed, invisibility will restore after the fade delay as long as Moonlight Shadow's duration has not expired.
notes: Units affected will not auto attack enemies.

zh.name: 月之暗面
zh.desc: 让米拉娜和所有己方英雄进入隐身状态。米拉娜在持续时间内获得伤害输出加成。只要还在月光阴影的持续时间内，即使隐身被打破也会在短时间内重新淡入隐身。
notes: 受到作用的单位会自动停止攻击敌人。

en.name: Leap
en.desc: Mirana leaps forward into battle, empowering herself with a ferocious roar that grants bonus attack and movement speed. Speed bonus lasts 5 seconds.
en.shard: Grants +1 Leap charge.

zh.name: 跳跃
zh.desc: 米拉娜的坐骑向前跳跃加入战斗，发出一声凶狠的咆哮鼓舞它的主人，提升攻击和移动速度。速度加成持续5秒。
zh.shard: 获得+1跳跃能量点数。

en.name: Selemene's Faithful
en.desc: Healing Lotuses are 50% more effective on Mirana and her allies.

zh.name: 赛莉蒙妮的信徒
zh.desc: 疗伤莲花对米拉娜和她友军的效果提升50%。

en.name: Solar Flare
en.desc:
Gradually increases attack speed and damage of Mirana and all allied heroes, reaching maximum power after 6s. 

 Allies receive 50% of the bonus.

zh.name: 太阳金辉
zh.desc:
逐渐提升米拉娜和所有友方英雄的攻击速度和攻击力，6秒后达到最大威力。

友军获得50%加成效果。

en.name: Starstorm
en.desc: Calls down a wave of meteors to damage nearby enemy units. The closest enemy unit to Mirana in a 675 radius will be struck a second time.
notes: Starstorm is not blocked by Linken's Sphere.
Starstorm cannot hit invisible units.
Starstorm will choose a new target for the second meteor if the first died before impact.

zh.name: 群星风暴
zh.desc: 召唤一波流星砸向附近的敌方单位。675范围内最近的敌方单位将会再受到一次冲击。
notes: 群星风暴不会被林肯法球抵挡。
群星风暴不能伤害隐身单位。
如果原本要打击的目标死亡，群星风暴的第二次星落会重新选择一个目标。

en.name: Boundless Strike
en.desc: Monkey King enlarges his staff and slams it against the ground, stunning enemies in a line and damaging them with bonus damage and a critical hit based on his attack. Has True Strike.
en.shard: Boundless Strike applies Primal Spring with 35% of the max channeling duration power to enemies along the staff and at the end of the staff. When Boundless Strike is set to alt-cast, Monkey King leaps to the end of his staff.

zh.name: 棒击大地
zh.desc: 齐天大圣让金箍棒变大，并将其挥起猛击地面，眩晕一条直线上的敌人并造成额外伤害和基于他普通攻击的致命一击伤害。具有克敌机先效果。
zh.shard: 棒击大地对沿途和末端的敌人施加乾坤之跃，威力为最长持续施法时间的35%。棒击大地设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）后，齐天大圣还会跳跃至金箍棒的另一端。

en.name: Jingu Mastery
en.desc: Monkey King's attacks awaken the Jingu Bang's power. Upon the fourth hit on the same enemy hero, Monkey King earns 4 charged attacks that have bonus damage and lifesteal.
notes: Hitting an enemy with Boundless Strike adds to the hit counter.
Repeatedly hitting an enemy refreshes the Jingu Mastery debuff duration.
Hit charges on enemies cannot be dispelled.
Jingu Mastery buff on self can be dispelled.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 如意棒法
zh.desc: 齐天大圣的攻击唤醒了金箍棒的力量。连续攻击四次同个敌方英雄后，齐天大圣的下4次攻击得到加强，拥有攻击力加成和吸血效果。
notes: 棒击大地击中敌人时也会计入攻击次数。
再次攻击敌人将刷新如意棒法的计数持续时间。
敌人身上的计数效果无法被驱散。
自身的如意棒法效果可以被驱散。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

en.name: Mischief
en.desc: Changes Monkey King's shape to deceive opponents, using the environment nearby as inspiration for the disguise. Taking damage, attacking, or using any item or ability breaks Monkey King's disguise. Grants damage immunity for 0.1 seconds upon transforming.

zh.name: 七十二变
zh.desc: 齐天大圣以周遭事物为启发进行伪装，改变自己的外形，从而欺骗对手。受到伤害，发动攻击或使用任意物品都会失去伪装效果。变化后0.1秒内免疫伤害。

en.name: Primal Spring
en.desc: CHANNELED - Monkey King springs out from his tree perch, damaging and slowing enemies in the area where he lands. Damage and slow amounts are in proportion to channel duration.

zh.name: 乾坤之跃
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 齐天大圣从树顶跃下，对着陆区域内敌人造成减速和伤害。持续施法的时间越长，伤害和减速效果越高。

en.name: Changing of the Guard
en.desc: Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a 1.5s, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead. While transformed, Monkey King is invulnerable, but cannot attack or cast spells

zh.name: 出神入化
zh.desc: 齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，1.5秒内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。变身后齐天大圣为无敌，但是无法攻击或施放技能。

en.name: Tree Dance
en.desc: Monkey King jumps to a tree and perches atop it. While perched, he gains the Primal Spring ability-a channeled leap attack. If Monkey King's tree is destroyed, he falls and is stunned for 3s. Taking damage while on the ground puts Tree Dance on cooldown.
notes: Tree Dance cooldown starts upon landing.
Right-clicking the ground will have Monkey King drop from the tree.
Movement is interrupted if Monkey King is stunned, hexed or banished.

zh.name: 丛林之舞
zh.desc: 齐天大圣跳上一棵树并停在上面。停留时获得乾坤之跃技能——需要持续施法的跳跃式攻击。如果树木被摧毁，他将从树上掉下，并眩晕3秒。在地面受到伤害时丛林之舞将在一定时间内无法使用，处于冷却状态。
notes: 丛林之舞在落地时进入冷却。
右键点击地面后齐天大圣会从树上跳下。
齐天大圣受到眩晕、妖术或放逐作用时位移都会被打断。

en.name: Revert Form
en.desc: Reverts Monkey King's shape to his original form.

zh.name: 变回原状
zh.desc: 使齐天大圣恢复原状。

en.name: Wukong's Command
en.desc:
Monkey King creates a circular formation of soldiers that spread out from his position. If Monkey King leaves the area his soldiers disperse. The soldiers have Monkey King's attack that attacks at a fixed rate of 1.1s, and only targets enemy Heroes. Monkey King is granted bonus armor for the spell's duration.

Monkey King can transform into any one of his soldiers during Wukong's command, taking its place for a short duration, becoming indistinguishable from other soldiers, and leaving another soldier in his stead.
notes: Soldiers do not receive Jingu Mastery bonuses.
Soldiers do not copy Basher or Abyssal.
en.scepter: Spawns a monkey soldier near Monkey King at regular intervals. Soldiers do not spawn while invisible or on trees. Soldiers only attack buildings when Monkey King himself is nearby. Soldiers can now gain Jingu Mastery charges independently.

zh.name: 猴子猴孙
zh.desc:
齐天大圣变出圆形的猴子猴孙阵列，猴子猴孙从他的位置散开。若齐天大圣离开范围，猴子猴孙将会消失。猴子猴孙继承齐天大圣的攻击力，攻击频率为固定的1.1秒，并且只会以敌方英雄为目标。在技能持续时间内齐天大圣获得护甲加成。

齐天大圣可以在猴子猴孙期间变成其中一个猴子猴孙，短时间内取代其位置，无法和其他猴子猴孙相区分，并且在原地留下一个猴子猴孙。
notes: 猴子猴孙不会获得如意棒法的加成效果。
猴子猴孙不会继承碎颅锤和深渊之刃的效果。
zh.scepter: 每隔一段时间在齐天大圣附近产生一个猴子猴孙。隐身或上树时不会产生。只有齐天大圣在附近时猴子猴孙才会攻击建筑。猴子猴孙现在独立获得如意棒法的效果。
stats: 单个猴子猴孙产生间隔：4
单个猴子猴孙持续时间：15

en.name: Accumulation
en.desc: Morphling receives 50% of stat growth bonuses every half level instead of the full bonus at level up. All Attributes bonuses from skill points in the Talent Tree provide an additional +3 to Morphling's primary attribute.

zh.name: 积少成多
zh.desc: 变体精灵每半级获得50%属性成长加成，而不是升级时获得全额加成。天赋树的全属性附加技能点额外对变体精灵提供+3 主属性。

en.name: Adaptive Strike
en.desc:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes: Projectile moves at 1150 speed.

zh.name: 变体打击
zh.desc:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
notes: 弹道移动速度为1150。

en.name: Ebb
en.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Agility.

zh.name: 潮涨
zh.desc: 变体精灵的主属性现在是敏捷。

en.name: Ebb and Flow
en.desc: Morphling receives bonus cast range and slow resistance based on his current Strength, and attack range and movement speed based on his current Agility. These bonuses persist if he is morphed into another hero.
notes: Attack range bonuses during morph only apply when morphed into a Ranged hero.

zh.name: 潮涨潮落
zh.desc: 变体精灵根据当前力量值获得额外施法距离和减速抗性，根据当前敏捷值获得攻击距离和移动速度。这些效果在他变形为其他英雄时仍然有效。
notes: 变形期间的攻击距离加成只有在变形为远程英雄时有效。

en.name: Flow
en.desc: Morphling's Primary Attribute is now Strength. Adaptive Strike stuns based on Morphling's strength. Morphling gains 1% Spell Amp per 4 Agility.
notes: Break disables the Spell Amp per Agility.

zh.name: 潮落
zh.desc: 变体精灵的主属性现在是力量。变体打击会根据变体精灵的力量值造成眩晕。变体精灵每4点敏捷会获得1%技能增强。
notes: 破坏会禁用敏捷提供的技能增强。

en.name: Attribute Shift (Agility Gain)
en.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Strength and pouring them into Agility at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Agility Gain will also level up Strength Gain.
en.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

zh.name: 属性变换（敏捷获取）
zh.desc: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些力量以4 / 8 / 12 / 16点/秒的速率转化成敏捷。该过程可逆。
notes: 属性变换不能转化物品提供的属性加成。
升级敏捷获取时也会升级力量获取。
zh.shard: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

en.name: Morph Replicate
en.desc: Toggles Morphling's form between his own and the replicated enemy.

zh.name: 替换复制体
zh.desc: 变体精灵的形态在自身和复制体之间可以来回切换。

en.name: Attribute Shift (Strength Gain)
en.desc: Morphling shifts its form, pulling points from Agility and pouring them into Strength at a rate of 4 / 8 / 12 / 16. The process is reversible.
notes: Attribute Shift can't convert stats from items.
Leveling up Strength Gain will also level up Agility Gain.
en.shard: Morphling can shift attributes while stunned. Reduces mana cost.

zh.name: 属性变换（力量获取）
zh.desc: 变体精灵改变它的形态，将一些敏捷以4 / 8 / 12 / 16点/秒的速率转化成力量。该过程可逆。
notes: 属性变换不能转换物品提供的属性加成。
升级力量获取时也会升级敏捷获取。
zh.shard: 变体精灵在眩晕状态下可以变换属性。降低魔法消耗。

en.name: Morph
en.desc: Morphling changes his form to match the targeted enemy, gaining their basic abilities and changing his primary attribute based on his target. Can be toggled for the duration of the ability.
notes: You can't target yourself with Morph.
Morph won't copy Shard/Scepter abilities unless Morphling owns the respective item.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
en.scepter: Adds an alt-cast to Morph. When enabled, a strong illusion is created of the target hero that can cast all of the hero's basic abilities. If the illusion is alive when Morphling toggles the ability, he will take the place of the illusion, destroying it.

zh.name: 变形
zh.desc: 使自身向敌方目标改变，获得其基础技能，并且基于目标改变自己的主属性。技能持续时间内可以来回切换。
notes: 变体精灵自身及其控制的单位不能作为变形的目标。
变形不会复制魔晶/神杖类技能，除非变体精灵自身也拥有相应物品。
不会触发法术反弹。
zh.scepter: 变形增加多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标）。开启后会产生目标英雄的强幻象，可以施放英雄的所有基础技能。如果变体精灵切换变形时幻象还存活，他就会摧毁该幻象，并取而代之。

en.name: Syntropy
en.desc:
Morphling's attacks have increased attack range, slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

 If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum Attack Speed slow is applied. 

If Morphling's Strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum Movement Speed slow is applied.

zh.name: Syntropy
zh.desc:
Morphling's attacks have increased attack range, slowing the target's movement and attack speed.

 If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum Attack Speed slow is applied. 

If Morphling's Strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum Movement Speed slow is applied.

en.name: Waveform
en.desc: Morphling dissolves into liquid and surges forward, damaging enemy units in his path. Morphling is invulnerable during Waveform.

zh.name: 波浪形态
zh.desc: 变体精灵化为波浪向前涌进，对路径上的敌人造成伤害。变体精灵在波浪形态中是无敌的。

en.name: Hurl Boulder
en.desc: Hurls a boulder at the target, damaging and stunning them.

zh.name: 投石
zh.desc: 向目标扔出一块石头，造成伤害和眩晕。

en.name: Shard Split
en.desc: On death, Mud Golems shatter into several Shard Golems.

zh.name: 碎土傀儡
zh.desc: 死亡时泥土傀儡会破碎成数个碎土傀儡。

en.name: Cloak Aura
en.desc: This creature protects its allies with a Magic resistance aura. Creeps are better protected.

zh.name: 魔抗光环
zh.desc: 这个生物的魔抗光环保护它的友军。对非英雄单位的效果更强。

en.name: Dead Shot
en.desc:
Muerta fires a ghostly trickshot at an enemy unit or tree. When the bullet strikes, it damages and briefly slows, then ricochets in the targeted direction.

The ricochet damages all units that it passes through, stopping when it hits a hero. Heroes hit by the ricochet are feared away from the impact.
notes: Feared enemies are phased and unslowable.
The ricochet will travel 1.5x Dead Shot's cast range.
Can ricochet off of magic immune targets.
en.scepter: Dead Shot damage is increased. Dead Shot expands after it ricochets and pierces through enemy heroes as it fears them.

zh.name: 弹无虚发
zh.desc:
琼英碧灵向一个敌方单位或一棵树发射一颗幽灵子弹。子弹击中时会对敌人造成伤害和短暂减速，然后沿矢量目标的方向弹去。

跳弹将会对穿过的所有单位造成伤害，击中英雄后停下。被跳弹击中的英雄会被恐惧。
notes: 被恐惧的敌人为相位状态，无法被减速。
跳弹的行进距离为弹无虚发施法距离的1.5倍。
可以弹离减益免疫目标。
zh.scepter: 弹无虚发的伤害提升。弹无虚发的作用范围在弹跳后会扩大，并且跳弹恐惧敌人时会穿过敌方英雄。

en.name: Gunslinger
en.desc: Toggleable. When toggled on, Muerta's attacks have a chance to fire a second shot at another target.
notes: If no other units are in range, she fires both guns at the original target.
Secondary shots can hit units within Muerta's attack range plus 175.
The secondary shot can trigger attack modifiers.
Prioritizes heroes, then non-hero units, then buildings.

zh.name: 神枪在手
zh.desc: 可以开关。开启后，琼英碧灵攻击时有几率对另一个目标再射一枪。
notes: 如果距离内没有其他单位，她会向原目标发射两枪。
第二枪可以击中琼英碧灵攻击距离加上175范围内的单位。
第二枪可以触发攻击特效。
以英雄优先，然后是非英雄单位，然后是建筑。

en.name: Ofrenda
en.desc:
Muerta places a sacred altar at the targeted location that increases her attack speed when she is near it.

When respawning, Muerta will gain the benefits of Pierce The Veil's corporeal form for 50% of the duration and respawn at the Ofrenda.

Muerta can select the Ofrenda and force it to destroy itself. Only one Ofrenda can exist at a time.

zh.name: 祭台
zh.desc:
琼英碧灵在目标地点放下一座神圣的祭台，靠近时可以提升她的攻击速度。

复活时琼英碧灵会获得50%持续时间的越界加成效果，并且在祭台处复活。

琼英碧灵可以选中祭台，强行将其摧毁。同一时间只能存在一个祭台。

en.name: Destroy Ofrenda
en.desc: Destroy this Ofrenda, ensuring that Muerta will respawn in the fountain.

zh.name: 摧毁祭台
zh.desc: 摧毁这个祭台，确保琼英碧灵会在泉水复活。

en.name: Pierce the Veil
en.desc:
Muerta transforms, becoming ethereal, gaining bonus base damage and phased movement.

Passively allows Muerta to always attack ethereal targets and attack when she is ethereal. When either she or her target is ethereal, all of her attack damage is dealt as magical damage and her physical lifesteal is treated as spell lifesteal.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Muerta will dodge projectiles upon transformation.
Muerta cannot attack buildings while transformed.
en.shard:
Muerta gains %spell_lifesteal%% Spell Lifesteal during Pierce the Veil.
While Pierce the Veil is active Muerta permanently gains %spell_amp_steal%% spell amplification each time she kills an enemy Hero or they die in her vicinity. Bonus applies retroactively.

zh.name: 越界
zh.desc:
琼英碧灵变身，成为虚无状态，获得基础攻击力加成和相位移动状态。

被动使总是可以攻击虚无状态下的目标，并且她在虚无状态下也能攻击。在她或目标处于虚无时，她的所有攻击伤害均为魔法伤害，她的物理吸血被视为技能吸血。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 琼英碧灵在变身期间可以躲避弹道。
琼英碧灵在变身后无法攻击建筑。
zh.shard:
琼英碧灵在越界的持续时间内获得%spell_lifesteal%%技能吸血。
越界生效时每次击杀敌方英雄或有敌方英雄在附近阵亡时琼英碧灵都会永久获得%spell_amp_steal%%技能增强。永久加成具有追溯效果。

en.name: Spectral Slug
en.desc: Muerta shoots a spectral bullet at an enemy, dealing damage, knocking them back, and turning them ethereal for 3s - rendering them immune to physical damage and unable to attack. The target is slowed and -20% more vulnerable to magic damage. Enemies will not be knocked out of Muerta's attack range.

zh.name: 幽魂子弹
zh.desc: 琼英碧灵对一个敌人射出一颗幽灵子弹，造成伤害，将其击退并将其变为虚无状态，持续3秒——使他们对物理伤害免疫，并且无法攻击。目标被减速，并且承受的魔法伤害增加-20%。敌人不会被击出琼英碧灵的攻击距离。

en.name: Supernatural
en.desc: Whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of Muerta, she gains a stack of 1% spell amplification. When Muerta dies she loses half the stacks, rounded down.

zh.name: 超自然
zh.desc: 每当琼英碧灵附近925范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，她就会获得一层1%技能增强的叠加效果。琼英碧灵阵亡时，她会失去一半（向下取整）的叠加层数。

en.name: The Calling
en.desc: Summons a group of 4 revenants that slowly circle the targeted location. Enemies within the area are slowed. Revenants deal damage and silence enemies as they pass through them.

zh.name: 唤魂
zh.desc: 召唤4个亡魂，缓慢地环绕目标地点。在区域内的敌人会被减速。亡魂会在敌人穿过时造成伤害和沉默。

en.name: Deluge
en.desc: Naga Siren and all of her images hit nearby units with a damaging wave of water that caps their max movement speed.
notes: Casting Deluge doesn't interrupt channeling.

zh.name: 洪水
zh.desc: 娜迦海妖和她所有的幻象操控一道水波攻击附近单位，造成伤害并限制敌人的移动速度上限。
notes: 使用洪水不会打断持续施法。

en.name: Eelskin
en.desc: Naga Siren has bonus evasion, increased per every other Naga Siren within 900 radius.

zh.name: 鳗鱼皮
zh.desc: 娜迦海妖拥有闪避加成，900内每增加一个娜迦海妖都会提升。

en.name: Ensnare
en.desc: Interrupts the target and traps them in place, preventing movement or blinking. Can target units affected by Song of the Siren.
en.scepter: Increases cast range and projectile speed.  Allows Ensnare to target and affect Debuff Immune units. Ensnare applies Break.

zh.name: 诱捕
zh.desc: 打断目标的动作并将其困在原地，使其无法移动或闪烁。可以对海妖之歌作用下的单位施放。
zh.scepter: 提升施法距离和弹道速度。诱捕可以对减益免疫单位施放并且生效。诱捕会施加破坏效果。

en.name: Mirror Image
en.desc:
Creates multiple images of Naga Siren under her control.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Naga Siren is invulnerable for 0.5 seconds when casting, allowing her to dodge stuns and damage.
Upon casting, most effects are removed from Naga Siren.
Upon casting, existing Mirror Image illusions are destroyed.

zh.name: 镜像
zh.desc:
制造多个受娜迦海妖控制的镜像。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 娜迦海妖在施法时有0.5秒的无敌时间，可以用来躲避眩晕和伤害。
施放后，将会移除娜迦海妖身上大部分效果。
施放时现有的镜像幻象将被摧毁。

en.name: Reel In
en.desc: CHANNELED - Naga Siren channels for up to 5 seconds, pulling all units affected by Naga's Ensnare in a 1600 range towards her at a speed of 200. Channeling ends when the Ensnared unit is 100 distance away.
en.scepter: Allows Reel In to affect Spell Immune units.

zh.name: 捕捞
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 娜迦海妖最多持续施法5秒，以200的速度将1600范围内所有处于娜迦海妖诱捕作用下的单位朝她拉去。诱捕单位相距100时持续施法结束。
zh.scepter: 捕捞可以作用于技能免疫单位。

en.name: Rip Tide
en.desc: Naga Siren and her illusions deal bonus damage to enemies and reduce their armor for 4 seconds every 6 attacks.
notes: Using Rip Tide doesn't interrupt channeling.

zh.name: 激流
zh.desc: 娜迦海妖和她的幻象每经过6次攻击后就会对敌人造成额外伤害，并降低他们的护甲，持续4秒。
notes: 使用激流不会打断持续施法。

en.name: Slithereen Cutlass
en.desc: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for 6 seconds, up to a max of 10 stacks.

zh.name: Slithereen Cutlass
zh.desc: Naga Siren's attacks add a stacking debuff that causes the target to miss attacks for 6 seconds, up to a max of 10 stacks.

en.name: Song of the Siren
en.desc: All enemies in range of the Naga Siren are put into a magical stasis where they cannot act or be attacked. Using Song of the Siren again will end the duration early.
notes: Units affected by Song of the Siren are invulnerable and cannot take damage from any source.
The area of the song follows Naga, so if she moves far enough away from affected units, they will wake up.
en.shard: Allies in range of Song of the Siren recover a percentage of their health and mana per second.

zh.name: 海妖之歌
zh.desc: 娜迦海妖周围的所有敌人受到魔法影响陷入停滞状态，既无法行动也不会受到攻击。再次使用海妖之歌可以提前停止效果。
notes: 海妖之歌作用下的单位处于无敌状态，不会受到任何伤害。
