海妖之歌的作用范围以娜迦海妖为中心，如果她远离了作用单位，他们将会醒来。
zh.shard: 海妖之歌范围内友军每秒会恢复一定百分比的生命和魔法。

en.name: Song of the Siren End
en.desc: Release enemy units from your song so they can be targeted again.

zh.name: 终止海妖之歌
zh.desc: 将敌方单位从你的歌声中释放出来，使他们可以受到攻击。

en.name: Death Pulse
en.desc: Necrophos releases a wave of death around him, dealing damage to enemy units and healing allied units.
notes: Death Pulse can't be disjointed.

zh.name: 死亡脉冲
zh.desc: 瘟疫法师向他的周围释放死亡波纹，伤害敌方单位并治疗友军单位。
notes: 死亡脉冲不能被躲避。

en.name: Death Seeker
en.desc: Necrophos turns into a large Death Pulse towards the target unit's position. Once it arrives to the location, the Death Pulse spreads towards nearby enemies and allies.
notes: Does not trigger spell reflect.

zh.name: 死亡搜寻
zh.desc: 瘟疫法师变成一个大死亡脉冲，向目标单位的地点移动。到达该地点后，死亡脉冲会扩散至附近敌人和友军。
notes: 不会触发法术反弹。

en.name: Ghost Shroud
en.desc: Necrophos slips into the realm that separates the living from the dead. Unable to attack or be attacked, he emits an aura that slows enemies around him. He takes additional magic damage in this form, but his restorative powers are amplified.

zh.name: 幽魂护罩
zh.desc: 瘟疫法师步入将生者与死者相隔的领域。散发出一片灵气，减缓周围敌人的移动速度。在这个形态下，瘟疫法师为虚无状态，无法攻击或被攻击，受到的魔法伤害增加，但是生命/魔法恢复效果加强。

en.name: Heartstopper Aura
en.desc: Necrophos stills the hearts of his opponents, causing nearby enemy units to lose a percentage of their max health over time.
notes: Damage won't disable items like Blink Dagger.
Does not affect ancient creeps.
en.scepter: Heartstopper Aura's Health Decay is increased by 50% of Necrophos's current health regeneration.

zh.name: 竭心光环
zh.desc: 瘟疫法师让敌人的心脏停跳，使附近敌方单位按最大生命值一定百分比持续流失生命。
notes: 伤害不会禁用像闪烁匕首等物品。
不能作用于远古生物。
zh.scepter: 竭心光环的生命流失伤害提升，数值为瘟疫法师当前生命恢复的50%。

en.name: Reaper's Scythe
en.desc: Stuns the target enemy hero, then deals damage based on how much life it is missing. If Necrophos kills an enemy this way, he'll permanently gain Health and Mana Regen. Any kill under this effect is credited to Necrophos.
notes: Damage is dealt at the end of the stun.

zh.name: 死神镰刀
zh.desc: 眩晕目标敌方英雄，然后造成基于他当前损失生命值的伤害。瘟疫法师击杀敌人后将永久获得生命和魔法恢复。如果目标在死神镰刀效果下死亡，击杀者为瘟疫法师。
notes: 伤害在眩晕结束后结算。
stats: 每点损失生命值造成伤害：0.7 / 0.8 / 0.9

en.name: Sadist
en.desc: Necrophos gains stacking regen for 8 seconds for each unit he kills. Hero kills multiply the effect.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 施虐之心
zh.desc: 瘟疫法师每次击杀单位都将获得可叠加的恢复效果，持续8秒。击杀英雄后获得数倍的效果。
notes: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

en.name: Archer Aura
en.desc: Increases movement of nearby units.

zh.name: 死灵射手光环
zh.desc: 提升周围单位的移动速度。

en.name: Mana Burn
en.desc: Launches an arrow that burns away the targeted unit's mana, dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

zh.name: 法力燃烧
zh.desc: 射出一支魔箭，燃烧目标单位的魔法值，并造成与魔法值相等的伤害。

en.name: Purge
en.desc:
Dispels positive buffs from enemies and slows their movement speed.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: The slow starts at 100% and decreases over time to 20%.

zh.name: 净化
zh.desc:
驱散敌人身上的有益状态，并且减缓其移动速度。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 减速效果起始时为100%，然后持续减少至20%。

en.name: Last Will
en.desc: Deals damage to the unit that kills the Necronomicon Warrior.

zh.name: 遗愿
zh.desc: 对杀死死灵战士的单位造成伤害。

en.name: Mana Break
en.desc: Mana burned per hit, a portion of which is dealt as damage.

zh.name: 魔力损毁
zh.desc: 每次攻击燃烧掉目标的魔法值，并造成相当于损毁魔法值一定百分比的伤害

en.name: True Sight
en.desc: Reveals invisible units.

zh.name: 真实视域
zh.desc: 侦测隐形单位。

en.name: Spell Immunity
en.desc: This creature does not feel the effects of most magical spells.

zh.name: 技能免疫
zh.desc: 这个单位不受大部分魔法的影响。

en.name: Presence of the Dark Lord
en.desc: Shadow Fiend's presence reduces the armor of nearby enemies.
notes: Stacks fully with other armor reduction abilities and aura.

zh.name: 魔王降临
zh.desc: 影魔的出现使得周围的敌人护甲降低。
notes: 与其他降低护甲的技能和光环完全叠加。

en.name: Feast of Souls
en.desc:
Shadow Fiend gains Bonus Movement and Attack Speed for 8 seconds. For the duration of the effect, every 0.5s he collects souls from 2 enemies in a 600 radius. After the effect is over, he loses the souls whose owners are still alive, retaining the rest for 8s, after which souls that are over the Necromastery max stack count are also lost.

 Can only collect souls once from each individual enemy.

zh.name: 灵魂盛宴
zh.desc:
影魔获得移动速度和攻击速度加成，持续8秒。在持续时间内，每0.5秒他从600范围内的2个敌人身上收集灵魂。效果结束后，灵魂拥有者还存活的话，影魔会失去这些灵魂，否则可以保留8秒，在这之后，超过支配死灵最大叠加数量的灵魂也会失去。

从每个敌人身上只能收集一次灵魂。

en.name: Necromastery
en.desc: Shadow Fiend steals the soul from units he kills, gaining 1 bonus damage per soul. Hero kills grant 4 souls. On death, he releases 30% of them from bondage.
notes: Denies and neutral creeps also provide bonus damage through Necromastery.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
en.scepter: Increases max souls.

zh.name: 支配死灵
zh.desc: 影魔每杀死一个单位都会窃取其灵魂，每个灵魂获得1点额外攻击力。击杀英雄会获得4个灵魂。影魔死亡时30%的灵魂将逃离他的束缚。
notes: 反补、杀死中立生物也能收集到灵魂。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
zh.scepter: 提高灵魂数量上限。

en.name: Requiem of Souls
en.desc:
Shadow Fiend gathers up to 20 of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for 0.6 seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of 2.15. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery. 

 Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes: One line is generated from Shadow Fiend for every 1 soul in his possession.
Fear and movement slow do not apply if the Requiem was released on death.
en.scepter: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

zh.name: 魂之挽歌
zh.desc:
影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多20个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续0.6秒，最高可达2.15秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。

死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
notes: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每1个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。
zh.scepter: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。

en.name: Shadowraze
en.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground directly in front of him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
en.shard: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

zh.name: 毁灭阴影
zh.desc: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
notes: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
zh.shard: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少2秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的12%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

en.name: Shadowraze
en.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a short distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
en.shard: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

zh.name: 毁灭阴影
zh.desc: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
notes: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
zh.shard: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少2秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的12%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

en.name: Shadowraze
en.desc: Shadow Fiend razes the ground a longer distance away from him, dealing damage to enemy units in the area, dealing bonus damage based on his current Necromastery Soul amount. Adds a stacking damage amplifier on the target that causes the enemy to take bonus Shadowraze damage per stack.
notes: Stack duration refreshes on stack gain.
en.shard: Cooldown reduced by 2s per enemy hero hit. Applies a stacking 12% movement speed debuff on enemies hit.

zh.name: 毁灭阴影
zh.desc: 影魔对其正前方区域释放毁灭能量，对该区域中的敌人造成伤害，并且根据当前支配死灵的灵魂数量造成额外伤害。在目标身上施加一个连中效果，持续时间内再被毁灭阴影击中将受到额外伤害。
notes: 连中效果的持续时间在每次连中时刷新。
zh.shard: 每击中一名敌方英雄后冷却时间减少2秒。对击中的敌人施加可叠加的12%移动速度减缓的负面效果。

en.name: Crippling Fear
en.desc: Night Stalker horrifies all nearby enemies, causing them to become silenced and take damage over time while near him.  The effect lasts longer at night.

zh.name: 伤残恐惧
zh.desc: 暗夜魔王恐吓附近所有敌人，使他们在他身边时被沉默，并受到伤害。效果在夜晚持续更久。

en.name: Dark Ascension
en.desc: Night Stalker smothers the sun and summons instant darkness, so that he might use his powers at their fullest. Night Stalker gains flight and bonus damage during this time. Has unobstructed vision.

zh.name: 黑暗飞升
zh.desc: 暗夜魔王遮住太阳，让夜晚立刻降临，使他的力量可以得到最大程度的发挥。在此期间暗夜魔王获得飞行能力和攻击力加成。拥有顺畅视野。

en.name: Heart of Darkness
en.desc: Night Stalker's health regeneration is increased during the night and decreased during the day.
en.shard: Heart of Darkness now also applies to mana regeneration at night with the same values as health regeneration. Increases the duration of night time by 45s.

zh.name: 黑暗之心
zh.desc: 暗夜魔王的生命恢复在夜间提升，白天降低。
zh.shard: Heart of Darkness now also applies to mana regeneration at night with the same values as health regeneration. Increases the duration of night time by 45s.

en.name: Hunter in the Night
en.desc: Night Stalker is in his element at night, attacking and moving with great swiftness.
en.shard: Hunter in the Night may be cast on a creep, instantly killing it and restoring some of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana. Cannot target ancients during the daytime.
en.scepter: Increases bonus movement speed by 15% and attack speed by 50. Killing an enemy hero resets all basic ability cooldowns.

zh.name: 暗夜猎影
zh.desc: 暗夜魔王在夜晚如鱼得水，攻击和移动都变得迅速。
zh.shard: 可以主动对一个普通单位施放暗夜猎影，将其秒杀并恢复暗夜魔王最大生命和魔法的一定百分比。在白天无法对远古生物施放。
zh.scepter: 移动速度加成提升15%，攻击速度加成提升50。击杀敌方英雄会重置所有基础技能的冷却时间。

en.name: Midnight Feast
en.desc: Night Stalker heals himself when attacking enemy units. At night, the ability can be activated to instantly destroy a non-ancient creep and restore a percentage of Night Stalker's maximum health and mana.
notes: Amount of health gained from attacking is affecting by Health Restoration and is decreased when attacking non-hero targets.

zh.name: 午夜盛宴
zh.desc: 暗夜魔王攻击敌方单位时治疗自身。在夜晚可以主动施放，秒杀一个非远古非英雄单位，并回复暗夜魔王的最大生命值和最大魔法值的一定百分比。
notes: 攻击获得的生命值受到生命回复的影响，攻击非英雄目标时会减少。

en.name: Night Reign
en.desc: The game now starts at night instead of day. Night is longer than day.

zh.name: 长夜之治
zh.desc: 比赛现在会从夜晚开始，而不是白天。夜晚时间比白天长。

en.name: Void
en.desc: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes: Void does not ministun enemies during the day.
en.shard: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

zh.name: 虚空
zh.desc: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
notes: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。
zh.shard: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。

en.name: Burrow
en.desc: Nyx Assassin buries himself beneath the battlefield over a short duration. Once burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast, the range of Mind Flare and Impale is increased, and Impale's cooldown is decreased. While burrowed, Nyx Assassin is stationary, unable to attack, and invisible. Nyx Assassin gains damage reduction from all damage sources.
notes: Casting Vendetta will cancel burrow.

zh.name: 钻地
zh.desc: 司夜刺客经过短时间的掘地后钻入地下。钻地后尖刺外壳一施放就会直接眩晕附近所有敌人，神智爆裂和穿刺的施法距离提升，穿刺的冷却时间减少。钻地后司夜刺客固定在原地，无法攻击，并且是隐身状态。同时司夜刺客受到的所有伤害都会降低。
notes: 施放复仇将取消钻地状态。
stats: 钻地后尖刺外壳作用范围：400

en.name: Impale
en.desc: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units take damage, then are hurled into the air and stunned.
notes: The spikes move at 1600 units per second, over 750 range.
Impale cannot be blocked by Linken's Sphere.

zh.name: 穿刺
zh.desc: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位受到伤害，然后被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕。
notes: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒1600，最远作用距离为750。
穿刺不会被林肯法球格挡。

en.name: Mind Flare
en.desc: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last 15s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.

zh.name: 神智爆裂
zh.desc: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去15秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。

en.name: Mana Burn
en.desc: Nyx Assassin's damage on enemies also burns mana as a percentage of the damage dealt.

zh.name: 法力燃烧
zh.desc: 司夜刺客对敌人造成伤害还会燃烧造成伤害一定百分比的魔法。

en.name: Nyxth Sense
en.desc: Nyx Assassin can detect heroes within 400 units of himself.

zh.name: 夜神感知
zh.desc: 司夜刺客可以探测到附近400范围内的英雄。

en.name: Spiked Carapace
en.desc:
When activated while above ground, Spiked Carapace reflects and negates damage dealt to Nyx Assassin (max once from each source), as well as stunning the source of the damage. Activating Spiked Carapace will not break Vendetta invisibility.

While Burrowed, Spiked Carapace instantly stuns nearby enemies when cast.
notes: The damage is calculated after all reductions.
Spiked Carapace will only trigger on damage from other player controlled sources.
The damage reflected will have the same damage type as it had when it was dealt to Nyx Assassin.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 尖刺外壳
zh.desc:
激活状态下，尖刺外壳可以反弹并无效化司夜刺客受到的伤害（每个攻击者最多作用一次），同时眩晕攻击者。激活尖刺外壳不会打破复仇的隐身状态。

钻地状态下尖刺外壳施放后将立刻眩晕周围的敌人。
notes: 反弹的伤害与司夜刺客本应受到的实际伤害相同。
尖刺外壳只有在受到玩家控制来源的伤害后会反弹。
反弹的伤害与司夜刺客受到的伤害类型相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Unburrow
en.desc: Emerge from the burrow.

zh.name: 现身
zh.desc: 从钻地状态中现身。

en.name: Vendetta
en.desc: Nyx Assassin becomes invisible and gains a speed bonus. If Nyx Assassin attacks to break the invisibility, massive bonus damage is dealt with the attack that applies a break to the target. Nyx Assassin has 75 additional attack range and a 70% faster attack animation for this attack.
notes: If a spell is used to break the invisibility, or the invisibility expires, the bonus damage is lost.
With Aghanim's Shard, the Break is applied before the bonus damage.
en.shard: Decreases cooldown by 10s. For the first 15s of Vendetta, Nyx is hasted and has unobstructed pathing.

zh.name: 复仇
zh.desc: 司夜刺客进入隐身状态并获得移动速度加成。如果司夜刺客以攻击打破隐身，当次攻击将造成超高额外伤害，并对目标施加破坏效果。司夜刺客当次攻击具有75额外攻击距离，并且攻击动作加快70%。
notes: 如果在隐身期间使用了技能，或者隐身时间结束，额外伤害的效果将会消失。
会在造成额外伤害前施加破坏效果。
zh.shard: 冷却时间减少10秒。在复仇的最初15秒内，司夜刺客为极速状态，并且移动无视地形。

en.name: Arcane Orb
en.desc: Adds extra pure damage to Outworld Destroyer's attacks, based on his remaining mana pool.
notes: The damage is calculated after the mana cost is spent.
en.scepter: Arcane Orb bounces to an additional target for %bounce_damage_reduction%% less damage.

zh.name: 奥术天球
zh.desc: 殁境神蚀者的攻击附带基于剩余魔法值的额外纯粹伤害。
notes: 根据使用此技能后的魔法值计算附加伤害。
zh.scepter: 奥术天球额外弹跳至一个目标，造成的伤害降低%bounce_damage_reduction%%。

en.name: Astral Imprisonment
en.desc: Steals a percentage of the target's max mana and places them into an astral prison. The hidden unit is invulnerable and disabled. When the astral prison implodes, it deals damage to the target.
notes: Imprisoned units can still be hit by Sanity's Eclipse.
Max mana steal does not increase Outworld Destroyer's current mana values or directly reduce the victim's mana values.
en.shard: Astral Imprisonment now deals damage in an area. Also allows allies to move at 70% movement speed during Astral Imprisonment (they are visible, but untargettable and can't perform any other actions).

zh.name: 星体禁锢
zh.desc: 窃取目标最大魔法值的一定百分比，将其禁锢在星体中。被隐藏的英雄处于无敌和无法行动状态。禁锢结束时，对目标造成伤害。
notes: 被禁锢的单位依然能受到神智之蚀的作用。
最大魔法值窃取效果不会提升殁境神蚀者的当前魔法值，也不会直接减少目标的当前魔法值。
zh.shard: 星体禁锢现在会造成范围伤害。另外友军在星体禁锢期间能以70%移动速度进行移动（他们为可见状态，但无法成为目标，也不能执行其他任何动作）。

en.name: Essence Flux
en.desc: Passively grants a chance to restore a percentage of your max mana each time you cast an ability. Restores less mana from spells that modify attacks.

zh.name: 精华变迁
zh.desc: 被动拥有一定几率在施放技能时回复最大魔法值的一定百分比。通过攻击特效的技能回复的魔法会减少。

en.name: Objurgation
en.desc: Increases Outworld Destroyer's maximum mana. When cast, protects Outworld Destroyer with an all damage barrier equal to a flat amount and a percentage of his maximum mana.
en.scepter: Increases max mana to barrier. Damage that would bring Outworld Destroyer below 20% health is prevented. When that happens, Outworld Destroyer receives a strong dispel and gains an undispellable instance of Objurgation. This effect cannot occur more than once every 80 seconds.

zh.name: 责难
zh.desc: 提升殁境神蚀者的最大魔法值。施放后，殁境神蚀者获得全伤害护盾，数值为固定值 + 最大魔法值的一定百分比。
zh.scepter: 提升最大魔法值转为护盾的比例。阻止让殁境神蚀者的血量低于20%的伤害。阻止生效时，殁境神蚀者获得一次强驱散，和不可驱散的责难效果。这个效果每80秒只能触发一次。

en.name: Ominous Discernment
en.desc: Outworld Destroyer gains an additional 2.5 mana per point of Intelligence.

zh.name: 殁境神力
zh.desc: 殁境神蚀者的每点智力额外提供2.5点魔法。

en.name: Sanity's Eclipse
en.desc: Unleashes a psychic blast that deals damage to enemies based on the difference between your max mana and the target's max mana. Sanity's Eclipse can hit units trapped by Astral Imprisonment.

zh.name: 神智之蚀
zh.desc: 释放出一道神智冲击波，伤害数值基于自身与目标的最大魔法值之差。神智之蚀可以作用于星体禁锢中的单位。

en.name: Ogre Smash!
en.desc: Ogre slowly charges a big attack stunning for 2.4 seconds and dealing 200 / 250 / 300 / 400 + 8% of their current HP as damage to all units in front of him.

zh.name: 食人魔重击！
zh.desc: 食人魔缓慢蓄力并出击，对他前方所有单位造成2.4秒眩晕和200 / 250 / 300 / 400 + 8%当前生命的伤害。

en.name: Bloodlust
en.desc: Incites a frenzy in a friendly unit, increasing its movement speed and attack speed. Gives bonus attack speed if cast on Ogre himself. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 700 area of effect to receive Bloodlust.

zh.name: 嗜血术
zh.desc: 激起一个友方单位的狂暴，增加其移动和攻击速度。对食人魔魔法师自身施放时攻击速度加成更高。可以对防御塔施放。
notes: 触发多重施法时，700范围内的友方单位将随机获得嗜血术效果。

en.name: Dumb Luck
en.desc: Ogre Magi's max Intelligence is 0. He receives mana and mana regeneration from Strength.

zh.name: 傻福
zh.desc: 食人魔魔法师的智力值上限为0。他通过力量来获得魔法和魔法恢复。
stats: 每点力量提供最大魔法：6
每点力量提供魔法恢复：0.02

en.name: Fireblast
en.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing damage and stunning the target.
notes: When Multicast, Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.
en.scepter: Fireblast is refined, reducing cooldown by 1s and increasing cast speed by 25%.

zh.name: 火焰爆轰
zh.desc: 以一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成伤害并使目标眩晕。
notes: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有0.6秒的间隔。
zh.scepter: 很精通的火焰爆轰，冷却时间减少1秒，施法速度提升25%。

en.name: Ice Armor
en.desc: The Ogre Frostmage summons an invisible layer of icy air that surrounds the target friendly unit, increasing its armor and temporarily slowing any enemies that dare attack it.

zh.name: 寒冰盔甲
zh.desc: 食人魔冰霜法师召唤一层看不见的冰气围住目标友方单位，提高它的护甲值并短暂减速任何胆敢攻击它的敌人。

en.name: Ignite
en.desc: Drenches the target and another random unit in volatile chemicals, causing it to burst into flames. The target is in immense pain, taking damage and moving more slowly.
notes: Multicast makes this spell have a chance to cast multiple times at random enemy units in a 1400 area of effect.
Ignite hitting an already affected unit adds to the burn duration.

zh.name: 引燃
zh.desc: 使目标和另一个随机单位浸透在挥发性化学物质中，导致其瞬间被火焰吞噬。目标处在极度痛苦之中，受到伤害并且移动缓慢。
notes: 多重施法将使此技能有几率对1400范围内的随机敌方单位进行多次施放。
引燃现在击中已受到作用的单位后会增加持续时间。

en.name: Multicast
en.desc: Enables Ogre Magi to cast his abilities and items multiple times with each use. Each point of Strength adds to Multicast chance. Every 16 Strength adds 1%.
notes: Only targeted abilities and items have a chance to be multicast.
Targeted abilities and items apply to additional enemies and neutrals in an AoE around Ogre. Fireblast and Unrefined Fireblast hit the same target multiple times.

zh.name: 多重施法
zh.desc: 使食人魔魔法师在单次施法中有概率多次施放同一技能和物品。每16点力量提升1%多重施法几率。
notes: 只有指向性技能和物品有几率触发多重施法。
指向性技能和物品额外对食人魔周围一定作用范围内敌人和中立生物生效。火焰爆轰和未精通的火焰爆轰将对同个目标生效多次。

en.name: Fire Shield
en.desc: Creates a shield around the target ally, absorbing a percentage of the damage of next 3 attacks from enemy heroes. When damage is absorbed, a fireball is launched at the attacker. Can be cast on towers.
notes: When multicast, nearby allies will be selected randomly in an 1000 area of effect to receive Fire Shield.

zh.name: 烈火护盾
zh.desc: 创造一个围绕友军目标的护盾，吸收接下来3次来自敌方英雄攻击的一定百分比伤害。吸收伤害后向攻击者发射火球。可以对防御塔施放。
notes: 触发多重施法时，1000范围内的友方单位将随机获得烈火护盾效果。

en.name: Unrefined Fireblast
en.desc: Blasts an enemy unit with a wave of fire, dealing 150 + 1.5x Ogre's Strength in damage and stunning the target. Its mana cost is 35% of Ogre Magi's current mana.
notes: When Multicast, Unrefined Fireblast hits the same target each time with a 0.6 seconds interval.

zh.name: 未精通的火焰爆轰
zh.desc: 操控一波火焰轰击一个敌方单位，造成150 + 1.5倍食人魔力量的伤害并使目标眩晕。魔法消耗为食人魔魔法师当前魔法的35%。
notes: 触发多重施法时，两次火焰爆轰之间有0.6秒的间隔。

en.name: Degen Aura
en.desc: Degenerates the movement capabilities of enemy units that stray too near, slowing their movement speed.
notes: Does not affect Debuff Immune units.

zh.name: 退化光环
zh.desc: 削弱过于靠近的敌方单位的移动能力，降低其移动速度。
notes: 对减益免疫单位无效。

en.name: Guardian Angel
en.desc: Omniknight calls upon a Guardian Angel that grants immunity from physical damage to all allied units near Omniknight.
en.scepter: Guardian Angel has global radius, affects buildings, and amplifies health restoration.

zh.name: 守护天使
zh.desc: 全能骑士召唤出守护天使，使全能骑士附近的所有友方单位对物理伤害免疫。
zh.scepter: 守护天使的作用范围为全地图，影响建筑并增强生命回复。

en.name: Hammer of Purity
en.desc:
Omniknight imbues his hammer with holy power, causing his attack to have increased range, deal pure damage based on a percentage of his base damage and slow his target for a short duration.

 Omniknight heals for 40% of the damage dealt over 4s.

zh.name: 纯洁之锤
zh.desc:
全能骑士将神圣之力注入他的战锤，使他的攻击距离提升，会根据基础攻击力的一定百分比造成纯粹伤害，并且使目标短时间内被减速。

全能骑士会在4秒内回复40%造成的伤害。

en.name: Healing Hammer
en.desc: Ability damage done to enemies by Omniknight heals him over time.

zh.name: 疗伤之锤
zh.desc: 全能骑士对敌人造成的技能伤害会持续治疗全能骑士。

en.name: Repel
en.desc: Grants Debuff Immunity with 60% magic resistance, as well as bonus HP Regen.

zh.name: 驱逐
zh.desc: 提供减益免疫状态和60%魔法抗性，以及额外生命恢复。

en.name: Purification
en.desc: Instantly heals a friendly unit and damages all nearby enemy units.
en.shard: After a 3s delay, the target is Purified again with 65% effectiveness.

zh.name: 洗礼
zh.desc: 立即治疗一个友方单位，并对周围的敌军造成伤害。
zh.shard: 3秒延迟后目标会再次受到65%威力的洗礼。

en.name: Clairvoyant Cure
en.desc: Heal amplification increased by 0.75% per hero level.

zh.name: 预言家疗伤
zh.desc: 每级英雄等级提升0.75%治疗增强。

en.name: Clairvoyant Curse
en.desc: Spell amplification increased by 1% per hero level.

zh.name: 预言家诅咒
zh.desc: 每级英雄等级提升1%技能增强。

en.name: Diviner's Deck
en.desc:
Oracle pulls a random Tarot Card now and every 90 seconds to receives its buff for 90 seconds. Oracle always knows the next Tarot Card.

Death: 40% Spell Amplification
The Fool: 100% Increased Gold Gain
The World: 150% Increased Intelligence
The Lovers: 40% Heal Amplification
The Tower: 400 All Damage Barrier (regenerates after not taking damage for 7s)

zh.name: 占卜师牌组
zh.desc:
神谕者会立刻抽取一张塔罗牌，之后每90秒一次，每张的加成效果持续90秒。神谕者知道接下来是哪张塔罗牌。

死亡：40%技能增强
愚者：100%金钱获取提升
世界：150%智力值提升
恋人：40%治疗增强
高塔：400点全伤害护盾（7秒后未受到伤害会恢复）

en.name: False Promise
en.desc:
Temporarily alters an ally's destiny, delaying any healing or damage taken until False Promise ends. Any healing that is delayed by False Promise is amplified. Removes most negative status effects and disables on initial cast.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Delayed damage and healing will take armor and magic resistance reductions into account when received.
The delayed damage and healing takes effect as soon as the target becomes vulnerable.

zh.name: 虚妄之诺
zh.desc:
暂时篡改队友的命运，技能期间受到的任何治疗和伤害效果将在虚妄之诺结束后结算，其中治疗效果结算时效果更强。施放时将移除目标身上大部分的负面状态效果。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes: 伤害和治疗效果虽然被延缓结算，但是结算时依然会考虑护甲和魔法抗性的减免。
经过延缓的伤害和治疗效果在目标失去本技能效果后立刻结算。

en.name: Fate's Edict
en.desc: Oracle enraptures a target, disarming them and granting them 100% magic damage resistance.

zh.name: 命运敕令
zh.desc: 神谕者让目标沉醉，将其缴械并提升其100%魔法抗性。

en.name: Fortune's End
en.desc:
CHANNELED - Gathers Oracle's power into a bolt of scouring energy that, when released, damages, roots, and dispels enemies of buffs in an area around the target. If target is an ally it will only dispel debuffs. The root duration increases with channeling time.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Affects invulnerable units.

zh.name: 气运之末
zh.desc:
持续施法 - 将神谕者的力量汇聚为一股蕴含荡涤之力的能量，对敌方目标释放这股能量可以对其造成伤害，使其被缠绕，并且驱散其附近区域的魔法效果。如果目标是友军，将只造成驱散效果。缠绕时间随着持续施法时间逐渐提升。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 可以作用无敌单位。

en.name: Prognosticate
en.desc: Oracle will predict and announce to allies, where the next power rune will spawn (top or bottom) as well as Roshan's exact respawn time.

zh.name: 预言
zh.desc: 神谕者将预测并对友军宣布，下个强化神符出现的地点（上路或下路），以及肉山的准确复活时间。

en.name: Purifying Flames
en.desc: Burns away impurities, dealing heavy magic damage to the target before causing them to regenerate health over time. The amount of health regenerated over its duration exceeds the amount of initial damage. Can be cast on enemies and allies.
notes: The healing from Purifying Flames can be stacked with itself.
The damage from Purifying Flames cannot be lethal to allies.

zh.name: 涤罪之焰
zh.desc: 将目标身上一切不洁之物净化，对其造成大量魔法伤害，并使其在接下来的一段时间内逐渐恢复生命值。恢复的生命值总量将超过受到的伤害。可对友方和敌方单位施放。
notes: 涤罪之焰的治疗效果可以相互叠加。
涤罪之焰的伤害对友军不会致死。

en.name: Rain of Destiny
en.desc: Brings forth rain to the target area. Enemies standing in the area receive damage and have reduced Heal Amplification. Allies in the area heal and have increased incoming Heal Amplification.

zh.name: 天命之雨
zh.desc: 在目标范围内降下大雨。站在该区域的敌人受到每秒伤害，并且治疗增强被削弱。区域内友军被治疗，并且具有治疗增强效果。

en.name: Fortune Favors the Bold
en.desc: Random item and ability effects of enemies near Pangolier have a reduced chance to affect him.
notes: Applies to hero abilities and items.
Effect is a relative reduction in chance for effects to happen.

zh.name: 天佑勇者
zh.desc: 附近敌人攻击石鳞剑士时，他们触发物品和技能的随机类攻击特效的几率有所降低。
notes: 对英雄技能和物品有效。
效果是特效发生的几率相对降低。

en.name: Rolling Thunder
en.desc:
Pangolier curls into a debuff immune ball with 80% magic resistance and rolls out. When rolling, he moves at an increased speed and can move through trees, but has a decreased ability to turn. Striking enemies knocks them back, inflicting damage proportional to his attack damage and stunning them when they land. 

Colliding with walls or cliffs will cause a temporary pause while Pangolier reverses in direction.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: Enemies can be stunned multiple times per use, but cannot be affected a subsequent time until the previous stun duration ends.
If Pangolier is disabled while rolling, he will continue to stun and knock enemies that come within range.
It takes Pangolier 1s to reach full roll speed.

zh.name: 地雷滚滚
zh.desc:
石鳞剑士卷成一个减益免疫状态的圆球，拥有80%魔法抗性，隆隆地向前滚去。滚动时移动速度提升，可以碾过树木，但是转身速率降低。敌人被击中后会被击退，然后受到与他的攻击力成正比的伤害，并且被眩晕。

与地形障碍相撞后会暂时停止滚动，并且滚动方向变反。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 敌人在技能期间可以多次被眩晕，但是只有上一次眩晕结束后才会再次被眩晕。
即使石鳞剑士在滚动时被控制，他依然会对范围内敌人造成眩晕和击退。
石鳞剑士需要1秒才能达到全额的滚动速度。

en.name: Stop Rolling
en.desc: Halt!

zh.name: 停止滚动
zh.desc: 停！

en.name: Lucky Shot
en.desc: Pangolier rolls the dice and lets fate decide the outcome for his enemies. Grants a chance to drastically slow their attack speed and reduce armor on any damage dealt by Pangolier's attacks or abilities.

zh.name: 幸运一击
zh.desc: 石鳞剑士孤注一掷，让命运决定敌人的下场。石鳞剑士的攻击或技能拥有一定几率大幅降低攻击速度，同时削弱护甲。

en.name: Roll Up
en.desc: Pangolier curls into an immobile protective ball, gaining debuff immunity, 80% magic resistance, and allowing him to turn. Can be cast during Rolling Thunder to temporarily hit the brakes. Can cast Rolling Thunder and Shield Crash during Roll Up. If enemies attack Pangolier during this, he will roll away from the attacker, applying Rolling Thunder damage/stun if there are enemies in the way.

zh.name: 卷土重来
zh.desc: 石鳞剑士将自身卷成保护性的圆球，获得减益免疫状态，拥有80%魔法抗性加成，并且可以转身。可以在地雷滚滚期间施放，暂停滚动。可以在卷土重来期间施放地雷滚滚和甲盾冲击。若敌人在此期间发动攻击，将滚离攻击者，对途中的敌人施加地雷滚滚的伤害/眩晕。

en.name: End Roll Up
en.desc: Ends Pangolier's Roll Up early.

zh.name: 中止卷土重来
zh.desc: 提前中止石鳞剑士的卷土重来。

en.name: Shield Crash
en.desc:
Pangolier jumps in the air and slams back to the ground in front of his current position damaging all enemies in a radius. Pangolier gains an all damage barrier for a short time if Shield Crash hits an enemy hero.

Forward movement is maintained if Shield Crash is used while Rolling Thunder is active, and allows Rolling Thunder to clear walls or cliffs.
en.scepter: Causes Shield Crash to cast a 2-attack Swashbuckle every 90 degrees around your hero that deals 75% damage.

zh.name: 甲盾冲击
zh.desc:
石鳞剑士跃入空中，再落向当前位置的前方地面造成冲击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害。甲盾冲击只要击中任意敌方英雄，他就能在短时间内获得一定数值的全伤害护盾。

地雷滚滚过程中使用甲盾冲击将会保持前进，并且可以使地雷滚滚跨过地形障碍。
zh.scepter: 甲盾冲击将围绕英雄每90度施放一个刺击2次的虚张声势，造成75%伤害。

en.name: Swashbuckle
en.desc:
Pangolier dashes along the target line, then slashes and briefly slows all enemies in the drawn direction with several quick swipes.

Lucky Shot has a chance to activate from this damage.
notes: Casting Swashbuckle during Rolling Thunder ends Rolling Thunder.

zh.name: 虚张声势
zh.desc:
石鳞剑士先冲向目标地点，再向指示方向上的所有敌人刺出数剑并减速他们。

刺剑有几率触发幸运一击。
notes: 在地雷滚滚期间施放虚张声势将使地雷滚滚提前结束。

en.name: Blur
en.desc: Phantom Assassin blurs her body, disjointing incoming projectiles, increasing her movement speed, causing her to be impossible to see until she comes near enemy heroes or towers.
notes: Attacking Roshan with a regular attack will dispel Blur.
en.shard: Decreases Cooldown by 10s. Any time Phantom Assassin gets a hero kill, her ability cooldowns advance 60% of their max cooldown values.

zh.name: 魅影无形
zh.desc: 幻影刺客模糊自己的身形，躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道，提升她的移动速度，使她无法被看到，直到她靠近敌方英雄或防御塔。
notes: 通过普通攻击攻击肉山会驱散魅影无形。
zh.shard: 冷却时间减少10秒。只要幻影刺客击杀英雄，她的技能冷却时间都会加快60%最高冷却时间。

en.name: Coup de Grace
en.desc: Phantom Assassin refines her combat abilities, acquiring a chance of gaining Deadly Focus with each attack. When attacking with Deadly Focus, Phantom Assassin will consume the buff and guarantee a critical hit. Stifling Dagger has a bonus chance to cause Deadly Focus.

zh.name: 恩赐解脱
zh.desc: 幻影刺客的战斗技能得到精进，每次攻击时有几率获得致命专注。攻击时若带有致命专注，幻影刺客会消耗该效果，并且必定产生一次致命一击。窒碍短匕拥有额外几率获得致命专注。

en.name: Fan of Knives
en.desc: Phantom Assassin releases sharp blades around her, dealing a percentage of each victim's max health on impact and applying Break.

zh.name: 刀阵旋风
zh.desc: 幻影刺客对附近范围内敌人放出尖利的刀刃，击中时造成每名受害者最大生命值一定百分比的伤害并施加破坏效果。

en.name: Immaterial
en.desc:
Phantom Assassin focuses inward, increasing her ability to evade enemy attacks.

Stacks diminishingly with other sources of Evasion.

zh.name: 飘忽不定
zh.desc:
幻影刺客专注一心，闪避敌人攻击的技艺得到提升。

与其他闪避效果为非线性叠加。

en.name: Phantom Strike
en.desc: Teleports to a unit, friendly or enemy, and grants bonus attack speed while attacking if it's an enemy unit.

zh.name: 幻影突袭
zh.desc: 传送到一个单位身旁，敌我皆可，如果目标是敌方单位将进行攻击并获得攻速加成。

en.name: Stifling Dagger
en.desc: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing 65 / 70 / 75 / 80+30 / 45 / 60 / 75% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes: If an attack effect is chance-based, the chance of its application will be the same as its chance to occur.
Spell-immune enemies are not affected by Stifling Dagger's slow.
Stifling Dagger grants vision around its location while it travels and upon impact.

zh.name: 窒碍短匕
zh.desc: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为65 / 70 / 75 / 80+幻影刺客攻击伤害的30 / 45 / 60 / 75%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
notes: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

en.name: Doppelganger
en.desc:
Phantom Lancer briefly vanishes from the battlefield. After 1 second, Phantom Lancer and any of his nearby illusions reappear at a random position within the targeted location, along with two additional doppelgangers. Extends duration of all illusions. The two added doppelgangers have different properties: one takes normal damage and deals none, while the other takes 500% bonus damage and deals -80% less damage.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes: This ability can be used to dodge projectiles, and dispel debuffs.
Trees near a reappearing unit will be destroyed.
Phantom Lancer and his allies can see which illusion is the 100% damage illusion.

zh.name: 神行百变
zh.desc:
幻影长矛手暂时从战场上消失。经过1秒，幻影长矛手和附近的所有幻象都会出现在目标地点的随机位置，并产生两个新的幻象。施放技能后延长所有幻象的持续时间。新加的两个幻象拥有不同的特性：一个承受正常百分比的伤害，不具有攻击力，另一个额外承受500%伤害，继承的攻击力相比本体减少-80%。

驱散类型：弱驱散
notes: 这个技能可以躲避攻击和技能弹道，并且驱散负面效果。
重新现身的单位附近的树木将会被摧毁。
幻影长矛手和他的队友可以分辨出哪个幻象承受100%伤害。

en.name: Illusory Armaments
en.desc: Whenever an illusion of Phantom Lancer is created, its outgoing damage cannot go below a fixed value for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 灵幻兵械
zh.desc: 幻影长矛手只要制造出幻象，该幻象的继承攻击力不会低于一定值，持续3秒。

en.name: Juxtapose
en.desc: Phantom Lancer has a chance to fracture his presence on an attack, creating an illusion of himself. Illusions also have a chance to fracture further. Illusions created from Phantom Lancer last for 8 seconds, while illusions created from other illusions last 4 seconds.
en.shard: Adds an active ability to Juxtapose. Renders Phantom Lancer invisible for up to 8 seconds while generating a duplicate image to confuse enemies. His movement speed is increased by 15% during this invisibility.

zh.name: 并列
zh.desc: 幻影长矛手的攻击有一定几率使自己的存在破碎，产生自身的幻象。幻象也有几率进一步破碎，再产生幻象。幻影长矛手产生的幻象持续8秒，幻象产生的幻象则持续4秒。
zh.shard: 并列增加主动技能。使幻影长矛手进入隐身，最多持续8秒，同时产生一个复制幻象来迷惑敌人。隐身期间自身移动速度提升15%。

en.name: Phantom Rush
en.desc: When targeting an enemy for an attack, Phantom Lancer quickly charges into range, gaining increased movement speed and evasion.
notes: If the attack order is cancelled, the movement speed bonus is lost.
Rush movement speed is 800.
en.scepter: Increases Range. Whenever Phantom Lancer Rushes through enemies, he creates Juxtapose illusions that attack them. Additionally, every 600 units rushed creates a Juxtapose illusion that rushes to the target alongside Phantom Lancer.

zh.name: 幻影冲锋
zh.desc: 对目标发动攻击后，幻影长矛手将快速向其冲去，获得移动速度和闪避提升。
notes: 如果冲锋中途取消攻击指令，那么移动速度加成就会消失。
冲锋过程中移动速度为800。
zh.scepter: 提升距离。每当幻影长矛手冲锋时穿过敌人，他就会制造并列幻象攻击他们。另外，每冲锋600距离还会在幻影长矛手身旁制造一个并列幻象，向目标冲去。

en.name: Spirit Lance
en.desc: Sends a magical spirit lance to a target enemy unit that damages and slows, while summoning an illusory phantom to attack the unit.
notes: Illusions within 675 range of Phantom Lancer will mimic the cast animation.
en.scepter: Spirit Lance bounces once on enemies, prioritizing Heroes. Increases Spirit Lance illusion damage.

zh.name: 灵魂之矛
zh.desc: 对敌方目标单位投出一支有魔力的灵魂之矛，造成伤害并减速，同时召唤一个幻象攻击该单位。
notes: 幻影长矛手附近675范围内的幻象也会模仿施法动作。
zh.scepter: 灵魂之矛可以向范围内敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先。提升灵魂之矛的幻象继承攻击力。

en.name: Blinding Sun
en.desc: Phoenix ability debuffs apply a stackable %blind_per_second%% Miss chance per second. Lasts %blind_duration% seconds.

zh.name: 阳光猛烈
zh.desc: 凤凰技能的负面效果会施加一个可叠加的每秒%blind_per_second%%攻击落空几率。持续%blind_duration%秒。

en.name: Dying Light
en.desc: Phoenix deals 3.5% of its missing health as magic damage to all enemies in a 400 radius every second.
notes: Dying Light deals damage while Phoenix is transformed during Supernova.

zh.name: 消逝之光
zh.desc: 凤凰每秒对400范围内所有敌人造成3.5%自身缺失生命值的魔法伤害。
notes: 消逝之光在凤凰变身为超新星期间也会造成伤害。

en.name: Fire Spirits
en.desc: Summons 4 fire spirits that circle around Phoenix. Each spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.
en.shard: Causes Fire Spirits to become a passive charge-based ability. Has 7 second replenish time.

zh.name: 烈火精灵
zh.desc: 召唤4只围绕凤凰飞行的烈火精灵。每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
notes: 烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。
zh.shard: 烈火精灵变成被动充能技能。具有7秒充能时间。

en.name: Icarus Dive
en.desc: Phoenix dives forward in an arc with a fixed distance in the targeted direction, dealing damage over time and slowing the movement speed of any units it comes into contact with, and then orbiting back to its original position. If Phoenix casts Supernova, the dive ends.
notes: Icarus Dive has a 2 second travel duration, and can be cancelled by casting the ability again while in flight.

zh.name: 凤凰冲击
zh.desc: 凤凰向目标方向进行圆弧状飞行，飞行距离固定，对沿途的敌人造成持续伤害并减缓其移动速度，然后返回初始位置。飞行过程中如果施放超新星将停止飞行。
notes: 凤凰冲击的飞行时间为2秒，可以在飞行途中再次施放来终止飞行。

en.name: Stop Icarus Dive
en.desc: Immediately cancels the dive.

zh.name: 终止凤凰冲击
zh.desc: 马上停止冲击。

en.name: Launch Fire Spirit
en.desc: Each fire spirit can be launched independently at a targeted area of effect. Affected enemy units take damage over time and have their attack speed greatly reduced.
notes: Fire Spirits reveal the area they strike for 1 second.

zh.name: 发动烈火精灵
zh.desc: 每一只烈火精灵都能被单独发射到指定区域。对敌人持续造成伤害并大幅降低他们的攻击速度。
notes: 烈火精灵现在到达目标区域后将获得1秒的视野。

en.name: Sun Ray
en.desc: Phoenix expels a beam of light at the cost of its own health. The beam damages enemies and heals allies for a base amount plus a percentage of their max health. The percentage increases as the beam continues to fire.
notes: Sun Ray has a width of 130 units, and a length of 1200 units.
Sun Ray is canceled if Phoenix gets stunned, silenced, cycloned, hexed or slept.
Phoenix can use items and abilities without canceling Sun Ray.
en.shard: Allows Sun Ray to be cast during Supernova.

zh.name: 烈日炙烤
zh.desc: 凤凰以损失生命能量为代价，向前射出一束炽热的光线炙烤敌人。光线对敌人造成伤害，并且能治疗友军，伤害和治疗的数值均为基础数值加上目标最大生命值的一定百分比。随着光线不断炙烤，百分比也会不断增加。
notes: 烈日炙烤的宽度为130，长度为1200。
凤凰受到眩晕、沉默、飓风、妖术或睡眠等效果时烈日炙烤将会中断。
凤凰可以使用物品和其他技能，不会打断烈日炙烤。
zh.shard: 超新星期间可以施放烈日炙烤。

en.name: Stop Sun Ray
en.desc: Immediately stops the Sun Ray.

zh.name: 终止烈日炙烤
zh.desc: 马上停止烈日炙烤。

en.name: Toggle Movement
en.desc: Toggles slow forward movement during Sun Ray firing.
notes: Sun Ray allows Phoenix to move over cliffs and trees.

zh.name: 切换移动状态
zh.desc: 在烈日炙烤时切换为缓慢前行状态。
notes: 烈日炙烤允许凤凰穿越地形和树木。

en.name: Supernova
en.desc:
The Phoenix willingly ends its current life for the chance to be reborn. Transforms into a burning sun that scorches enemies in a huge area. The sun can be destroyed by attacks from enemy Heroes. After 6 seconds the sun explodes, stunning all nearby enemies while restoring Phoenix to full health and mana with refreshed abilities.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
en.scepter: Increases number of attacks to destroy Supernova and allows Phoenix to cast Supernova on an allied hero, bringing both into the sun to be reborn together.

zh.name: 超新星
zh.desc:
凤凰十分乐意终结自己现在的生命来换取重生。将自己变为一颗燃烧的恒星，灼烧附近一大片区域内的敌人。恒星受到敌方英雄一定次数的攻击后将会被摧毁。经过6秒后恒星将会爆炸，眩晕周围所有敌人。而凤凰的生命和魔法值都会回到满状态，并且所有技能的冷却时间都会刷新。

驱散类型：强驱散
zh.scepter: 摧毁超新星所需的攻击次数增加，凤凰可以对友方英雄施放超新星，使双方共同变为恒星进行重生。

en.name: Guild Banner
en.desc: Plant your guild's banner to mark this battleground for you all!

zh.name: 公会旗帜
zh.desc: 插下你的公会旗帜，为大家标记这片战场！

en.name: High Five
en.desc: Throw your hand (or handy appendage) in the air!

zh.name: 击掌
zh.desc: 高举你的手（或手状附肢）。

en.name: Thunder Clap
en.desc: The Hellbear Smasher claps his massive hands together, creating a deafening blast. The blast damages nearby enemies and throws them off their footing.

zh.name: 雷霆一击
zh.desc: 地狱熊怪粉碎者将它巨大的手掌猛烈拍合，发出震耳欲聋的冲击。冲击伤害附近敌人并掀倒他们。

en.name: Colossal
en.desc: Primal Beast has 10% base Slow Resistance and gains 0.5% bonus Area of Effect and 1% Slow Resistance for every 100 Max Health.

zh.name: 庞
zh.desc: 獸拥有10%基础减速抗性，每拥有100点生命上限就获得+0.5%作用范围加成和+1%减速抗性。

en.name: Onslaught
en.desc:
Primal Beast charges up and then runs in the chosen direction, knocking back enemies and allies alike. Enemy units are damaged and stunned on impact. The longer the charge duration, the farther Primal Beast's momentum will carry him. 

 Can be cancelled at any time with the Stop command.

zh.name: 突
zh.desc:
獸积蓄力量再向选定方向冲去，将敌人和队友同时击退。敌方单位被撞时受到伤害，并且被眩晕。蓄力时间越长，獸冲的距离越远。

可以随时使用停止指令来中止。

en.name: Begin Onslaught
en.desc: Begins the rush to the specified location.

zh.name: 正在突进
zh.desc: 开始奔向指定地点。

en.name: Pulverize
en.desc: CHANNELED - Primal Beast channels his rage, grabbing the target enemy and slamming them into the ground repeatedly, damaging and mini-stunning any enemies caught in the AoE. Each consecutive hit deals bonus damage. Lasts 2.3 seconds.

zh.name: 捶
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 獸释放出他的怒火，抓起敌方目标，反复将其向地面捶击，对范围内所有敌人造成伤害和短暂眩晕。每次连续击中会造成额外伤害。持续2.3秒。

en.name: Rock Throw
en.desc:
Primal Beast throws a rock at the target location that stuns and damages enemies. The rock cannot be thrown within a minimum range of Primal Beast. After landing, the rock splits into 3 additional fragments that land behind the initial target location.

 Rock Throw increases stacks of Uproar for each hero hit.

zh.name: 砸
zh.desc:
獸向目标地点扔出一块岩石，对敌人造成眩晕和伤害。岩石无法扔向獸身边的最小范围内。岩石落地后会分裂成3块碎石，落在初始目标地点的后方。

砸每击中一名英雄都会增加咤的一层叠加效果。

en.name: Trample
en.desc: Primal Beast stomps over everything. For every 140 units traveled, all enemies around the Beast receive damage. Deals base damage plus a multiplier of Primal Beast's attack damage. Primal Beast is disarmed for the duration of the ability.

zh.name: 踏
zh.desc: 獸践踏一切。每行进140距离就会对獸附近范围内所有敌人造成伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上獸攻击力的一定系数。獸在技能期间被缴械。

en.name: Uproar
en.desc:
The Beast's temper causes every instance of 50 hero damage or more to grant a stack of Uproar.  

 When activated, Primal Beast releases a roar that slows surrounding enemies and grants the Beast additional attack damage and armor for 7 seconds based on his current stacks of Uproar.
notes: Primal Beast cannot gain Uproar stacks from self damage.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
en.scepter: When Primal Beast activates Uproar, he releases 3 waves of 2 projectiles per stack of uproar each in a circle around him. Projectiles deal damage and Break enemies hit. After a short delay, each projectile splinters in two.

zh.name: 咤
zh.desc:
獸的脾性使獸每次受到的敌方英雄伤害超过50点后就会获得咤的叠加效果。

主动施放后，獸释放出咆哮声，减速附近敌人，并且獸根据咤的当前叠加层数获得额外攻击力和护甲，持续7秒。
notes: 獸对自身造成伤害无法获得咤的叠加效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
zh.scepter: 獸开启咤时，以自身为圆心施放出3波弹道，每波每层咤的叠加效果有2个弹道。弹道造成伤害并对击中的敌人施加破坏效果。经过短暂延迟后每个弹道会分裂成两个。
stats: 每层叠加咆哮护甲加成：2 / 3 / 4 / 5

en.name: Dream Coil
en.desc: Creates a coil of volatile magic that latches onto enemy Heroes, damaging and leashing them.  If the enemy hero stretches the coil by moving too far away, it snaps, stunning and dealing additional damage.
en.scepter: All enemies affected by Dream Coil are attacked at a rate equal to 90% of Puck's attack rate. The attacks continue while the target is stunned if they break the Dream Coil.

zh.name: 梦境缠绕
zh.desc: 创造一个变化无常的的魔法梦境来困住敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害和束缚。如果被困住的敌方英雄试图挣脱缠绕走出梦境，将因为梦境破碎而受到眩晕和额外伤害。
zh.scepter: 梦境缠绕作用下的所有敌人都会被帕克攻击，攻击频率基于帕克攻击频率的90%。即使目标挣脱梦境，被眩晕时攻击也会继续。

en.name: Ethereal Jaunt
en.desc: Teleports Puck to a flying Illusory Orb.

zh.name: 灵动之翼
zh.desc: 让帕克能传送到幻象法球所在的位置。

en.name: Illusory Orb
en.desc:
Vector Targeted. Puck launches a magic orb that travels along the path, damaging enemy units along the way. The orb deals an additional 3% of its impact damage every 0.5s in its area of effect, but if it exceeds the max cast range it will be destroyed.

 At any point, Puck may teleport to the orb's location using Ethereal Jaunt.

 Can be put on alt-cast to launch the Orb straight ahead.
notes: The Illusory Orb grants unobstructed vision around its location while it travels.
Jaunting to the Orb will disjoint projectiles.

zh.name: 幻象法球
zh.desc:
以矢量为目标。帕克向路线方向发出一个魔法球，对经过路径上的敌人造成伤害。法球每0.5秒会在作用范围内额外造成3%击中伤害，但超过最大施法距离后法球会被摧毁。

在幻象法球飞行过程中，帕克可以使用灵动之翼来传送到法球所在的位置。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），让法球的路线为向前的直线。
notes: 幻象法球在飞行途中提供顺畅视野。
将自己传送到幻象法球可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。

en.name: Phase Shift
en.desc: CHANNELED - Puck briefly shifts into another dimension where it is immune from harm.
notes: Puck retains collision size while under the effects of Phase Shift.
Issuing any action will cancel Phase Shift.
Puck is invulnerable during Phase Shift.
en.shard: Puck's attacks deal bonus magic damage. Puck attacks all enemies within its attack range every time it phase shifts.

zh.name: 相位转移
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 帕克暂时将自己转移到另一个位面，从而免疫伤害。
notes: 帕克在相位转移状态下依然具有碰撞体积。
进行任何动作都会中止相位转移。
帕克在相位转移状态下无敌。
zh.shard: 帕克的攻击造成额外魔法伤害。帕克每次施放相位转移时对攻击距离内所有敌人发动一次攻击。

en.name: Puckish
en.desc: Whenever Puck disjoints an attack, it restores 3% of its max health and mana. Dodging a targeted spell projectile restores 3x that amount. Does not apply to attacks by Towers.

zh.name: 顽皮克敌
zh.desc: 每当帕克躲避攻击时，它就会分别回复最大生命值和最大魔法值的3%。躲避指向性技能的弹道将回复3倍数值。防御塔的攻击不会对此生效。

en.name: Waning Rift
en.desc: Puck teleports to the target location and releases a burst of faerie dust that deals damage and silences enemy units nearby.

zh.name: 新月之痕
zh.desc: 帕克传送至目标地点洒出它神秘的仙女粉尘，对周围的敌人造成伤害和沉默。

en.name: Dismember
en.desc: CHANNELED - Pudge chows down on an enemy unit, disabling it and dealing damage over time. Damage is increased by Pudge's Strength and heals him for the total amount. Pudge pulls the unit at a rate of 75 units, up to a minimum of 125 range.
notes: If a unit becomes invisible while Dismembered, it will still be under the effects of Dismember.

zh.name: 肢解
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 帕吉撕咬一个敌方单位，使其失去行动能力并受到持续伤害。伤害量为基础伤害加上帕吉力量值的一定百分比，帕吉将回复与伤害量相等的生命。帕吉会将该单位以每秒75的速度向自身牵引，最多牵引125距离。
notes: 即使肢解的目标在受到作用的过程中隐身，还是不会脱离肢解的作用。

en.name: Eject
en.desc: Ejects the swallowed allied hero inside of you.

zh.name: 倾吐
zh.desc: 吐出体内的友方英雄。

en.name: Meat Shield
en.desc: Pudge covers himself with a layer of flesh that blocks damage of any type taken from any source.

zh.name: 肉盾
zh.desc: 帕吉用一层血肉包裹自己，可以格挡所有来源的所有类型伤害。

en.name: Flesh Heap
en.desc: Pudge's skin thickens permanently every time he kills an enemy Hero, gaining 2 bonus Strength for each stack.
notes: Enemy Heroes that die within 450 of Pudge grant a stack regardless of its killer.

zh.name: 腐肉堆积
zh.desc: 每次帕吉击杀敌方英雄时，他的皮肤就会永久变厚，获得的每层叠加效果为2点额外力量。
notes: 帕吉附近450范围内敌方英雄阵亡时他都会获得一层叠加效果，不论击杀者是谁。

en.name: Meat Hook
en.desc: Launches a bloody hook toward a unit or location. The hook will snag the first unit it encounters, dragging the unit back to Pudge, killing it if it's a non-ancient creep and dealing damage if it is an enemy otherwise.
notes: Interrupts channeling spells of the primary target if it's an enemy.
Meat Hook hits invisible units.
Meat Hook can go through trees, cliffs, buildings, ancient units and Roshan.
Meat Hook can drag friendly units, but they won't be damaged.
Meat Hook can hit and drag runes to Pudge, refunding the Hook's mana cost.
en.shard:
When Meat Hook hits an enemy, it deals bonus damage based on the distance pulled.

When Meat Hook hits an ally, Meat Hook's cooldown is reduced by 50%.

zh.name: 肉钩
zh.desc: 向一个单位或方向射出血腥的肉钩。勾住第一个遭遇的单位，并将它拖到帕吉身边，如果是非远古单位会被秒杀，其他敌方单位则是受到伤害。
notes: 钩中敌人后将打断持续施法类技能。
肉钩能击中隐身单位。
肉钩可以穿过树木、地形、建筑、远古生物和肉山。
肉钩可以拖拽友方单位，不过他们不会受到伤害。
肉钩可以将神符拖拽至帕吉身旁，并返还肉钩的魔法消耗。
zh.shard:
肉钩击中敌人时会根据牵引距离造成额外伤害。

肉钩击中友军时，肉钩的冷却时间会减少50%。

en.name: Rot
en.desc: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
notes: Using Rot doesn't interrupt channeling.
Rot hits invisible units.
If Pudge is silenced, he can't deactivate Rot if it's activated.
Rot self-damage is non-lethal.
en.scepter: Increases Rot radius by 200, damage by 90, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by 20%.

zh.name: 腐烂
zh.desc: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
notes: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。
zh.scepter: 腐烂的作用范围提升200，伤害提升90点，并且可以降低敌人的20%生命回复。

en.name: Decrepify
en.desc: A powerful banishing spell that slows a unit and renders it unable to attack or be attacked. Healing on affected allies is increased, while afflicted enemies take extra magic damage instead.
notes: Only magical and pure damage can affect a unit under the effects of Decrepify.
Doesn't slow allied units.
Can be used on your Nether Ward.

zh.name: 衰老
zh.desc: 一个强大的驱逐咒语，能使一个单位进入虚无状态，无法攻击或受到攻击。受作用的友军提升了治疗效果，而受作用的敌军会被减速，并且承受额外魔法伤害。
notes: 只有魔法伤害和纯粹伤害可以作用于处于衰老状态的单位。
不会对友方单位造成减速。
可以对幽冥守卫施放。

en.name: Life Drain
en.desc:
CHANNELED - When cast on an enemy, Pugna drains health from the target enemy unit to heal himself and granting vision over the target.

When cast on an ally, Pugna will drain his own health into his ally.
en.shard: Life Drain can target your Nether Ward, causing life drain to refract to all enemy heroes within 700 units of the ward for 75% of its normal value. The effect is interrupted if the ward is destroyed.
en.scepter: Reduces cooldown by 7s. When targeting an enemy hero, Pugna reduces their outgoing spell damage by 8% per second up to a maximum of 75% and increases his own, up to a maximum of 100%. When draining through a Nether Ward using Shard, the rate of increase/decrease is 4% instead. Debuff lasts 8 seconds.

zh.name: 生命汲取
zh.desc:
持续施法 - 使用生命汲取时，帕格纳吸取目标敌方单位的生命值，并获得其视野。

向队友施放可以将自己的生命值转移给队友。
zh.shard: 生命汲取可以对幽冥守卫施放，使生命汲取可以折射至守卫附近700范围内所有敌方英雄，造成75%效果。守卫被摧毁后效果将会中断。
zh.scepter: 冷却时间减少7秒。以敌方英雄为目标时，帕格纳每秒降低他们8%技能伤害输出，最高可达到75%，并且自身的技能伤害输出提升，最高可达到100%。魔晶升级下对幽冥守卫施放时降低和提升的速率为4%。负面效果持续8秒。

en.name: Nether Blast
en.desc: An exploding pulse deals damage to enemies and structures in the area.  Deals 65% damage to structures.
notes: Damage is delayed by 0.8 seconds.

zh.name: 幽冥爆轰
zh.desc: 一个爆炸性脉冲，对敌方单位造成伤害。对建筑物造成65%伤害。
notes: 伤害生效延迟为0.8秒。

en.name: Nether Ward
en.desc: Pugna places a Nether Ward at the target location. The ward will fire at any enemy hero who casts a spell dealing base damage plus the damage multiplier of the mana spent by the enemy hero.
notes: Nether Ward deals damage before the actual spell is cast, so if the caster dies the spell will have no effect.
Nether Ward can be decrepified.
Illusions and creeps deal 25% damage to Nether Ward.
en.shard: Increases cast range to 175.

zh.name: 幽冥守卫
zh.desc: 帕格纳在目标地点放置一个幽冥守卫。守卫将对任何施法的敌方英雄发射魔力闪光。幽冥守卫造成的伤害为基础伤害加上敌方英雄施法时消耗魔法值的数倍。
notes: 技能施放后幽冥守卫先造成伤害，技能才会生效，所以如果施法者因此阵亡，施放的技能将没有效果。
幽冥守卫可以受到衰老的作用。
幻象和非英雄单位对幽冥守卫造成25%的伤害。
zh.shard: 施法距离提升至175。

en.name: Oblivion Savant
en.desc:
Pugna can cast spells and use items while channeling.

Pugna receives 1.5% spell amplification per destroyed tower.

zh.name: 湮灭专家
zh.desc:
帕格纳可以在持续施法期间施放技能和使用物品。

每摧毁一座防御塔，帕格纳都会获得1.5%技能增强。

en.name: Blink
en.desc: Short distance teleportation that allows Queen of Pain to move in and out of combat.
notes: You can use Blink to dodge incoming projectiles.
en.shard: Releases a sonic boom when Queen of Pain blinks, at both her starting and ending locations. Deals 125 damage in a 300 AoE and silences the target for 1.75 seconds.

zh.name: 闪烁
zh.desc: 短距离传送，能让痛苦女王自由出入战场。
notes: 闪烁可以躲避多种飞行过程中的攻击和技能弹道。
zh.shard: 在痛苦女王的闪烁起点和落地点各释放一次音爆。在300范围内造成125点伤害，并沉默1.75秒。

en.name: Bondage
en.desc: Whenever an enemy within 1200 range deals spell damage to Queen of Pain, she returns 20% of the damage dealt.

zh.name: 束手束脚
zh.desc: 每当1200范围内的敌人对痛苦女王造成技能伤害时，她就会反弹造成伤害的20%。

en.name: Masochist
en.desc: Queen of Pain has bonus Spell Amplification but a percentage of her spell damage is reflected back to her.
notes: Damage to illusions is not reflected.
Damage reflected is before reduction.
Damage reflected is non-lethal.
Includes Spell damage from items.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 受虐成狂
zh.desc: 痛苦女王拥有技能增强加成，但是她技能伤害的一定百分比会反弹回她自己身上。
notes: 对幻象的伤害不会反弹。
反弹的伤害计算在减免前。
反弹的伤害不会致死。
包括来自物品的技能伤害。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Scream Of Pain
en.desc:
The Queen of Pain lets loose a piercing scream around her, damaging nearby enemies.

25% of the damage dealt to heroes is reflected back to her.
notes: Scream Of Pain will hit invisible units.
Scream Of Pain cannot be disjointed.
Damage to illusions is not reflected. Damage reflected is before reduction and non-lethal.
Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 痛苦尖叫
zh.desc:
痛苦女王发出刺耳的尖叫，对周围敌人造成伤害。

造成伤害的25%会反弹回她身上。
notes: 痛苦尖叫能作用隐身单位。
痛苦尖叫无法被躲避。
对幻象造成的伤害不会反弹。反弹的伤害为减免前的，而且不致死。
反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Shadow Strike
en.desc: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for 16 seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
notes: The affected unit slowly regains its original movement speed every second during the duration.
Units afflicted by Shadow Strike can be denied by their allies when their HP drops below 25% of their maximum health.
en.scepter: Causes Shadow Strike to become a 300 AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

zh.name: 暗影突袭
zh.desc: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续16秒。每3秒会再造成一次伤害。
notes: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。
zh.scepter: 暗影突袭变为300范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。

en.name: Sonic Wave
en.desc: Creates a gigantic wave of sound in front of Queen of Pain, dealing heavy damage to all enemy units in its wake and pushing them back.
notes: Sonic Wave can hit units up to 1150 units away.

zh.name: 超声冲击波
zh.desc: 痛苦女王在她面前制造出强大的声波，对其轨迹上的所有敌人造成大量伤害，并将他们击退。
notes: 超声冲击波最远能伤害1150距离外的单位。

en.name: Succubus
en.desc: All sources of Spell Lifesteal also apply to Pure Damage. Queen of Pain gains Spell Lifesteal that increases with proximity to her enemies. Lifesteal is at its maximum when the enemy is 150 units or closer to her and at its minimum when the enemy is 800 units or further from her.

zh.name: 魅魔
zh.desc: 所有来源的技能吸血也对纯粹伤害生效。痛苦女王获得技能吸血，与敌人的距离越近效果越强。敌人距离她不到150距离时达到最强效果，距离她超过800距离时为最弱效果。

en.name: Armor Power
en.desc:
Clockwerk's outgoing damage increases by 0.25% per point of armor.

Clockwerk can consume Chainmails to permanently gain +4 armor per Chainmail consumed. Can stack. Self-cast to consume.

zh.name: 装甲力量
zh.desc:
发条技师的每点护甲都会使伤害输出增加0.25%。

发条技师可以消耗锁子甲，永久获得+4点护甲。可以叠加。对自身施放后即可消耗。

en.name: Battery Assault
en.desc: Discharges high-powered shrapnel at random nearby enemy units, dealing minor magical damage and ministun.
notes: Remains active if Clockwerk is disabled.

zh.name: 弹幕冲击
zh.desc: 向附近敌方单位随机射出高能弹片，造成小额魔法伤害和短暂眩晕。
notes: 发条技师被控制后仍然有效。

en.name: Hookshot
en.desc: Fires a grappling device rapidly at the target location.  If the hook hits a unit, Clockwerk launches himself into the target, stunning and dealing damage to everyone in a 175 radius around the hit target. Any enemies Clockwerk collides with along the way are damaged and stunned.
notes: Hookshot will latch and take Clockwerk to allies, but not damage or disable them.

zh.name: 发射钩爪
zh.desc: 向目标位置高速射出钩爪，如果命中一个单位，发条技师会将自己牵引到目标身边，对目标附近175范围内所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。对牵引时冲撞到的单位也造成伤害和眩晕。
notes: 发射钩爪可以抓住友方单位并将发条技师牵引过去，但是不会造成伤害和眩晕。

en.name: Jetpack
en.desc: Clockwerk activates a jetpack, gaining flying movement, flying vision, and bonus movement speed. Clockwerk has a severely-limited turn rate during this time and cannot attack. Jetpack can be toggled on and off for the duration of the buff.

zh.name: 喷气背包
zh.desc: 发条技师开动喷气背包，获得飞行移动状态，飞行视野和移动速度加成。发条技师的转身速率大幅降低，并且无法攻击。在加成状态的持续时间内可以开启和关闭喷气背包。

en.name: Jetpack Toggle
en.desc: Toggles Jetpack on and off.

zh.name: 喷气背包开关
zh.desc: 开启或关闭喷气背包。

en.name: Overclocking
en.desc:
Supercharges Clockwerks abilities:

Battery Assault: Increased radius and affects all enemies in its range.
Power Cogs: Radius increased, and Clockwerk's armor while near Power Cogs is increased.
Rocket Flares: Increased damage, vision and slow duration, and fire additional rockets to either side of the target.
Hookshot: Stun radius and duration increased.
Jetpack: Moves faster.

Clockwerk's movement and attack speed becomes slowed to a crawl after the duration runs out.

zh.name: 超速运转
zh.desc:
使发条技师的所有技能变得强力：

弹幕冲击：作用范围提升，并且可以作用于范围内所有敌人。
能量齿轮：成型范围提升，并且发条技师靠近能量齿轮时护甲提升。
照明火箭：伤害、视野和减速时间提升，并且发射时向目标两侧各额外发射一枚。
发射钩爪：眩晕范围和时间均有提升。
喷气背包：移动得更快。

持续时间结束后发条技师的移动和攻击速度降到最低。
stats: 发射钩爪额外作用范围：50%
发射钩爪额外眩晕时间：50%
照明火箭额外持续时间：35%

en.name: Power Cogs
en.desc:
Forms a ring of energized cogs around Clockwerk, trapping any units that are near. Enemies outside the trap that touch a cog are knocked back, losing health and mana. Once a cog has delivered a shock, it will power down. Damage is increased by 50% of the mana burned.

 Cogs can be destroyed by enemy attacks, but Clockwerk can push them up to 850 / 900 / 950 / 1000 distance away with one hit. Clockwerk can move through the cogs freely, disabling them as he passes over.
notes: Cogs can shock invisible units.

zh.name: 能量齿轮
zh.desc:
在发条技师周围形成一圈通电的齿轮，困住附近的单位。在外侧的敌人碰到齿轮会被电流震退，损失一定的生命和魔法。并且50%损失魔法也会加入到伤害。一个齿轮发动过一次震击后就会报废。

敌人攻击齿轮数次后可将其摧毁，而发条技师需要攻击一次会将齿轮推出850 / 900 / 950 / 1000距离。发条技师可以自由穿行齿轮，穿行时会使齿轮失效。
notes: 齿轮可以震退隐身单位。

en.name: Rocket Flare
en.desc: Fires a global range flare that explodes over a given area. Upon impact, enemies in the area take damage and are briefly slowed. Rocket flare provides vision over the impact area for 6 seconds.

zh.name: 照明火箭
zh.desc: 向全地图范围内的指定区域发射照明弹。击中时对区域内敌人造成伤害和短暂减速。照明火箭提供6秒击中区域的视野。

en.name: Dynamo
en.desc: Razor gains 1.25% spell amplification for every 20 points of attack damage.

zh.name: 雷电交加
zh.desc: 雷泽的攻击力每达到20点就会获得1.25%技能增强。

en.name: Eye of the Storm
en.desc: A powerful lightning storm strikes out at the enemy unit with the lowest health, dealing damage and reducing armor.
notes: Each blast targets the lowest health enemy unit within range.
Eye of the Storm will prioritize striking static linked heroes.
Successive casts of Eye of the Storm will stack.
en.scepter: Causes Eye of the Storm to strike two different units instead of one and can damage structures. When striking buildings, it will only target towers, barracks, and the Ancient.

zh.name: 风暴之眼
zh.desc: 强大的闪电风暴，打击生命值最低的敌方单位，造成伤害并削弱护甲。
notes: 每次打击都会以范围内血量最低的敌方单位为目标。
风暴之眼优先打击受到静电连接作用的英雄。
连续施放的风暴之眼可以叠加。
zh.scepter: 风暴之眼可以同时打击两个目标，并且能对建筑造成伤害。打击建筑时，只会以防御塔、兵营和遗迹作为目标。

en.name: Plasma Field
en.desc: Releases a wave of energetic plasma that grows in power as it expands, but also zaps on contraction, slowing and dealing damage to enemy units caught in its path. Damage and slow increases with distance from Razor. The Plasma Field hits each unit twice, once each direction.

zh.name: 等离子场
zh.desc: 释放一波威力随扩张程度提升的等离子能量场，收缩时也会对经过的敌人造成伤害和减速。距离雷泽越远，伤害和减速越高。等离子场对每个单位造成两次伤害。

en.name: Static Link
en.desc: Creates a charged link between Razor and an enemy Hero, stealing damage from the target and giving it to Razor. Allows Razor to attack while moving with the link active.
notes: The link is broken when either unit dies or the distance between them becomes 250 units greater than Static Link's cast range.
en.shard: Increases Cast Range. Slows Razor's target by %move_speed_factor%x the amount of damage stolen while the link is active.

zh.name: 静电连接
zh.desc: 在雷泽和敌方英雄之间创造静电连接，偷取目标的攻击力并转移给雷泽。雷泽在连接生效时可以边移动边攻击。
notes: 链接在一方单位死亡或双方距离超过250后断裂。
zh.shard: 提升施法距离。减缓目标的移动速度，数值为连接生效时%move_speed_factor%倍的攻击力窃取量。

en.name: Storm Surge
en.desc: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes: Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
en.shard: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is 2x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by 2s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

zh.name: 风暴涌动
zh.desc: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
notes: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
zh.shard: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为2倍，打击冷却时间减少2秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。

en.name: Unstable Current
en.desc: Passively increases Razor's movement speed.

zh.name: 不稳定电流
zh.desc: 被动提升雷泽的移动速度。

en.name: Cloak and Dagger
en.desc: Riki fades into the shadows, becoming invisible until he attacks. Hero kills and assists grant additional experience.

zh.name: 刀光谍影
zh.desc: 力丸遁入阴影，变为隐身状态，主动攻击敌人后力丸将会显形。击杀英雄和助攻会提供额外经验。

en.name: Blink Strike
en.desc: Teleports behind the target unit, momentarily slowing them by 100% and attacking them with bonus damage if it is an enemy.

zh.name: 闪烁突袭
zh.desc: 传送到目标背后，如果是敌人对其造成100%短暂减速，并发动一次拥有额外伤害的攻击。

en.name: Backstab
en.desc: Every time Riki strikes his enemy from behind, he deals additional bonus damage equal to a multiple of his Agility.
notes: Works when denying friendly units at 30% effectiveness.
Illusions of Riki will play Backstab animations, but not deal any bonus damage.

zh.name: 背刺
zh.desc: 力丸每次从背后攻击敌人时都会造成额外伤害，伤害量为自身敏捷的一定倍数。
notes: 反补友方单位时具有30%效果。
力丸的幻象也会有背刺的动作，但是不会造成额外伤害。

en.name: Smoke Screen
en.desc: Throws down a smoke bomb, silencing enemies and causing them to miss attacks.
notes: Can be cast during Tricks of the Trade.
Doesn't prevent the use of active items.
en.shard: Enemies caught in the smoke screen have their armor reduced by 5 and cannot be targeted by their allies.

zh.name: 烟幕
zh.desc: 丢下一个烟雾弹，沉默其中的敌人，同时使他们的攻击落空。
notes: 可以在绝杀秘技期间施放。
不能阻止使用物品。
zh.shard: 烟幕中的敌人护甲降低5点，而且无法成为他们友军的目标。

en.name: Tricks of the Trade
en.desc: CHANNELED - Riki phases out of the world and periodically strikes 2 random enemy units from behind in an area around him. He has fixed attack damage while phased out.
en.scepter: Increases Cast Range to 400. Allows you to target an allied unit, hiding inside them for the duration. While hiding in an allied unit, they have 15% bonus movement speed, and Tricks of the Trade lasts 1s longer and does an additional 2 attacks.

zh.name: 绝杀秘技
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 力丸转移出现实位面，每隔一段时间从背后随机攻击附近的2个随机敌方单位。期间他的攻击伤害为固定值。
zh.scepter: 提升施法距离至400。可以对友方单位施放，持续时间内藏在他们体内。藏在友方单位体内时，他会拥有15%移动速度加成，同时绝杀秘技的持续时间提升1秒，并且额外发动2次攻击。

en.name: Crystal Ball
en.desc:
Use: Clairvoyance
Scans a targeted 450 area with global range for 5 seconds. Indicates whether there are enemy heroes in that area for the duration. Reveals invisible units and wards in the scanned area, but does not provide vision. The reveal effect lingers for 1 second.

zh.name: 水晶球
zh.desc:
使用：千里眼
扫描全地图上450范围的目标区域，持续5秒。会显示持续时间内该区域是否存在敌方英雄。会在扫描区域内显示隐形单位和守卫，但是不会提供视野。显示效果会粘滞1秒。

en.name: Dark Carnival Barker
en.desc:
Ringmaster receives a random single-use Dark Carnival Souvenir whenever an enemy hero dies within 925 units of him. Additional Souvenirs are held as charges.

If Ringmaster does not have a Souvenir when he dies he will be granted one.

zh.name: 暗黑狂欢主持
zh.desc:
只要百戏大王附近925范围内有敌方英雄阵亡，他就会随机获得一件可用一次的暗黑狂欢纪念品。额外的纪念品会以能量的形式存下。

如果百戏大王没有纪念品，阵亡时会获得一件。

en.name: Souvenir Slot
en.desc: Gather souvenirs from kills and assists.

zh.name: 纪念品栏位
zh.desc: 击杀和助攻会收集纪念品。

en.name: Funhouse Mirror
en.desc:
Use: Proportion Distortion
Creates 1 imperfect image of your hero that lasts 18 seconds. Your illusion deals 100% and takes  300% damage.
notes: Has a 0.2 second cast time during which you are invulnerable.

zh.name: 哈哈镜
zh.desc:
使用：比例失真
制造英雄的1个不完美幻象，持续18秒。幻象继承100%攻击力，承受300%伤害。
notes: 有0.2秒的施法时间，其间处于无敌状态。

en.name: Impalement Arts
en.desc: Ringmaster throws one of his daggers to a precise point of his choosing. If he strikes an enemy, the dagger deals impact damage, briefly slows the unit hit, and causes them to bleed. The bleeding deals a percentage of the victim's maximum health in damage every second to heroes and flat damage per second to creeps.

zh.name: 尖刀戏
zh.desc: 百戏大王向自己精心选择的地点扔出一把匕首。匕首击中敌人会造成即时伤害，短暂减速击中的单位，并且使他们流血。流血的英雄受到基于目标最大生命值一定百分比的每秒伤害，流血的非英雄单位受到每秒固定伤害。
stats: 每秒最大生命值伤害（英雄）：3 / 4 / 5 / 6%

en.name: Spotlight
en.desc: Ringmaster shines 3 spotlights that sweep over an area. Enemies in the light have a chance to miss their attacks and are revealed if invisible. Illusions hit by the beam fade away, losing a percentage of their maximum health each second. These effects linger for 0.3 seconds after leaving the light.

zh.name: 聚光灯
zh.desc: 百戏大王用3束聚光灯照亮一片区域。灯光下的敌人有几率丢失攻击，隐身状态下也会显形。被光束击中的幻象会逐渐消散，每秒失去一定百分比的最大生命值。这些效果在灯束离开后会粘滞0.3秒。

en.name: Strongman Tonic
en.desc:
Use: Forcefully Imbibe
Temporarily increases an allied hero's Strength by 5 plus 1 per Ringmaster's level for 8 seconds. The effect holds for 4 seconds and then deteriorates over the duration.

zh.name: 强力水
zh.desc:
使用：强力吸收
暂时提升友方英雄的力量，数值为5 + 1 * 百戏大王等级，持续8秒。效果会维持4秒然后在持续时间内不断减弱。

en.name: Unicycle
en.desc:
Use: Saddle Up
Summons a speedy unicycle to ride around on for 10 seconds. 1.5s after mounting the unicycle, taking damage from enemy hero sources greater than 20 dismounts the rider. Crashing into trees destroys them and slows the unicycle. Attacking, using channeled abilities, or crashing into units and other obstacles also dismounts the rider.

zh.name: 独轮车
zh.desc:
使用：上车
召唤一辆快速的独轮车并骑上去，持续10秒。上车1.5秒后受到来自敌方英雄的伤害超过20点会让他下车。撞到树木会将其摧毁，并且独轮车会减速。攻击、使用持续施法类技能或者撞到单位和其他障碍物都会使他下车。

en.name: Tame the Beasts
en.desc: CHANNELED - Ringmaster twirls his whip for up to 1 second then cracks it. Whipped enemies are damaged and flee in fear from Ringmaster. Channel time exponentially increases damage and extends the fear duration, but reduces the radius.

zh.name: 驯兽术
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 百戏大王卷起他的鞭子，最多持续1秒，然后猛甩出去。被鞭打的敌人会受到伤害，并且被恐惧，逃离百戏大王。持续施法时间会使伤害和恐惧时间成倍增加，但是作用范围减少。

en.name: Crack
en.desc: *CRACK*

en.name: Escape Act
en.desc: Ringmaster packs himself or an allied hero into a mobile, extradimensional box. Boxed units gain phased movement, slow resistance, bonus magic resistance, and bonus movement speed. They are also untargetable, muted, silenced, and disarmed. The box will pop open after the effect expires or it moves out of the initial area.
en.scepter: Escape Act has 2 charges. When the box pops open, Impalement Art daggers are thrown in all directions, and all enemies around it take damage.

zh.name: 逃生技
zh.desc: 把一名友方英雄装进可动的异维度箱子。友军被装入后拥有相位移动状态，获得额外魔法抗性、减速抗性和移动速度。并且无法成为目标，被锁闭、沉默和缴械。效果结束后或者移动到初始区域之外箱子都会打开。
zh.scepter: 逃生技拥有2点能量点数。逃生箱打开时会朝所有方向放出尖刀戏匕首，并且范围内所有敌人受到伤害。

en.name: Weighted Pie
en.desc:
Use: Toss Pie
Knocks enemies back, slows them by 45% and reduces their vision to 50 recovering over 3 seconds, and prevents them from receiving vision from their allies for the duration. Instantly kills any non-ancient creep.

zh.name: 超重派
zh.desc:
使用：扔派
将敌人击退，减缓其45%移动速度并将其视野减少至50，移动速度和视野会在3秒内恢复，并且目标的友军在持续时间内对他提供视野。立刻秒杀任何非远古非英雄单位。

en.name: Wheel of Wonder
en.desc:
Ringmaster rolls the Wheel of Wonder to the targeted location, knocking aside enemies along the way. After it reaches its target, enemies in range of the wheel take damage over time and are slowed by -50%.

Enemy heroes who face the wheel for more than 0.5 seconds are mesmerized and drawn towards it. The first enemy to be mesmerized triggers a timer for the wheel to explode. If the timer is not triggered, it will automatically explode after 4 seconds.

zh.name: 奇观轮
zh.desc:
百戏大王推出奇观轮向目标地点滚去，击退沿途的敌人。到达目的地后，范围内的敌人会持续受到伤害，并且被减速-50%。

敌方英雄面对转轮超过0.5秒会被迷住，朝其走去。首个敌人着迷后会触发转轮爆炸的倒计时。如果没有触发倒计时，在4秒后转轮会自动爆炸。

en.name: Whoopee Cushion
en.desc:
Use: Whoopsie
Propels your hero forward 400 units. Leaves a 250 radius stink cloud behind for 3 seconds that slows enemies by -30%.

zh.name: 整蛊垫
zh.desc:
使用：噗
把英雄向前推动400距离。在身后留下一团250范围的臭云，持续3秒，使敌人减速-30%。

en.name: Bash
en.desc: Roshan has a chance to stun on attack.

zh.name: 重击
zh.desc: 肉山的攻击有一定概率造成眩晕。

en.name: Strength of the Immortal
en.desc: Roshan possesses numerous protective abilities, including 55% magic damage resistance, the ability to reduce damage from attacking illusions, and a scaling armor bonus that increases as time goes on.

zh.name: 不朽之力
zh.desc: 肉山拥有多个保护性技能，包括55%魔法抗性，攻击它的幻象造成的伤害较低，以及随着时间推移增加自身的护甲。

en.name: Throw
en.desc: Heroes that get in Roshan's way while he's moving between pits will be violently thrown away. Upon landing, heroes take damage and become stunned for 1 second. Deals additional damage for each throw he's done within one cycle of moving between pits.
notes: Heroes will be thrown away from Roshan based on their relative position to Roshan.
stats: TARGET HP DAMAGE GROWTH PER MINUTE: 0.5%

zh.name: 扔出
zh.desc: 肉山在巢穴之间移动时，会把挡路的英雄抓起再猛地扔出去。英雄落地后会受到伤害，并被眩晕1秒。巢穴之间移动的每个周期内，每次肉山扔出英雄后扔出伤害都会增加。
notes: 英雄被肉山扔出的方向取决于他们和他之间的相对位置。
stats: 每分钟提升目标生命值伤害：0.5%

en.name: Roar of Retribution
en.desc: When facing the team that last killed him, Roshan will release an angry roar, heard everywhere on the map, that damages everyone in a 600 AoE and disarms them for 2 seconds. Units that have been roared take 25% increased incoming damage.

zh.name: 复仇咆哮
zh.desc: 肉山在面对上次击杀他的队伍时，会发出一声愤怒的咆哮，全地图都可以听到，对600范围内所有单位造成伤害，并且缴械2秒。被咆哮作用的单位受到的伤害将提高2%。
stats: 伤害增加的负面状态持续时间：12

en.name: Slam
en.desc: Roshan slams the ground, damaging and slowing all nearby enemies. Slam's damage will increase every minute. Slam does 100% increased damage to creeps.

zh.name: 震击
zh.desc: 肉山猛击地面，对周围的敌人造成伤害和减速。震击的伤害每分钟都会提升。震击对非英雄单位造成的伤害增加100%。

en.name: Spell Block
en.desc: Roshan will block one targeted spell every 15 seconds. Also reduces status effects by 25%.

zh.name: 法术抵挡
zh.desc: 肉山每15秒会抵抗一次指向性法术。另外负面状态效果降低25%。

en.name: Arcane Supremacy
en.desc: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.

zh.name: 奥术至尊
zh.desc: 拉比克对奥术的熟稔使他拥有更远的施法距离，和额外技能增强。

en.name: Curiosity
en.desc:
Rubick gains 1 stack of Curiosity per level that grants him 1 base damage, 0.3% Buff/Debuff Duration, and 2 AOE Bonus. 

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within 1200 distance of him, he gains 2 Curiosity for 20 seconds.  If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last 3 seconds, he gains 1 Curiosity permanently.

zh.name: 奇心
zh.desc:
拉比克现在每级获得1层奇心的叠加效果，每层奇心提供1点基础攻击力，0.3%增益/减益持续时间，和2作用范围加成。

如果拉比克看到1200范围内有敌方英雄施放技能，他就会获得2层奇心，持续20秒。如果当前提供临时奇心的敌人在受到来自拉比克的伤害后3秒内阵亡，他就会永久获得1层奇心。

en.name: Stolen Spell
en.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

zh.name: 窃取的魔法
zh.desc: 本技能栏在使用魔法窃取获得魔法后可以使用。

en.name: Stolen Spell
en.desc: Spells acquired with Spell Steal will replace this slot.

zh.name: 窃取的魔法
zh.desc: 本技能栏在使用魔法窃取获得魔法后可以使用。

en.name: Fade Bolt
en.desc: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.

zh.name: 弱化能流
zh.desc: 拉比克制造一道强大的奥术能量流，在多个敌方单位之间流动，造成伤害并降低他们的攻击力和技能伤害。每次跳跃造成的伤害递减。

en.name: Might and Magus
en.desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

zh.name: 力量与魔法
zh.desc: Rubick gains stacking bonus area of effect when he casts a spell.

en.name: Spell Steal
en.desc: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
notes: Cannot steal item abilities.
Rubick will steal the Aghanim's Shard version of the ability, if he himself has an Aghanim's Shard.
Does not trigger spell reflect.
en.shard: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
en.scepter: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.

zh.name: 技能窃取
zh.desc: 拉比克钻研一个敌方英雄的魔法精华之痕，学习这个英雄最后释放的技能的秘密。拉比克将可以使用这个技能，维持几分钟或直到他死亡。
notes: 无法窃取物品类技能。
拉比克若拥有阿哈利姆魔晶，则窃取的技能会是魔晶升级版本。
不会触发法术反弹。
zh.shard: 窃取的技能升级为相应的魔晶版本。
zh.scepter: 可窃取的技能提升至2个。提升施法距离，并且窃取的技能会升级成神杖版本。
stats: 窃取的技能冷却时间减少：10 / 20 / 30%

en.name: Telekinesis
en.desc: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
notes: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
en.shard: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to 375 and throw delay is reduced to 0.5 seconds.

zh.name: 隔空取物
zh.desc: 拉比克利用他的隔空取物能力，将敌人短暂抬到空中，然后猛投向地面。被投下的单位会砸晕落地点附近的敌人。
notes: 目标滞空时，拉比克可以使用次级技能将目标扔往目标方向。
单位落地后，自身不会受到范围眩晕效果。
zh.shard: 可以对自身或友军施放隔空取物。投掷距离增加至375，投掷延迟降低至0.5秒。

en.name: Telekinesis Land
en.desc: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.

zh.name: 隔空取物着陆
zh.desc: 选择隔空取物结束时目标的落地点。

en.name: Telekinesis Land
en.desc: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

zh.name: 隔空取物着陆
zh.desc: 选择隔空取物结束时拉比克的落地点。

en.name: Burrowstrike
en.desc:
Sand King burrows into the ground and tunnels forward, damaging and stunning enemy units above him as he resurfaces. Adds Caustic Finale poison to heroes hit

 Can be put on alt-cast to immediately cast in the desired direction, without walking towards the targeted location.
notes: Does not trigger spell block or spell reflect.

zh.name: 掘地穿刺
zh.desc:
沙王钻入地面挖掘隧道前进，穿出地面时伤害并眩晕上方的敌方单位。对击中的英雄施加腐尸毒。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），直接朝指定方向立刻施放，不需要走向目标地点。
notes: 不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

en.name: Caustic Finale
en.desc: Sand King's attacks inject a venom that causes enemy units to violently explode when they die that does a flat amount of damage and an additional amount based on the dying units max health.

zh.name: 腐尸毒
zh.desc: 沙王的攻击对敌方单位注入毒液，使他们死亡时发生剧烈爆炸，造成固定数值的伤害加上基于阵亡单位最大生命值的额外伤害。

en.name: Epicenter
en.desc: After a cast point of 2 seconds, Sand King sends a disturbance into the earth, causing it to shudder violently. All enemies caught within range will take damage and become slowed. Each subsequent pulse increases the radius of damage dealt.
notes: The pulses are centered on Sand King, not where he first cast the spell.
en.shard: Every 3s causes a small single Epicenter Pulse around Sand King.
en.scepter: When the pulses start, 3 Stinger attack areas are created every 0.5s at random locations, each measuring 35% of the Epicenter's current radius, that apply 40% of Stinger damage to enemies hit. Shard pulses cause 1 attack(s).

zh.name: 地震
zh.desc: 经过2秒施法前摇后，沙王向地中发送扰动，引起大地剧烈震动。所有范围内的敌人会受到伤害并被减速。每次后续震波都会提高伤害传播半径。
notes: 地震波将以沙王为中心，而不是他施放技能的地点。
zh.shard: 每3秒会在沙王身上产生一个较小的地震波。
zh.scepter: 地震的脉冲开始时每0.5秒会在随机地点产生3片尾刺的攻击区域，每片区域为地震当前范围的35%，对击中的敌人造成40%尾刺伤害。魔晶的地震波会产生1次攻击。

en.name: Sand Storm
en.desc: Sand King creates a fearsome sandstorm that damages enemy units and grants Sand King Invisibility while he is in it. The effect ends when Sand King leaves the area.
notes: Sand Storm can be used to dodge projectiles.
Sand King briefly becomes visible upon attacking or using spells while in Sand Storm. Sand King will become invisible again in 0.7 seconds.

zh.name: 沙尘暴
zh.desc: 沙王制造一起可怕的沙尘暴，对敌方单位造成伤害，同时沙王身处其中时获得隐身效果。沙王离开该区域后效果结束。
notes: 沙尘暴可以用来躲避攻击和技能弹道。
沙王在沙尘暴中攻击或使用技能会暂时显形。0.7秒后将再次隐形。

en.name: Stinger
en.desc: Sand King strikes an area, performing an attack on all enemies in the area of effect, dealing extra damage to each. Enemies within an innermost radius of 125 take 40% extra damage. Applies Caustic Finale and a slow to all enemies hit.
en.shard: A Caustic Finale explosion that deals %caustic_damage_pct%% damage is created around every enemy hero hit in Stinger's innermost radius. Does not apply to strikes created by Aghanim's Scepter upgrade.

zh.name: 尾刺
zh.desc: 沙王袭击一片区域，对范围内所有敌人发动一次攻击，对每个敌人造成额外伤害。最中心125范围内敌人将受到40%额外伤害。对所有击中的敌人施加腐尸毒和减速效果。
zh.shard: 被尾刺的最中心范围击中的每个敌方英雄都会立刻产生一次腐尸毒的爆炸，造成%caustic_damage_pct%%伤害。阿哈利姆神杖升级产生的尾刺不会施加。

en.name: Shockwave
en.desc: The Satyr Tormenter tears open an unstable rift to the underworld, creating a shockwave that travels in a line along the ground, dealing damage to enemies it hits.

zh.name: 冲击波
zh.desc: 萨特苦难使者撕开一条通向地狱的不稳定裂缝，产生一道直线穿过地面的冲击波，对击中的敌人造成伤害。

en.name: Unholy Aura
en.desc: The Satyr Tormenter's demonic communion allows him to emanate regenerative power, increasing the health regeneration of himself and all nearby allies.

zh.name: 邪恶光环
zh.desc: 萨特苦难使者的恶魔之力让他散发出回复能量，提高他和附近友军的生命恢复能力。

en.name: Mana Burn
en.desc: The Satyr Mindstealer removes a fragment of his enemy's soul, burning away mana equal to 20 / 25 / 30 / 35 + 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5x the target's intelligence, and dealing damage equal to the amount of mana burned.

zh.name: 法力燃烧
zh.desc: 萨特窃神者偷走敌人灵魂的一块碎片，燃烧掉目标的魔法值并造成等量伤害，数值为20 / 25 / 30 / 35 + 1 / 1.5 / 2 / 2.5倍目标智力值。

en.name: Purge
en.desc:
The Satyr Banisher knows every trick in the book, allowing him to dispel debuffs from allies or buffs from enemies. His trickery also slows the enemy's movement.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel

zh.name: 净化
zh.desc:
萨特放逐者通晓所有的诡计，让他能驱散友军身上的负面效果或者敌人身上的增益效果。

驱散类型：弱驱散

en.name: Carnival Balloon
en.desc: Release a balloon

zh.name: 狂欢气球
zh.desc: 释放一个气球

en.name: Carnival Firework
en.desc: Shoot a firework into the air.

zh.name: 狂欢烟花
zh.desc: 将烟花射向半空。

en.name: Carnival Pie
en.desc: Throw a pie

zh.name: 狂欢馅饼
zh.desc: 扔出一个馅饼

en.name: Decorate Tree
en.desc: Give any tree a delightfully seasonal touch.

zh.name: 装饰树木
zh.desc: 给任意树木加上一丝欢快的节日气氛。

en.name: Festive Firework
en.desc: Shoot a firework into the air.

zh.name: 节日烟花
zh.desc: 将烟花射向半空。

en.name: Firecrackers
en.desc: Throw some firecrackers. Seriously, throw them!

zh.name: 鞭炮
zh.desc: 扔串鞭炮。真的，快扔！

en.name: Spirit of Frostivus
en.desc: CHANNELED. Steals an enemy hero's stack of Frostivus hats, or gives your stack to an allied hero.
en.scepter: Spirit of Frostivus becomes an Area of Effect ability, affecting units within a radius of 400 in the target area. Hats are taken from enemies first, then evenly distributed amongst allies.

zh.name: 迎霜精神
zh.desc: 持续施法。偷取一顶敌方英雄的迎霜节帽子，或者把自己的一顶帽子送给一名友方英雄。
zh.scepter: 迎霜精神变为范围型技能，影响目标区域400范围内的单位。会先拿走敌人的帽子，然后均分给友军。

en.name: Year of the Rat Balloon
en.desc: Inflate and send off an adorable, bouncy New Bloom balloon.

zh.name: 鼠年气球
zh.desc: 吹出一个可爱又有弹性的芳晓气球。

en.name: Tree Decorations
en.desc: Give any tree a delightful, seasonal touch.

zh.name: 树木装饰
zh.desc: 给任意树木加上一丝欢快的节日气氛。

en.name: Dancing Lion
en.desc: Summon a happy and energetic Lion to keep you and your allies company.

zh.name: 舞狮
zh.desc: 召唤一头快乐活泼的狮子，陪伴你和你的盟友。

en.name: Summon Penguin
en.desc: Summon a friendly penguin who slides around. Each time a hero bumps the penguin, it gains speed and lasts a bit longer.
notes: Your team's penguins will pass through enemy heroes that you don't have vision of.

zh.name: 召唤企鹅
zh.desc: 召唤一只友好的企鹅在周围滑行。每次企鹅被英雄碰到后都会加速，持续时间也会延长。
notes: 己方企鹅碰到视野外的敌方英雄时会直接穿过去。

en.name: Build Snowman
en.desc: Construct a jolly snowman.

zh.name: 堆雪人
zh.desc: 堆一个欢乐的雪人。

en.name: Throw Snowball
en.desc: Throw a snowball at an ally or enemy.

zh.name: 投掷雪球
zh.desc: 向一名友军或敌人投掷雪球。

en.name: Disco Ball
en.desc: The healing power of dance will not increase your HP regen. But that's not why we dance.

zh.name: 迪斯科球
zh.desc: 跳舞的治愈力不会提升你的生命恢复。不过那并不是我们跳舞的原因。

en.name: Guild Banner
en.desc: Plant your guild's banner to mark this battleground for you all!

zh.name: 公会旗帜
zh.desc: 插下你的公会旗帜，为大家标记这片战场！

en.name: High Five
en.desc: Throw your hand (or handy appendage) in the air!

zh.name: 击掌
zh.desc: 高举你的手（或手状附肢）！

en.name: Hot Pepper
en.desc: Toss a hot pepper to another hero--friend or foe. The pepper explodes after a random amount of time. Don't get caught holding it!

zh.name: 辣椒
zh.desc: 向另一名英雄——不论敌友扔出辣椒。辣椒在一段随机事件后爆炸。别在握着的时候被抓到！

en.name: Ditch that Hot Pepper!
en.desc: Get rid of that Hot Pepper before it explodes! Toss it to a friendly or enemy hero.

zh.name: 快丢了那根辣椒！
zh.desc: 在那根辣椒爆炸前丢了它！扔给友方或敌方英雄。

en.name: Summoning Portal
en.desc: Make no promises, tell no lies. Make lots of promises, kill anyone who calls you a liar.

zh.name: 召唤之门
zh.desc: 没有诺言，没有谎言。许下很多诺言，杀掉所有说你撒谎的。

en.name: Soccer Ball
en.desc: It doesn't matter what game we're playing. I slay.

zh.name: 足球
zh.desc: 我们在玩什么游戏不重要。我都是主宰全场。

en.name: Summon Balloon
en.desc: Channel to summon a seasonal balloon. The longer you channel, the larger the balloon.

zh.name: 召唤气球
zh.desc: 持续施法后召唤一个活动气球。持续施法越久，气球越大。

en.name: Blow Bubbles
en.desc: Toggle to blow bubbles.

zh.name: 吹泡泡
zh.desc: 切换后开始吹泡泡。

en.name: Conga Line
en.desc: Toggle to start or stop a Conga Line. Team members can join by right-clicking anyone in your line.

zh.name: 康加舞
zh.desc: 切换可开始或停止康加舞。队伍成员可以右键点击队形内任何人员来加入。

en.name: The Gauntlet
en.desc: Throw a gauntlet at an opposing hero to challenge them to a duel. If they accept, both players will be engaged in a battle to the death.

zh.name: 试炼
zh.desc: 向敌方英雄抛出试炼，挑战他们进行决斗。如果他们接受，双方将进入至死方休的战斗。

en.name: Demonic Cleanse
en.desc:
Cleanses the target allied unit, removing negative buffs for the duration.  At the end of the duration, the unit is healed. Units under the effect of Disruption can still be affected by Demonic Cleanse.

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
