If the illusion is alive when Vengeful Spirit respawn, she will take its place. XP earned by her illusion is given to her. Strong Illusions are not instantly killed by spells.

zh.name: 复仇光环
zh.desc: 复仇之魂的存在提升了附近友方英雄的攻击力。复仇之魂自身获得25%额外加成。
notes: 破坏会使攻击力光环失效。
zh.scepter:
提升自身加成系数。死亡时产生一个复仇之魂的强幻象，继承全额攻击力，可以施放自己的所有技能。

复仇之魂复活时若幻象依然存在，则自身会直接将其取代。幻象获得的经验将给予英雄。强幻象不会被相关技能秒杀。

en.name: Magic Missile
en.desc: Fires a magic missile at an enemy unit, stunning and dealing damage.
en.shard: Bounces once on an enemy, prioritizing heroes, within 75% of Magic Missile's current cast range from the first target.

zh.name: 魔法箭
zh.desc: 向一个敌方单位射出魔法箭，眩晕并造成伤害。
zh.shard: 可以对敌人弹射一次，以英雄优先，弹射距离为主目标的75%魔法箭施法距离内。

en.name: Nether Swap
en.desc: Instantaneously swaps positions with a target Hero, friend or enemy. Nether Swap interrupts channeling abilities on the target. Enemy Swapped units take damage. Vengeful Spirit and allied swapped units gain a barrier equal to the damage dealt.
notes: Works on Spell Immune units.
Trees near Vengeful Spirit and the target will be destroyed when the spell is cast.
Channeling spells are interrupted by Nether Swap.

zh.name: 移形换位
zh.desc: 与一个目标英雄瞬间交换位置，不论敌我。移形换位会打断目标的持续施法。敌方英雄被交换后受到伤害。复仇之魂和被交换的友方英雄都会获得等同于造成伤害的护盾。
notes: 对减益免疫单位有效。
技能施放后复仇之魂和目标附近的树木将会被摧毁。
移形换位能够打断持续施法。

en.name: Retribution
en.desc:
Vengeful Spirit is considered both a ranged and a melee attacker to gain the respective bonuses.

When killed by an enemy hero, Vengeful Spirit deals 20% bonus damage to her killer until their next death. Only one debuff can exist at a time.

zh.name: 恶有恶报
zh.desc:
复仇之魂的攻击同时被视为远程和近战，可以获得相应加成。

只要敌方英雄击杀了复仇之魂，他们会获得一个负面效果，直到下次阵亡，期间复仇之魂会对他们造成20%额外伤害。同一时间只能存在一个负面效果。

en.name: Soul Strike
en.desc: Vengeful Spirit's ranged attacks behave as if they were melee attacks.

zh.name: 灵魂打击
zh.desc: 复仇之魂的远程攻击具有近战攻击的行为。

en.name: Wave of Terror
en.desc: Vengeful Spirit lets loose a wicked cry, weakening the total attack damage and armor of enemies, and giving vision of the path ahead.

zh.name: 恐怖波动
zh.desc: 复仇之魂放出邪恶的嚎叫，削弱敌人的总攻击力和护甲，并打开前方经过路径的视野。

en.name: Noxious Plague
en.desc: Infects an enemy with a plague that does damage on application then slows the target and deals damage over time based on their maximum health. When the debuff ends for any reason, all debuffs from Venomancer on the initial target and the plague are spread to nearby targets. Additional spreads beyond the first do not deal impact damage.
notes: Spread debuffs have fixed duration and are not modified by status resistance or debuff amplification.
en.scepter: Decreases cooldown by 35 seconds. Infected units have decreased magic resistance. Additional spreads from hero targets deal full impact damage.

zh.name: 恶性瘟疫
zh.desc: 使一名敌人感染致命的瘟疫，施加时造成伤害，然后减速目标，并且基于目标的最大生命值造成持续伤害。不论负面状态以何种方式消失，瘟疫都会带着剧毒术士施加给初始目标的所有负面状态一起扩散到附近目标。第一次以外的额外扩散不会造成初始伤害。
notes: 扩散的负面状态拥有固定的持续时间，不会受到状态抗性和负面状态增强的影响。
zh.scepter: 冷却时间减少35秒。感染的单位拥有的魔法抗性会降低。来自英雄目标的额外扩散会造成全额的击中伤害。

en.name: Plague Ward
en.desc: Summons a plague ward to attack enemy units and structures. The ward is immune to magic. Wards gain the Poison Sting level from Venomancer, dealing 50% of the full damage.

zh.name: 瘟疫守卫
zh.desc: 召唤一个瘟疫守卫来攻击敌方单位和建筑。守卫对魔法免疫。守卫拥有毒刺攻击，效果与毒刺技能的当前等级相同，造成50%的原技能伤害。

en.name: Poison Nova
en.desc: Venomancer emits a spreading ring of poison that does nonlethal damage over time to enemy units. Damage done is a base amount plus a percentage of the target's max health.

zh.name: 剧毒新星
zh.desc: Venomancer emits a spreading ring of poison that does nonlethal damage over time to enemy units. Damage done is a base amount plus a percentage of the target's max health.

en.name: Poison Sting
en.desc: Venomancer's attacks slow enemies and deal damage over time.
notes: Poison Sting damage can be lethal.
Damage from Poison Sting does not interrupt healing from items, nor does it activate the cooldown on Blink Dagger.
en.shard: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

zh.name: 毒刺
zh.desc: 剧毒的攻击会持续减速敌人并造成伤害。
notes: 毒刺的伤害可以致死。
毒刺造成的持续性伤害不会打断物品的回复效果，也不能使闪烁匕首进行冷却状态。
zh.shard: Whenever Poison Sting is applied, it deals extra damage equal to %debuff_dmg%% of the attacker's base damage for every debuff the enemy has from Venomancer or a unit he controls.

en.name: Septic Shock
en.desc: Venomancer's attacks deal extra damage based on how many debuffs the attack target has. Extra damage is dealt as magical damage. Only counts debuffs from Venomancer or his Plague Wards.
notes: Break only disables the bonus damage for Venomancer's attacks.
en.shard: Plague Wards also deal Septic Shock damage based on their attack damage.
en.scepter: Increases base damage per debuff.

zh.name: 脓毒休克
zh.desc: 剧毒术士的攻击会根据目标身上拥有的负面效果数量造成额外伤害。额外伤害为魔法伤害。只会计算来自剧毒术士或他的瘟疫守卫的负面效果。
notes: 破坏只会使剧毒术士攻击的额外伤害失效。
zh.shard: 瘟疫守卫还会根据他们的攻击力造成脓毒休克的伤害。
zh.scepter: 提升每个负面状态提供的基础伤害。
stats: 每个负面效果基础伤害：8%

en.name: Snakebite
en.desc: Venomancer summons a Spawn of Aktok to sink its fangs into a target, dealing magic damage and applying a toxin that does damage every second. When the target attacks while infected, they take the initial damage again.

zh.name: 毒蛇撕咬
zh.desc: 剧毒术士召唤阿克特克的幼体，把它的毒牙刺入一个敌人，造成魔法伤害，并施加造成每秒伤害的剧毒。目标在感染时发动攻击，他就会再次受到初始伤害。

en.name: Venomous Gale
en.desc: Launches a ball of venom in a line, poisoning enemy units so that they take both initial damage and damage over time, as well as suffering slowed movement.  Venomous Gale deals damage every 3 seconds over its duration.
notes: Venomous Gale can be lethal.
Duration damage is dealt every 3 seconds.
Slow starts at -35 / -40 / -45 / -50%, and decreases as time passes.
en.shard: Increases cast range and projectile speed by 25%. When Venomous Gale impacts enemy heroes, 2 Plague Wards are created around them.

zh.name: 瘴气
zh.desc: 沿直线射出一个毒液球，碰到的敌人受到初始伤害和持续伤害，并受到减速效果影响。瘴气在持续时间内每3秒造成一次持续伤害。
notes: 瘴气可以致死。
技能持续时间内每3秒造成一次伤害。
初始减速效果为-35 / -40 / -45 / -50%，减速效果将逐渐降低。
zh.shard: 施法距离和弹道速度提升25%。瘴气只要击中每个敌方英雄就会在他们周围制造2个瘟疫守卫。

en.name: Corrosive Skin
en.desc: Viper exudes an infectious toxin that damages and slows the attack speed of any enemy that damages it in a 1200 radius. The acid exudate also increases Viper's resistance to magic.
notes: Stacks multiplicatively with other magic damage resistance sources.
Break prevents the application of Corrosive Skin. Does not disable Corrosive Skin application from Nosedive.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.
en.scepter: Corrosive Skin applies 4x the attack speed slow to enemies that are within 500 distance of Viper.  Viper's Corrosive Skin Magic Resistance and Damage per Second are gradually increased while he is in Nethertoxin, up to 50% increased effect after 4s.

zh.name: 腐蚀皮肤
zh.desc: 蝮蛇分泌出感染性的毒素，1200范围内任何伤害它的敌人都将受到伤害，同时攻击速度也被降低。这种酸性分泌物还能提高蝮蛇的魔法抗性。
notes: 与其他提升魔法抗性的物品和技能叠加。
破坏会使腐蚀皮肤不再施加效果。极恶俯冲还是会施加腐蚀皮肤。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。
zh.scepter: 腐蚀皮肤会对距离冥界亚龙500范围内的敌人施加4倍攻击速度降低效果。当冥界亚龙处于幽冥剧毒中，腐蚀皮肤的魔法抗性和每秒伤害会逐渐提升，在4秒后，达到最高的50%提升。

en.name: Nethertoxin
en.desc: Viper releases a Nethertoxin at the targeted area. Units in that area take an increasing damage over time based on how long they remain in it. Units in it have their attack speed slowed.
notes: Multiple Nethertoxins do not stack.

zh.name: 幽冥剧毒
zh.desc: 蝮蛇向目标区域释放幽冥剧毒。范围内的单位持续受到伤害，在区域内停留的时间越长，受到的伤害也越高。同时他们的攻击速度会被降低。
notes: 多个幽冥剧毒不会叠加。
stats: 最高每秒伤害所需时间：4

en.name: Nosedive
en.desc: Viper slams into the ground, releasing a Nethertoxin and splattering each enemy in a 500 AoE for 4 seconds with the effect of Corrosive Skin.

zh.name: 极恶俯冲
zh.desc: 冥界亚龙冲向地面，释放幽冥剧毒并且500范围内所有敌人均被溅上持续4秒的腐蚀皮肤酸液。

en.name: Poison Attack
en.desc: Intensifies Viper's venom, adding an effect to his normal attack that applies a stacking movement speed slow and magic resistance deduction while dealing damage over time. Stacks up to 6 times.
en.shard: Increases max stacks, and causes Poison Attack to lower armor per stack and to affect buildings for reduced damage.

zh.name: 毒性攻击
zh.desc: 蝮蛇的毒液得到强化，使他的普通攻击附带效果，可以降低目标的移动速度和魔法抗性，并持续造成伤害。效果可以叠加，最多叠加6次。
zh.shard: 提升最大叠加次数，毒性攻击可以降低护甲，并且可以作用于建筑，造成的伤害有所降低。

en.name: Predator
en.desc: Viper's attacks deal an additional instance of physical damage per missing health percentage of the target hero.

zh.name: 掠食
zh.desc: 冥界亚龙的攻击会根据目标英雄缺失的生命百分比额外造成一次物理伤害。

en.name: Viper Strike
en.desc: Viper slows the targeted enemy unit's movement and attack speed while also disabling their passives and dealing poison damage over time. The slowing effect reduces over the duration of the poison.

zh.name: 蝮蛇突袭
zh.desc: 蝮蛇降低敌方目标单位的移动和攻击速度，同时破坏其被动技能并造成持续毒素伤害。移动和攻击速度会在毒素的持续时间内逐渐恢复。

en.name: Grave Chill
en.desc: Visage drains the movement and attack speed of the targeted unit, gaining the drained speed for itself and nearby Familiars.
notes: The two buffs can be removed separately by dispels.
The speed gained is independent of the speed lost on the target.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will also receive bonuses from Grave Chill.

zh.name: 黄泉颤抖
zh.desc: 维萨吉吸取目标单位的移动和攻击速度，自身和附近的佣兽获得等量加成。
notes: 两个状态效果是分开驱散的。
速度加成和目标的速度减少相互独立。
维萨吉周围900内的佣兽也将获得黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

en.name: Gravekeeper's Cloak
en.desc:
Visage generates a layered barrier that protects him from damage.  If he receives damage from a player, one layer is removed, and takes time to recover.

Visage's Familiars are protected by his cloak when within 900 range of him, based on the number of layers Visage has.
notes: Each time Visage receives damage greater than the Minimum Damage that was not self-inflicted and was from a player owned source, a layer is removed.
Familiars within 900 range of Visage will receive the current damage reduction from Gravekeeper's Cloak.
Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
en.shard: Gains an active component, allowing Visage to use Stone Form, stunning enemies for 0.8 / 1.0 / 1.2 seconds in an 375 area around it, dealing 60 / 100 / 140 damage and becoming invulnerable for 6 seconds.  Restores up to 25% of your health.

zh.name: 陵卫斗篷
zh.desc:
维萨吉产生数层屏障来保护他，降低受到的伤害。每当他受到来自玩家的伤害，就会失去一层屏障，失去的屏障需要一定时间才能恢复。

维萨吉的佣兽在900范围内也会受到斗篷的保护，承伤降低的数值取决于维萨吉拥有的层数。
notes: 每次维萨吉受到来自其他玩家的伤害超过最小伤害时，保护层就会移除一层。
佣兽在维萨吉周围900范围内将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果。
破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
zh.shard: 获得主动效果，维萨吉可以化作石像形态，对身边375范围内的敌人造成0.8/1.0/1.2秒眩晕，同时造成60/100/140点伤害，获得6秒无敌状态。最多恢复25%生命值。

en.name: Lurker
en.desc:
Visage's ability cooldown durations are accelerated as long as he's not taking damage.

Grants a stack every 2s that Visage does not take damage. Each stack grants 2% cooldown acceleration with a max of 8 stacks. Stacks fade after 2s upon taking any damage.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.
Affects Visage's ability cooldown durations, including spells already on cooldown.

zh.name: 潜伏
zh.desc:
只要维萨吉没有受到伤害，他的技能冷却速度就会加快。

维萨吉每2秒没有受到伤害就会获得一层叠加效果。每层叠加效果提供2%冷却速度加快，最多为8层。叠加效果会在受到任意伤害2秒后消失。
notes: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。
影响维萨吉的技能冷却时间，包括正在冷却的技能。

en.name: Silent as the Grave
en.desc: Visage gains flying movement and bonus movement speed.  Upon attacking or casting, the speed and flying movement are lost and Visage and his familiars deal additional attack damage for 2s.
en.scepter: Increases movement speed, damage, and duration. Turns Visage and familiars invisible for the duration until the flying movement is lost.

zh.name: 静如古墓
zh.desc: 维萨吉获得飞行移动状态和移动速度加成。攻击或施法后，将失去移速加成和飞行移动状态，同时维萨吉和他的佣兽在2秒内拥有额外攻击力。
zh.scepter: 移动速度、额外攻击力和持续时间提升。维萨吉和佣兽在持续时间内为隐身状态，直到失去飞行移动状态。

en.name: Soul Assumption
en.desc: Visage gathers charges of soul essence each time nearby heroes take more than 100 damage. When the essence is released, it deals base damage as well as damage for each gathered soul charge.
notes: Charges are only gained for damage greater than 2 and less than 3000 that is dealt by a player or Roshan.  Self-damage or Soul Assumption damage isn't counted.

zh.name: 灵魂超度
zh.desc: 每次附近英雄（不论敌我）受到的伤害超过100点，维萨吉就能集聚灵魂精华的能量。将精华释放后，会对目标单位造成基础伤害，每一点集聚的能量还将造成额外伤害。
notes: 能量点数只计算来自玩家或肉山的伤害，必须大于2点小于3000点。自残型伤害和灵魂超度造成的伤害不计算在内。

en.name: Stone Form
en.desc:
Orders the Familiar closest to Visage to cast Stone Form in its current location, turning into stone and smashing into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form.

 Can be alt-cast to order the closest Familiar to the target location to move there and cast Stone Form.
notes: While Stone Form is not dispellable, the stun can be removed by strong dispels.

zh.name: 石像形态
zh.desc:
命令离维萨吉最近的佣兽在当前地点施放石像形态，化为石像并坠向地面，对范围的所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。此时佣兽无敌，并非常迅速地恢复生命值。6秒后佣兽自动解除石像形态。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），命令最近的佣兽移动至目标地点再施放石像形态。
notes: 尽管石像形态无法被驱散，但眩晕效果可以被强驱散移除。

en.name: Summon Familiars
en.desc:
Conjures 2 blind Familiars to fight for Visage.  Familiars possess the Stone Form ability, that allows them to turn into stone, stunning enemies upon landing.  While in Stone Form, Familiars are invulnerable, and rapidly regenerate their health.  Familiars grant high bounty when killed.

The ability can be cast in the alt-cast state to recall Visages familiars after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.
notes: Casting Summon Familiars will replace any existing Familiars.
Familiars within range of Visage will receive bonuses from Gravekeeper's Cloak and Grave Chill.

zh.name: 召唤佣兽
zh.desc:
召唤2只盲眼的佣兽为维萨吉作战。佣兽拥有石像形态技能，可以化为石像，在落地时使敌人眩晕。在石像形态中的佣兽无敌，并且迅速回复生命值。佣兽被击杀时给予高额奖励。

技能可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），在4秒后召回维萨吉的佣兽，在此期间佣兽无法攻击或行动。
notes: 施放召唤佣兽后已有的佣兽将会死亡。
佣兽在维萨吉周围时将获得当前陵卫斗篷的承伤降低效果和黄泉颤抖的加成效果。

en.name: Recall Familiar
en.desc: Recall this familiar to Visage after 4s, during which they cannot attack or act.

zh.name: 召回佣兽
zh.desc: 4秒后把佣兽召回到维萨吉身边，期间他们无法攻击或行动。

en.name: Stone Form
en.desc:
After a short delay, the Familiar turns into stone and smashes into the ground, stunning and damaging all targets in the area.  The Familiar becomes invulnerable, and will regain its health very rapidly.  After 6 seconds, the Familiar will automatically leave Stone Form. 

 Can be alt-cast to order the Familiar to move to the target location and cast Stone Form.

zh.name: 石像形态
zh.desc:
短暂延迟后，佣兽化为石像并坠向地面，对范围的所有敌人造成眩晕和伤害。此时佣兽无敌，并非常迅速地恢复生命值。6秒后佣兽自动解除石像形态。

可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），命令佣兽移动至目标地点再施放石像形态。

en.name: Aether Remnant
en.desc: Void Spirit dispatches a remnant to the target location. The remnant stands watch over the region, facing the direction of his vector. When a unit crosses its gaze, the remnant pulls it in and damages it.
en.shard: Creates an additional watcher path that rotates around the remnant.  The remnant now provides True Sight, and no longer triggers on creeps, instead dealing 50% damage to them every second in both paths. Does not reveal wards.

zh.name: 残阴
zh.desc: 虚无之灵向目标地点派出一个残像。残像观察着一片区域，面朝矢量的方向。当有目标进入其视线，残像会拉扯，并造成伤害。
zh.shard: 额外产生一道观察路径，会围绕残阴旋转。残阴现在会提供真实视域，不再对非英雄单位触发，而是每秒在两道路径上造成50%伤害。不会使守卫显形。

en.name: Astral Step
en.desc: Void Spirit tears a rift through the astral plane to appear at the target location, attacking all enemies along the path. This attack inflicts a void mark that slows for 1.25 seconds and then detonates.
notes: Astral Step attacks do not cleave.

zh.name: 太虚之径
zh.desc: 虚无之灵撕裂现实进入精神位面，再出现在目标地点，对沿途的所有敌人造成伤害。此次攻击将施加一个太虚印记，造成1.25秒减速，然后引爆。
notes: 太虚之径的攻击不会分裂。

en.name: Dissimilate
en.desc: Void Spirit temporarily fades into the aether, creating a number of portals through which he can reassemble himself. Upon exiting a portal, he damages all enemies in the area.

zh.name: 异化
zh.desc: 虚无之灵暂时遁入太虚，创造数个灵扉。穿过灵扉他能重组自身。穿出灵扉后，他对区域内所有敌人造成伤害。

en.name: Intrinsic Edge
en.desc: Void Spirit gains 15% more attack damage per point of each attribute, and 30% more HP regen from Strength, attack speed from Agility, and mana regen from Intelligence.

zh.name: 内在优势
zh.desc: 虚无之灵从每点属性获得的攻击力提升15%，并且从力量中获得的生命恢复、敏捷中获得的攻击速度和智力中获得的魔法恢复提升30%。

en.name: Resonant Pulse
en.desc: Void Spirit wraps himself in a protective shield that absorbs physical damage and emits a single damaging pulse around him. The shield gains increased damage absorption for each enemy hero the pulse hits.
en.scepter: Causes Resonant Pulse to silence and gain 2 charges.

zh.name: 共鸣脉冲
zh.desc: 虚无之灵将自己包裹在保护性护盾之中，可以吸收物理伤害，并围绕自身发出一次伤害性脉冲。脉冲每击中一名敌方英雄，护盾的伤害吸收量都会提升。
zh.scepter: 共鸣脉冲可以沉默敌人，并获得2点能量点数。
stats: 每击中一个英雄护盾数值：50 / 70 / 90 / 110

en.name: Symmetry
en.desc: Void Spirit gains a physical damage barrier when dealing magic damage to enemy heroes.

zh.name: 对称
zh.desc: 虚无之灵对敌方英雄造成魔法伤害时获得物理伤害护盾。

en.name: Black Grimoire
en.desc: Grants Warlock the item Black Grimoire, which can be consumed to gain experience for each kill Warlock participated in. Starts with 1 charge.

zh.name: 黑暗魔典
zh.desc: 术士获得物品黑暗魔典，消耗物品后可以根据术士参与的击杀来获得经验。初始拥有1点能量。
stats: 每次击杀/助攻提供经验：200

en.name: Eldritch Summoning
en.desc: Whenever an enemy unit dies while afflicted by one or more of Warlock's abilities, a minor imp is summoned that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes on death. Imps will automatically seek out nearby units, favoring fatally bonded heroes, and will explode when reaching their prey.
en.shard: Increases the health and explosion damage of minor imps.

zh.name: 邪术召唤
zh.desc: 只要敌方单位在受到一个或多个术士的技能作用下阵亡，就会召唤出一个魔童，持续15秒，死亡时会爆炸。魔童会自动搜寻附近单位，优先选择致命连接下的英雄，到达猎物时就会爆炸。
zh.shard: 提升小魔童的生命值和爆炸伤害。

en.name: Fatal Bonds
en.desc: Binds several visible enemy units together, causing a percentage of the damage dealt to one of them to be felt by the others.
notes: The shared damage type is the same as the type of damage inflicted.
Damage done by this ability is considered reflected damage. Reflected damage does not provide any lifesteal and cannot be reflected.

zh.name: 致命连接
zh.desc: 将数个可见的敌方单位连接在一起，其中一人所受伤害的一定百分比会被其他所有人感受到。
notes: 共享伤害的类型与原伤害相同。
这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

en.name: Flaming Fists
en.desc: Deals extra damage to nearby units when attacking.

zh.name: 烈焰之拳
zh.desc: 在攻击时对附近敌方单位造成额外伤害。

en.name: Permanent Immolation
en.desc: Burns the Golem's nearby enemy units, dealing damage per second.

zh.name: 永久献祭
zh.desc: 地狱火燃烧它周围的敌方单位，每秒造成伤害。

en.name: Eldritch Explosion
en.desc: Shortly after dying, a burst of magic damage is dealt to all enemies in a small area. Does 50% less damage to non-hero targets.

zh.name: 魔异爆炸
zh.desc: 阵亡后不久就会对小范围内所有敌人造成魔法爆发伤害。对非英雄目标造成的伤害减少50%。

en.name: Chaotic Offering
en.desc: Summons a Golem from the depths, stunning enemies for 0.8 seconds. The Golem lives 60 seconds, takes reduced damage from spells, has increased Slow Resistance, has Permanent Immolation and Flaming Fists on attack.
notes: This ability destroys trees in its area of effect.
en.scepter: Calls 2 Golems.

zh.name: 混乱之祭
zh.desc: 从深渊召唤一个地狱火，眩晕敌人0.8秒。地狱火持续60秒，能够减免部分技能的伤害，具有较高的减速抗性，拥有永久献祭和烈焰之拳技能。
notes: 该技能将摧毁作用范围内的树木。
zh.scepter: 召唤2个地狱火。

en.name: Shadow Word
en.desc: Warlock whispers an incantation, casting a spell on a unit that makes it deal damage to nearby enemy units and heal nearby ally units. Target Unit will also heal or be damaged depending on whether they are ally or enemy.
en.scepter: Increases Effect Radius. Shadow Word now applies to %additional_targets% additional units in a %cast_aoe% radius, prioritizing heroes. The healing and damage on the additional targets is reduced by %secondary_reduction%%.

zh.name: 暗言术
zh.desc: 术士低声说出一个咒语，对一个单位施展法术，使周围的敌方单位受到伤害，周围的友方单位被治疗。目标单位也会被治疗或受到伤害，取决于他是友军还是敌人。
zh.scepter: 提升作用范围。现在暗言术会施加给%cast_aoe%范围内%additional_targets%个额外单位，以英雄优先。额外单位的治疗和伤害量减少%secondary_reduction%%。

en.name: Upheaval
en.desc: CHANNELED - A powerful slowing and damaging current that grows stronger as it's channeled. Lasts up to 10 / 12 / 14 / 16 seconds. Enemies are slowed for 1 second after leaving the area or the spell ends.
notes: The slow increase is based on length of the channel, not the duration an enemy was standing in the area.
en.shard: While channeling, Warlock spawns a minor imp every 2 seconds that lasts for 15 seconds and explodes dealing damage to all enemies around them upon death.

zh.name: 剧变
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 随施法时间增强的减速气流，还会造成伤害。持续最多10 / 12 / 14 / 16秒。在魔法结束或目标离开生效区域后，敌人仍会被减速1秒。
notes: 减速效果的增加是根据持续施法的时长，而不是敌人在区内停留的持续时间。
zh.shard: 持续施法时每2秒术士会召唤一个魔童，持续15秒，魔童死亡时会爆炸，对周围所有敌人造成伤害。

en.name: Seed Shot
en.desc: Hucks a seed at a target, slowing and damaging it. The seed can bounce multiple times to nearby targets.

zh.name: 松果出击
zh.desc: 向目标扔出一颗松果，造成减速和伤害。松果可以向附近目标弹射多次。

en.name: Geminate Attack
en.desc: Allows Weaver to dispatch two attacks at once.
notes: Additional attacks leave Weaver 0.25 seconds after the previous one, and have no range limit.
Bonus damage only applies to the geminated attack and not the original attack.
en.shard: Geminate Attack will also hit units within 1200 range of the original target that have The Swarm beetles attached to them.

zh.name: 连击
zh.desc: 允许编织者立刻发动两次攻击。
notes: 第二次攻击将在编织者第一次攻击的0.25秒后发出，并且没有距离限制。
额外伤害仅对连击的攻击有效，初始攻击没有额外伤害。
zh.shard: 连击还会击中虫群附着目标1200范围内的单位。

en.name: Rewoven
en.desc: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains 6 experience.
notes: Break disables the gaining of new stacks.
Break does not disable the bonuses from existing stacks.

zh.name: 重新编织
zh.desc: Every time Weaver damages an enemy hero with an ability, he gains 6 experience.
notes: 破坏会使技能无法获得新的叠加效果。
破坏不会使现有叠加效果提供的加成失效。

en.name: Shukuchi
en.desc: Weaver shifts out of visibility, gaining max movement speed and doing harm to any enemies it passes through.
notes: Can only damage the same unit once per cast.
en.shard: Shukuchi puts a mark on enemies it damages that last 4.6 seconds. 0.2s after Weaver exits Shukuchi, enemies with a mark within 1200 range will also be attacked with a secondary Geminate attack

zh.name: 缩地
zh.desc: 编织者进入隐身身，达到移动速度上限，在穿过敌方单位时还将造成伤害。
notes: 每次施放的技能只能对相同单位造成一次伤害。
zh.shard: 缩地在造成伤害的敌人身上留下一个标记，持续4.6秒。编织者脱离缩地状态0.2秒后，附近1200范围内拥有印记的敌人都会被连击的第二次攻击击中。

en.name: The Swarm
en.desc: Weaver launches a swarm of 12 young Weavers that latch on any enemy unit in their path, attacking and reducing armor until it is killed.
notes: When a beetle latches on a target, it will remain there until it is killed or the duration expires.
Beetles are Spell Immune, but can be killed in 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 attacks from a unit. Heroes deal double damage to beetles.
Beetles provide vision.

zh.name: 虫群
zh.desc: 编织者放出12只编织者幼虫，每只幼虫都会紧紧缠住它遇到的敌人，攻击敌人并削弱他们的护甲，直到幼虫被杀死。
notes: 甲虫抓住目标后将一直留在目标身上，除非甲虫被击杀或持续时间结束。
甲虫免疫技能，需要一个单位的6 / 7 / 8 / 9次攻击才能被击杀。英雄造成双倍伤害。
幼虫提供视野。

en.name: Threads of Fate
en.desc: Whenever Weaver deals damage to an enemy hero with an attack or ability, if he remains within 700 range of them for 1.5s, he establishes a Thread of Fate that briefly slows the enemy and ties Weaver and the enemy together. Each established thread of fate grants bonus damage to Weaver.

zh.name: 命运之线
zh.desc: 每当编织者的攻击或技能对敌方英雄造成伤害后，如果编织者在他们700范围内停留达到1.5秒，他就会织出命运之线，短暂减速敌人并把他们与编织者相连。每织出一条命运之线就会使编织者获得攻击力加成。

en.name: Time Lapse
en.desc:
Weaver warps backward to whatever position it was in five seconds earlier--regaining the HP and mana from that time. No effect on cooldown, gold or experience.

DISPEL TYPE: Strong Dispel
notes: Removes most negative buffs from Weaver.
Time Lapse disjoints projectiles.
en.scepter: Time Lapse may target allied Heroes with 500 cast range.

zh.name: 时光倒流
zh.desc:
编织者回到五秒前的时间点，获得当时的生命值和魔法值。不影响冷却时间、金钱和经验。

驱散类型：强驱散
notes: 能够移除编织者身上大部分的负面状态。
时光倒流可以躲避攻击和技能弹道。
zh.scepter: 时光倒流可以对500施法距离内的友方英雄施放。

en.name: Easy Breezy
en.desc: Windranger's movement speed cannot be lower than 240 and can reach 600.

zh.name: 举步生风
zh.desc: 风行者的移动速度不会低于240，而且可以达到600。

en.name: Focus Fire
en.desc: Windranger channels the wind to gain 350 / 425 / 500 additional attack speed against a single enemy unit or structure, though with a reduction to her attack damage.  Extra damage from secondary item effects is not reduced.
notes: Issuing a Hold Position command will pause Windranger's attacks.
Windranger can move while attacking.

zh.name: 集中火力
zh.desc: 风行者受风的引领，攻击敌方单位或建筑的攻击速度增加350 / 425 / 500，但是攻击力降低。不过次级物品效果的额外伤害不会降低。
notes: 下达停在原地的指令会暂停风行者的攻击。
风行者在攻击时可以移动。

en.name: Focus Fire Cancel
en.desc: End your Focus Fire early.

zh.name: 集中火力取消
zh.desc: 提前结束集中火力。

en.name: Gale Force
en.desc: Vector Targeted. Summons a strong wind that pushes all enemies in the target area towards the target direction.

zh.name: 狂风之力
zh.desc: 以矢量为目标。召唤出一阵强风，将目标区域内所有敌人朝目标方向推去。

en.name: Powershot
en.desc: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to 1 second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes: Powershot will destroy trees in its area of effect.

zh.name: 强力击
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力1秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
notes: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

en.name: Shackleshot
en.desc: Shackles the target to an enemy unit or tree in a line directly behind it.  If no unit or tree is present, the stun duration is reduced to 0.6.
notes: This spell can shackle two enemies together, stunning them both.
Can shackle the target to an enemy unit or tree at most 575 behind the target.
Shackleshot can be disjointed.

zh.name: 束缚击
zh.desc: 将目标束缚在正对其后的一个敌方单位或树上。若目标后面没有其它敌方单位或树木，则眩晕时间减少至0.6秒。
notes: 该技能可以将两个敌人一起束缚，使他们同时眩晕。
束缚击能将目标束缚在身后最多575距离的敌方单位或树木。
束缚击可以被躲避。

en.name: Tailwind
en.desc:
Using an ability conjures a stacking Tailwind that gives Windranger a brief burst of movement speed. Movement speed bonus gradually starts fading halfway through the Tailwind duration.

Passively increases Windranger's max movement speed.
en.scepter: Attacks grant Tailwind. Tailwind lasts longer and is undispellable.

zh.name: 一路顺风
zh.desc:
施放技能会召唤一阵顺风，向风行者提供短时间的移动速度爆发。移动速度加成在顺风持续时间的半途开始逐渐衰减。

被动提升风行者的移动速度上限。
zh.scepter: 攻击也会提供顺风效果。顺风的持续时间更长，并且不可驱散。
stats: 每层叠加移动速度加成：35%

en.name: Windrun
en.desc: Increases movement speed and adds evasion from all physical attacks.

zh.name: 风行
zh.desc: 提升移动速度，并闪避一切物理攻击。

en.name: Eldwurm Studies
en.desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

zh.name: Eldwurm Studies
zh.desc: Winter Wyvern can skill this ability to reduce all ability and talent level requirements by 1. On the next level up, Winter Wyvern will receive an additional ability point for every level that was put into Eldwurm Studies since the last level up.

en.name: Arctic Burn
en.desc: Winter Wyvern soars upon an arctic wind, granting her unobstructed movement and allowing her to exhale a blistering chill into each attack. While soaring, her attacks travel further and faster, and slow enemies with a magical freeze that strips them of 4 / 6 / 8 / 10% of their current health each second.
notes: This ability does not affect Roshan.
Reduces Winter Wyvern's attack point to 0.1.
The damage and slow from Arctic Burn can be dispelled.
en.scepter: Causes Arctic Burn to be a toggle ability, draining mana every second when active. Increases Winter Wyvern's movement speed.

zh.name: 严寒烧灼
zh.desc: 寒冬飞龙乘着一股极地寒风扶摇而上，移动将无视地形，每次攻击都将呼出逼人的寒气。高飞时，她的攻击距离更远，攻击弹道速度也更快，被攻击的敌人在寒意作用下，移动速度会被减缓，同时每秒损失4 / 6 / 8 / 10%当前生命值。
notes: 本技能无法作用于肉山。
寒冬飞龙的攻击前摇降低至0.1秒。
严寒烧灼的持续伤害和减速可以被驱散。
zh.scepter: 严寒烧灼变成开关型技能，开启后每秒消耗一定量魔法。提升寒冬飞龙的移动速度。

en.name: Cold Embrace
en.desc: Encases an ally in an icy cocoon, freezing them solid while healing a base amount as well as a percentage of their maximum health each second. The cocoon blocks all physical damage.
en.shard: Reduces cooldown by 4 seconds. Allied units gain bonus attack damage when emerging from the icy cocoon.

zh.name: 极寒之拥
zh.desc: 将队友封入一个冰茧中，使其被冻在原地并恢复生命值，恢复数值为基础数值加上最大生命值的一定比例。冰茧将阻隔一切物理伤害。
zh.shard: 冷却时间减少4秒。友方单位从冰茧解冻后获得额外攻击力。

en.name: Dragon Sight
en.desc: Winter Wyvern gains bonus damage when her attack range is over 400.

zh.name: 飞龙视野
zh.desc: 寒冬飞龙的攻击距离超过了400后获得攻击力加成。

en.name: Eldwurm Scholar
en.desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within 1200 of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to 25% of the ultimate's manacost.

zh.name: 古龙学者
zh.desc: When an enemy hero casts an Ultimate ability within 1200 of Winter Wyvern, she receives experience equal to 25% of the ultimate's manacost.

en.name: Eldwurm's Edda
en.desc: Grants Winter Wyvern the item Eldwurm's Edda, which can be consumed to increase the current and maximum level of a basic ability by one and Winter Wyvern's base intelligence by 25% of its current value at the time of consumption.

zh.name: 古龙诗集
zh.desc: 寒冬飞龙获得物品“古龙诗集”，可以消耗，使一个基础技能的当前和最高等级均提升一级，另外寒冬飞龙的基础智力提升，数值为消耗时相应数值的25%。

en.name: Essence of the Blueheart
en.desc: Winter Wyvern's heals also restore mana.

zh.name: 蓝心精华
zh.desc: 寒冬飞龙的治疗也会回复魔法。

en.name: Splinter Blast
en.desc: Launches a ball of brittle ice toward a unit. The ice shatters on impact, leaving the primary target completely unaffected, while hurling damaging splinters into nearby enemies in a 500 base radius. Enemies struck by these splinters are slowed by 27 / 30 / 33 / 36%.
notes: The primary projectile moves at 1200 movement speed.
The primary projectile cannot be disjointed and cannot be targeted towards Winter Wyvern herself.

zh.name: 碎裂冲击
zh.desc: 向一个单位发射一团易碎的冰球。冰球一击中目标就会碎裂，而目标单位将不会受到任何效果，但是附近500基础范围内敌人都将因碎片的冲击受到伤害，并且移动速度减缓27 / 30 / 33 / 36%。
notes: 主弹道的移动速度为1200。
主弹道无法被躲避，而且不能以寒冬飞龙自身为目标。

en.name: Winter's Curse
en.desc: Winter Wyvern dispells then freezes an enemy in place while striking those nearby with a maddening curse which causes them to attack their frozen ally with increased attack speed. The frozen ally and those cursed to attack their ally are immune to all damage from their enemies with the exception of damage from Winter Wyvern or her controlled units. Enemy heroes which enter the cursed area after the cast add to the duration of the curse.
notes: If the target dies to its allies, Winter Wyvern will receive credit for the kill.
Will only pierce the spell immunity of the primary target, not the target's surrounding allies.

zh.name: 寒冬诅咒
zh.desc: 寒冬飞龙驱散一个敌方目标并将其冻在原地，附近的其他敌人将受到癫狂诅咒，对冻住的队友进行攻击，而且攻击速度得到提升。冻住的目标和被诅咒攻击队友的敌人不会受到任何来自敌方的伤害，不过寒冬飞龙或她控制的单位造成的伤害除外。敌方英雄进入施放后的诅咒范围内会增加诅咒的持续时间。
notes: 如果目标被其队友击杀，击杀者将仍是寒冰飞龙。
无视主目标的减益免疫状态，但是对目标周围的减益免疫队友无效。
stats: 每个英雄的额外持续时间：1.5
每个非英雄的额外持续时间：0.5

en.name: Equilibrium
en.desc: Io gains outgoing damage amplification the closer it is to full health, and Health Restoration and Healing Amplification the closer it is to zero health.

zh.name: 衡势
zh.desc: 艾欧获得伤害输出增强，血量越高，数值越高。同时，艾欧还获得生命回复和治疗增强，血量越低，数值越高。

en.name: Wellspring
en.desc: Io regenerates from consumables and the fountain 2x faster.
notes: Total amount of restored health or mana remains the same.
Only applies to Healing Salve, Tango, Clarity, Bottle, Urn of Shadows, Spirit Vessel, Mana Draught, and Pollywog Charm.

zh.name: 源泉
zh.desc: 消耗品和泉水的恢复速度在艾欧身上为2倍。
notes: 生命和魔法的回复总量不变。
只会对治疗药膏、树之祭祀、净化药水、魔瓶、影之灵龛、魂之灵瓮、魔力药水和蝌蚪护符生效。

en.name: Overcharge
en.desc: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health. If Io is Tethered to an ally, that unit also gains any bonuses granted by Overcharge.

zh.name: 过载
zh.desc: 艾欧获得攻击速度、技能增强和基于最大生命值的生命恢复。如果艾欧和一个友军连接，该单位也会获得过载提供的所有增益效果。

en.name: Relocate
en.desc: Teleports Io and a tethered ally to any location. After the spell expires, Io and the tethered ally will return to their original location. Double-click to teleport to your team's base fountain.
notes: Enemies receive a visual indicator in the world and on the minimap of the target location during the cast delay.
If Io is disabled during the cast delay, Relocate is cancelled.
If an allied hero is Tethered, that hero will teleport along with you. You can break the tether at any time to prevent that hero from teleporting with you.
Only heroes, creep heroes, and illusions can be relocated.

zh.name: 降临
zh.desc: 将艾欧和与其连接的友军传送到地图上任何位置。持续时间结束后艾欧和相连的友军会被传送回原位。双击将传送回己方的泉水。
notes: 敌人在施法延迟期间会在大地图和小地图上目标区域都收到视觉特效提示。
如果艾欧在施法延迟期间被控制，降临将会取消。
如果羁绊连接了友方英雄，该英雄将和你一起被传送。你可以随时断开连接，防止英雄和你一同传送。
只有英雄、类英雄单位和幻象可以降临。

en.name: Spirits
en.desc: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io. If a particle collides with an enemy hero, it explodes, damaging all enemy units in an area around it.  Creeps take minor damage from touching a particle spirit, but do not cause them to explode.  When its duration ends, any remaining Spirits explode.
notes: After summoning, Io can call the spirits in and out.
en.scepter: Spirits now passively spawn around Io constantly every second up to the max. Spirits colliding with enemy Heroes slows them briefly. Can be activated to explode spirits.

zh.name: 幽魂
zh.desc: 召唤五个围绕艾欧起舞的幽魂，对所有碰触到的单位造成伤害。如果碰到的是敌方英雄，幽魂会爆炸，对其附近的所有敌人造成伤害。普通单位碰到幽魂会受到轻微伤害，但是不会使其爆炸。持续时间结束后，幽魂将自动爆炸。
notes: 召唤后艾欧可以拉近或拉远幽魂。
zh.scepter: 每秒被动产生幽魂围绕艾欧，直至数量上限。幽魂撞到英雄会将其短暂减速。可以主动施放来引爆幽魂。

en.name: Spirits In
en.desc: Sends the spirits closer to you. Can be toggled on and off.

zh.name: 拉近幽魂
zh.desc: 让幽魂靠近你。可以切换开关状态。

en.name: Spirits Out
en.desc: Sends the spirits farther away from you. Can be toggled on and off.

zh.name: 拉远幽魂
zh.desc: 让幽魂远离你。可以切换开关状态。

en.name: Tether
en.desc: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both. When Io restores health or mana, the tethered unit gains a portion of that amount. The tether breaks when the allied unit moves too far away, or Io cancels the tether. Tether slows enemies touching it.
notes: If you try to tether a unit that is 700 distance or further away from Io, Io will latch on and pull itself closer to the tethered unit (to a distance of 300).
The tethered unit will heal faster and will heal even if Io is at full health.
Io's movement speed matches the tethered unit's.
en.shard: Tether damages enemies touching it. Io is healed for 50% of the damage done.

zh.name: 羁绊
zh.desc: 将艾欧和一个友方单位连接在一起，提高双方的移动速度。当艾欧回复生命或魔法时，连在一起的友军将获得一部分回复效果。距离过远时连接将会断开，也可以主动断开连接。羁绊会减速触碰到的敌人。
notes: 如果羁绊的目标距离艾欧700码以外，艾欧将链接目标并将自己向目标牵引（牵引后相距300码）。
被羁绊连接的单位回复速度相比更快，艾欧满血时也能回复。
艾欧的移动速度与羁绊目标一致。
zh.shard: 羁绊会对触碰到的敌人造成伤害。艾欧会回复50%造成伤害。
stats: 对敌移动/攻击速度降低：15 / 30 / 45 / 60%

en.name: Break Tether
en.desc: Break the link to the tethered unit.

zh.name: 断开连接
zh.desc: 断开连接。

en.name: Death Ward
en.desc: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of 8 seconds. Death Ward has 50% bonus accuracy.
notes: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
en.scepter: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.

zh.name: 死亡守卫
zh.desc: 持续施法 - 召唤一个死亡守卫，会优先攻击其攻击距离内的敌方英雄。最多持续8秒。死亡守卫拥有50%额外必中率。
notes: 死亡守卫是无敌的，只有在巫医被打断或持续时间结束后才会被摧毁。
死亡守卫可以受到控制，选择攻击特定目标。
死亡守卫每0.22秒攻击一次。
zh.scepter: 死亡守卫的攻击会向附近英雄弹射。

en.name: Gris-Gris
en.desc:
Witch Doctor gets a Gris-Gris, an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. When the owner dies, 100% of the gold lost from death is added to the item, and will be refunded when the item is consumed. The value of the Gris-Gris is increased by 1 every 3s. 

 Right-click to consume and permanently remove the item.

zh.name: 驱邪护符
zh.desc:
巫医获得了驱邪护符，这件物品无法丢弃或放在背包里。拥有者阵亡时，死亡损失金钱的100%会加入到该物品中，物品被消耗后将退回这些金钱。驱邪护符的价值每3秒会增加1金。

右键点击可以消耗这件物品，并将其永久移除。

en.name: Maledict
en.desc: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled targets in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
notes: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

zh.name: 巫蛊咒术
zh.desc: 对一个较小区域内所有敌方英雄和玩家控制的目标施放诅咒，他们将每秒受到固定伤害，并且从诅咒开始每4秒根据失去的血量再受到爆发伤害。
notes: 受到作用的英雄如果在结算时当前血量高于原血量，则额外伤害为0。

en.name: Paralyzing Cask
en.desc: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
notes: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

zh.name: 麻痹药剂
zh.desc: 抛出一个装满麻痹粉末的药剂，在敌方单位之间弹跳，眩晕击中的敌人并造成伤害。每次弹跳都会提升伤害。
notes: 目标可以受到多次作用，只要附近有其他单位可以进行弹跳。

en.name: Voodoo Restoration
en.desc: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
notes: Healing is done in 0.33 second intervals.
Can heal Spell Immune units.

zh.name: 巫毒疗法
zh.desc: 巫医集中魔力治疗附近的友军单位，开启巫毒疗法后会持续消耗巫医的魔法。
notes: 治疗间隔为0.33秒。
对减益免疫单位有效。

en.name: Voodoo Switcheroo
en.desc: Turns Witch Doctor into a Death Ward briefly with reduced attack speed. He is hidden during this time.

zh.name: 巫毒变身术
zh.desc: 巫医暂时变成死亡守卫，死亡守卫的攻击速度有所降低。这段时间内自己为隐藏状态。

en.name: Arc Lightning
en.desc: Hurls a bolt of lightning that leaps through nearby enemy units that deal damage.

zh.name: 弧形闪电
zh.desc: 释放一道会跳跃穿越附近敌人的闪电，并造成伤害。

en.name: Nimbus
en.desc: Creates a storm cloud anywhere on the map that automatically casts Lightning Bolt on nearby enemies.
notes: Grants 125 gold if destroyed by an enemy hero.
Affects the closest enemy unit with strikes from Zeus's current level of Lightning Bolt.
Towers and creeps do half damage to the Nimbus.

zh.name: 雷云
zh.desc: 在地图任意地点创造一朵雷云，雷云将自动对附近敌人施放雷击。
notes: 敌方英雄将其摧毁后可以获得125金。
以宙斯当前等级的雷击作用于最近的敌方单位。
防御塔和非英雄单位对雷云造成半额伤害。

en.name: Heavenly Jump
en.desc: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets 900 unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

zh.name: 神圣一跳
zh.desc: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近900范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。

en.name: Lightning Bolt
en.desc: Calls down a bolt of lightning to strike an enemy unit, causing damage and a mini-stun. When cast, Lightning Bolt briefly provides unobstructed vision and True Sight around the target in a 600 radius. Can be cast on the ground, affecting the closest enemy hero in 325 range.
notes: You can interrupt channeling spells and items with this ability.

zh.name: 雷击
zh.desc: 召唤一道闪电打击一个敌方单位，造成伤害及短暂眩晕。施放后，雷击在目标周围600范围内提供空中视野和真实视域。本技能可以对地施放，将会自动作用于325范围内最近的敌方英雄上。
notes: 该技能可以打断持续施法类技能和物品。

en.name: Lightning Hands
en.desc: Zeus gains bonus attack speed and his attacks create Arc Lightnings that deal a percentage of its damage. Can be toggled off to stop this effect.

zh.name: 霹雳之手
zh.desc: 宙斯获得攻击速度加成，并且他的攻击会产生弧形闪电，造成一定百分比的伤害。可以关闭，使攻击不附带该效果。

en.name: Static Field
en.desc: Zeus shocks any enemy that he attacks or is hit by his abilities, causing damage equal to a percentage of their current health.

zh.name: 静电场
zh.desc: 宙斯攻击或通过技能击中敌人都会电击他们，造成他们当前生命值一定百分比的伤害。

en.name: Thundergod's Wrath
en.desc: Strikes all enemy heroes with a bolt of lightning, dealing damage no matter where they may be. Provides True Sight around each hero before they are struck.

zh.name: 雷神之怒
zh.desc: 用闪电打击所有敌方英雄，对他们造成伤害，无论他们身在何处。在打击前提供每个英雄的真实视域。
